jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Join our innovative team as an AI Engineer and be at the forefront of developing cutting\-edge artificial intelligence solutions that transform data into actionable insights. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in machine learning, statistical analysis, and big data systems to design, implement, and optimize AI models that drive strategic decision\-making. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where creativity meets technical excellence, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact. **Position Summary** The AI Engineer turns artificial intelligence concepts into production\-ready systems. They combine soft\-ware engineering, machine learning, data engineering, and product knowledge to build dependable AI applications. The AI Engineer reports to the Head of Information Technology \& Data. **Purpose** The AI Engineer designs, builds, tests, and deploys AI and machine\-learning systems. **Position Responsibilities** * *Build, Monitor \& Optimize*\- Use generative capabilities within a broader system that plans steps, makes decisions, executes actions autonomously, and adapts. Create test suites, datasets, and release criteria to ensure reliability and safety. Track performance, troubleshoot issues, and improve speed, accuracy, and scalability. * *Design AI systems*\- Develop algorithms, models, and AI\-powered applications focused on the underwriting process, and business insights. * *Data Pipeline Development*\- Collect, clean, and process large datasets for training and inference. * *Deploy \& integrate models*\- Implement models into production software, APIs, and cloud environments (Azure) * *Stay current on AI advancements\-* Keep up with emerging models, generative AI, and tooling. * Perform other related duties as requested, required, and/or as assigned in support of organizational goals. **Education, Training, and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, information technology, engineering, or related discipline preferred Prior experience in insurance, financial services, or risk management environments strongly preferred * Experience creating AI skills, AI agents, Multiagentic agents, and/or LLM using RAG architecture ; * or * Equivalent combination of education and demonstrated experience. **Skills and Knowledge** * Programming skills (Python, Java, or similar) * Understanding of LLMs, generative AI, and retrieval\-augmented systems * Cloud computing experience (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Strong communication and collaboration skills. * Ability to work on a dynamic, Entrepreneurial team that has concurrent projects Experience with Fabric is a plus. * Understanding of insurance concepts such as loss ratios, underwriting performance, claim patterns, and risk segmentation is beneficial. **Competencies and Personal Characteristics** * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills. * Ability to translate technical findings into practical business recommendations. * Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset. * Ability to work collaboratively across departments. * High attention to detail and commitment to data integrity. * Performs effectively when changes in priorities, direction and resources occur. * Ability to perform duties under in a fast\-paced, high volume, office environment. * Capacity to deal calmly and effectively with problems and unknown situations. * Works with integrity and ethically. Upholds and supports the company’s goals and values. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to maintain cloud infrastructure, support application deployments, and help keep business systems reliable and secure. You'll work with cloud resources, networking, automation, and monitoring tools to resolve technical issues and improve day\-to\-day operations. The role involves both planned infrastructure work and troubleshooting when something goes wrong. You should be comfortable investigating problems, documenting changes, and working with other technical teams to find practical solutions. We're interested in someone who understands how cloud services fit together and takes care when making changes that could affect live systems. **What You'll Be Responsible For** * Configure, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure based on application and business requirements. * Manage cloud resources such as virtual machines, storage, networking, and access permissions. * Monitor system availability, resource usage, and performance to identify potential problems. * Investigate infrastructure failures, service interruptions, and application deployment issues. * Support the deployment and maintenance of applications hosted in cloud environments. * Review cloud configurations and access controls to identify security risks and areas for improvement. * Use scripts and automation to reduce repetitive infrastructure tasks. * Assist with backup procedures, recovery planning, and routine infrastructure maintenance. * Work with developers and IT colleagues to resolve networking, configuration, and deployment problems. * Review resource consumption and identify opportunities to manage cloud costs. * Maintain accurate documentation of infrastructure configurations, operational procedures, and system changes. * Follow established change\-management procedures and communicate risks before making changes to production environments. **What You'll Bring** We are looking for someone with a practical understanding of cloud infrastructure and a methodical approach to technical problem\-solving. You should have: * Experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * An understanding of virtual machines, cloud storage, networking, and identity and access management. * Familiarity with Linux or Windows server environments. * Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting. * Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell. * An understanding of system monitoring, troubleshooting, and infrastructure security. * The ability to investigate technical issues and document the steps taken to resolve them. * Good organisation and attention to detail when managing configurations and system changes. * Clear communication skills when working with technical colleagues and other stakeholders. * The ability to manage priorities and provide accurate progress updates. Experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Docker, or CI/CD tools is useful. Relevant cloud certifications are also an advantage. **What to Expect in the Role** You'll be expected to keep infrastructure documentation current, report technical problems promptly, and test changes before they affect production systems. When an issue cannot be resolved immediately, you should explain the impact, document what has been investigated, and communicate the next steps. The role also involves reviewing existing processes and recommending improvements when they can make infrastructure easier to maintain, more reliable, or more secure. **Working Schedule** **Days:** Monday to Friday **Hours:** 9:00 AM–5:00 PM **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia **How to Apply** Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Include your cloud engineering experience, the platforms and tools you have used, and any relevant certifications. You can also describe a cloud infrastructure project you worked on, the technical problem you addressed, and your contribution to the result. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** **Applicants will be considered based on job\-related skills, experience, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable employment laws.** Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

You'll help investigate service issues, support deployments, review system configurations, and work with other technical teams to resolve problems. We need someone who approaches technical changes carefully, documents their work, and communicates clearly when an issue affects system performance or delivery. **What You'll Be Responsible For** * Configure, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure based on application and business requirements. * Manage cloud resources, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and access permissions. * Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, and resource usage to identify potential problems. * Troubleshoot server, connectivity, configuration, and deployment issues. * Support application releases and coordinate infrastructure changes with development and IT teams. * Review cloud configurations and access controls to identify security concerns. * Use scripting and automation to reduce repetitive infrastructure tasks. * Assist with backup procedures, recovery planning, and routine maintenance. * Investigate service interruptions and document the steps taken to resolve them. * Review resource consumption and identify opportunities to manage cloud costs. * Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, and technical procedures. * Follow change\-management processes and communicate risks before modifying production systems. **What You'll Bring** We are looking for someone with a practical understanding of cloud infrastructure and a methodical approach to technical problem\-solving. You should have: * Experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of cloud computing, virtual machines, storage, and infrastructure networking. * Familiarity with Linux or Windows server environments. * An understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, and network troubleshooting. * Experience with scripting tools such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell. * Familiarity with system monitoring, access management, and infrastructure security. * The ability to investigate technical issues and explain findings clearly. * Good documentation habits and attention to detail. * The ability to work with developers, IT colleagues, and other stakeholders. * Sound judgement when making changes that could affect live services. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. The Principal Design Engineer leads the design, qualification, and lifecycle support of high\-performance coaxial, twisted\-pair, twinaxial, fiber\-optic, Power over Ethernet (PoE), Single Pair Ethernet (SPE), Class 4 power, and hybrid cable products. jobs.title: Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst
jobs.description: The Supreme Court of Nevada, Administrative Office of the Courts (AOC), is seeking a Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst to support and expand the Nevada Courts Data Warehouse. The Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst plays a crucial role in Nevada Courts Data Warehouse in developing, maintaining, testing, and supporting the programming and data transformations that move court data into reliable statewide reporting structures. The incumbent applies advanced programming and database skills to develop complex queries, stored procedures, data transformations, and automated processes. This position works closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements, implement approved business rules, resolve data and programming issues, and expand the Data Warehouse and related data services to support current and future AOC initiatives. This position may require travel to various court locations throughout Nevada and occasional travel outside of Nevada. Occasional overtime and work on holidays, nights, and/or weekends may be required. This position can be located in Carson City or Las Vegas. After an initial training period, there may be an opportunity for a hybrid remote/in\-office schedule. **Examples of Duties** * Business Analysis and Solutions Design: Work closely with business stakeholders to gather and document requirements, understand business processes, and identify opportunities for improvement. Create detailed technical designs and implement solutions that align with business requirements and architectural standards. * Translate business needs into technical specifications and actionable plans. * Support integration of new court systems, data sources, and AOC applications into the Data Warehouse and related reporting environment. * Support future AOC initiatives that depend on consistent data collection, transformation, integration, and reporting. * Participate in requirements analysis, technical design, coding, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support for Data Warehouse enhancements. * Develop and execute test plans to validate solutions. * Work with other units of the AOC to ensure transformations reflect approved business rules and produce reliable reporting data and/or metrics. * Database Development: Develop, maintain, and support Data Warehouse code, scripts, queries, procedures, jobs, and data\-transformation processes. * Build and maintain extract, transform, and load processes that collect, standardize, validate, and load court data from approved source systems. * Develop and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and other code used for data integration, validation, reporting, and analysis. * Optimize code and data\-processing workflows for performance, scalability, maintainability, and efficient use of resources. * Technical Support and Documentation: Provide support for production databases and applications, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions in a timely manner. Monitor and enhance system performance. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for database structures, processes, and system configurations. Ensure documentation is up\-to\-date and accessible. * Troubleshoot failed or incomplete data loads, transformation errors, mapping issues, performance problems, and other programming defects. * Maintain source\-to\-target mappings, transformation specifications, code documentation, dependencies, version history, and operational runbooks. * Assist with user acceptance testing and validation of data transformations, reports, and interfaces before production release. * Collaboration: Work with cross\-functional teams, including end users, developers, data analysts, and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery and integration. Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing. * Security: Apply secure coding, change\-management, source\-control, and release\-management practices established by the AOC. * Protect confidential, restricted, and sensitive court information and comply with applicable judiciary policies governing data access and use. * Follow department policies and procedures. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * Professional programming or data\-engineering experience involving relational databases, structured data, integrations, or enterprise reporting environments. * Strong SQL skills and experience developing queries, stored procedures, scripts, or comparable database programming components. * Experience developing or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, data transformations, interfaces, or automated data workflows. * Knowledge of data structures, database concepts, testing, error handling, logging, source control, and software development practices. * Ability to analyze technical problems, trace data through multiple processing steps, and develop maintainable solutions. * Skilled at delivering precise, high\-quality documentation for system requirements, codebases, data mappings, test results, and technical dependencies. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, integration services, scripting languages, or the technologies used by the AOC Data Warehouse (AWS services including Redshift and Glue) is preferred. If this position is approved for remote/hybrid work, the incumbent is required to work a minimum of 40 hours in the office per pay period, in accordance with a supervisor\-approved schedule. The remaining work hours are eligible to be performed remotely in accordance with operational needs and applicable remote\-work policies. The incumbent must be able to work effectively and collaborate with employees while working remotely. The individual must be proficient in virtual meeting platforms such as Microsoft Teams and be able to perform all duties through a reliable internet connection provided by the employee. The internet connection must be sufficient to support all job functions, with a minimum download speed of 50–100 Mbps. Higher speeds may be necessary if the connection is shared with other members of the household. **Additional** **Benefits include:** * **Health Insurance:** medical, dental, prescription, vision, life and disability insurance programs for employees and dependents/family are offered through the Public Employees’ Benefits Program (PEBP). * **Vacation:** Accrual of three weeks of annual leave each year. * **Sick Leave:** Accrual of three weeks of sick leave each year. * **Holidays:** 12 paid holidays per year. * **Retirement:** Participation in the Nevada Public Employees’ Retirement System (PERS). * **Deferred Compensation:** The State has a voluntary deferred compensation program. * **No Nevada state income tax.** * **Positions are eligible for Public Service Loan Forgiveness.** * **Flexibility:** a work\-life balance beyond compare! Please note the posted salary is based on the Employee/Employer paid retirement contribution plan to PERS. **Applicants should submit a cover letter and resume.** **This recruitment is scheduled to close at 11:59 p.m. on October 29, 2026\. Based on the number of applications received, the recruitment may close early. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.**

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (Backend Focus)
jobs.description: **Full\-Stack Developer (Backend Focus)** Location: Southern California \| Hybrid Department: Engineering \& Product Experience Level: Junior to Mid\-Level Compensation: $35 to $45 per hour Schedule: Hybrid \| One day per week in person \| SoCal **Role Overview** AIVA MD is looking for a Full\-Stack Developer with a strong backend focus to join our engineering team. You will need to know Django (Python), React, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Everything is written from scratch on a clean stack we own and operate entirely. No legacy code, no shortcuts. We build for healthcare, which means correctness and security are non\-negotiable. This role is for someone who wants to build something real, learn fast, and work closely with the leadership team. You will not be handed a ticket queue and left alone. You will be in the details with us every day. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and maintain Django REST API endpoints, clinical records, and multi\-tenant data routing * Build React/Vite frontend components including dashboards, forms, modals, and real\-time updates * Write and review database migrations following additive\-only practices no critical changes without explicit sign\-off * Test all changes on staging before production, nothing goes to production untested * Participate in code review and maintain clean, documented code as features ship * Identify bugs, flag blockers early, and communicate clearly on what is in progress and what is done **Required Qualifications** * 1 to 3 years of experience in software development or a strong portfolio of personal or open source projects * Python \-\- comfortable writing functions, classes, and working with libraries * Django basics \-\- understands models, views, URLs, migrations, and how the ORM works * React \-\- can build functional components with hooks, manage state, and make API calls * Git \-\- knows how to branch, commit, push, and open a pull request without breaking things * Linux command line \-\- can SSH into a server, navigate directories, and run commands * SQL basics \-\- can read a query, understand joins, and write a simple migration * Strong attention to detail and a commitment to getting things right the first time * Comfortable asking questions before guessing, especially on anything that touches patient data * Must reside in Southern California and be available for one in\-person day per week * Must be authorized to work in the United States **Preferred Qualifications** Experience in healthcare or regulated software is preferred but not required. Exposure to any of the following is a plus: * AWS services * PostgreSQL * HIPAA\-compliant software development * WebSockets or real\-time features * Docker or containerization basics * EHR systems or healthcare data standards **What We're Looking For** We are looking for someone who is curious, careful, and takes ownership of their work. The right candidate reads existing code before writing new code, understands the pattern before adding to it, and recognizes that in a healthcare platform a mistake is not just a bug, it is a compliance risk. You do not need to know everything. You do need to be the kind of developer who figures things out, communicates clearly when something is unclear, and never ships code they are not confident in. Experience is helpful but attitude and work ethic matter more at this level. The Performance Engineer will be a subject matter expert in photovoltaic system and Battery storage behavior, plant performance metrics, and operational analytics, helping drive continuous improvement across the renewable energy portfolio. **Responsibilities** * Monitor and analyze fleet\-wide solar plant performance, availability, and energy production against budget, P50 forecasts, and contractual guarantees. * Develop, maintain, and improve performance monitoring dashboards, KPIs, and reporting tools. * Assist in root cause analyses of underperformance events and production losses. * Evaluate SCADA, meteorological, inverter, tracker, and revenue meter data to identify operational issues and optimization opportunities. * Perform daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance assessments for operating assets. * Validate expected energy production through statistical analysis and comparison against performance models. * Support asset managers in assessing operational risks and revenue impacts associated with plant performance issues. * Collaborate with O\&M providers and internal resources to troubleshoot equipment failures and recurring performance losses. * Analyze inverter, tracker, module, and balance\-of\-system performance trends and degradation rates. * Lead performance guarantee evaluations, liquidated damages assessments, and contractual performance testing activities. * Review and update production forecasts, weather assumptions, and performance models as operating data becomes available. * Develop and maintain fleet degradation analyses and long\-term performance projections. * Identify and quantify opportunities for performance improvements and operational cost reductions. * Support due diligence efforts for project acquisitions, financing activities, and portfolio valuations. * Prepare technical reports, presentations, and executive summaries for internal and external stakeholders. * Stay current with evolving industry standards, technologies, and best practices related to solar PV, BESS, trackers, inverters, and energy analytics. * Develop automation tools, scripts, and analytical workflows using Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel VBA, or similar platforms. * Support incident investigations and recommend corrective actions to improve fleet reliability and performance. * Onboard new assets in performance platforms. **Requirements*** Minimum 3 years of renewable industry experience in a performance\-related role * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering (preferred), Meteorology, Statistics, Physics, or some other quantitative field * Strong knowledge of PV solar energy systems and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) * Proficiency in data analysis using Excel, Python, MATLAB, Fabric or other related software. * Understanding inverter operation, power conversion principles, and power electronics. * Advanced understanding of and experience with PVsyst software. * Professional verbal and written communication skills * Ability to discuss technical and advanced engineering concepts to both expert and non\-technical people. * Self\-motivated, able to work both independently with minimal oversight and in coordination with other groups and individuals. * Excellent time management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects, at times in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred:** * Experience with utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). * Experience supporting NERC, ISO, or utility compliance requirements. * Familiarity with SCADA platforms such as AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, OEM monitoring systems, or similar tools. * Experience with performance guarantee testing and ASTM performance testing protocols. * Knowledge of energy markets and renewable asset commercial operations. * Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced data science applications in renewable energy. * Experience managing third\-party O\&M or EPC contractors Location: Hybrid in Houston, Texas (4 days in office, Fridays remote). **Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Visa sponsorship or transfer visas, including H\-1B or L\-2, are not available for this position.** **Benefits** Panthera Grid Partners offers an exciting benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending account, company\-paid life insurance and short\-term disability, voluntary life, and long\-term disability, paid paternal leave, and a retirement plan with matching contributions. Full\-time position with competitive compensation package, including bonus.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves. **Realm\-X** is AppFolio's AI\-native platform powering this transformation. It enables a new generation of intelligent capabilities across our products, including Realm\-X Assistant (copilot), Flows (AI Agentic workflows) and Performers (autonomous AI Agents). Realm\-X serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale AI\-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high\-impact experiences directly to our customers**. At its core, Realm\-X is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable AI systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. This foundation allows us to build **context\-aware, action\-oriented AI systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision\-making. **Who We Are Looking For** We're seeking a **Principal Machine Learning Engineer** to help define and lead the next generation of AI systems within Realm\-X, and to drive AppFolio's long\-term **autonomous** Real Estate Performance Management (RPM) platform — autonomous AI agents that can deliver property management performance. This is a **company\-impact role**. You will own mission\-critical AI capabilities, shape long\-term technical strategy, and act as a **technical visionary and advisor** across teams and leadership. You'll operate at the intersection of **traditional machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI**, building systems that go beyond AI assistance into **execution, automation, and optimization**. This role is for someone who doesn't just build systems — but **redefines how they should be built**. **Your Impact** * **Architect \& Lead:** Help define the technical vision and architecture for AI systems across Realm\-X in partnership with senior leadership. * **Scale Intelligent AI Agents:** Design and deploy advanced AI Agentic systems that combine reasoning, planning, and execution, including multi\-agent orchestration across specialist agents (e.g., maintenance, leasing, accounting, collections). * **Improve the Foundation:** Establish platform primitives and abstractions to enable context\-aware, action\-oriented AI that goes beyond simple assistance to true automation. Improve the standards for end\-to\-end ML systems: data collection, model training, evaluation, deployment, and inference infrastructure. * **Production Excellence:** Architect and build scalable, multi\-modal, and real\-time AI applications, ensuring high\-quality deployment standards. * **ML for Autonomous Property Management:** Drive AppFolio's transition toward autonomous property management operations. Use existing LLMs today and instrument the proprietary data collection now that will let us selectively train, fine\-tune, and RL\-optimize open source LLM and SLM for the RPM domain — optimizing performance, latency, and cost. * **Reinforcement Learning for Agent Policies:** Build the data and feedback loops needed to enable Reinforcement Learning over agent action policies in the partially observable, high\-stakes property management environment. **Qualifications** * **Systems thinker:** You think in terms of systems, platforms, and long\-term leverage, not just features. * **Production builder:** You've built and scaled ML/AI systems in production with meaningful business impact. * **Ambiguity:** You operate effectively in high ambiguity, turning unclear problems into a clear direction. * **Influence:** You've led or influenced large, cross\-team technical initiatives. * **Originality:** You introduce new ideas, architectures, or paradigms — not just implement existing ones. * **Owner\-operator:** You bring a founder / owner\-operator mindset: you take ownership, act with urgency, and focus on outcomes. * **Pace:** You have a strong desire to move fast and deliver impact, while maintaining sound engineering judgment. * **Collaboration:** You are humble, collaborative, and low\-ego, and you elevate those around you. * **Sustainability:** You value work\-life balance as a foundation for sustained high performance. * **Vertical conviction:** You bring genuine interest in winning a specific industry vertical (real estate) rather than chasing horizontal AI hype. **Must Have** * Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (required). * 10\+ years of expe ial scale. * **Full ML lifecycle:** Strong understanding of data extraction, model training, evaluation, deployment, and integration into production software. * **Core stack:** Expert in Python, PyTorch, NumPy, AWS, Docker, SQL, embeddings, and RAG. * **Agent tooling:** Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LLM observability tools (LangSmith). * **Production ML at scale:** Experience designing and operating production\-grade ML systems at scale. * **Ontology \& knowledge graphs:** Applied experience with ontology\-driven systems, knowledge graphs, or semantic layers used to model business domains for AI systems. * **AI\-native engineering:** Proficiency with AI coding tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, code generation tools). **Nice to Have** * **Reinforcement Learning depth:** Deep RL expertise applied to sequential decision\-making under partial observability. * Experience designing evaluation and benchmarking systems for AI. * Background in distributed systems and real\-time architectures. * Experience building platforms used by multiple engineering teams. * Contributions to industry thought leadership (publications, talks, open source, etc.). **Location** Find out more about our locations by visiting our site. All late\-stage candidates complete an in\-person meeting with an AppFolian as part of our hiring process. **Compensation \& Benefits** The compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is:$264,000 \- $363,000 base pay. The actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity. Please note that compensation is just one aspect of a comprehensive Total Rewards package. The compensation range listed here does not include additional benefits or any discretionary bonuses you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type. Regular full\-time employees are eligible for benefits \- see here. **About AppFolio** AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. For more information about AppFolio, visit appfolio.com. **Why AppFolio** **Grow** \| We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves. **Learn** \| We partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. We're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best\-in\-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills. **Impact** \| We are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities. **Connect** \| We excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. We create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed. **Paddle as One.** Learn more at appfolio.com/company/careers ***Statement of Equal Opportunity*** *At AppFolio, we value diversity in backgrounds and perspectives and depend on it to drive our innovative culture. That’s why we’re a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we believe that our products, our teams, and our business are stronger because of it. This means that no matter what race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, or veteran status, you’re always welcome at AppFolio.* Compensation Range: $264K \- $363K

jobs.title: Principal Tooling Design & Polymer Molding SME
jobs.description: **Lead with purpose. Engineer for impact.** ------------------------------------------- Join Alcon’s Engineering function and help us elevate quality, processes, products, packaging, and materials to improve sight for patients everywhere. As our Principal Tooling Design and Polymer Molding SME, you will set the technical bar for injection molding and tooling across global operations, connecting R and D to manufacturing to deliver reliable, cost effective, compliant production. ### **How you will make a difference** **Innovate and design** – Create precision mold tooling and architect molding processes tuned to part geometry, material properties, production volume, and cost objectives.**Industrialize and validate** – Lead improvements and validations for molds, tooling support systems, and equipment; execute capability studies, DOE, and IQ OQ PQ to lock in performance.**Optimize and troubleshoot** – Resolve molding and equipment issues, improve automation including end of arm interfaces, and strengthen hot runner performance.**Scale new products** – Drive New Product Introduction from concept to ramp up while managing timeline, risk, and cost targets, partnering closely with suppliers and contract manufacturers.**Mentor and elevate** – Coach junior engineers and technicians in molding and tooling best practices; champion continuous improvement and operational excellence.**Comply and document** – Ensure designs and processes meet medical device regulatory, safety, and quality standards; maintain documentation, change control, and GxP aligned records per SOPs.### **Role specifics** * Oversee molding trials, generate clear process documentation, and assess raw material impacts on molding performance * Collaborate with cross functional partners to lower defects, enhance mold performance, and increase throughput * Scout advanced tooling technologies and auxiliary equipment to improve safety, efficiency, and cost * Recommend capital investments, standardize tooling, and produce capital justifications ### **Your background** * Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience pathway: high school plus 13 years, Associate’s plus 9 years, M.S. plus 2 years, or PhD plus 0 years * Fluent English communication * 5 years of relevant experience * Work schedule: Exempt, 40 hours per week, Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM EST – 5:00 PM EST * Travel: up to 10 percent * Work setting: onsite * Relocation available * Sponsorship not available ### **Preferred strengths** * Engineering degree with Plastics or Mechanical emphasis preferred; other disciplines considered * Strong command of scientific molding * Demonstrated success troubleshooting and optimizing molding processes and equipment * Experience with molding process validation and qualification IQ OQ PQ * Hot runner systems and troubleshooting experience * Automation troubleshooting including EOA tooling * Experience with process monitoring systems * Experience performing contact and non contact dimensional inspection * Industry experience in medical device or other regulated settings ### **Tools and focus areas** * Injection Molding Machine Husky * Troubleshooting Industrial Automation Equipment * Process Engineering * Injection Molding Experience ### **Thrive with us** * Team with peers to share standard processes and learnings as work evolves * Accelerate your development with focused growth opportunities * Join our mission to deliver innovative products and solutions that improve sight and lives * Benefit from a robust package that includes health, life, retirement, flexible time off for exempt associates, PTO for hourly associates, and more See your impact at alcon.com.careers

jobs.title: Quality Engineer - Superior Completions - Lafayette, LA.
jobs.description: **Superior Completion Services, a Superior Energy Services Company**, has the technology, resources, and experience to deliver effective well\-completion services in any downhole condition. As a global provider of best\-in\-class conventional, unconventional, intelligent, and sand control tools, Superior Energy provides field\-proven state\-of\-the\-art technology that reduces risk, increases completion efficiencies, and maximizes production on land, shelf, Deepwater, and Ultra\-Deepwater arenas. **Join Our Growing Team at Superior Completion Services!** ##### **Superior Completion Services** **is excited to seek** **a** **Quality Engineer** **for** **our** **Lafayette, LA** **office****.** Our **Quality Enginee**r will lead the charge in shaping and elevating Superior Completions’ Quality Management System by transforming policies, procedures, manuals, and work instructions into a cohesive, high‑performing framework that drives operational excellence. This role also champions the creation of meaningful quality metrics that fuel continuous improvement across the organization. This role partners closely with supervisors and managers to ensure quality standards are fully understood, consistently applied, and continuously optimized. Serves as a strategic guide, identifying gaps, coaching leaders, and empowering teams to deliver safer, smarter, and more efficient performance every day. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Initiate, follow\-up, and implement corrective actions after completion of Root Cause Analysis (RCA); provide guidance to supervisors and managers on ways to address the issues. Makes a determination on whether proposed corrective actions meet the need as stated in the Corrective Action. * Write, develop, initiate, and maintain standards and procedures for the performance of Quality Assurance, Inspection, and Test functions * Establish controls and inspection points to facilitate detection, correction, and prevention of nonconformities in materials, parts, assemblies, and products (Corrective Action/Preventive Action (CAPA) for continuous improvement * Review inspection fixtures and gauges that are used as “Media of Inspection.” * Manage the Nonconforming Material system (Report Database) * Assist the Quality Management team in the preparation, implementation, and maintenance of the Quality Assurance Program * Assist the Quality Management team in the formulation, implementation, and maintenance of quality objectives * Perform statistical studies, including generating metrics reports, for the purpose of evaluating or reporting quality and reliability information; provide guidance to supervisors and managers on ways to improve based on the analyses that are performed * Assist in the implementation and maintenance of advanced quality concepts such as Continuous Quality Improvement and Statistical Process Control * Perform internal quality surveys and audits for assuring that the requirements of the Quality System are being attained; provide coaching and guidance to supervisors and managers on existing gaps, and work with them to define action plans to address these issues * Perform Supplier Qualification audits; provide recommendations on suppliers that should be retained or not on the preferred supplier list, based on the results of the audits. Provide feedback to suppliers on minor infractions and provide guidance on what is needed in order to meet required specifications * Prepare, revise when necessary, and distribute Quality Plans based upon product and/or customer requirements; serve as liaison for the organization to ensure any changes that are required are implemented * Review, recommend, and communicate the Quality Department’s comments to proposed customer specifications * Investigate and obtaina resolution to warranty claims and customer complaints, as assigned * Recommend product revisions, process changes, and testing procedures to ensure that quality standards are being attained * Assure that quality standards comply with division and departmental policies, national and international codes, and applicable safety requirements * Provide technical expertise in areas such as welding, metallurgy, nondestructive testing, and inspection methods The above statements are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified; nothing restricts the company’s right to change, assign, or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time or for any reason **EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE** * High School Diploma or Equivalent Required * If degreed, we prefer Quality Engineering, Quality and Statistical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with Quality certification * Bachelor’s degree preferred in Engineering or at least **five years’** related quality or industry experience, as well as training with a Certified Quality Engineering Certificate or equivalent; or equivalent combination of education and experience **TECHNICAL SKILLS** * Current practices, equipment, materials, supplies, and technology used in the oil and gas industry * Knowledge, competency, and experience in Quality Assurance * Knowledge relating to completion services procedures and processes * Proficiency with personal computers and software, but not limited to, Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint * Experience with statistical software is desirable **Superior Energy Services has Excellent Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life, Matching 401(k), and Personal Time Off (PTO) **To be considered for this position, please select the link “Apply Now”** *We are an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate against any job applicant because of race, color, religion, natural origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics prohibited by law.* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **Job Title: Senior Data Engineer** Experience: 8 Years Employment Type: Contract / W2 Location: McLean, Virginia Duration: Contract Job Description We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with 8 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and data engineering solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, SQL, ETL/ELT, cloud platforms, and big data technologies. Preferred Qualifications \* Experience with Kafka or other streaming technologies. \* Familiarity with Delta Lake and cloud\-based data architectures. \* Experience with data modeling and data governance. \* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Aldie, VA 20105

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: * **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry\-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms. The research/AI team is the dedicated AI/ML and data science arm of the Ad Platform organization. Its mission is to advance AI and machine learning capabilities across Ad Platform by delivering scalable, high impact AI/ML and data science solutions that enhance ad decisioning, forecasting, experimentation and ad experience. We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join this innovative team. This role is a great opportunity for a seasoned data science professional who thrives at the intersection of advanced analytics, machine learning, and business strategy. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will spearhead ML and data science initiatives that shape the future of advertising technology. You will be responsible for designing and executing ML and data science solutions that drive measurable impact across ad decisioning, forecasting, experimentation, and user experience optimization, as well leading evaluation and optimization of generative AI mixed media advertisement creation and enhancement technologies. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Drive innovation and apply data science and statistical analysis in a variety of areas to enhance every aspect of advertising serving, including inventory forecasting, ad experience, ad pacing, pricing, targeting, advertising creation and enhancement, and efficient ad delivery. * Translate business questions into data science framework; develop data analysis and ML models for complex ad challenges with fast turnaround. * Define and evaluate key metrics in various product areas. * Partner closely with generative AI specialists to support the creation of datasets for generative AI modeling applications. * Develop Standard Operating Procedures for human\-driven evaluations or labeling. * Deliver data insights and provide data\-driven recommendations to cross\-team stakeholders. * Design and analyze A/B tests for machine learning algorithm iterations. * Establish strong partnership with stakeholders, including product managers, engineers and program managers, in a collaborative environment. **WHAT TO BRING** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of relevant industry experience in data science at leading internet or technology companies. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Early Career) – C++ & Systems
jobs.description: **About SirenOpt** SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro\- and nano\-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks. SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non\-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics\-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real\-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made. We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia. **About the job** **Job Title:** Software Engineer (Early Career) – C\+\+ \& Systems **Location:** On\-Site (San Leandro, CA) **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Role Overview** SirenOpt is seeking a **Software Engineer** to help build and maintain the real\-time data pipeline behind our sensing platform: acquiring data from multiple sensors, processing and storing it on Linux\-based systems, and delivering it to the applications our customers rely on. You will work primarily in modern C\+\+ and Python, with mentorship from senior engineers, and you will be hands\-on with real hardware in our lab to test and validate what you build. This is a role for someone who wants to grow into a well\-rounded systems engineer by shipping production software end to end, from a first design discussion to a feature running at a customer site. **What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain software components in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\) for Linux\-based systems, with guidance from senior engineers * Implement features, fix bugs, and write unit and integration tests across the data pipeline, from sensor acquisition through processing and storage to the services that deliver results to applications * Write and maintain Python scripts for automation, testing, and data analysis * Read, and where needed modify, existing code written in other languages across our codebase * Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, and verify their output through testing, profiling, and code review * Run the system on real hardware in the lab to test and validate your changes, including setting up sensors and collecting data * Participate in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback, and follow team conventions for code quality * Help diagnose and debug issues across software and hardware boundaries, working with firmware and hardware engineers * Measure and improve performance of existing code under the direction of senior engineers * Document your work so that others on the team can build on it **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome) * 0–2 years of professional software development experience; internships, co\-ops, research, and substantial personal or open\-source projects count * Solid foundation in C\+\+, including memory management, references and pointers, the standard library, and basic object\-oriented and generic programming * Strong ability to read, understand, and write Python, including working within existing Python codebases used for automation, testing, and data analysis * Ability to pick up new programming languages quickly; our codebase spans several languages and you will need to read, and occasionally modify, code outside of C\+\+ and Python * Understanding of core computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and concurrency basics * Comfortable with the everyday toolchain: Linux command line, build tools (CMake or similar), a debugger, and Git\-based workflows (branches, pull requests, code review) * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of a real development workflow, and the judgment to review and test what they produce * Comfortable working hands\-on with lab and test equipment: setting up sensors, running the system on real hardware, and collecting data for testing and validation (we will train you on our specific equipment) * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well with teammates across disciplines **Nice to have:** * Experience with Qt, gRPC, or Protocol Buffers * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing * Experience with profiling and debugging tools such as perf, Valgrind, GDB, or sanitizers * Familiarity with hardware communication interfaces such as Ethernet, USB, or Serial * Contributions to open\-source projects **What You'll Learn** You will work on a real\-time sensing platform that is already running at some of the largest manufacturers in the world, on a small team where your code reaches customers quickly. * How a high\-throughput, multi\-sensor data pipeline is built end to end, from acquisition through processing and storage, and kept reliable in production * Modern C\+\+ and Linux systems engineering, with regular code review and mentorship from senior engineers * How software, firmware, and hardware teams work together to ship a physical product * How to use AI coding tools effectively and responsibly in a professional engineering workflow * A clear path to grow into a mid\-level engineer with ownership of your own components **Benefits** * Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience * Health, Dental, Vision plans provided * 401k matching provided * Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

jobs.description: AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves. **Realm\-X** is AppFolio's AI\-native platform powering this transformation. It enables a new generation of intelligent capabilities across our products, including Realm\-X Assistant (copilot), Flows (AI Agentic workflows) and Performers (autonomous AI Agents). Realm\-X serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale AI\-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high\-impact experiences directly to our customers**. At its core, Realm\-X is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable AI systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. This foundation allows us to build **context\-aware, action\-oriented AI systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision\-making. **Who We Are Looking For** We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to design and ship the next generation of voice and conversational AI agents within Realm\-X. This role helps define AppFolio's production voice and chat agent pipelines, working at the intersection of LLM agent frameworks, real\-time voice technology, and streaming infrastructure. You will work with Product, Voice channel, and ML Platform teams to translate cutting\-edge agent and voice research into reliable, low\-latency, multi\-channel experiences that scale across our entire customer base. **Your Impact** * **Ship Voice \& Text Agents:** Architect and ship voice and text agent pipelines that handle real\-time, multi\-turn customer interactions. * **Reasoning vs. Latency:** Make principled trade\-offs between reasoning depth and latency across frontier LLMs, smaller models, and routing strategies. * **Lead a Pod:** Lead a small pod of ML and platform engineers; raise the bar on agent evaluation, observability, and incident response. * **Define Quality:** Partner with Product and Voice channel teams to define KPIs, eval harnesses, and acceptance criteria for agent quality. * **Optimize for Voice:** Drive selective Small Language Model (SLM) fine\-tuning and inference optimization for voice latency and cost. **Qualifications** * You have 5\+ years of experience developing and scaling web\-based applications, preferably in a SaaS environment. * You have shipped production AI agents serving real users in voice and/or text channels. * You think in pipelines and systems, not just models. * You move fast, deliver impact, and maintain sound engineering judgment. * You are humble, collaborative, and low\-ego, and you elevate those around you. * You value work\-life balance as a foundation for sustained high performance. **Must Have** * **Agent frameworks:** Deep, shipped experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, and LangChain Deep Agents (or equivalent agent frameworks). * **Voice stack:** Hands\-on with Voice\-to\-Voice models and traditional TTS / STT pipelines; understands the trade\-offs between end\-to\-end voice models and modular STT LLM TTS architectures. * **LLM fluency:** Strong grasp of LLM reasoning behavior, tool use, structured output, and reasoning\-vs\-latency trade\-offs across providers. * **Telephony \& cloud:** Production experience with Twilio (or comparable telephony) and AWS. * **Engineering:** Expert Python, async programming, and WebSockets for real\-time, bidirectional streaming. * **ML fundamentals:** Solid foundation in deep learning, model evaluation, and inference optimization; able to deploy with Docker on AWS. * **Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to lead a small team, mentor engineers, and partner credibly with Product and Design. **Nice to Have** * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related technical discipline. * Experience fine\-tuning Small Language Models for domain\-specific voice applications. * Familiarity with RAG over structured business data and tool\-using agents over API surfaces. * Prior experience in regulated or customer\-facing industries with strict reliability requirements. * Publicly verifiable work on GitHub, in open\-source agent frameworks, or in community competitions. **Location** Find out more about our locations by visiting our site. The actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity. Regular full\-time employees are eligible for benefits \- see here. **About AppFolio** AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. jobs.description: Description: **About the Company** Throughout history, transformative advancements in infrastructure have propelled humanity forward—from Vanderbilt’s railroads to Edison’s electrical grid and Eisenhower’s highways. With a remote\-first culture, we are driven by our mission to advance the UAS industry while creating an environment where people of diverse backgrounds and perspectives thrive as engineers, UAS consultants, creative thinkers, and passionate innovators. **Job Summary** Do you want to help build the digital infrastructure that will power the future of autonomous aviation? At Airspace Link, we are building the technology that enables drones to safely integrate into the national airspace. Our platform supports cities, government agencies, and enterprises as they launch and scale drone programs that improve public safety, enhance operational efficiency, and unlock new capabilities. As a Sr. Python Engineer, you will build the backend services and distributed systems that power AirHub® Portal. You will build scalable systems that support complex workflows, geospatial data, and mission\-critical operations while helping shape the future of the rapidly evolving UAS industry. You will partner closely with engineers across Platform, Data, Product, and Infrastructure teams, as well as product managers and domain experts, to deliver reliable, scalable, customer\-focused solutions. jobs.title: Lead Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **WE ARE GAMEMAKERS** **Who we are:** We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better. We are currently working on Project ETHOS, a new free\-to\-play, 3rd person rogue\-like hero shooter and an exciting evolution on the genre! **Who You Are:** 31st Union is looking for a Lead Backend Engineer to lead the team that builds and runs our studio\-hosted services. You will manage backend engineers in our US and EU studios, own the architecture of our services and infrastructure, and write code alongside the team. You are the first point of contact for backend technical decisions and backend incidents. This role reports to the Director \- Online Services. This role is based in our San Mateo, California studio and is open to fully remote candidates. **Responsibilities:** **Team Leadership** * Manage backend engineering team: hold regular 1:1s, set goals, give performance feedback, and lead hiring. * Run the backend team's planning: maintain the backlog, estimate work, and set sprint priorities against the online services roadmap. * Set the team's engineering standards for code review, testing, documentation and on\-call readiness. **Architecture and Development** * Own the architecture of our studio\-hosted services and infrastructure, including service boundaries, data models, APIs and deployment topology. * Scope backend work for new game features. * Write and review technical designs for new services and major changes. * Implement and review implementations for proprietary studio backend services. **Releases and Deployment** * Align backend roadmap with studio release schedule. * Diagnose, fix and deploy backend hotfixes through the studio hotfix process. * Maintain the continuous integration pipelines and deployment automation for our services. **Operations** * Own monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks and incident reporting for studio services. * Run the backend on\-call rotation, and act as first responder and escalation point for backend incidents. * Load test services before major releases, fix performance bottlenecks, and optimize service costs. * Implement and test failover and disaster recovery for our services and their data. **Platform Integration** * Integrate studio proprietary services with 2K and external platform services. * Debug cross\-service issues with external engineering partners. **Required Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of server\-side development experience, complemented by a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Has led or managed backend engineers on a shipped AAA title, preferably a live\-service or competitive multiplayer game. * Fluent in C\#, and proficient in Python or Go. * Strong grasp of distributed systems, concurrency and scalable service design. * Hands\-on experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DocumentDB, and with Redis. * Has deployed and operated production services on AWS. * Gives direct, constructive feedback and invites it from others. **Relevant Experience:** * Kubernetes, Helm and microservice architectures. * Profiling and optimizing distributed systems, including database queries and service calls. * Real\-time messaging, such as MQTT, and API gateways. * C\+\+ and Unreal Engine. * Online game systems such as matchmaking, social, progression, commerce and telemetry. * Running a live title: incident response, capacity planning and cost management. The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $169,100 and $250,280 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Technical Product Owner, Enterprise Search \& AI** Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. **This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career**. **The Impact You’ll Make in this Role** As a Technical Product Owner for Enterprise Search \& AI, you will serve as the critical operational bridge between strategic platform roadmaps and technical sprint execution for 3M’s enterprise search ecosystem. Operating as an individual contributor within a cross\-functional pod, you will deconstruct high\-level business needs into actionable technical requirements across search infrastructure, AI\-powered retrieval, and digital experience platforms, prioritizing the day\-to\-day tactical backlog to deliver scalable, high\-performance search capabilities that power digital commerce, content discovery, and emerging AI applications. Here, you will make an impact by: * Backlog \& Requirement Engineering — Translating the Director of Product \& Portfolio Management’s long\-term search and AI platform vision into highly detailed user stories, technical specifications, and structured acceptance criteria spanning search API enhancements, ingestion pipeline improvements, index architecture changes, and AI retrieval features. * Tactical Backlog Prioritization — Owning, refining, and prioritizing the day\-to\-day pod\-level backlog to optimize sprint velocity and engineering throughput across the enterprise search stack, balancing platform reliability work against new AI\-driven capabilities such as hybrid retrieval, semantic search, and RAG\-enabled experiences. * Sprint Execution Guidance — Partnering daily with the Enterprise Search Tech Lead and vendor engineers to provide absolute clarity on execution requirements during agile ceremonies, ensuring alignment on search relevance tuning, infrastructure\-as\-code changes, and AI model integration work. * Product Quality \& Acceptance — Serving as the gatekeeper for user acceptance testing (UAT), verifying that vendor\-built and internally developed artifacts strictly adhere to defined technical benchmarks for search performance, relevance accuracy, API response times, and AI output quality before release. * Adoption \& Platform Feedback — Monitoring search platform utilization, tracking adoption metrics across consuming applications (product navigator, digital commerce, AI assistants), and funneling real\-world feedback on search relevance and AI feature effectiveness back to the Product \& Portfolio Management director. * AI \& Search Capability Evolution — Defining and prioritizing product requirements for the platform’s evolution toward hybrid retrieval approaches combining lexical and semantic/vector search, supporting RAG pipelines, LLM grounding, and agentic AI use cases that drive competitive advantage. * Multi\-Feature Capability Mapping — Mastering competing business group requirements across interconnected search, content, and AI platform modules, governing dependencies and release schedules across ingestion workflows, search APIs, and downstream digital experiences. * Shared Accountability: Release \& Deployment — Co\-owning product release schedules and deployment calendar targets alongside Program/Project Managers (PVMO), coordinating CI/CD pipeline releases and infrastructure changes. * Shared Accountability: Technical Quality — Co\-owning software quality metrics, architectural alignment, and technical debt constraints with the Enterprise Search Tech Lead (TSL), including search index health, pipeline reliability, and AI model performance. * Shared Accountability: Business Value — Co\-owning business value metrics and customer satisfaction feedback loops with the assigned Business Relationship Manager (BRM), including search relevance KPIs and AI feature adoption rates. **Key Responsibilities:** * Backlog \& Requirement Engineering — Translate the Director of Product \& Portfolio Management's long\-term search and AI platform vision into detailed user stories, technical specifications, and structured acceptance criteria covering search API enhancements, ingestion pipeline improvements, index architecture changes, and AI retrieval features. * Tactical Backlog Prioritization — Own, refine, and prioritize the day\-to\-day pod\-level backlog to optimize sprint velocity and engineering throughput, balancing platform reliability work against new AI\-driven capabilities (hybrid retrieval, semantic search, RAG\-enabled experiences). * Sprint Execution Guidance — Partner daily with the Ente of three (3\) years owning or managing search, data platform, or AI\-driven product portfolios, in a private, public, government, or military environment * **Work location:** * 3M Center, Maplewood, MN or 3M Facility, Austin, TX This role follows an on\-site working model, requiring the employee to work at least four days a week at either the 3M Center in Maplewood, MN or the 3M Facility in Austin, TX. **Travel: May include up to 10% domestic or international** **Relocation: May be authorized** **Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).** **Supporting Your jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission:** 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. **Our People:** People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry\-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference\-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. **Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform** **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area or Austin, TX (Hybrid) **About the Role** ------------------ 6sense has agents and an MCP server in production today, used by real customers. This role takes them further by building more capable agents, strengthening the API and tool layer, and expanding an ecosystem that external agents, clients, and partners can connect to. You'll work across the full path from a customer's agent to 6sense data and actions, including APIs, tools, MCP, orchestration, context, evaluation, and security. 6sense is working to become the default Contextual Intelligence layer for B2B, and agents and MCP are how that context reaches customers, partners, and their AI tools. You'll partner closely with the team building contextual intelligence, write production Python daily, own multi\-month projects, support the teams and customers who depend on these systems, and keep the platform current as the agent tooling landscape evolves. **What You'll Own** ------------------- ### **Agents and Orchestration** * Extend LangGraph orchestrators with typed state, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointing, durable execution, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Select and implement routing, orchestrator\-worker, plan\-and\-execute, reflection, and multi\-agent handoff patterns based on business needs. * Run agents headless through API\-first and MCP\-first architectures across in\-app, chat, workflow, and partner surfaces from a shared core. * Build and maintain reusable components for state management, memory, tool\-calling, and agent\-to\-agent delegation with scoped permissions. ### **APIs, Tools, and MCP** * Evolve the APIs and tools agents use to access 6sense data and take action for both human and LLM consumers. * Optimize tool design for agent success, including naming, descriptions, schemas, response formats, error handling, and token efficiency. * Re\-design and scale the MCP layer for production workloads, including concurrency, per\-tenant quotas, latency budgets, caching, graceful degradation, backward compatibility, and adoption of emerging MCP capabilities. * Onboard external MCP clients, AI assistants, agent platforms, and partners. Develop integration guides and reference clients and define trust boundaries for third\-party MCP server integrations. * Strengthen platform reliability through idempotency, retries, rate limits, permissions, spend controls, and standards for tool contracts, versioning, and discovery. ### **Context and Evaluation** * Partner with the Contextual Intelligence team to expose context through MCP, APIs, and tools, enabling a unified context layer across all customer touchpoints. * Define and enforce contracts around returned data, freshness, provenance, and tenant and user\-level access controls. * Improve permission\-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, citations, context assembly, and memory management within token and latency constraints. * Expand evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, tool\-selection accuracy, tool\-call accuracy, end\-to\-end task success metrics, regression testing, release gates, and context quality measurements. * Enhance tracing and usage analytics while reporting on task success rates, tool\-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost efficiency. ### **Security, Privacy, and Trust** * Make security a first\-class consideration across every tool, API, agent, and MCP change. * Review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities and security risks. * Enforce tenant isolation and user\-level authorization for all requests while maintaining short\-lived, scoped credentials. * Protect against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agent autonomy, and data leakage through
