jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI\-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing. **The Opportunity at Altana** The Engineering team is responsible for building out the product for bringing this vision to life. We are creating a platform fundamentally driven by AI, which scales to a massive trove of data, and a diverse customer base; it is a complex system that will stretch engineering in many directions. Shipping products that customers actually adopt, not just products that ship, takes a particular kind of engineering practice. It means starting inside the customer's workflow rather than at the ticket. It means treating every release as a hypothesis you can prove or disprove. It means reaching for AI as a primary building block, not a feature you bolt on at the end. And it means owning a product end‑to‑end, from the first conversation through the telemetry six months later. As a Senior Engineer at Altana, that's the work and you'll lead others doing it. You'll embed with product and design, get on calls with users, form hypotheses about where the real pain is, and lead a small team turning those hypotheses into shipped, adopted products. You'll measure your work in customer outcomes, not commits. **You Will** * **Spend real time with customers.** Sit alongside them in their workflows, watch where they get stuck, and translate what you learn into product bets your team is willing to ship behind. * **Partner with the product team to decide** ***what*** **to build, not just** ***how***. Form hypotheses about customer value, design the smallest experiment that could prove them out, and learn fast. Push back on briefs that aren't grounded in evidence. * **Take new product surfaces from 0 to 1\.** Pitch, prototype, ship, and drive adoption with real users. You are as fluent in "did this land?" as you are in "is this maintainable?" * **Build AI‑native by default**. LLMs, agents, evals, retrieval, and modern AI tooling are first‑class building blocks in your stack, not bolt‑ons. You make principled choices about where AI changes the product equation and where it doesn't. * **Own end‑to‑end outcomes**. From the first customer conversation to telemetry on the dashboard six months later — including the architecture and instrumentation choices that make that telemetry meaningful. * **Set the technical bar for your team**. Review designs and code with a high standard for quality, simplicity, and customer impact, and a low tolerance for engineering work that can't be traced back to a customer outcome. * **Mentor engineers in customer‑centric, hypothesis‑driven product development**. Help them build the instincts to talk to users, run experiments, and tell when a feature is done because it's loved, not because the ticket is closed. * **Drive technical decision‑making with a bias toward shipping**. Choose practical, iterative designs that get a working version in front of customers fast, then evolve them as you learn. **You Have** * You've deployed production code and services to cloud\-hosted environments. * You have demonstrated experience delivering incremental releases from proof\-of\-concept to MVP to production. * Self\-starter with demonstrated experience working on large, complex problems. * You care deeply about engineering excellence, clean code, and knowledge\-sharing. * You have strong written and verbal communication skills. * Experience leading other engineers on complex projects. **Nice to have, but not required** * Experience with Python Machine Learning toolsets (Numpy, Pandas, Dedupe). * Experience with container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes. **Technologies we love to use at Altana** * Languages: Python, PySpark * Tools: Docker, Git, Kubernetes, Swagger/OpenAPI, AWS/Azure, MLFlow, Celery * Datastores: Databricks and Delta Lakes **This role is based in Brooklyn, NY, USA with hybrid work flexibility and candidates must be within commuting distance from our Williamsburg, Brooklyn office** **US Salary Range and Benefits** $170,000 \- $200,000 USD The salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position. Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: * Flexible Time Off: Altana operates with a Flexible Time Oﬀ (FTO) policy that gives you agency over your own time oﬀ so you can maximize your w coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency. * 401(k) Savings: Save for and invest in your future using our Guideline 401(k) retirement savings program. * Commuter Benefits: Save money on your commute by setting aside pre\-tax funds for public transit or parking! * Wellness: Because we value mental and emotional health, every Altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to Calm, the \#1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness. * Pet Insurance: Pets are family too! Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan. * Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support. * Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre\-tax funds for childcare expenses The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process. ### **Our Values** Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana's culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers. * **Trust:** Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable. * **Resilience:** In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It's how we respond when things don't go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward. * **Stewardship:** We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. We believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. Each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. And we are stewards of the greater good of the company. By holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission. * **Courage:** Courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Responsibilities: **THE ROLE:** This is a critical role in improving quality and reliability of AMD’s industry‑leading Server CPUs and Instinct accelerators. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, test, yield, quality, and data science. You will work hands‑on with massive volumes of manufacturing and test data, transforming them into actionable insights and production‑ready analytics and machine‑learning solutions. You will develop, deploy, and use tools for analyzing test and reliability data, deploy advanced analytics that reduce DPPM (defective parts per million), detect excursions earlier, and optimize test time and cost at scale. This is a highly cross‑functional role where you will partner closely with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality/Reliability, and Operations teams, influencing decisions from early ramp through high‑volume manufacturing. The ideal candidate enjoys moving from exploration to deployment, and communicating results clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders. **THE PERSON:** You are a curious, analytical problem solver who thrives in complex, data‑rich environments. You enjoy uncovering patterns in noisy data and translating them into practical improvements that matter in production. You collaborate naturally across functions, influence without authority, and are comfortable balancing deep technical work with clear communication. You are equally effective working independently or as part of a fast‑paced, cross‑disciplinary team, and you take pride in building robust, reusable solutions that scale. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Partner with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Yield Engineering, Quality, and Operations to identify, define, and prioritize analytics and machine‑learning use cases that materially improve yield, quality, and cost. * Develop and deploy ML/AI solutions for parametric outlier screening, drift detection, and excursion/anomaly detection across wafer, lot, site, and package dimensions. * Perform in‑depth root‑cause analysis of yield loss and DPPM drivers by correlating test, fab, assembly, and design variables; distinguish systemic issues from statistical noise. * Build, productionize, and maintain yield and quality analytics within AMD’s AVA analytics platform, moving models from experimentation to scalable deployment. * Drive adaptive test, screening, and binning strategies using data‑driven insights to optimize product quality and manufacturing efficiency. * Author clear technical documentation and reports; present findings and recommendations to cross‑functional teams and executive audiences. * Contribute reusable code, analytics frameworks, and best practices that elevate team capability and accelerate future development. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:*** Strong background in semiconductor product development, yield engineering, or test engineering, with hands‑on experience analyzing high‑volume manufacturing data. * Solid foundations in statistics and machine learning, including hypothesis testing, DOE/RSM, regression, classification, outlier detection, time‑series analysis, and anomaly detection. * Familiarity with Python and SQL for data analysis and modeling (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit‑learn), general coding experience and demonstrated past ability in related scientific computing work. * Practical knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing and test flows, including wafer sort and final test, binning strategies, DPPM analysis, reliability screens, and excursion management. * Familiarity with yield analytics ecosystems similar to AMD’s environment; experience with server‑class CPUs and/or accelerator/GPU products is highly desirable. * Demonstrated ability to deploy analytics or ML solutions into production environments, not just develop them in notebooks. **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:*** Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctoral degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Math, or a related technical discipline is preferred. **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** **\#LI\-AP1** Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher\-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively. We envision a future where family\-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Curious and highly resourceful, you are excited by both emerging AI capabilities and rigorous software engineering. integrations, and reusable AI components required to move solutions from prototype to reliable production use. **Work with complex healthcare information:** Create systems that extract, retrieve, and reason over clinical documents, conversations, operational records, and other structured and unstructured data. **Evaluate and improve system quality:** Build representative datasets, measure Applied AI work. * You grow your ability to independently own increasingly complex projects and technical decisions. * You build a strong understanding of when to use AI, deterministic software, or human review to produce the best outcome. **What you’ll have:** --------------------- * 2\+ years of professional  d willingness to engage directly with users and operational workflows. * Clear written and verbal communication skills. * Must reside in or be willing to permanently relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area. * Experience with Python, agent architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation, document intelligence, multimodal models, structured generation, model evaluation, monitoring, or prompt optimization is preferred but not required. * Experience in healthcare, fintech, jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, Platform and Automations
jobs.description: **About us** AbuvThePar runs an Amazon wholesale education program. Our students learn how to open accounts with real brands, buy inventory at wholesale, and sell it on Amazon. Behind the program are teams for purchasing, brand outreach, and student coaching, plus the software that ties all of it together. **About the role** We run the business on our own apps and automations: a platform for our students, an ops platform for our team, and scheduled jobs that move data between them and the tools we use every day. Most of it was built with AI coding tools, and it has grown past what our current team can keep up with. This role keeps all of it running, fixes what breaks, and ships what's next. If AI\-built code makes you nervous, this isn't the role. If it makes you curious, keep reading. **What's already builtAcre: the student platform** The app our students use to run their wholesale business day to day. * Find brands to work with and build lead lists * Look up the right contacts at each brand (email and phone), from our own brand database and outside data providers * Research a brand before a call: prep notes, talking points, and the brand's products on Amazon * Track every brand from first contact to closed deal, with tasks, notes, and files * Write emails that land as drafts in the student's own Gmail, and pull in the replies * Listing tools: copy checks for Amazon listings and product image generation * A background job system for long\-running work, with usage limits for each student Next up on the roadmap: more Amazon data sources, usage credits, and speed work as more students join. **Ivy: the ops platform** The internal app our team uses to run purchasing, offers, and fulfillment. It is several apps in one codebase. * **Purchasing:** upload purchase orders, check the profit on each product, approve or decline * **Student offers:** turn approved orders into offers for students, with a Google Sheet and a Gmail draft for each student * **Offer tracking:** see which offers were sent, accepted, or declined, with weekly reports * **PO flow:** follow each order from close through supplier payment, warehouse receiving, and invoicing (Xero) * **Account management:** track which products each student is approved to sell * **Brand outreach:** a database of 20,000\+ brands and their contacts, with contact lookup and call queues * **Coach workspace:** student profiles and rosters for our coaching team **Automations** * Offer texts: when an offer email goes out, the student gets a text (through GoHighLevel) and one reminder 48 hours later * Gmail sync that tracks offer emails and replies * Scheduled jobs (GitHub Actions and cron) that keep Ivy, Google Sheets, and our CRM in sync * Email sequences to students and brands (Hunter) * Brand research and contact lookup pipelines in Python and Node, using Hunter, Apollo, SerpAPI, and LLMs **Tech stack** * **Apps:** Next.js and React. Acre is TypeScript, Ivy is JavaScript (pnpm \+ Turborepo monorepo) * **Database:** Supabase (Postgres, row\-level security, storage) * **Hosting:** Vercel (Acre), Railway (Ivy) * **Code and CI:** GitHub, GitHub Actions * **Testing:** Vitest, Playwright * **Scripts:** Node and Python * **Outside services:** Google Workspace APIs (Gmail, Sheets, Drive), GoHighLevel, Hunter, Apollo, SerpAPI, OpenRouter for LLM calls, Xero * **AI coding tools:** Claude Code, Codex **What you'll doEvery week** * **Fix bugs** across Acre, Ivy, and the automations. When someone says "it's broken," find which step broke, fix it, ship it, and check it on the live app. Same day when you can. * **Run deploys** on Vercel and Railway, watch the logs, and roll back fast when something goes wrong. * **Change the database safely:** write and apply migrations, keep row\-level security tight, and keep backups current. * **Keep the automations healthy:** notice when a scheduled job or sync stops, find out why, and get it running again. * **Watch usage and limits** on outside APIs (contact lookup, AI, texting) so nothing runs out without warning. **Projects** * Ship Acre roadmap features end to end * Clean up screens that confuse students or staff, in both apps * Speed up slow pages as more students and data come in * Add tests for the parts that break most often * Keep a short doc for each system, so nobody has to guess how it works The bug work matters most. Done means you saw it working live, not "it should work now." **Your first 90 days** * **First 30 days:** Get access to everything. Map how Acre, Ivy, and the automations fit together: what calls what, where the data lives, and what runs on a schedule. Fix your first live bugs. * **By day 60:** You own the bug queue and deploys for both apps. * **By day 90:** You ship Acre roadmap features end to end, from the idea to checking it live. **What you're good at** * Reading a system you didn't write and mapping it: what calls what, where the data lives, what runs in the background * Deploys and keeping apps up: GitHub, Vercel, Railway, env vars, logs, rollbacks * Postgres and Supabase: migrations, row\-level security, and never deleting what you can't get back * Next.js, React, and TypeScript, enough to fix it and ship it * A good eye for UX/UI. You can tell when a screen is confusing and make it simpler. * Working with AI coding tools and checking their work instead of trusting it * Clear written updates: what broke, what you changed, and how you checked it **Nice to have** * Experience with Amazon selling, ecommerce, or wholesale * Python for scripts and data jobs * Connecting tools through their APIs: Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, GoHighLevel, or other CRMs * Background jobs, queues, and scheduled tasks **How we work** * Find out why something broke before you fix it. * Small changes shipped often beat big risky ones. * Back up before you change data. Never delete what you can't get back. * AI writes a lot of the code. You check all of it. **This isn't for you if** * You need a full spec before you start anything * "It works on my machine" feels like done to you * You'd rather rebuild a system from scratch than learn the one that's already running **How to apply** Skip the long cover letter. When you apply, send us three things: * One thing you built or fixed, with a link if you can share it * What broke along the way, and how you found it * Your available hours and time zone A resume is fine too, but we read those three answers first. Pay: Up to $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: Accellor is an AI\-native services firm purpose\-built for the post\-ChatGPT era. Free from legacy constraints, we focus on delivering measurable business outcomes through advanced AI, data, and engineering capabilities. Our mission is to operationalize AI at scale and unlock sustained enterprise value. Our offerings span AI solutions, data services, enterprise applications, and product engineering, tailored to industry\-specific needs across healthcare, life sciences, telecom, retail, financial services, and technology. By leveraging design thinking and technology\-agnostic architectures, we ensure faster time\-to\-value and seamless interoperability. With a proven track record of enabling Fortune 100 enterprises and global innovators, Accellor stands as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to harness the full potential of AI. Our vision is clear: to build intelligent, connected ecosystems that deliver measurable outcomes and redefine the future of enterprise transformation. **Role Summary****:** We are looking for a GenAI Engineer to advance how software is designed, built, tested, and delivered using frontier AI models and coding agents. You will work with models from OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and other providers, alongside AI development environments such as Cursor. You will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with prompt engineering and agent orchestration to improve development productivity, software quality, and cost efficiency. This role is suited to engineers who enjoy building working software, evaluating new approaches, and turning successful experiments into reliable engineering practices. Recent graduates with strong projects and demonstrable skills are encouraged to apply. **Key Responsibilities****:** **Build and Deliver Software:** * Develop features, resolve defects, refactor applications, and create automated tests using AI\-assisted development tools. * Use Cursor and other coding environments effectively for repository exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and code review. * Translate product requirements into well\-defined engineering tasks, technical approaches, and acceptance criteria. * Take ownership of code quality and delivery readiness, including changes produced by AI models or agents. * Collaborate with product, engineering, and quality teams to deliver reliable software releases. **Develop and Evaluate Prompts:** * Design and maintain effective prompts, repository instructions, context strategies, and reusable workflows for software engineering tasks. * Provide models with the relevant architecture, dependencies, coding standards, constraints, and expected outcomes. * Establish repeatable evaluations to assess correctness, consistency, requirement coverage, and the need for human intervention. * Improve prompts and workflows using evidence from test results, code reviews, and delivery outcomes. **Orchestrate Coding Agents:** * Build coordinated groups of coding agents to support planning, implementation, testing, review, and documentation. * Design reliable task delegation, handover, takeover, and recovery workflows with clear ownership and shared task state. * Manage parallel execution, task dependencies, isolated workspaces, and integration conflicts. * Define appropriate tool access, execution boundaries, and human review checkpoints. * Ensure agent\-produced changes can be traced, reviewed, tested, and integrated into the codebase **Improve Engineering Efficiency:** * Select models and tools based on task requirements, quality, latency, and cost. * Optimize context size, token consumption, model routing, retries, and agent execution overhead. * Establish baselines and measure improvements in development throughput, delivery time, review effort, and AI expenditure. * Maintain clear reporting on weekly and monthly delivery trends, including pull requests raised and merged. * Share validated practices and reusable tools that improve the effectiveness of the wider engineering team. **Requirements** **Minimum Qualifications:** * 0–4 years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or applied AI development. Academic, personal, and open\-source projects will also be considered. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, or C\#. * Hands\-on experience applying frontier models, including OpenAI models or Anthropic Claude, to software development. * Practical experience with Cursor or comparable AI coding environments. * Strong prompt engineering skills, including task decomposition, context preparation, structured outputs, and iterative evaluation. * Working knowledge of Git, pull requests, debugging, automated testing, APIs, and CI/CD. * Ability to understand existing codebases and independently assess the correctness of AI\-generated code. * Clear communication, collaborative working habits, and ownership of engineering outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience developing workflows with multiple coding agents, including delegation, handover, and integration. * Familiarity with model APIs, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience evaluating prompts and models using defined datasets, acceptance criteria, and automated checks. * Experience monitoring AI usage, engineering productivity, and cost efficiency. * Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, deployment automation, and application observability. * A portfolio of working software demonstrating effective use of AI tools, supported by tests and technical documentation. **Performance and Impact:** Success in this role is demonstrated through sustained contributions to software delivery, engineering quality, and team effectiveness. Performance expectations will reflect the scope, complexity, and level of ownership associated with the role. **Delivery and execution \-** **Expected Contribution:** Deliver meaningful, well\-scoped changes with predictable execution and clear ownership. **Representative Indicators:** Weekly and monthly PR submissions and merges; task completion; time to review\-ready code; PR cycle time. **Engineering excellence \-** **Expected Contribution:** Produce maintainable, secure, and reliable software that meets product and technical requirements. **Representative Indicators:** Acceptance\-criteria completion; automated verification results; review rework; escaped defects; release stability. **AI workflow effectiveness \- Expected Contribution:** Develop prompts and workflows that consistently produce useful, verifiable engineering results. **Representative Indicators:** Evaluation success rates; output consistency; first\-pass acceptance; human correction and intervention required. **Cost and resource efficiency \- Expected Contribution:** Improve the economics of AI\-assisted development while maintaining delivery and quality standards. **Representative Indicators:** AI cost per accepted task or merged PR; token consumption; retry overhead; improvement against established baselines. **Agent orchestration \- Expected Contribution:** Coordinate coding agents effectively across task execution, handovers, and integration. **Representative Indicators:** Successful task completion and handovers; recovery effectiveness; integration conflicts; manual intervention. **Team contribution \- Expected Contribution:** Extend individual impact through reusable tools, clear documentation, and effective collaboration. **Representative Indicators:** Adoption of shared workflows; reuse of validated prompts and tools; improvements in team delivery outcomes. These indicators support a broader assessment of engineering impact. Pull request volume is considered in the context of complexity, business value, collaboration, and software quality. **What you will bring:** Strong technical curiosity, thoughtful judgment, and a commitment to building dependable software. You will be comfortable experimenting with emerging tools, validating their results, and taking responsibility for the code and systems you help deliver. back\-end applications with RESTful APIs, handling asynchronous requests and data flows using tools such as Axios or Fetch. * Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes into high\-quality, production\-ready interfaces. * Ensure cross\-browser compatibility, responsive behavior, and accessibility best practices across different devices and screen sizes. * Optimize application performance, including load times, rendering efficiency, and overall front\-end responsiveness. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve front\-end issues, including layout, styling, and API integration problems. * Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and adhere to coding standards and best practices. * Work closely with backend engineers to define and refine API contracts, data models, and integration patterns. * Contribute to front\-end build and deployment processes using modern tooling (e.g., module bundlers, task runners, and package managers). * Continuously stay up to date with emerging front\-end technologies, frameworks, and best practices, and apply them where appropriate. * Collaborate with product and stakeholder teams to estimate effort, plan sprints, and deliver features on schedule. * Create and maintain technical documentation for components, features, and front\-end workflows. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field required. * Approximately 5\+ years of professional experience as a Web Developer or Front\-End Engineer. * Professional experience with Vue.js (Vue 3 preferred), including component\-based architecture and state management patterns. * Strong experience with Tailwind CSS and responsive design techniques for building mobile\-first, cross\-device interfaces. * Solid understanding of RESTful API integration and asynchronous request handling (e.g., Axios, Fetch). * Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+) with a strong grasp of core web concepts and browser behavior. * Demonstrated GUI experience, with a strong eye for detail in layout, typography, and visual consistency. * Experience with version control systems, particularly Git, and collaborative development workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews). * Familiarity with performance optimization techniques and tools for diagnosing front\-end bottlenecks. * Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code following industry best practices. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to debug complex front\-end issues across environments. * Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross\-functional agile teams. * Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. #### **The Role** The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship. This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi\-day engagements. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment\-based visas such as H\-1B, F\-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment. #### **What You'll Do** * Build AI\-powered agents and tools end\-to\-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to production * Design and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval\-augmented workflows * Define evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain\-specific * Work directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production quality * Partner with core engineering teams to generalize client\-specific work into product features * Contribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines) * Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance #### **Who You Are** * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language) * Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputs * Comfort with SQL for data exploration and building data\-grounded AI workflows * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) * You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified. * A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate. * You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code does * BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience #### **Nice to Have** * Experience building agentic systems (multi\-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows) * Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment) * Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting) * Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container\-based deployments * Experience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality **Our Values** * **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. * **Build Together \-** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. * **Champion Our Clients \-** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. * **Drive Innovation \-** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. * **Embrace Learning \-** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

jobs.title: Core Agent Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description The Opportunity Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Product, you will be a key technical contributor for Adobe's up\-and\-coming AI\-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together for hundreds of millions of creators. You will own hands\-on buildout of the agent across the full stack and across Adobe's target platforms, from desktop and mobile to web and embedded surfaces. You will help reshape the way the team works in the age of agentic engineering. And you will be getting in on the ground floor to help shape the team and its practices. This is a rare opportunity to build the engineering foundations of Adobe's soon\-to\-be most visible AI product — from model integration and agentic reasoning patterns, to production infrastructure and cross\-platform delivery. The right person brings deep, hands\-on full\-stack expertise, proven experience shipping agentic systems, a genuine enthusiasm for transforming how engineering itself is done with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the craft to write production\-quality code that holds up over time. What you'll do Own full\-stack implementation across Adobe's Agentic Product — from LLM integration and agentic reasoning layers, to API surfaces, client runtimes, and platform\-specific delivery on desktop, mobile, and web. **Contribute to the production buildout of the agent:** translating prototype\-quality capabilities into robust, scalable, maintainable systems that meet Adobe's quality and reliability bar for a large, diverse audience. Drive hands\-on implementation of high\-leverage components — including model orchestration, tool use, multi\-step task execution, context and memory management, and agent evaluation infrastructure. Champion the adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices — using tools like Claude Code, Codex, and emerging agentic development platforms to accelerate implementation, raise code quality, and fundamentally change how the team ships. Model new workflows where AI is a first\-class collaborator in the development process. **Contribute to developer experience:** tooling, local development loops, CI/CD ergonomics, and the scaffolding that lets a team move fast and confidently in a fast\-moving AI product environment. Stay current with the model capabilities ecosystem, evaluating new LLM approaches and frameworks, and contributing recommendations on when and how to adopt them. Help build and maintain the evaluation and quality framework for agent behavior — the evals, benchmarks, and systematic feedback loops that allow the team to measure progress and catch regressions as capabilities evolve. Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to translate product ambitions into technically grounded delivery — surfacing constraints early, proposing implementation options, and ensuring scope is set based on accurate technical understanding. Collaborate across Adobe's platform, infrastructure, data, and security teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built on a foundation that supports guardrails, data protection, observability, and the operational requirements of a product at Adobe's scale. Raise the bar for peers on the team by generating excellent code, driving high\-signal code review processes, and sharing technical knowledge in agentic engineering. What you'll need to succeed Solid, hands\-on experience with large language models — including practical fluency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval\-augmented generation, and the operational realities of running LLM\-backed systems in production. **Experience building and shipping agentic systems:** tool use, multi\-step reasoning, agent orchestration frameworks, memory and context persistence, and the failure modes that emerge at each layer. Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and a track record of integrating these into real development workflows. Enthusiasm for pushing the boundary of what AI\-augmented engineering can look like at the frontier. Full\-stack engineering depth sufficient to contribute across the agent's entire surface area — including backend services, client SDKs, and platform\-specific integration patterns for Adobe's target platforms. **Strong engineering craft:** readable, well\-structured, production\-quality code; opinionated views on testing, local dev ergonomics, and the scaffolding that helps a team stay productive as a codebase grows. Clear communication skills — able to discuss technical tradeoffs with PM leads and senior technical stakeholders, flag issues early, and collaborate effectively across disciplines. Comfort operating in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment where the underlying models, frameworks, and user expectations   growth. jobs.title: Head of Engineering, AI Platform
jobs.description: **About AiDASH** AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com. The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\. Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together! **The Role** AiDASH is scaling fast — our satellite and AI\-powered utility products are set for aggressive customer growth over the next two years, and engineering is at the heart of making it happen. We're hiring a **Head of Engineering, AI Platform** to join our engineering leadership team in a newly created role. In this role, you'll build our new Data Inference AI Pipeline team from the ground up to support our rapidly growing customer base. This is a rare opportunity to build both the team and the system from scratch: you'll shape the architecture, culture, and hiring bar of a new AI team from day one, and own the pipeline that powers our AI products as our customer base grows. In this role, you will report to the VP of Engineering and have real ownership over technical decisions, team design, and engineering practices. Our pending acquisition by Schneider Electric will accelerate our mission as we bring our combined offering to our joint customer base, and the systems you build will power outcomes at an even greater scale. **Location:** Palo Alto, CA (hybrid/2 days per week in the office) **How** **you'll** **make an impact:** * **Build the Data Inference AI Pipeline team** + Define the team's charter, headcount plan, and hiring bar, and make the first several hires, bringing in talent from both within AiDASH and outside + Architect a multimodal data inference pipeline that scales with customer growth while keeping compute and infrastructure cost per inference efficient + Build the model training and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) feedback loops that keep our AI accurate and continuously improving + Establish strong engineering practices from day one, including code review, testing, on\-call, and release process * **Lead and grow the team** + Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers and leads, and manage performance as needed, building a high\-performing, high\-ownership culture + Partner with Product, Data Science, and Design to shape roadmap trade\-offs and sequencing + Own technical decisions within your team's scope, and partner with the VP of Engineering on cross\-org architecture decisions + Give the leadership a clear, reliable view of progress, risks, and resourcing needs **What success looks like in your first 6 months:** * The Data Inference AI Pipeline team is staffed with its first core hires, from within AiDASH and outside, and running on an architecture that scales with growing data volume without a proportional rise in infrastructure cost * The team has clear ownership, a steady delivery cadence, and visible engineering practices (code review, on\-call, release process) in place * Leadership has a clear, reliable read on the team's progress, risks, and resourcing needs **What** **we're** **looking for:** **Minimum Qualifications** * 10\+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3\-5\+ years leading engineering teams (managing managers or senior ICs) * A track record of building a team or system from scratch, not just scaling an existing one * Hands\-on experience architecting data/ML pipelines at scale, with a strong grasp of throughput, latency, and cost\-efficiency trade\-offs for inference workloads * Experience building modern AI systems, including reasoning frameworks, agentic capabilities, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), self\-correction loops, and memory and state management, that shipped to production for real customers, not as research or internal proof\-of\-concept work * Strong background in cloud\-native, multi\-tenant SaaS architectures (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices) * Proven ability to improve delivery predictability and accelerate onboarding and go\-live for enterprise customers * Confidence owning technical decisions within a defined scope, while partnering with a VP on strategy and resourcing * Experience managing global, distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones * High ownership mindset, low ego, and a collaborative spirit, with a passion for building teams that do their best work * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote\-sensing pipelines * A background in utilities, energy, or infrastructure * Experience hiring and scaling a net\-new engineering team in a high\-growth (Series B/C) startup environment * Open\-source contributions, technical certifications, or published engineering writing **What you'll love:** * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children * Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles * 401(k) Plan: Begin contributing after two months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered * Parental Leave: Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers * Generous Vacation Policy: Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you * Winter Break: From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy time with family and friends! We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work. We offer a competitive annual pay range of $300,000 to $330,000 for this full\-time position, which includes a base salary and bonus based on performance. This range reflects the anticipated annual pay range (base \+ bonus) for new hires. We strive to ensure our compensation packages are equitable and aligned with industry standards. Your recruiter can share more about compensation during the hiring process. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs. Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy\-policy/

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description: **About Airwallex** ------------------- Airwallex is the AI\-native financial operating system for a real\-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85\+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific. We're co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder\-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. **How you'll make impact** -------------------------- Growth Engineering at Airwallex is building an AI\-native platform that powers customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. We're developing scalable infrastructure, intelligent decision systems, and automation capabilities that connect product, sales, and marketing to drive measurable business outcomes. As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll play a critical role in defining the technical architecture and building the foundational systems that power Growth at scale. * **Drive technical strategy and architecture** for critical Growth Engineering platforms, influencing engineering decisions across multiple teams and leading complex initiatives from design through production. * **Build scalable backend infrastructure**, including high\-performance APIs, distributed services, event\-driven architectures, and real\-time data processing systems that power growth automation and intelligent decision\-making. * **Develop AI\-native platform capabilities** that transform customer signals, product usage, lifecycle events, and business context into personalized experiences, next\-best actions, and automated workflows. * **Design for reliability and scale**, establishing strong foundations for performance, fault tolerance, observability, security, and operational excellence. * **Translate ambiguous business challenges into technical solutions**, partnering with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and engineering teams to deliver measurable outcomes. * **Elevate engineering excellence** through architectural leadership, technical mentorship, thoughtful design reviews, and hands\-on contributions to complex engineering problems. US: You'll work from our San Francisco office three days a week. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- ### **Essentials** * **8\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, with substantial experience in backend development and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * **Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Kotlin, or a comparable backend language**, with solid computer science fundamentals, object\-oriented design skills, and experience with frameworks such as FastAPI or Spring Boot. * **Deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture**, including domain\-driven design, event\-driven architectures, scalability, reliability, and modern engineering practices. * **Proven Staff\-level technical leadership**, with a track record of driving complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives, shaping architectural decisions, and mentoring other engineers. * **Strong ownership and execution skills**, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, make pragmatic technical tradeoffs, and deliver high\-quality solutions from design through production operations. ### **Preferred** * Experience building growth platforms, experimentation systems, customer segmentation engines, marketing automation, or data\-intensive applications. * Experience building AI\-powered applications or agentic workflows, including LLM integration, tool orchestration, evaluation, and production observability. * Experience with real\-time data pipelines, streaming technologies, or large\-scale event processing. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP, containerization, and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with production observability and reliability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or equivalent. * Experience designing integrations across product, analytics, CRM, marketing, or other enterprise systems. * Experience in high\-growth technology companies, fintech, payments, or regulated environments. **You'll thrive here if** ------------------------- * **You have high agency.** You proactively identify high\-impact opportunities, shape technical direction, and drive execution without waiting for detailed instructions. * **You think in systems.** You build reusable platforms and abstractions that enable multiple teams to move faster rather than optimizing for one\-off solutions. * **You're pragmatic and outcome\-oriented.** You balance long\-term architectural quality with speed of delivery, and measure success by real\-world impact. * **You're comfortable with ambiguity.** You make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information, validate assumptions quickly, and adapt as you learn. * **You lead through influence.** You communicate clearly, challenge ideas constructively, mentor other engineers, and build alignment across teams. * **You balance autonomy with collaboration.** You know when to make decisions independently and when broader alignment is essential. * **You thrive in a global environment.** You're comfortable collaborating across distributed teams and time zones, including APAC, EMEA, and the US. **Learn more about your team** ------------------------------ Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI\-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers. You’ll build high\-traffic platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next\-best actions, and measurable incremental value. The work spans both human \+ AI and autonomous operating models: AI\-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails. The challenge is to combine consumer\-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI\-native global financial platform grows. **Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters** -------------------------------------------------------------- *To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.* *Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Compensation Range: $163K \- $279K

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Manager – Software Engineering** As a Software Engineering Manager, you will lead and manage a team of back\-end developers that work on all server\-side aspects of smart home security. Our mandate is very broad and includes but not limited to processing security events, monitoring station signaling, testing\-automation and integrating a wide and diverse set of devices with the Alarm.com connected ecosystem. This role works in domains with a strong focus on reliability and uptime. Our software development includes working on backend services, websites, and database design that make\-up our whole ecosystem. You will have the opportunity to manage projects that span a variety of technical areas while also managing a team of 5\-7 software engineers, provide technical mentorship to the developers on your team, deliver projects, set project timelines, and generate work for your team. Typical projects will involve diverse technologies. You'll have the opportunity to work across various technical areas using the latest technologies while using Agile development methods. Strong multi\-tasking skills and the ability to self\-learn are must\-have attributes. You will be collaborating with stake holders across multiple offices, strong communication skills a must. Very few small companies innovate and develop across such a broad range of technologies as Alarm.com. This position is ideal for the candidate who seeks a small, friendly company culture where one can work closely with smart and highly productive people across a very interesting spectrum of wireless, software, and hardware/device technologies to develop outstanding consumer products. **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?** * **Collaborate with outstanding people**: We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers. You will be able to learn something new and impart your knowledge across the team. * **Make an immediate impact**: You can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You will be empowered to perform as soon as you join the team! * **Work with real stuff:** You will write code that interacts with the physical world. You'll be able to see your work in action with the numerous IoT devices we work with every day. * **Gain well rounded experience**: Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business. * **Be Empowered**: We don't want to micro\-manage you. We barely want to tell you what to do. We want you to own stuff and bring your experience to make those products best in class. * **Work with the latest technologies**: You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT and SaaS technology. Our tech stack includes C\#, .NET, SQL Server, Kafka, and Kubernetes * **Focus on fun**: Alarm.com places high value on our team culture. We even have a committee dedicated to hosting a stand\-out holiday party, happy hours, and other fun corporate events. * **Alarm.com** values working together and collaborating in person. Our employees work from the office 4 days a week. * Other duties as assigned. **WHAT DO YOU NEED?** * Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field or equivalent work experience * 8\+ years of professional software development experience * 3\+ years of professional experience managing and mentoring a team of developers * Strong object\-oriented programming skills; C\# a plus * Experience with database design and development * Knowledge of networking concepts, principles, and technologies * Experience working with physical systems * Experience with agentic AI software development practices * Experience developing scalable service\-oriented architectures. * Ability to communicate effectively with engineers and non\-engineers alike. * Experience hiring, developing and managing a diverse and talented team of engineers * Proven track record delivering large scale, cross\-functional projects on time and in a high\-quality manner, exploring technical feasibility and prioritization tradeoffs as well as process improvements along the way. Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration\-related support, is not available for this position at this time. **WHY WORK FOR** **ALARM.COM****?** * **Collaborate with outstanding people:** We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers. * **Make an immediate impact:** New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team! * **Gain well rounded experience:** Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business. * **Community and Camaraderie:** One of our core values is to 'Keep It Fun,' which to us means fostering a strong sense of community. Our culture is built on collaboration and connection, where we celebrate our successes and believe that a positive, engaging environment is key to doing our best work. * **Alarm.com** **values working together and collaborating in person. Our employees work from the office** **4 days a week****.** **COMPANY INFO** Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. Millions of homeowners and businesses rely on Alarm.com's technology to secure, monitor, and manage their environments from anywhere. Our comprehensive suite of solutions—including security, video surveillance, access control, active shooter detection, intelligent automation, energy management, and wellness—is delivered exclusively through a trusted network of thousands of professional service providers and commercial integrators across North America and worldwide. Alarm.com's common stock is traded on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ALRM. Alarm.com delivers serious security for serious people. For more information, please visit www.alarm.com. **COMPANY BENEFITS** Our total rewards package is designed to support you holistically—in your health, your finances, and your life outside of work. The package includes medical plans with company subsidies, a Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution, and a 401(k) with an employer match. We encourage a healthy work\-life balance with paid vacation that increases with tenure, paid holidays, wellness time, and paid maternity and bonding leave. To complete the package, we also provide company\-paid disability and life insurance, all within a collaborative and casual work environment. **Alarm.com** **is an Equal Opportunity Employer** In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government\-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision. **Notice To Third Party Agencies:** Alarm.com understands the value of professional recruiting services. However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position. In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third\-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you. If you are interested in working with Alarm.com, please email your company information and standard agreement to RecruitingPartnerships@Alarm.com.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (MANTL)
jobs.description: Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data\-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action. Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best \& Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy \- transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary \- come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S. As a remote\-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title. Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn! The Staff Software Engineer is a senior individual contributor who sets technical direction and delivers complex, cross\-team software capabilities across Alkami's digital banking platform. This role turns ambiguous product and business needs into scalable system designs, robust APIs, secure integrations, and intuitive experiences for financial institution administrators and digital banking users. The position partners with product, design, security, architecture, site reliability, data, and engineering teams to manage tradeoffs, improve reliability and developer effectiveness, and raise engineering standards through mentorship, reviews, and hands\-on delivery. The Staff Software Engineer is accountable for code quality and operational outcomes while influencing without direct people\-management responsibility. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Lead cross\-team delivery across experiences, services, APIs, data, and integrations. * Turn ambiguous product and business needs into technical strategies, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. * Set architecture across domains, document tradeoffs, and align teams on scalable, secure patterns. * Write and review tested code in TypeScript and Node.js, Python, Go, or similar languages for full stack applications * Design secure APIs, domain models, microservices, workflows, and data contracts. * Build for reliability and performance using error handling, observability, capacity planning, graceful degradation, and recovery patterns. * Lead third\-party integration design across authentication, privacy, data mapping, rate limits, retries, idempotency, monitoring, and vendor failures. * Drive cross\-team execution by managing dependencies, sequencing work, reducing risk, and making timely decisions when tradeoffs are unclear. * Mentor engineers through reviews, pairing, documentation, and hands\-on coaching. * Partner with product, design, security, architecture, site reliability, data, and engineering leaders to balance speed, experience, operability, and risk. * Lead incident response and root\-cause analysis, driving prevention and operational readiness. * Improve engineering effectiveness through reusable patterns, automated tests, CI/CD, developer tooling, and secure, human\-reviewed use of AI\-assisted tools. **Recommended Experience \& Education** **Minimum Years of Experience** Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience; or 6 years and an advanced degree. Education Level Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or another related field or equivalent work experience **Knowledge, Skills, \& Qualifications** **Required** * Experience delivering complex production software and leading technical direction across teams or domains * Deep proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, Python, Go, or similar languages for frontend and/or backend use, with the ability to work across the stack * Advanced system design across domain\-driven design, microservices, REST APIs, distributed systems, data stores, and integrations * Strong discipline in testing, error handling, observability, performance, security, and maintainable delivery * Ability to influence without authority, communicate architecture clearly, and mentor engineers through reviews and hands\-on guidance * Ability to turn ambiguity into pragmatic plans, manage cross\-team dependencies, and drive measurable outcomes * Experience in Agile, iterative delivery and improving team practices through feedback and continuous learning **Preferred** * Experience in SaaS, FinTech, digital banking, payments, or another regulated technology environment * Experience with ReactJS, NestJS, or comparable frontend and backend frameworks * Experience with GraphQL * Experience designing third\-party integrations for financial data, identity, or communications platforms * Experience with cloud platforms, containers, orchestration, infrastructure as code, or event\-driven architecture **Physical Demands** * Ability to lift a minimum of 5 pounds to a maximum of 10 pounds unassisted * Ability to stand, sit, stoop, walk, stretch, reach, and use full range of body motions * Manual dexterity as required for specific equipment The salary range for this position is: $140,000 \- $175,000**Cool Things to Know** ======================= **Not Just Any Company**: Alkami has an awesome diverse and inclusive environment. We have a FUN culture and offer great benefits, including remote\-first environment, unlimited paid time off, 401(k) with employer match, and more. **Work Authorization**: We cannot offer employment sponsorship at this time. Candidates must be eligible to work in the US for full\-time employment. **Recruiters**: We are not looking for outside recruiting firms to help us in this search. Thank you for understanding. **Pay Transparency:** As of January 1, 2023, new states and locales have enacted pay equity laws that require more pay transparency by employers in the following states: California, Colorado (effective January 1, 2021\), Connecticut, Maryland, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Rhode Island and Washington. **The Important Stuff** ======================= **Alkami Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind:** Alkami is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Alkami are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Alkami will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Alkami encourages applicants of all ages. **\#LI\-REMOTE**

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Operations Engineer (Full-time Hybrid, Morrisville, NC Based)
jobs.description: The AI Operations Engineer is responsible for the operational stability, reliability, and continuous performance of deployed AI models and services. The AI Operations Engineer ensures that AI solutions built are seamlessly operationalized, monitored, and maintained in production environments. By managing the lifecycle of AI applications, from automated deployment and infrastructure scaling to real\-time monitoring and incident response, this role ensures that AI\-driven capabilities remain secure, cost\-efficient, and highly available to support Alliance Health’s mission\-critical clinical and operational workflows. **This position is full\-time hybrid. Selected candidate must come into the Home office in Morrisville on Wednesdays, for business meeting as needed, reside within 50 miles of Morrisville North Carolina.** **Responsibilities \& Duties** AI Model Deployment \& Infrastructure Operations * Deploy, monitor, support, and maintain AI models in production environments, ensuring seamless integration with existing enterprise systems * Develop and manage automated CI/CD and MLOps pipelines for model packaging, testing, deployment, rollback, and full lifecycle management * Architect and manage hybrid cloud\-AI environments that support multi\-model, multi\-agent, and edge AI deployments * Implement infrastructure automation using scripting, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and configuration management to ensure scalable and resilient AI services * Design and optimize AI infrastructure in collaboration with server, cloud, and platform engineering teams to support high\-performance workloads AI System Observability \& Reliability * Maintain comprehensive observability across all AI systems through advanced logging, metrics, performance monitoring, tracing, and alerting * Detect and respond to critical operational risks, including model drift, performance degradation, and training\-serving skew * Define and monitor key operational metrics such as availability, latency, throughput, token consumption, model cost, and task\-completion rates * Provide ongoing technical support, including rapid incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for AI platforms and user\-facing services * Improve platform reliability, resilience, and cost\-efficiency through continuous tuning, automation, and operational improvements AI Governance, Security \& Compliance * Partner with Cybersecurity, Risk, and AI Governance teams to implement and evidence required security controls * Implement threat\-resistant AI infrastructure and enforce security frameworks to protect against data exfiltration and unauthorized access * Ensure compliance with regulatory obligations and internal policies by maintaining model version control, audit trails, and lineage/traceability for data, prompts, and outputs * Enforce data governance patterns, including privacy controls, data masking, and the secure management of secrets and identity across AI workflows Operational Enablement \& Collaboration * Enable self\-service platform consumption for AI Engineers and Data Scientists via standardized APIs, reusable pipelines, templates, and documentation * Collaborate across divisions to align technical implementations with mission\-critical business objectives and reduce operational disruption * Communicate technical constraints such as latency, cost, and performance effectively to business stakeholders and technical leads * Evaluate emerging AI tools, frameworks, and infrastructure approaches to determine their operational fit, supportability, and long\-term value for the organization * Develop and maintain essential technical documentation, including runbooks, architecture diagrams, and standard operational procedures User and Technical Support \& Troubleshooting * Provide hands\-on technical assistance to resolve issues arising from the integration of AI models into existing business workflows and systems * Perform root cause analysis for technical failures in AI pipelines, We are looking for experienced engineers who are comfortable owning services end to end: API design, data modeling, deployments, and production debugging.
