authorization, and IdP services. * Create and evolve shared libraries and SDKs. * Integrate with identity providers and keep login and access policies working reliably across products. * Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot identity services in production. * Help modernize legacy authentication patterns as the platform evolves. * Own work end to end, from requirements through delivery and follow\-up. * Collaborate with other engineering teams on identity and access integration. * Maintain high code quality, write tests, and participate in code reviews. * Help investigate incidents and bugs, including on\-call rotation. #### **Who You Are (must\-haves)** * You have **5\+ years of experience** writing code in strongly\-typed languages, with at least **one year of experience in Go**. * You have experience building web applications with **React and TypeScript**. * You have worked with relational databases before \- we use **PostgreSQL**, but we are not particularly picky about this one as long as you have a solid grasp on the fundamentals. * You have worked at a **startup** before \- you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre\-existing processes or documentation. * You are not afraid of **taking a task from start to finish** \- gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results. * You have worked at least 3 years on **systems at scale**. #### **Who You Might Be (nice\-to\-haves)** * You know what a **JWT** token is, and how **OpenID Connect** and **SAML** work. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Ads runs one of the largest real\-time decision systems in the world. To meet advertiser goals, we process \>4 million ad requests per second, and this team decides which of them are worth the compute. Generative AI and LLMs are tools you reach for when they help, not the point of the work. The impact also reaches beyond Amazon: we donated the Dynamic Traffic Engine (DTE) to the IAB Tech Lab as an open\-source framework that lets demand\-side platforms signal which bid requests they value, so supply\-side platforms send fewer wasteful ones and QPS waste drops across the whole programmatic supply chain. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, GEOS Science Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- This role sits in Business Innovation and AI (BIA), part of Global Ops Enterprise Services (GOES), and works on the Real Estate Optimization System (REOS). REOS decides where Amazon builds. It models the supply chain from fulfillment centers through sort centers and delivery stations to the customer as a time\-space network over a 20\-year horizon, and ranks candidate sites on total network cost — transportation, labor, real estate and unmet demand — rather than on rent alone. Alongside the core engine we are building a family of AI tools that source candidate properties from across the market, assemble and validate the data behind a study, and generate the cost briefs that explain a recommendation, and we are extending the same optimization to zip\-code\-level Sub Same Day siting. You will work alongside scientists, and with partner teams in GOES Portfolio Management, Capacity Planning and Finance. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to own the optimization models behind REOS. You will formulate the models that decide where Amazon builds, engineer the solution methods that make them tractable at network scale, lead the initiatives that extend them, and take the recommendations to the Development Managers and Finance partners who act on them. The work is hands\-on and close to the decision: your models become the basis for real capital commitments. The people who make those commitments are your customers. You will work with Development Managers, Capacity Planning teams and Finance partners to understand what they need, build and run the model that answers it, deliver the result, and explain what it recommends in terms they can act on and defend. Reporting to the Science Manager, you will own the technical approach on the models you build and mentor the scientists working alongside you. Key job responsibilities * Formulate and solve large\-scale optimization models — linear, mixed\-integer, network flow and stochastic or robust variants — that recommend site locations and network topology at lowest total cost. * Select and engineer the solution methodology — decomposition, column generation, cutting planes, relaxations and heuristics — so models solve reliably at production scale and within business timelines. * Own the modeling assumptions and the cost structure behind them, and make the trade\-offs explicit and defensible to Finance. * Implement and productionize models in Python against commercial and open\-source solvers, with the data pipelines and validation that keep them trustworthy, and maintain them as the network and the data change. * Engage customers directly: elicit the real problem, translate it into a formulation, run scenarios with them, deliver results, and explain what the model recommends and why. * Lead initiatives end to end, apply AI tooling to the science workflow, and raise the bar for the scientists around you through design review and mentoring. A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing experiment results and refining a machine learning model before syncing with engineers on a production integration plan. After lunch, you could be whiteboarding a new algorithmic approach with colleagues from product and science teams, then drafting a research document that outlines your methodology and findings. You will regularly present your work to leadership, participate in science reviews, and stay connected to the latest research in your field to inform your next initiative. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Building Connectivity Engineering
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Every Amazon data center runs on networks no customer ever sees: the corporate network that engineers and tools use to reach the fleet, the segmented networks that cameras and badge readers ride on, the network for building systems, and the isolated controls networks behind power and cooling. Building Connectivity Engineering (BCE), part of AWS Networking, owns the design and operation of those fabrics in every Amazon data center, and builds them into more than 100 new sites a year. Building Connectivity Software Systems (BCSS) is the software team inside BCE. We build the controller for these networks. It holds the intended state of every fabric as a model, computes everything a new site needs (addresses, routing identifiers, ports, cabling, device registration) before a technician plugs in the first rack, renders device configuration from the model, and drives the deployment and monitoring platforms that AWS Networking already runs. The first production release went live in September 2026 and took a site build that used to need about twenty hand\-run steps down to one request. Most of the controller is still ahead of us. We are hiring Software Development Engineers to build the next releases: a versioned model of intended network state with full history and rollback, device configuration rendered from that model instead of written by hand, and the orchestration that takes a site from a plan to live traffic with one physical touch. You will design services, write the design documents for them, build them on AWS, prove them in shadow mode against real sites, and run them in production. The network engineers who hold the fabric knowledge are your partners; your code is the engine their models run on. Key job responsibilities * Design and build services in AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, EventBridge, CDK), modeled with Smithy and deployed through pipelines you own. * Write the design document for what you build. Every engineer on this team writes designs; it is a core part of the job, and seniority is not the gate. * Integrate with the systems of record in AWS Networking (IP address management, device registry, routing\-policy store, configuration store and release, deployment, cabling plans), and find out what each contract actually does, against the real service, before committing to a date. * Prove correctness in shadow mode: compute what the automation would do for a site, diff it against what engineers did by hand, and get to zero discrepancies before any cutover. * Own what you ship in production: metrics, alarms, runbooks, and a turn in the team's on\-call rotation, which covers the new services and the ones the team inherited. * Keep fabric knowledge out of the code. New fabrics, site types and rack types arrive as models the network engineers author; your job is to make the second one cost a configuration change. * Estimate honestly: size work by how novel it is and how many systems outside the team it touches, raise partner asks early, and say what is unknown. A day in the life You pick up a card to add a new reservation type to the allocation service. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Application deadline: Oct 20, 2026 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon's Data Center Bridge (DC Bridge) organization builds and operates the software that runs AWS's worldwide data centers. The DC Console team is hiring a senior, frontend\-leaning full\-stack engineer to set the technical direction for the platform that lets every builder in DC Bridge ship data center operator experiences, not just the team that owns the console. You should be a senior engineer with real depth in modern TypeScript, React, Rust or equivalent programming language. Browser fundamentals and high\-volume real\-time UX, and a track record of leading the design of systems other teams build on. Half of this role is platform engineering (build systems, deployment, and the mechanics of how frontend code gets to a browser), so you should be comfortable owning architecture that spans repositories, pipelines and teams you don't manage. You take personal pride in interfaces operators trust during an incident, and you raise the engineering bar of the people around you. Key job responsibilities * Own the architecture of the platform that lets engineering teams across the organization ship features into a shared operator console (independent packages, independent pipelines, composed into one product at runtime) and write the design documents that set its direction. * Define the contract between the console shell and the teams that build on it: navigation, routing, page registration and shared services, versioned so partner teams can upgrade on their own schedule. * Lead the resolution of the hardest cross\-origin problems a federated frontend creates (authenticated module loading, edge authentication, content security policy, per\-stage isolation, and graceful fallback when the module registry is unreachable) and make the security trade\-offs explicit. * Drive self\-service onboarding end to end, so a partner team gets a working module, account, CDN and pipeline in one step, including teams that bring their own backend. Measure time to first deploy and drive it down. * Set the operational bar for the platform: per\-team health metrics, alarms, paging and user reports, so each feature team owns its own module's quality without owning the shell. * Plan and lead the migration of existing pages out of the monolith, sequencing work across teams and keeping every rollout reversible behind feature flags. * Guide the design of real\-time visualizations of power and cooling data that operators rely on during site events. * Influence partner teams through design reviews, security reviews and office hours, so a federated frontend doesn't fragment into ten different products. * Mentor engineers on the team, review their designs and code, and help grow the next set of technical leads. knowledge, and help colleagues across IT and the firm put it to work * A power user of AI tools such as ChatGPT/Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and Wispr Flow, with a drive to reshape how IT functions * with working knowledge of cloud infrastructure * Low ego, high empathy: you listen to different perspectives, question your assumptions, and use evidence to find the best solutions * High agency: you controls, API credentials, and third\-party integrations * Ability to analyze usage, cost, and outcome data and translate findings into practical recommendations to improve AI usage and efficiency * Strong communication skills: clear writing and polished public speaker and presenter The anticipated salary range for this role is between $189,000 \- $221,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope. This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave. **a16z culture** ---------------- * We do only first class business and only in a first class way * We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business * We believe in the future and bet the firm that way * We are all different, we recognize that, and we win * We celebrate the good times * We do it for the team * We play to win At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. jobs.title: Cleaning Validation Engineer
jobs.description: **Applied Laboratories** is seeking a **Cleaning Validation Engineer** to develop, execute, and maintain cleaning validation programs within a GMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for validation protocol development, hold\-time studies, contamination control, data analysis, investigations, and regulatory compliance activities. The **Cleaning Validation Engineer** will collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Microbiology, Engineering, and Validation teams to maintain compliant cleaning processes and support production readiness. **Essential Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Create and review cleaning validation protocols, risk assessments, validation reports, and master planning documents. * Design and execute cleaning validation studies involving swab, rinse, total organic carbon (TOC), chemical, and microbiological sampling. * Develop and justify acceptance limits using risk\-based and scientifically sound methodologies. * Perform dirty hold\-time, clean hold\-time, and sanitization hold\-time studies and establish validated operating limits. * Compile, analyze, trend, and report validation data. * Investigate deviations, out\-of\-specification results, and cleaning failures. * Provide technical support for cleaning process improvements, clean\-in\-place systems, contamination control, and troubleshooting activities. * Support recovery studies, analytical method suitability, and validation of cleaning verification methods. * Lead change\-control assessments, periodic reviews, and continued verification of validated cleaning processes. * Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Microbiology, Engineering, and Validation teams to maintain compliance and production readiness. * Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, corrective and preventive action activities, and responses to audit observations. * Review equipment designs and qualification activities to support cleanability and contamination prevention. * Ensure compliance with FDA, EMA, GMP, and company quality\-system requirements. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in a science or engineering discipline, or equivalent experience. * Experience in a GMP\-regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. * Strong knowledge of cleaning validation, contamination control, cleaning chemistry, and manufacturing processes. * Experience conducting dirty hold\-time, clean hold\-time, and sanitization hold\-time validation studies. * Knowledge of swab, rinse, TOC, chemical, and microbiological testing methodologies. * Experience with risk assessments, matrix validation approaches, and worst\-case product evaluations. * Ability to perform data analysis, root\-cause investigations, and CAPA development. * Knowledge of FDA, EMA, Annex 1, and industry guidance related to cleaning validation. * Excellent communication, technical writing, and project\-management skills. * Experience supporting regulatory inspections and audits is preferred. * Experience training and mentoring personnel is preferred. * Ability to troubleshoot complex manufacturing cleaning systems is preferred. **Work Environment** -------------------- This position may work in laboratory, manufacturing, production, warehouse, and office environments based on assigned responsibilities. The role requires compliance with safety, quality, cGMP, sanitation, and personal protective equipment requirements. The position may involve standing, walking, bending, reaching, fine\-motor work, lifting or carrying materials, and accessing production or warehouse areas. Employees may be exposed to noise, odors, powders, liquids, chemicals, and slippery surfaces. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Why Applied Laboratories?** ----------------------------- At Applied Laboratories, we are committed to producing quality products while maintaining a safe, collaborative, and compliant workplace. This position offers the opportunity to apply scientific and engineering expertise, influence critical validation programs, and work across multiple functions to support reliable pharmaceutical manufacturing.

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer, Finance & Operations
jobs.description: ### **Who We Are** At Apptegy, we are more than a tech company; we are partners dedicated to transforming how schools communicate and shape the future of education. Your work here will directly empower districts to share their stories, engage their communities, and celebrate student success. We're a team of thoughtful, high\-performing individuals committed to making a tangible impact. If you're looking for a dynamic environment where you'll be supported with exceptional mentorship and resources to grow your career, come build with us.**The Role** ------------ We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer who thrives on building durable, fast\-moving solutions that unlock operational efficiency and connect people, processes, and tools across the functions that run the company. In this role, you will serve as a hands\-on builder and cross\-functional partner, working with leaders and process owners across finance and operations to design and implement AI\-powered workflows that make our teams more effective. You will focus on using tools like Claude and Claude Code, N8N, Glean, and direct API work against NetSuite, Salesforce, and Snowflake to automate, integrate, and scale how we work without needing to reinvent the wheel. This is not a traditional engineering role. It is ideal for someone who loves solving complex problems at the intersection of technology and business operations, a true solutions engineer who is just as comfortable connecting APIs as sitting with an accountant to learn why a process works the way it does. You will also work closely with the AI Champions and builders already embedded across the business to align efforts, ensure adoption, and share best practices company\-wide. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Find the work** by partnering with process owners to map how work actually happens today, including the exceptions, the workarounds, and the steps that only live with a user. Much of the highest\-value work will be work nobody filed a request for. * **Size it before you build it** by defining the metric and stating the expected result up front, whether that is hours removed, cycle time, error rate, or cost avoided, then measuring the actual result once it ships. * **Build and automate smart workflows** using AI agents and skills, API integrations, SQL and Python, workflow orchestration, and scripting against the systems where the work lives, taking each one from prototype to production. * **Own the connective layer** by moving data cleanly between NetSuite, Salesforce, DealHub, Workday, Greenhouse, Snowflake, and the rest of the stack through APIs, webhooks, and pipelines, including the reconciliations that prove both sides agree. * **Multiply the builders already in each function** by publishing the shared primitives, patterns, and templates they need, so capability compounds instead of queueing behind one person, and by maintaining the automation inventory, including retiring what no longer earns its place. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 2\-4\+ years of experience in a technical, operations, or automation\-focused role such as solutions engineering, business systems, RevOps, or technical program management.. * Working proficiency in at least one scripting language, plus experience integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and data flows. * Hands\-on production experience with modern AI tooling such as Claude / Claude Code, Cursor, agent frameworks, MCP, or N8N, and informed opinions about when each is the wrong choice. * Real depth in at least one enterprise business system and its data model. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills with the ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable technical solutions. * A builder's mindset that is creative, curious, and eager to experiment with new technologies to drive efficiency. * Excellent communication skills and comfort working with multiple stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment. **What Makes You Stand Out** ---------------------------- * Experience in B2B SaaS, EdTech, or fintech industries. * Familiarity with scripting or data tools such as Python, JavaScript, or SQL for customization and troubleshooting. * Experience across a finance stack or a GTM stack (ERP, CRM, CPQ, support platforms). * Understanding of AI\-powered automation systems and data enrichment tools. ### **Why Apptegy** Join a team that's committed to your success. At Apptegy, we're passionate about creating an environment where you can do your best work and find true fulfillment. We believe in investing in our people—both professionally and personally—because your well\-being drives our collective impact. US Employee Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage Retirement 401(k) with employer match Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) Mental Health Reimbursement Unlimited paid time off, including seasonal (December) company\-wide time off Paid parental and medical leave MX Employee Benefits: Private medical insurance for you and your dependents Life insurance 15 days Aguinaldo Vales de Despensa Fondo de Ahorro Caja de Ahorro Flexible paid time off policy Paid travel to/from Little Rock, Arkansas for Onboarding. Apptegy champions the thoughtful integration of AI to empower our teams and processes. As we seek to understand your individual capabilities and how you might contribute, we ask that all responses to application questions and during interviews are genuinely your own. jobs.title: Senior Perception Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. You will drive research and development of advanced perception systems that empower Apptronik's humanoid robots to understand and interact with complex human environments. Your work will focus heavily on SLAM, visual\-inertial odometry, world modeling, and learning\-based perception, alongside object detection and multi\-sensor fusion, creating the foundation for robust autonomy in real\-world settings. You will design and optimize deep learning models for real\-time detection, tracking, segmentation, scene understanding, and state estimation while contributing to scalable pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment. You will also integrate data from multiple modalities—Cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, and IMUs—into unified world models that support navigation, manipulation, safety, and human\-robot interaction. This role requires balancing research innovation with practical engineering to deliver deployable, high\-performance SLAM and perception stacks. You will collaborate across Reinforcement Learning teams, Platform Software team, and Systems teams, and contribute to shaping Apptronik's perception and autonomy roadmap. Your work will directly accelerate the development of humanoid robots that can safely operate in human spaces, adapt to dynamic environments, and extend human capability. ### **Core Responsibilities** * Lead Design, develop, and optimize perception and SLAM pipelines for humanoid robots, including visual\-inertial odometry, mapping, localization, object detection, tracking, segmentation, pose estimation, and scene understanding. * Develop multi\-sensor fusion frameworks that integrate cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, and IMUs for robust real\-time state estimation and mapping in dynamic human\-centered environments. * Contribute to scalable data pipelines, training infrastructure, and inference frameworks to accelerate model development, evaluation, and deployment. * Drive research and deployment of learning\-based models for SLAM, 3D scene understanding, and perception optimized for humanoid locomotion, manipulation, and human\-robot interaction. * Implement performance profiling, regression testing, and telemetry systems to ensure perception and SLAM modules meet strict latency, accuracy, and reliability requirements on edge devices. * Collaborate with planning, control, and hardware teams to define perception\-to\-action interfaces, ensuring real\-time compatibility with locomotion and manipulation pipelines. * Guide the integration of synthetic data (e.g., simulation frameworks like IsaacSim) with real\-world datasets to enhance model generalization and robustness. Contribute to best practices in code quality, model versioning, reproducibility, and deployment. * ### **Required Qualifications** * MS/PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or related field. * 3\- 5\+ years building and shipping perception and/or SLAM systems in robotics or real\-time vision applications. * Strong background in SLAM, VIO, probabilistic state estimation, and deep learning for computer vision. * Practical expertise in detection, segmentation, multi\-object tracking, 3D perception, and learning\-based mapping/localization. * Hands\-on experience with modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow) and computer vision / multi\-modal libraries such as OpenCV, Detectron2, YOLO, and foundation models for perception and language (e.g., SAM, CLIP, DINOv2, Flamingo). * Proficiency in Python and modern C\+\+, with strong software engineering fundamentals (version control, testing, CI/CD). * Deep understanding of 3D geometry, camera models, and probabilistic estimation (EKF/UKF, factor graphs, SLAM, VIO). * Experience deploying optimized perception or SLAM models on edge hardware (GPU/NPU/embedded platforms) under compute, latency, and thermal constraints. Track record of shipping ML/Perception or SLAM systems from R\&D into production robotics platforms. * ### **Preferred Experience** * Experience with humanoid robots, bipedal locomotion, and manipulation tasks. * Experience with modern SLAM frameworks (e.g., ORB\-SLAM, VINS, Kimera, Cartographer) or learning\-based SLAM systems. * Strong classical computer vision skills (geometry\-based methods, feature extraction) complementing learning\-based approaches. * Expertise in model acceleration, quantization, or compression (TensorRT, ONNX Runtime). * Familiarity with real\-time frameworks and middleware such as ROS 2, GStreamer, or zero\-copy pipelines. * Knowledge of synthetic data generation and domain adaptation techniques for training perception and SLAM models. * Contributions to open\-source robotics or vision software stacks. The annual salary range is $220,000 \- $250,000 * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. Apptronik provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

collaboration tools. + Understanding of data warehousing, analytics, and business intelligence solutions. * Cybersecurity \& Governance * + Understanding of cybersecurity best practices related to databases, AI platforms, and enterprise applications. + Knowledge of data governance, data privacy, retention, and compliance principles. + Experience implementing security and access controls across enterprise systems. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent organizational and project management skills. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and You’ll take real tickets from day one and own them from design through deployment. * **Growth with support.** Work alongside senior engineers who invest in your development through code reviews, pairing, and mentorship, so your technical skills grow with every sprint you ship. * **Engineering excellence.** Help keep our codebase healthy by writing unit and integration tests, contributing to CI/CD pipelines, triaging bugs, and improving the reliability and performance of the systems that power our analytics products. * **Collaborative partnership.** Work closely with product managers, data scientists, and fellow engineers to turn ideas into working software, and be a dependable voice in standups, design discussions, and cross\-functional projects. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and write clean, scalable, production code (our backend team primarily works in Python, SQL, SAS, and C\#; Compensation is flexible and tailored to your qualifications, relevant experience, and location of hire. But the perks don’t stop there — we’re committed to creating a workplace where people can do meaningful work, grow their careers, and still have a life outside the office. You’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, flexible work hours, a collaborative environment, and real opportunities for advancement. **Collaboration is in our DNA, and we thrive on the energy of working together — the spontaneous ideas, face\-to\-face teamwork, and culture you can only build in a room.** But we also value the focus and freedom that remote flexibility brings. That's why our Boulder, CO office and Raleigh, NC workspace run on a hybrid schedule (3 days in\-office, 2 days remote). **Need accommodations? jobs.title: GTM Recruiter
jobs.description: ### **Why AssemblyAI** AssemblyAI builds the best\-in\-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M\+ inference calls monthly, process 1M\+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion\+ end\-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we're looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. We are one of the most capital\-efficient AI companies on the planet \- with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue\-dense teams within the fastest\-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale \- processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth\-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow\-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. We're committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! **About the role:** ------------------- AssemblyAI is building the leading Voice AI infrastructure platform, and our go\-to\-market team is growing fast. We're looking for a GTM Recruiter to help us hire the Account Executives, BDRs, Customer Success, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Marketers who bring our models to developers and enterprises around the world. You'll own a portfolio of GTM reqs from first conversation to signed offer, working closely with our GTM Recruiting Lead and hiring managers across Sales, Customer Solutions, and Marketing. It's a high\-volume, high\-bar role: we're hiring a lot of people, and every one of them needs to be great. AI is one of the most competitive talent markets in tech. Great GTM people have a lot of options, and many of them aren't actively looking. This role is about finding them, starting real conversations, and showing them why AssemblyAI is worth the move. ### **What You'll Do** * Own full\-cycle recruiting for 5\-6 open GTM roles at a time, from intake and sourcing through offer and close * Source proactively through LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, referrals, communities, events, and AI\-assisted tools * Leverage modern AI tools to accelerate market research, craft tailored candidate messaging, and optimize workflow velocity * Run Zoom screens that assess for what matters in each role (pipeline generation, technical fluency, coachability) and share crisp, decision\-ready feedback * Partner with hiring managers to calibrate profiles, run interview loops in Greenhouse, and keep decisions moving * Manage offers end to end, including OTE and commission conversations, competing offers, and closing * Keep Greenhouse clean and current so the team can trust the funnel data * Deliver a candidate experience people talk about — fast, transparent, and human, whether or not they join * **You'll thrive here if** you enjoy building, move quickly, and like finding creative ways to solve hard hiring problems. ### **What You'll Need** * 3\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting, with significant experience hiring GTM roles (sales, customer success, marketing) at B2B SaaS, API, or developer\-tools companies, ideally at a high\-growth startup * A track record of hiring at volume (25\+ GTM hires a year) across levels, from SDR to senior AE * Strong passive sourcing skills: boolean search, creative channels, and comfort using AI tools to work faster * Curiosity about the AI landscape and a creative approach to reaching talent * Working knowledge of sales roles and comp (OTE, quota, ramp) and the ability to sell a role to sought\-after candidates * Experience with Greenhouse (or a similar ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, and a sourcing CRM like Juicebox * Organized and fast: you can run many processes in parallel without anyone falling through the cracks * Clear, warm communication and the ability to manage many searches at once **Pay Transparency:** AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer. Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range. The range provided applies to candidates located in the **United States**. For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process. **Compensation:** $120,000 \- $140,000 The expected cash compensation for this role is listed above. Our total compensation package includes competitive equity grants and 100% employer\-paid benefits. ### **AI to Interview:** If you're selected for an interview, please review this resource to better understand how AssemblyAI approaches the use of AI in our interview process. ### **GDPR privacy notice:** Candidates from the EU should review this job applicant privacy notice before applying. ### **Keep Exploring AssemblyAI:** Speech\-to\-text \| Streaming speech\-to\-text \| Speech Understanding \| LLM Gateway Try the Playground Our $50M Series C fundraise Check us out on YouTube!

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** -------------------- AssetMark is a leading strategic provider of innovative investment and consulting solutions serving independent financial advisors. We provide investment, relationship, and practice management solutions that advisors use in helping clients achieve wealth, independence, and purpose. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are seeking a strategic and technically strong Director of Service/Site Reliability Engineering and Observability to lead the reliability, monitoring, performance, and operational excellence of an enterprise environment hosted exclusively on Microsoft Azure. This leader will own the strategy and operating model for SRE and observability across both Azure Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service (IaaS) and native Azure managed services. The scope includes real\-time applications, APIs, virtual machines, containers, serverless workloads, integrations, databases, messaging platforms, data pipelines, and batch\-processing systems. The role requires a combination of enterprise leadership, Azure architecture knowledge, application\-development experience, production troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to build scalable practices that improve availability, performance, resilience, security, and customer experience. The Director will partner closely with application development, cloud infrastructure, security, architecture, data, service management, and business teams to ensure Azure\-hosted systems are observable, supportable, secure, resilient, and ready for production. At AssetMark, reliability is a first\-order expression of client obsession. Our SRE team plays a critical role in delivering the consistent, trusted technology experience that advisors depend on to run their businesses. **We can only consider candidates for this position who are able to accommodate a hybrid work schedule and are close to our Charlotte, NC office.** **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **SRE and Observability Strategy** * Define and execute an enterprise\-wide SRE and observability strategy aligned with business priorities, technology objectives, and risk\-management requirements. * Establish standards for metrics, logs, traces, events, dashboards, alerting, instrumentation, service ownership, telemetry quality, and data retention. * Develop a multi\-year roadmap for Azure observability platforms, reliability engineering, automation, resilience, and operational maturity. * Define service\-level indicators, service\-level objectives, service\-level agreements, error budgets, availability targets, latency objectives, and performance standards. * Establish operational\-readiness requirements for new applications, major releases, infrastructure changes, Azure service implementations, and third\-party integrations. * Evaluate and govern observability platforms, tools, vendors, integrations, licensing, access, security, and operating costs. * Promote consistent reliability and observability practices across Azure subscriptions, resource groups, environments, and service teams. ### **Azure Platform Reliability and Observability** * Lead reliability and observability practices across Azure IaaS and native Azure services, including virtual machines, scale sets, containers, serverless workloads, managed databases, storage, messaging, integration services, and data platforms. * Establish Azure\-native monitoring and telemetry standards using capabilities such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Azure Managed Grafana, Activity Logs, Resource Health, and Azure Service Health. * Ensure end\-to\-end visibility across application, infrastructure, platform, network, identity, security, data, and third\-party dependencies. * Define standards for Azure diagnostic settings, centralized logging, metric collection, distributed tracing, correlation IDs, alert routing, dashboard design, and telemetry retention. * Partner with cloud platform and architecture teams to improve the reliability of Azure subscriptions, management groups, networking, identity, access controls, policies, and shared services. * Ensure Azure\-hosted services are designed with appropriate availability, scalability, recoverability, monitoring, and operational support requirements. ### **Real\-Time Monitoring and Operational Excellence** * Lead the design and operation of real\-time monitoring for business\-critical applications, customer\-facing services, APIs, Azure infrastructure, databases, networks, messaging systems, and integrations. * Improve the quality, relevance, and actionability of alerts while reducing alert fatigue and unnecessary escalations. * Create executive, operational, and engineering dashboards that clearly communicate system health, business impact, trends, and emerging risks. * Establish effective on\-call, escalation, incident response, major incident management, and service\-restoration practices. * Participate in root\-cause analysis, problem management, post\-inc ngineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Measures of Success** ----------------------- Success in this role will include: * Improved availability, reliability, performance, and resilience of critical Azure\-hosted enterprise services. * Increased observability coverage across Azure IaaS, native Azure services, real\-time applications, integrations, and batch systems. * Faster detection, diagnosis, communication, and resolution of incidents. * Reduced alert noise, repeat incidents, manual effort, and operational risk. * Consistent adoption of SLOs, instrumentation, Azure monitoring standards, operational\-readiness requirements, and effective runbooks. * Higher batch\-processing success rates and improved on\-time completion of critical workloads. * Stronger collaboration between development, operations, cloud infrastructure, security, data, and business teams. * A mature, scalable, and high\-performing SRE and observability organization. *Compensation: The Base Salary range for this position is between $180,000\-$219,000\.* *This information reflects a base salary range that AssetMark reasonably expects to pay for the position based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, education, experience, and actual work location. This position will also be eligible for additional variable incentive compensation and competitive benefits.* *Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US to be considered. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.* \#LI\-hybrid \#LI\-TN1 **Who We Are \& What We Offer:** We are AssetMark, a company on the move, shaping the future of financial services. Growth is in our DNA. Every day, we combine technology, insight, and collaboration to create new possibilities for advisors, for our people and for our investors. At AssetMark your ideas matter; they’re heard, valued, and drive meaningful change. Join a team that sets new standards and creates space for you to thrive and do your best work. **Our Mission** Our mission is simple: to help our 10,500\+ financial advisors make a meaningful difference in their clients’ lives. We do this by combining powerful technology, holistic support, and expert consulting to help advisors run stronger, more efficient businesses. Backed by a comprehensive suite of investment solutions and a trust company that boasts of $150B\+ AUM, our platform empowers advisors to deliver exceptional service and an outstanding client experience. **Our Values** Heart. Client Success. Integrity. Respect. Excellence. Our values are how we show up every day. **We believe in:** * Leading with Heart, in truly making a difference in the lives of others: teammates, clients, investors and communities. * Obsessing over Client Success, bringing a relentless focus on what matters to clients that sets us apart and creates loyal, lasting relationships. * Unyielding Integrity, doing what’s right, always. Even when it’s hard. * Collective Respect, in being authentic, inclusive and valuing all voices while winning together. * Operating with Excellence, in learning fast, continuously improving, innovating and collaborating to find new and better solutions. These values shape our culture, guide our decisions, and define what it means to be part of the AssetMark family. **Our Culture \& Benefits** Our culture brings our mission and values to life. Here, we do what’s right, embrace diverse ideas, and innovate together. We also offer a wide range of benefits to support you and your family—because thriving at work starts with thriving in life. * Flex Time or Paid Time Off and Sick Time Off * 401K – 6% Employer Match * Medical, Dental, Vision – HDHP or PPO * HSA – Employer contribution (HDHP only) * Volunteer Time Off * Career Development / Recognition * Fitness Reimbursement * Hybrid Work Schedule As an Equal Opportunity Employer, AssetMark is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Clinical AI Translation & Solutions
jobs.description: **Location** Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States **Job ID** R\-261869 **Date posted** 14/10/2026 **Job Title: Director, AI Research** **Introduction to role:** Are you ready to turn complex clinical workflows into safe, measurable AI systems that accelerate trials and meaningfully improve patient outcomes? This role sits at the heart of how we design, conduct, monitor, and analyze clinical studies—translating real\-world operations into AI solutions that scale across the enterprise and deliver tangible business value. You will work side\-by\-side with clinical professionals and engineers to observe how work truly happens, identify where AI can safely help, and translate that understanding into working software. Do you thrive on building hands\-on prototypes, making disciplined scope decisions, and staying accountable through evaluation, deployment, adoption, and iteration? Your initial focus will include agentic workflows for clinical operations, with the expectation that reusable patterns will extend across Clinical Development. **Accountabilities:** * Portfolio Ownership: Own a portfolio of clinical AI workflows from discovery through deployment, adoption, and measurable benefit realization, ensuring early wins become platform capabilities. * Workflow Discovery and Design: Observe CRAs, site\-monitoring leaders, clinical operations, and medical stakeholders to convert pain points into product requirements, data contracts, acceptance criteria, and evaluation plans. * Hands\-on Prototyping and Delivery: Build and iterate prototypes in Python; contribute production code, review pull requests, inspect logs, reproduce failures, and collaborate with engineers to resolve them. * Agentic Workflow Design: Combine language models, deterministic services, enterprise tools, and human review with clear evidence provenance, uncertainty handling, and fail\-safe behavior. * Scope and Release Discipline: Separate demonstrations from production releases and distinguish non\-GxP workflows from regulated use, making transparent risk and lifecycle trade\-offs. * Outcome Measurement: Define outcome measures spanning technical performance, clinical usefulness, workflow quality, user adoption, cycle time, and operational impact. * Human\-in\-the\-Loop Testing: Lead testing with clinical experts and translate feedback into prioritized, testable product changes that increase trust and adoption. * Data Access and Governance: Partner with data\-product owners and platform teams to establish reliable access to clinical systems, documents, and structured data while protecting privacy and integrity. * Compliance by Design: Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory, Privacy, Security, and R\&D IT to embed GCP, GxP, validation, auditability, and lifecycle requirements from the outset. * Reuse and Build/Buy Decisions: Promote reuse of enterprise platforms, data products, agent components, and evaluation assets; identify when to build, buy, partner, or adapt. * Communication and Influence: Communicate product decisions, evidence, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs clearly to technical teams, clinical leaders, and executives. * Mentorship and Standards: Mentor scientists and engineers and raise the team’s standard for product thinking, technical execution, and clinical partnership. **Essential Skills/Experience:** * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline; or an MD, master’s degree, or equivalent experience supported by a strong computational track record. * 4 to 7 years of post\-PhD (or equivalent) experience delivering applied AI/ML or data products, including experience in healthcare, life sciences, clinical research, or another high\-consequence domain. * Current, hands\-on coding ability in Python and SQL, with experience using version control, tests, APIs, data pipelines, and modern cloud or containerized development environments. * Experience building or deploying LLM\-based or agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, workflow orchestration, and human review. * Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous stakeholder needs into a bounded product, working prototype, measurable acceptance criteria, and delivery plan. * Ability to lead workflow\-discovery and design sessions with clinical professionals and communicate credibly without oversimplifying clinical, operational, or regulatory constraints. * Experience evaluating AI systems using both technical metrics and expert judgment, including cases where ground truth is noisy, incomplete, or context dependent. * Strong understanding of trustworthy AI practices, and how to design provenance, access control, and uncertainty handling directly into a working system. * Excellent written and verbal communication across engineering, scientific, clinical, quality, and executive audiences. * Evidence of leading cross\-functional delivery through influence, including prioritization, conflict resolution, and shipping decisions under ambiguity. **Desirable Skills/Experience:** * Direct experience with clinical trial conduct, site monitoring, risk\-based monitoring, medical monitoring, clinical data review, or trial technology in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO, or health\-system environment. * Working knowledge of GCP and GxP computerized\-system validation, and how to scope a feature for regulated versus non\-regulated use before it is built. * Experience with clinical systems and data such as CTMS, EDC, eTMF, safety systems, EHR, monitoring reports, or clinical data platforms. * Experience designing reusable product capabilities across multiple therapeutic areas, studies, or business units. * Familiarity with observability, LLMOps/MLOps, and production monitoring for deployed AI systems, and how evaluation results feed release decisions. * Publications, patents, open\-source contributions, or a record of shipping technically differentiated AI products. The annual base pay for this position ranges from **$144,648\.8 to $216,973\.2 USD**. Our positions may be eligible for various incentives, including short\-term incentive bonuses, equity\-based awards for salaried roles, and commissions for sales roles. Benefits may include qualified retirement programs, paid time off—including vacation, holidays, and leave—as well as health, dental, and vision coverage, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. AstraZeneca is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and to providing a workplace free from discrimination. AstraZeneca is committed to accommodating persons with disabilities. Accommodation is available upon request for all aspects of the recruitment, assessment, and selection process. Requests may be made by emailing **AZCHumanResources@astrazeneca.com**. **Why AstraZeneca:** Join a technology\-powered organization where your AI leadership directly shapes how life\-changing medicines reach patients. Here, unexpected combinations of experts come together to tackle problems end to end—data foundations, AI models, platforms, and business applications—so your work moves from idea to enterprise scale. You will be empowered to take ownership, explore bold approaches, and push boundaries through hands\-on experimentation, including hackathons and large\-scale data challenges. We blend ambition with support: kindness matters as much as rigor; learning, coaching, and feedback are part of our daily rhythm; and every contribution is tied to a purpose bigger than any single team. This is a place to build trustworthy AI in partnership with clinicians and engineers, using cutting\-edge tools while keeping patient impact front and center. **Call to Action:** If you are ready to lead hands\-on, high\-consequence AI that clinicians trust and engineers love—while creating reusable capabilities that move an entire enterprise—step forward and shape what’s next! \#LI\-Hybrid **Date Posted** 15\-Oct\-2026 **Closing Date** 29\-Nov\-2026 Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. jobs.title: Program Director - Evinova
jobs.description: **Location** Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R\-262006 **Date posted** 15/10/2026 **WHO WE ARE** Are you ready to be part of the future of healthcare? Can you think big, be bold, and harness the power of digital and AI to tackle longstanding life sciences challenges? Then Evinova, a new health tech business part of the AstraZeneca Group, might be for you! Transform billions of patients’ lives through technology, data, and innovative ways of working. You’re radical, decisive, and transformative. Someone excited to use technology to improve patients’ health. We’re building a new Health\-tech business – Evinova, a fully\-owned subsidiary of AstraZeneca Group. Evinova delivers market\-leading digital health solutions that are science\-based, evidence\-led, and human experience\-driven. Thoughtful risks and quick decisions come together to accelerate innovation across the life sciences sector. Be part of a diverse team that pushes the boundaries of science by digitally empowering a deeper understanding of the patients we’re helping. Launch pioneering digital solutions that improve the patients’ experience and deliver better health outcomes. Together, we have the opportunity to combine deep scientific expertise with digital and artificial intelligence to serve the wider healthcare community and create new standards across the sector. We are in an active growth phase. Our platform is evolving quickly, our customer base is growing, and our delivery capability is scaling alongside it. We operate in a regulated environment, with sophisticated sponsor customers who have high expectations and real experience of enterprise implementation. We are building delivery capability that matches the quality of our product ambition. That means hiring great people who bring structure and who are motivated by building something, not just running it. **WHAT THE ROLE IS** As a Program Director, you own a customer account implementation program end to end — from kick\-off through go\-live and into the ongoing customer relationship. An account program may be a single workstream or several running in parallel. You are the accountable delivery lead across all of it: the customer's primary point of contact, the owner of the plan and its risks, and the person who keeps the team coordinated and on track, building the customer's confidence along the way. The program’s size and complexity, will drive the specific activities needed to be performed. Some account implementation programs will also be assigned a Project Manager. Where one is assigned, they own the day\-to\-day plan mechanics, RAID log upkeep, and status cadence for their workstream(s), freeing you to focus on the customer relationship, risk ownership, cross\-functional blocking issue, and the judgement calls that come with an evolving platform. Where no Project Manager is assigned, you run that workstream directly yourself. Either way, you hold customer account program\-level accountability — the plan, the risk, and the relationship — start to finish. This is a hands\-on role; you are close enough to the build and rollout to spot problems before they raise. Accountability does not shift at debut. Post\-go\-live, you continue to own the overall customer relationship — including quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and ongoing relationship management — while a Project Manager, where one is assigned, becomes the customer's day\-to\-day point of contact for post\-go\-live implementation needs within their workstream. This role is the engine that turns a signed contract into a live, adopted solution. You will be joining a team that is scaling. jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Asurint has redefined screening by blending advanced technology with human insights, creating a smarter, more effective way to screen. Our compliant, data\-driven, tech\-enabled solutions deliver faster, more reliable results to empower confident decisions. At Asurint, each member of our team plays and integral part as we work together to drive informed decisions through advanced screening solutions for fair and safe workplaces and communities. **Summary** The Business Intelligence Engineer is responsible for delivering innovative BI solutions and reliable and accurate data marts that help drive business growth and make operations more efficient. **Responsibilities** * Designs, builds, and deploys BI solutions for both internal and external customers and maintains and supports data analytics platforms. * Recognizes data trends and corrects data quality issues quickly, completely, and permanently. * Collaborates with IT peers and business partners to focus on production support, service requests, and roadmap initiatives to ensure a balanced delivery of services and solutions aligned with business objectives. * Provides support for operational systems by troubleshooting and testing (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, BI tools). * Creates database queries, stored procedures, functions, and views as needed. * Shares domain and technical expertise, providing technical mentorship and cross\-training to other peers and team members. * Maintains BI documentation and source system data mapping documentation. * Follows the software development life cycle in all development efforts. * Creates and maintains Business Intelligence documentation. * Performs continual remediation of BI systems and data structures to improve overall performance as well as data accuracy, integrity, and security. * Provides ad hoc reports as needed/identified in support of the business where self\-service is not available/possible. * Other duties as required. Relevant business management systems such as general ledger, HRIS, CRM, etc. is preferred. * Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or in a related engineering field is required. * Certifications or licensure: Any industry certifications in the field of technology preferred. If you do any work\-related driving while at Asurint, a driver’s license and ability to maintain a driving record that is satisfactory to the company’s liability insurance carrier is required. * Years of relevant experience: 5 to 7 years is preferred. * Years of experience supervising: None. **Working Conditions** * The work environment involves everyday risks or discomforts that require normal safety precautions typical of offices, including the need for general safe workplace practices with office equipment and computers, avoidance of trips and falls, and observance of fire regulations. * This position is performed remotely within the United States or in an office setting in the Cleveland, Ohio headquarters, although off\-site meetings in various settings may occur. * Inside Asurint’s office environment, the noise level is usually quiet to moderate. * In a remote setting, the employee is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure work environment, for arranging the off\-site workspace in an ergonomically sound manner, and for maintaining standard Internet speeds in order to work effectively. * In a remote setting, the employee is required to ensure that all equipment and records that are the property of Asurint but have been relocated to the off\-site workplace, are maintained in a safe and secure manner and are used only for business purposes. * The schedule is generally normal Eastern Time Zone business hours (unless otherwise communicated based on position or working location), although the employee may be required to perform work, attend meetings and events before or after normal workings hours, and occasionally on weekends and evenings. * Some travel by personal automobile and a valid driver’s license may be required. Occasional overnight travel may be required. * Ability to lift light objects (less than 20 pounds) and carry them short distances (20 feet or less) is required. * The work environment involves everyday risks or discomforts that require normal safety precautions typical of offices, including the need for general safe workplace practices with office equipment and computers, avoidance of trips and falls, and observance of fire regulations. **Benefits** In exchange for your unique abilities, perspectives and teamwork, Asurint offers a competitive salary and an excellent benefit package \- with options you can select according to your needs \- which includes: * Medical, dental and vision effective first day of employment * 401(k) with employer match * Paid time off * 10 company\-paid holidays * Employee Assistance Program * Wellness Program * Paid Bereavement * Pet Bereavement * Pet Insurance * Volunteer time off * Telecommuting Stipend * Professional development programs * Short\-term disability * Company\-paid long\-term disability * Company\-paid life insurance * Flexible spending/health savings accounts * Employee referral bonus * Asurint is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Atlas Air Worldwide. Move the World with Us!** At Atlas Air Worldwide, we're not just an airline, we're a global engine powering cargo, passenger, and leasing operations across more than 70 countries. As a leader in outsourced aviation logistics, we're built on a foundation of **safety**, **service excellence**, **integrity**, **innovation**, **teamwork**, and **responsibility**. With over 30 years of history, a modern all\-Boeing fleet, and nearly 5,000 teammates collaborating across operations, technical, and corporate functions, we're driven by purpose. **If you're ready to grow, innovate, and help us deliver excellence every single day, you belong here.** **Position Summary:** Atlas Air is seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data Platform and Engineering team. This is an early\-career individual contributor role for an engineer who can deliver well\-defined data solutions with guidance, build strong engineering fundamentals, and grow ownership over increasingly complex work. As we continue to build our data environment on Databricks, you will help build and operate reliable data pipelines, transformations, and data models. You will work within established architecture and standards, partner with more experienced engineers, and author production\-quality code that supports analytics, data science, AI/ML, and operational decision\-making. **Major Accountabilities:** **Data Pipeline Development** * Build, test, deploy, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for structured and semi\-structured data sources using established patterns and frameworks. * Develop data transformations that convert source data into accurate, documented, and reusable datasets. * Implement data models and data products based on defined business requirements and technical designs. * Use Databricks, Spark, orchestration tools, and cloud services to complete scoped engineering work with support from senior team members. * Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality, maintainability, and performance. **Data Quality \& Operations** * Create automated tests, validation checks, logging, and monitoring the pipelines and datasets you develop. * Investigate data quality, reliability, and performance issues; resolve routine issues independently and escalate broader problems appropriately. * Produce clear technical documentation, including data definitions, lineage, runbooks, and support notes. * Participate in the team's on\-call and incident response practices, with appropriate guidance and escalation support. * Follow established security, privacy, governance, and access control requirements. **Collaboration \& Growth** * Work with Data Analytics, Data Science, Software Engineering, IT, Security, and business partners to clarify requirements and deliver fit\-for\-purpose solutions. * Break defined requirements into engineering tasks, communicate progress and risks, and deliver work within agreed timelines. * Contribute to team standards for source control, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and operational readiness. * Learn the Atlas Air business domain and use that understanding to improve the usefulness and reliability of data products. * Seek feedback, share knowledge, and progressively take ownership of larger components and less\-defined problems. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum 1 year of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field. * Working proficiency in SQL and at least one general\-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Rust, Java, C\+\+, etc.). * Experience building or supporting data pipelines, transformations, or data models in a professional, internship, academic, or substantial project setting. * Familiarity with core data engineering concepts, including ETL/ELT, relational data modeling, data quality testing, and pipeline orchestration. * Experience with Git\-based development practices and an understanding of code review, automated testing, and deployment workflows. * Ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical partners. **Desired Qualifications:** * Hands\-on exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, or another distributed data\-processing platform. * Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework and an orchestration tool such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster. * Familiarity with one major cloud platform and its data services: AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Exposure to streaming or event\-driven technologies such as Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Structured Streaming, or Flink. * Familiarity with BI, data science, or machine learning workflows and the data products that support them. * Experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or another operationally complex industry. At **Atlas Air Worldwide**, we believe in the power of people, the promise of innovation, and the responsibility we hold to each other, to our customers, and to the planet. Join us and be part of a team that lifts more than cargo; we lift ambition.

jobs.title: Principal AI Developer Experience Engineer
jobs.description: At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world\-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state\-of\-the\-art in quantum computing. Atom Computing is seeking a Principal AI Developer Experience Engineer to improve how our physicists and engineers use AI in their daily work. You will set best practices for AI\-assisted engineering and build shared tooling that lets teams quickly adopt new AI\-driven workflows. You will also influence product architecture to broaden where LLM\-driven workflows apply, including areas where hardware, timing, or reliability requirements have typically called for conventional methods. This role’s aim is to accelerate work in experiment analysis, optics development, PCB and FPGA design, and quantum control software (C\+\+/Rust) development. Due to the need to engineer physical systems, the role will be on\-site in Boulder, CO at least 3 days per week. ### **Responsibilities** * Define, document, and maintain best practices for AI\-assisted coding, testing, code review, and research workflows. * Influence guidelines for using LLMs on performance\-critical software, including embedded C\+\+ and Rust, RTOS applications, and kernel device drivers: where AI assistance is appropriate, how generated code is reviewed and tested, and how memory safety, timing, and determinism are verified before merge. * Make forward\-looking electronics architecture improvements to our AI tooling and integrations so they keep pace with advances in models and agents and with shifts in engineers' tool preferences, and track industry benchmarks for AI\-assisted developer productivity so our practices stay current. * Build ways to measure the output of AI and LLM\-driven workflows, such as defect and revert rates of AI\-assisted changes, review findings, test coverage, performance regressions, new capabilities added, and time saved, and use the results to refine tools and guidelines. * Ensure safe and reliable operation of AI in quantum processors. ### **Experience \& Education** * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Artificial Intelligence * 8\+ years of software development ### **Qualifications** * Strong software engineering skills in Python, and experience writing embedded software in C\+\+ or Rust, including manual memory management, hard real\-time constraints, and kernel device driver implementation. * Influencing an organization of \> 50 engineers using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) on a daily basis, identifying pitfalls and measuring impact. * Working knowledge of how LLMs behave in practice: context management, prompting, agentic workflows, harnesses, effective safety practices, tool use, and judging output quality. * Clear written and spoken communication with audiences ranging from physicists to new software hires. An ability to influence a multi\-discipline engineering organization. Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short\- and long\-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day! The base salary range for this position is between $170,000 \- $200,000, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
