jobs.title: Sr/Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Consumer Apps
jobs.description: **About Attain** **Built for consumers and companies, alike** Klover's engineering team powers one of the fastest\-growing fintech platforms in the U.S., supporting over one million active users each month. Our systems process and move more than $1\.5 billion annually, enabling real\-time access to financial tools, rewards, and services that help people improve their day\-to\-day lives. As part of this team, you'll help design, build, and scale the systems that underpin Klover's core products and platform. You'll work on high\-impact, production\-grade systems that prioritize reliability, security, and performance, and that integrate with a broad ecosystem of internal and external services. The work you do will directly shape how users interact with Klover's products, access their money, and experience transparent, low\-fee financial services. Klover engineers collaborate closely with colleagues across backend, frontend, data science, and product teams to deliver scalable, high\-quality solutions for a rapidly growing user base. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies and architectures while helping define and evolve the next generation of inclusive, data\-powered financial products—building systems and interfaces that emphasize reliability, privacy, and performance at scale. ***Attain Office Hybrid Schedule (where applicable):*** * *Chicago, IL \& New York, NY:* *4 days in\-office; 1 day remote* * *We are open to discussing a remote arrangement for the right candidate* #### **About the Role** As a Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a critical role in building out and maintaining the infrastructure that powers all of our systems, as well as all of the supporting tools to ensure that those systems are running smoothly. Automation is the core of this role. We expect you to hunt down manual toil wherever it hides and engineer it out of existence — and to do that with the best tooling available, including AI agents you direct to write, test, and ship infrastructure code. We treat fluency with modern AI as a first\-class SRE skill, along with cloud platform literacy, a strong dedication to observability, and a laser\-focus on improving developer experience. You will work closely with nearly every engineering team at Attain, helping to ensure that our systems are operating at peak efficiency, and preparing us to handle the scale of our future growth. #### **What a typical week might look like** * Use AI agents as a force multiplier for yourself and others * Create, improve, and maintain internal agentic tools and harnesses * Add automation to both existing and new systems until manual processes, and the toil that comes with them, simply go away * Write Terraform modules for deploying infrastructure resources via our GitLab pipelines * Develop Helm charts for deploying services and jobs in our Kubernetes cluster * Define metrics, network policies, and routing rules for our Istio service mesh * Monitor and maintain our GCP BigQuery, Spanner, and CloudSQL databases * Pipe metrics to our Google\-managed Prometheus instance and build out Grafana dashboards and alerts to increase visibility on our systems * Experiment with GCP offerings, 3rd party vendors, AI tooling, and open\-source projects to further automate and secure day\-to\-day operations * Pair with engineering leads to instrument and monitor critical functionality * Participate in architecture design and capacity planning discussions to ensure that our systems are scalable, maintainable, reliable, and secure * Build, maintain, and improve our CI/CD pipeline #### **You'll be a great fit for the role if** * You reach for automation before you reach for a runbook, and a manual process is something you want to delete, not document * You treat AI agents as power tools and have real opinions about how to drive them — especially when to stop trusting them * You are comfortable wearing many hats * You have a willingness to learn and teach in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment * You have a strong desire to automate things * You readily provide constructive feedback, and also proactively seek feedback to improve yourself * You like to get your hands dirty and tinker with/stress test new technologies #### **Preferred Qualifications** * 6\+ years of experience building and maintaining large\-scale cloud\-native infrastructure (AWS and/or GCP) * Demonstrated fluency directing AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to build, operate, and debug real infrastructure; and robust and experienced judgment on verification of their work * A track record of replacing manual operations with durable automation * Experience working with the containerization technologies Docker, Kubernetes, and Istio or a similar service mesh technology * Experience with SQL database technologies such as MySQL, Google BigQuery, and Google Spanner * Experience with stream technologies such as Kafka and Amazon Kinesis * Experience with pub sub technologies such as AWS SNS and Google Pub/Sub * Experience with serverless computing technologies such as AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Functions/Google Cloud Run * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform * Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana * Strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals * Experience with SOC2 and PCI Compliance processes and requirements ***We are excited to hear from you.*** At Attain, we are passionate about finding people to continuously help us grow our organization. We encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't match every detail on the job description. If we don't see something that immediately fits, we will keep your resume on file for future opportunities.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Core Services
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. ### **Who We Are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly to make transportation safer, increasingly accessible, and more reliable and efficient than ever before. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you'll solve massively complex problems alongside other passionate, smart people, growing as an expert while broadening your field of knowledge. For Aurora’s latest news, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are excited about building the future of transportation that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient \& accessible for all. We are searching for an exceptional Backend Software Engineer to join the Aurora Services Engineering team and take on a critical role in building Aurora's suite of fleet management tools. The Aurora Services Engineering org creates full\-stack solutions including backend services, web apps, mobile apps, and real\-time onboard code that enable commercial operation of autonomous vehicle fleets at scale. Our mission is to build the software that drives the commercial side of our platform such as assigning work to autonomous vehicles, providing remote support, managing a fleet of vehicles, and receiving orders from customers. As Aurora prepares to massively scale its fleet and integrate with partners on an API level, the tools we build are critical to the efficient daily operation of our business. We are looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Core Services team under Aurora Services. You will help the Aurora Services Org to build the new asset management solution to scale up the autonomous vehicles fleet. ### **In this role, you will** * Design complex systems from the ground up. Partnering closely with Software, Hardware and infrastructure engineering teams. * Partner with Product Managers, Designers and Operation Stakeholders to deliver the benefit of Self Driving Vehicles quickly, safely and broadly. * Design, implement and maintain a micro\-services running in the Aurora’s AWS cloud used to monitor and manage the entire Aurora Self Driving Fleet. * Design, implement the fleet management solution and the vehicle communication system. * Establish technology and infrastructure to scale our products with high availability and reliability. * Contribute and evolve our team culture around mentorship, feedback,collaboration, and engineering excellence. ### **You will be a good fit if you have** * 2 or more years of experience in building backend services. * Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field. * Experience with web communication protocols, including REST, gRPC and GraphQL. * Experience with building large scale, high concurrent, high throughput and safety critical backend services. * Phenomenal communication skills. We build software with people and for people. You know how to write an effective technical spec, provide feedback to others, translate technical concepts into lay terms, and incorporate feedback into your efforts. You value and practice openness, empathy, kindness, and collaboration. * A preference for action. You will use good judgment to balance speed and quality. You will deliver products that are built in a responsible and sustainable way. You will use a self\-starter mentality to thrive in a growing environment where all hands are on deck, and consider no obstacle too big or too small. You will notice where there is a need and will hustle to fill it. * The drive to make teams stronger. You're excited to work hard and fast to the finish line on new opportunities with a collaborative and integrated team. You will be proactive in engaging conflict with openness, patience and kindness in an environment where it is safe to lean on each other and learn from failures. * Motivation to own the product lifecycle end to end. You’re happy to engage with our product and design teams and our internal customers to understand their needs and find ways to meet them. You ensure that product development stays on course all the way through release and post\-release support. ### **Desirable Experience** * Experience with autonomous vehicle development. * Experience with IoT, real time communication between devices and cloud. * Experience with application release strategies such as feature flagging, A/B testing and canary release. * Experience with observability and monitoring of safety critical systems. * Experience with fleet management solutions for Robots, Vehicles or Aerial Drones. * Experience with external customer facing software including production rollout with real customers. * Experience with safety and mission critical applications. *For roles based in Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $139,000 \- $223,000 per year. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $126,000 \- $201,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. We are building Beacon to scale by adding software. The thesis is simple: portfolio operations, value creation, and deal sourcing are bottlenecked by human attention, and an agentic operating system can lift that ceiling by an order of magnitude. We are building that system. It has two pieces. A sensing layer is a cross\-portfolio data lake on open table formats with a feature store on top that makes the data agent\-readable. An action layer runs workflows across three domains: how we run the portfolio, how we grow the portfolio, and how we acquire into it. Underneath both sits a feedback loop that captures every action and outcome with stable identifiers. Beacon has raised $550M\+ from investors including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, and the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp. **About the Role** ------------------ Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the engineers who go where the work is. You will be embedded with one or two portfolio companies at a time — sitting with the GM, the operators, and the customer success lead — figuring out where the leverage is, and shipping agentic software directly into their operation. The platforms exist. You are the person who turns them into outcomes on a specific business. This is a Palantir\-style FDE role applied to private equity operations. You will spend a meaningful fraction of your time on\-site or in the portco’s tools, and the rest of your time back at Beacon HQ pulling the patterns you learned back into the platform. The best FDEs at Beacon will not just deliver for the portcos they are deployed at — they will compress what they learned into reusable playbooks that ship to every other portco in the same vertical. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Embed deeply with portcos. Spend the first few weeks at a new portco understanding the operating model from the inside: what the GM cares about, where revenue actually comes from, where the team’s time goes, where the system is leaking. Earn the trust of the operators before you start changing things. * Find the leverage. Identify the 2–3 workflows where agentic software will meaningfully change the trajectory of the business — churn\-save, pricing experiments, lead enrichment, support deflection, AR follow\-up, bug\-fix PRs, weekly pulse, whatever the specific portco needs. Pick the wedge, not the wish list. * Ship the wedge. Build the integrations, the prompts, the evals, the workflows, and the UI surfaces required to land the first agentic loop at that portco. Use the platforms our core engineering team is building, and extend them when they fall short. * Operate the loop. Stay close to the system after it ships. Watch the outcomes. Tune the prompts. Adjust the autonomy tier as the system earns trust. Hand off cleanly to portfolio ops once the loop is stable. * Compound the learnings. Bring the patterns back to HQ. Codify what worked into playbooks that ship to every other portco in the vertical. The 11th deployment in a home\-services SaaS should be 10x faster than the 1st, and that compression is your job as much as the engineers building the platform. * Carry the GM relationship. You are the technical face of Beacon to the portco GM. Build the trust, set the expectations, and make sure the GM sees the system as their leverage — not Beacon’s audit tool. **Who You Are** --------------- * A strong generalist engineer. You can ship full\-stack TypeScript or Python on the backend, React on the frontend, SQL fluently, comfortable in someone else’s codebase within a day. You do not need to be a specialist in any one stack. You need to be the person who can land the whole thing. * Customer\-obsessed. You like being in the room with the operator, the GM, the customer success lead. You take the problem they actually have, not the problem they described. You are not interested in building platforms that no one uses. * High autonomy, low ego. You will be the only Beacon engineer on the ground at a portco most of the time. You need to make calls without a committee, defend them when challenged, and change your mind when you are wrong. * Comfortable with LLM\-native engineering. You have shipped real software using foundation models — not toy demos. You know how to write evals, when to fine\-tune, how to keep an agentic workflow from going off the rails, and where the autonomy tier should sit for any given action class. * Operator instincts. You can read a P\&L. You understand why a churn\-save matters more than a feature launch this quarter. You know that a 5\-point improvement in support deflection is worth more than a 50\-point improvement in code\-review velocity, depending on the business. * Strong written communicator. Beacon runs on writing. You will write the wedge memo, the GM update, the post\-deployment retro, the playbook that ships to every other portco. If your writing is fuzzy, the system stays fuzzy. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Prior FDE experience * PE, consulting, or M\&A diligence exposure, particularly the post\-LOI integration cadence * Comfort with Iceberg\-based data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks) and event\-driven systems * Built or operated agentic systems in production, including evals, autonomy gating, and outcome tracking **Our Values at Beacon Software** * Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. * Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. * Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected. * Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world \- compounding growth. ***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI\-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.* ***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*

jobs.title: Data Warehouse Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission:** Touch Lives. Improve Outcomes. BioTouch is a single\-source, international provider for all mission\-critical kitting and logistics needs. We partner with a wide range of medical facilities and healthcare providers to bring a higher level of care to healthcare delivery. Simply put, we are doing our part in the healthcare specialty logistics arena! **The Role:** We are seeking a Data Warehouse Engineer to join our IT department. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the organization's cloud data warehouse, with a focus on ingesting, transforming, and modeling data using Fivetran, dbt (data build tool), and Snowflake. The successful candidate will work closely with analytics, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable, well\-documented, and high\-quality data pipelines that support reporting and decision\-making across the organization. This position will need to sit within the greater Columbus area, for our largest medical kitting sites.### **Job Responsibilities** **Your Impact:** Design, build, and maintain automated data ingestion pipelines using Fivetran to extract data from source systems into the Snowflake data warehouse. Develop, test, and maintain data transformation models using dbt, following modular and version\-controlled development practices. Administer and optimize the Snowflake environment, including performance tuning, warehouse sizing, and cost management. Write efficient, well\-documented SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis. Implement data quality checks, automated testing, and monitoring within dbt and the broader data pipeline. Maintain clear documentation of data models, pipeline architecture, and data lineage. Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues in a timely manner. Collaborate with business intelligence, analytics, and software engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable data sets. Support data governance, security, and access\-control practices within the data warehouse environment. Participate in code reviews and contribute to the team's engineering standards and best practices.### **Required Skills and Qualifications** **What You Bring:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience. Minimum of two (2\) years of professional experience writing and optimizing SQL queries. Minimum of two (2\) years of professional experience working with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse platform. Experience with Fivetran or a similar ELT/data ingestion tool is required. Experience with dbt (data build tool) for data transformation and modeling is required. Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts, including dimensional modeling, ELT/ETL design patterns, and data pipeline orchestration **What We Need:** Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform). Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and CI/CD practices for data pipelines. Experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt Cloud, or similar). Familiarity with data governance **What You’ll Get:** Medical, Dental, Vision after 30 days HSA and PPO plans available Company paid Life Insurance, AD\&D, and Long Term Disability 401(k) with generous company match after 90 days Supplemental Voluntary Benefits like Short Term Disability, Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity Employee Assistance Program $500 Referral Bonus Available!

jobs.title: Security Operations & Detection Engineer (SecOps) – AI Cloud
jobs.description: Bitdeer is a world\-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure. Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence. Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia. To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/ (https://ir.bitdeer.com/%3C/p%3E%3Cp%3E%3C/p%3E%3Cp%3E%3Cstrong%3EJob) ### **About the Role** We are seeking a hands\-on **Security Operations \& Detection Engineer** to join our AI Cloud Security team on the SecOps line. Based in Los Angeles, this role focuses on real\-time security alert monitoring, triage, incident response, and active detection engineering across AI Cloud's production estate—spanning GPU/AIDC infrastructure, our core cloud platform, and public\-facing services. This is a technical, hands\-on operations and engineering role (not a policy or management position) working regular US Pacific daytime hours, featuring tight collaboration with our global security team. ### **Responsibilities** * **Security Monitoring \& Response:** Perform on\-shift triage, containment, escalation, and post\-incident writeups for P1/P2 security incidents across our GPU/AIDC infrastructure, cloud platform, and public services. * **SLA Adherence:** Consistently meet team SLAs for critical incidents (P1 acknowledgment within $\\le$ 15 minutes, response start within $\\le$ 30 minutes). * **Detection Engineering:** Continuously tune and build alert rules within our self\-built SIEM, HIDS, and WAF telemetry to suppress false positives and keep paging high\-signal. * **Alert\-Triage Automation:** Contribute to building and refining agentic triage workflows to automate routine responses and reduce noise. * **Cross\-Site Collaboration:** Conduct daily written and live handoffs with our Singapore security team to ensure seamless global operations across shifts. ### **Requirements** * **Experience:** 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in a SOC, Incident Response (IR), or Detection Engineering role, with comfort acting as the primary on\-shift responder. * **Infrastructure Fundamentals:** Strong Linux and Kubernetes fundamentals; comfortable operating across cloud platforms and bare\-metal/GPU environments. * **Query \& Scripting:** Practical SIEM query experience (OpenSearch, Splunk DSL, or similar) and scripting skills in **Python** or **Go**. * **Host Detection \& Log Analysis:** Direct experience with host\-based detection tools (Falco, Wazuh, auditd), log analysis, and standard IR tooling. * **Schedule Flexibility:** Willingness and ability to participate in a weekend on\-call rotation. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves / Preferred Qualifications** * **Specialized Threat Experience:** Hands\-on incident response experience with crypto\-mining malware or supply\-chain security incidents. * **Runtime \& eBPF Security:** Exposure to eBPF\-based detection or runtime security tools (e.g., Tetragon, Falco internals). * **AI/GPU Infrastructure:** Familiarity with high\-performance computing environments (NVIDIA DGX/HGX, InfiniBand, or RoCE networking). * **Languages:** Professional fluency in Mandarin to facilitate day\-to\-day collaboration with our Singapore engineering site (English is required). * **Certifications:** Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, or CISSP are a plus. \- *Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, color, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Media API Platform
jobs.description: Bloomberg Media empowers global business leaders with breaking news, expert opinion and proprietary data distributed with global reach. With over 30 million unique visitors each month, our flagship website bloomberg.com is the go\-to destination for those looking to stay ahead of the curve. As one of the top 10 most visited financial and news sites on the web, we take pride in delivering top\-quality content that our audience can trust. The Media API Platform team builds and runs the API layer at the heart of Bloomberg Media's digital products. We empower Media engineers to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure APIs quickly. Our tools and standards make it easy to build, discover, and consume APIs across the org. Our internal GraphQL gateway serves backend services and is composed of more than a dozen subgraphs, spanning user and media domains in one schema. And it's growing, soon aggregating dozens of data sources from product and content teams across the organization. Our public GraphQL gateway serves client\-facing apps secured by pre\-approved queries. We also operate the shared building blocks all our APIs rely on: centralized authentication and authorization, rate limiting, token management and job management. We focus on reliability by building automated regression suites that run nightly and post\-deployment, daily test reports, and observability tooling—including AI\-assisted skills that track down latency regressions. The result is a team with wide impact: when engineers at Bloomberg Media need to build, find, or use an API quickly and safely, they use what we build. We are also excited about leveraging AI tooling to build, monitor, and release software, including agentic workflows for live features. What’s in it for you? * **High\-Impact Scale:** Own and scale the core API layer at Bloomberg Media, serving millions of users worldwide and handling up to 300k requests per minute. * **Modern Tech Stack \& Cutting\-Edge Tools:** Work with TypeScript/Node, Java/Kotlin, and AWS while pioneering AI\-assisted tooling, agentic workflows, and a rapidly expanding GraphQL ecosystem using various open\-source and in\-house tools. * **Ground\-Floor Agentic Development:** Get in on the ground floor of live agentic development workflows, pioneering AI\-assisted tooling and agent\-driven systems for cross\-organization software development and feature delivery. * **Graph Caching \& High\-Performance Scaling:** Tackle complex federated GraphQL caching challenges by building fine\-grained entity caching systems and optimizing response times to deliver high\-throughput, low\-latency performance for critical, high\-traffic destinations across Bloomberg Media. * **Ownership of Shared Building Blocks:** Build and maintain critical shared infrastructure relied upon by engineers across the company, including API gateways, centralized authentication, rate limiting, and token management. We'll trust you to: * Provide expert GraphQL guidance to client developer teams on best practices. * Grow our graph in a secure way for the future of possible agentic clients. * Develop and promote internal and open\-source GraphQL tooling for seamless deployments and adoption of a well\-governed federated graph. * Implement agentic workflows to ensure graph quality and speed of development. * Drive key initiatives like org\-wide identity and access management (IAM) adoption, advanced observability, and upgraded job scheduling services for critical offline workflows. * Analyze open\-source and vendor products to advise on buy vs. build decisions. * Partner closely with product and content teams across the organization, leading technical decisions, designing robust APIs, and mentoring engineers. What we are looking for: * 5\+ years of experience building and running backend services in production, including ownership of systems relied upon by other teams * Expertise in at least one of JavaScript/TypeScript (Node), Java, Kotlin, or Python * A solid grasp of distributed systems: service\-to\-service communication, caching, rate limiting, failure modes, and designing for reliability at scale * Real, current use of AI\-assisted and agentic engineering tools in your own work * Experience debugging production issues at web scale. You are comfortable with HTTP, core networking concepts (DNS, TLS, proxies, load balancers), and observability tools (logs, metrics, traces) to identify the root cause of latency spikes or intermittent failures * Strong cross\-team collaboration. You are happy to dig into another team's codebase, understand their domain,help them design their graph or API well, and build alignment * A habit of making things safer and easier for others: automated testing, CI/CD, clear standards and good documentation * Clear written and spoken communication, and a track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions Nice to have: * Hands\-on GraphQL experience, especially with Apollo Federation, schema design, and subgraph development. * Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) * Experience with authentication and authorization systems (OAuth, JWT, service identity/IAM) * Experience with AWS and container\-based deployment Salary Range \= 160,000 \- 240,000 USD Annual \+ Benefits \+ Bonus The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level. We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns. Discover what makes Bloomberg unique \- watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success. **Accommodations** ------------------ Bloomberg provides reasonable adjustment/accommodation to individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email AMER\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Americas), EMEA\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Europe, the Middle East and Africa), or APAC\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Asia\-Pacific), based on the region you are submitting an application for. jobs.description: Salary $18\.00 Hourly Location Main Campus (BG), OH Job Type Student Worker Job Number BGSU02042 Division President's Office Department Student Employment Opening Date 10/15/2026 Closing Date 10/20/2026 11:59 PM Eastern **Summary** ----------- Support an industry\-sponsored research project, funded by a Honda AI\+X Seed Grant, that develops an explainable, cost\-sensitive machine\-learning framework to predict equipment component failures within 24 hours and turn those predictions into practical maintenance recommendations. The Research Assistant will combine manufacturing and maintenance knowledge with data science skills to prepare equipment data, build and evaluate predictive models, and translate results into decisions that make sense on the plant floor. for machine sensor readings (voltage, rotation, pressure, vibration), error logs, maintenance and component\-replacement records, and machine attributes. * Acquire candidate datasets (public or partner\-provided) and audit data quality, including duplicates, missing records, and timestamp alignment. * Build a reproducible Python pipeline to clean and merge the records, construct 24\-hour failure labels, and prevent temporal leakage. * Engineer tabular features (current readings, 3\-hour and 24\-hour trends, recent event counts, time since maintenance) and prepare sequence windows from the sensor data. * Implement a sensor\-threshold baseline, then train and compare a LightGBM model and a compact Temporal Convolutional Network (PyTorch) using chronological data splits. * Evaluate models using PR\-AUC, precision, recall, Brier score, and calibration plots, and apply sigmoid or isotonic probability calibration. * Develop maintenance cost ratios and inspection\-capacity assumptions, and implement the cost\-sensitive alert\-ranking policy. * Evaluate results at the event level (failure coverage, alert lead time, false alerts per machine\-month, daily inspection workload). * Generate model explanations using TreeSHAP and integrated gradients, and interpret them from a maintenance and reliability perspective. * Maintain clear, version\-controlled code and documentation (GitHub), contribute to the final technical report and presentation, and support the final project showcase. * Perform other related research duties as assigned within the scope of the position. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Currently enrolled BGSU student (undergraduate or graduate) in good academic standing. * Major in Industrial/Systems Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechanical Engineering Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * Working Python skills (pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn) and coursework or project experience in data analysis or machine learning. * Basic understanding of manufacturing operations, equipment maintenance, or reliability concepts. * Strong written communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently with appropriate supervision. **Additional Information** -------------------------- * Preferred Qualifications: + Coursework or experience in predictive or preventive maintenance, reliability engineering, quality control, or Lean Six Sigma. + Industry or internship experience in a manufacturing environment. + Experience with LightGBM or XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow, time\-series or sensor data, or model explainability (SHAP). + Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Jupyter, and reproducible research practices. * Two openings. Total hours are capped at 120 hours for one student (manufacturing focus) and 100 hours for the other (computational focus). Work period: hire date through December 31, 2026, up to 20 hours per week, scheduled flexibly around the student’s classes. Work can be done in the lab or remotely, as arranged with the supervisor. jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: At BusRight, we're transforming an industry that has relied on outdated systems for far too long. School transportation is a critical part of everyday life for millions of students and families, yet much of the industry still depends on fragmented, manual processes. We’re building a modern transportation platform that makes school buses safer, smarter, and more efficient for students, families, schools, and communities nationwide. Our product ecosystem spans web, mobile, backend, mapping, real\-time systems, and integrations. As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you’ll take a leading role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and overall quality of that ecosystem. This role goes beyond executing test cases. You’ll help define how we approach quality, identify risks before they become customer problems, investigate complex production issues, improve automation and tooling, and influence engineering practices across teams. Why This Role Matters You’ll join an established QA function and help take it to the next level. We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, make sound quality and risk decisions, and act as a trusted technical partner to engineering and product teams. You’ll work across the entire development lifecycle—from requirements and technical design through implementation, release, production monitoring, and incident investigation. You’ll be expected to question assumptions, uncover difficult edge cases, identify systemic quality risks, and improve how we test and ship software. This is a hands\-on senior role. You’ll still test products directly, but you’ll also help shape test strategy, automation, tooling, processes, and quality standards across the organization. What You’ll Do Own Quality Across Complex Product Areas * Take ownership of quality for complex features and product areas across Web, Android, and Flutter applications. * Define appropriate test strategies based on technical complexity, customer impact, risk, and system architecture. * Perform exploratory, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing across interconnected systems. * Identify edge cases, failure modes, and risks that may not be obvious from product requirements alone. * Help teams determine appropriate release confidence and identify gaps before changes reach production. Investigate Complex Problems * Lead investigation of difficult bugs and production issues across frontend, mobile, backend, infrastructure, and third\-party integrations. * Analyze application logs, network traffic, API requests, database data, monitoring signals, and source code to isolate root causes. * Reproduce complex or intermittent issues and provide engineers with clear technical findings. * Distinguish symptoms from underlying causes and identify patterns across seemingly unrelated incidents. * Build scripts, utilities, or debugging tools when they can accelerate investigation or improve future troubleshooting. Drive Test Automation and Engineering Quality * Design, build, and maintain E2E and integration automation using tools such as Playwright/Maestro/Appium. * Identify where automation provides meaningful value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate. * Improve automation architecture, reliability, maintainability, and execution speed. * Work with engineers to improve testability at the application and system level. * Improve automated quality checks on CI/CD workflows. Influence Engineering and Product Decisions * Partner with engineers and product managers during planning and technical design to identify risks early. * Challenge unclear requirements, assumptions, and implementation decisions when they introduce unnecessary quality risk. * Communicate tradeoffs clearly and help teams make informed release decisions. * Represent the customer and operational perspective during technical discussions. * Collaborate closely with Support and other customer\-facing teams when investigating reported issues. Improve QA Processes and Quality Culture * Identify weaknesses in existing QA processes and propose practical improvements. * Improve test documentation, defect reporting, release validation, incident analysis, and quality metrics. * Help establish scalable testing practices as the product and engineering organization grow. * Share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and help less\-experienced QA engineers develop stronger testing and debugging skills. * Promote the idea that quality is a shared engineering responsibility rather than something owned only by QA. Who We’re Looking For Core Qualifications * 5\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Engineering in Test, or another strongly technical software quality role. * Significant experience testing complex web and mobile applications involving multiple interconnected services. * Advanced exploratory testing and risk\-analysis skills. * Strong experience investigating production issues using logs, APIs, databases, monitoring tools, and other technical signals. * Hands\-on experience with automated testing frameworks and methodologies. * Strong programming and debugging skills—you should be comfortable reading, understanding, and navigating production codebases. * Ability to write automation, debugging utilities, scripts, data\-analysis tools, or other engineering support tooling when needed. * Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, client\-server architecture, and data flows between services. * Strong understanding of the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), from requirements analysis and test design through execution, release validation, and production monitoring. * Experience working with defect tracking systems and test management practices. * Understanding of software security and privacy considerations, including authentication, authorization, data handling, access control, and common OWASP risks. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Experience with mapping, GPS/location systems, real\-time applications, or transportation technology is a strong plus. Technical Background Experience with some of the following technologies is useful, but expertise in every technology listed is not required. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems. * Web: React, TypeScript * APIs \& Backend: REST APIs, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase * Mobile: Android, Flutter * Automation: Playwright, Maestro, Appium * Observability \& Debugging: Datadog, Sentry, Google Cloud Platform, Proxyman * Data \& Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase Firestore, Google Cloud Platform * API tooling: Postman or similar tools * Security: OWASP, authentication/authorization concepts, privacy and data\-handling practices * Delivery: CI/CD pipelines, Agile software development practices * Mapping / Location: GPS, geospatial systems, mapping SDKs, routing, or other location\-based technologies What Makes Someone Successful in This Role* You naturally think in terms of risk, failure modes, and customer impact, not just expected behavior. * You are comfortable investigating problems across multiple layers of a system. * You can work independently when requirements are incomplete or the problem is poorly understood. * You know when deeper investigation is necessary and when additional testing provides diminishing returns. * You communicate quality concerns clearly without becoming a bottleneck for delivery. * You are comfortable challenging assumptions and advocating for technical improvements. * You look for opportunities to eliminate recurring problems rather than repeatedly testing around them. * You enjoy building tools and processes that make engineering teams more effective. * You balance attention to detail with pragmatic decision\-making.

jobs.title: Network Engineer (Data Center & Enterprise)
jobs.description: Help run a global network where performance and resilience really matter. This is a chance to join a global, technology\-led organization whose operations run on a data\-intensive network spanning multiple regions. Speed, security, and resilience are non\-negotiable here, and the Network Operations team in Houston plays a central part in keeping it that way. As a Network Engineer, you’ll cover enterprise, data center, cloud\-connected, security, and SD\-WAN environments. The role balances day\-to\-day operations with infrastructure projects that move the platform forward. jobs.title: Senior Staff R&D Technical Project Manager Design
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About This Role:** ==================== Crusoe is a vertically integrated AI infrastructure company with a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. Our competitive advantage—“Speed is the only moat”—is directly tied to our ability to rapidly design, manufacture, and deploy our own modular power and compute infrastructure. We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our R\&D organization and drive programs that evaluate and advance the next generation of AI data center technologies. You will manage initiatives that span multiple engineering disciplines—from early\-stage technology evaluations and partnerships with emerging startups and industry providers, through pilot\-scale validation and production handoff for hyperscale deployment. Crusoe’s R\&D team exists to look around corners: identifying the technologies and design approaches that will define future data center platforms, testing them rigorously, and delivering validated solutions to the engineering teams that build and deploy our infrastructure. As a TPM in his team, you will be the operational backbone of that process—coordinating across R\&D, engineering, external technology partners, and leadership to drive programs from concept through pilot to hyperscale readiness. **What You’ll Be Working On:** ============================== * **R\&D Program Execution:** Own and drive R\&D programs end\-to\-end—from early\-stage technology evaluation and partner engagement through pilot\-scale deployment and production handoff for hyperscale rollout. Bring structure, rigor, and pace to programs that are inherently exploratory. * **Engineering Team Partnership:** Serve as R\&D’s program interface to engineering teams across the company. Coordinate joint planning, manage shared initiative pipelines, and ensure R\&D outputs are aligned with the needs of the teams building and deploying infrastructure. * **Technology Evaluation Support:** Coordinate the operational aspects of technology evaluations: vendor engagements, test protocols, data collection, success criteria, and structured go/no\-go decision frameworks. Ensure evaluations are completed on schedule with clear, documented outcomes. * **External Partner Management:** Manage relationships with external technology vendors, emerging startups, design firms, and development partners engaged in R\&D programs. Own scope definition, deliverable quality, schedule accountability, contracts, and commercial terms. Help coordinate joint evaluations and pilot programs with industry and research partners. * **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Drive alignment across R\&D, engineering, operations, and leadership stakeholders. Translate technical complexity into clear program milestones, risk registers, and decision points that enable rapid execution. * **Program Reporting:** Maintain program status visibility through regular reporting to R\&D leadership and engineering stakeholders. Proactively identify and escalate risks and blockers. * **Technical Documentation:** Ensure R\&D programs produce comprehensive documentation—including technical assessments, pilot results, vendor evaluations, and production handoff packages—that enable engineering teams to adopt and scale R\&D\-validated solutions. **What You’ll Bring to the Team:** ================================== * **Experience:** 7\+ years of progressive experience in technical program management, project management, or systems engineering, with a meaningful portion in data center infrastructure, manufacturing, or related industrial environments. * **Technical Background:** Engineering degree or equivalent technical foundation. You started your career as an engineer and transitioned into program management—you bring genuine technical fluency to every conversation, not just process discipline. * **Data Center Knowledge:** Working familiarity with data center infrastructure—power distribution, cooling systems, facility design, or compute/networking. You can engage credibly with engineers across these domains and ask the right questions. * **Program Execution:** Demonstrated track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional programs on time. Comfortable managing ambiguity, competing priorities, and multiple concurrent workstreams. * **Vendor Management:** Experience managing external vendors, contractors, or design partners including contract negotiation, scope management, and delivery accountability. * **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to translate technical program details into clear executive summaries and to facilitate productive discussions across diverse engineering disciplines. **Bonus Points:** ================= * Direct experience in data center construction, commissioning, or operations. * Background in manufacturing environments, particularly modular or containerized systems. * Experience with power systems, cooling technologies, or high\-performance computing infrastructure. * PMP certification or equivalent program management credential. * Experience at a hyperscale cloud provider, major data center operator, or data center design/construction firm. * Prior experience in an R\&D, advanced engineering, or new product introduction (NPI) environment. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $175,000 \-$215,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

This includes writing and maintaining manifests and Helm charts, and managing deployments, scaling, ingress, secrets, and resource limits. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) that take code from commit to production reliably and repeatably. * Manage cloud resources with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates). * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics) to keep production AI services healthy, and troubleshoot cluster and application issues when they come up. * Apply cloud security best practices, including Entra ID (Azure AD) identity and role\-based access, managed identities, network isolation, and secure secrets handling. All of this should meet the data\-protection requirements for sensitive borrower information. * Optimize cloud cost and performance for AI workloads, including model hosting, inference scaling, and GPU/compute usage. ***Collaborative Product Engineering*** * Partner with operations, loan officers, compliance, marketing, and customer experience teams to identify high\-impact use cases for AI and translate them into scalable products. * Work closely with data engineering to source, prepare, and validate datasets used for model training and evaluation. * Develop secure, compliant, and well\-documented systems aligned with mortgage regulatory requirements. ***Model Development \& Optimization*** * Train, fine\-tune, or customize AI models to improve accuracy, performance, and relevance to mortgage workflows. * Implement continuous monitoring, versioning, and quality checks for AI models in production. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend adoption paths for the organization. ***Technical Leadership \& Best Practices*** * Establish development standards for AI\-enabled software, including testing strategies, documentation, and model governance. * Provide guidance on responsible AI usage, data protection, and fair lending considerations in all deployments. * Contribute to long\-term AI strategy to modernize the company’s tech stack and customer experience. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 3–5\+ years of software engineering experience building web or backend applications. * Hands\-on experience with machine learning or generative AI tools (OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, LangChain, vector databases, etc.). * Proficiency in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or C\#. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including hands\-on experience deploying, securing, and operating production workloads (compute, networking, identity, storage, and Key Vault). * Solid experience with containers and Kubernetes (preferably AKS), including deployments, services, ingress, config/secrets, autoscaling, and debugging workloads with kubectl. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for containerized applications. * Understanding of APIs, microservices, and modern software architecture patterns. **Preferred:** * Experience in fintech or mortgage/lending systems. * Familiarity with mortgage workflows: LOS, POS, underwriting, rate/pricing engines, and compliance considerations. * Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204 Developer, AZ\-104 Administrator, AZ\-305 Solutions Architect, or AI\-102 AI Engineer) and/or Kubernetes certifications (CKA or CKAD). * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or Bicep) and GitOps or Helm\-based deployment workflows. * Experience deploying and scaling AI/LLM workloads on Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, or self\-hosted models on AKS). * Knowledge of MLOps tools and frameworks for model deployment. * Experience building customer\-facing digital experiences. **Key Competencies:** * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to map operational processes to technical solutions. * Ability to work cross\-functionally and communicate complex concepts to non\-technical teams. * Ownership of systems in production, from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and incident response. * Curiosity and eagerness to explore new AI capabilities. * Commitment to data security, fair lending, and responsible AI use. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Perception and Controls
jobs.description: **Workplace Type:** Hybrid — Onsite 3–4 days per week across Santa Cruz and West Menlo Park, CA, with at least 1 day per week in Santa Cruz **Reports To:** Robotics \& Controls Manager **About Capstan Medical** ------------------------- At Capstan Medical, we're building one of the most exciting and innovative companies in medtech: a first\-of\-its\-kind robotic platform for minimally invasive heart valve treatment. Our team combines surgical robotics, catheter\-based delivery, and next\-generation implants to turn complex procedures into safer, lower\-stress solutions for patients and clinicians. We're a collaborative, hands\-on team that moves fast, wears multiple hats, and believes the best ideas can come from anyone. Based in Santa Cruz, our workspace blends Bay Area innovation with a lifestyle near trails, beaches, and open space—a great place to do meaningful, career\-defining work. ### **About the Role** **Teach a heart valve robot to see where it is.** We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our robotics and controls team. You'll help our robot understand where its devices are inside the patient, using intraprocedural imaging such as fluoroscopy and echocardiography. That means building perception for image\-to\-robot registration and pose estimation, and taking it from research into a clinical system. This is not a model\-in\-a\-notebook role. Your work runs on a real\-time robotic system, informs what physicians see during the procedure, and ships under FDA design controls. You'll also help shape how we collect, organize, and learn from our robot and imaging data, and use it to improve our device models and controllers. You'll have a large say in how ML is done here, from the tools and standards we adopt to which problems we tackle first, and you'll be the person the rest of the team turns to for ML judgment. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop methods to register intraprocedural imaging, such as fluoroscopy and echocardiography, to the robot. * Estimate the pose of catheters and implants from medical images. * Combine image\-based estimates with robot kinematics and other sensing, and quantify the uncertainty of each estimate. * Build data pipelines that capture, align, label, and version imaging and robot data for training and evaluation. * Use simulation and synthetic data where real clinical data is limited. * Fit and improve models of device behavior from data, and work with controls engineers to turn them into better control. * Work with clinical engineers and physicians to learn what the images show, what matters in the procedure, and what accuracy is good enough. * Read the literature, prototype what looks promising, and tell us plainly what works on our data and what doesn't. * Deploy models on the robot and meet real\-time latency budgets. * Write the validation, test datasets, and design documentation that let learned components pass FDA design controls. ### **Skills** * **Real\-World Machine Learning:** You've taken models out of notebooks and into products that run on real data, with all its noise, drift, and edge cases. * **Computer Vision:** Strong background in classical and learned computer vision, especially pose estimation, segmentation, tracking, or 2D/3D registration. * **3D Geometry:** Solid grasp of rigid transforms, rotations, camera projection models, and calibration. * **Programming:** Strong Python and PyTorch skills. Comfortable reading and writing C\+\+. * **Data Engineering:** You build pipelines, datasets, and evaluation harnesses that others can trust and reuse. * **Research and Prototyping:** You keep up with recent papers, can tell which ideas will survive contact with our data, and enjoy turning them into working prototypes. * **Problem\-Solving:** Comfortable with high ambiguity. You can take a fuzzy goal, break it into experiments, and pick a direction without a spec. * **Communication:** Excellent communicator who can explain ML clearly to controls engineers, clinical engineers, and physicians, document work effectively, and help the team decide when a model is good enough to trust. ### **Requirements** * MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. PhD is a plus. * 4\+ years of professional experience in computer vision or machine learning, classical or learned, including at least one system shipped to production on real\-world data. * Experience working with scarce, noisy, or expensive data, using synthetic data, augmentation, self\-supervision, or physics priors to make up for it. * Experience building ML on data from physical systems such as robots, cameras, medical imaging, or sensors. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and own problems end\-to\-end. * Ability to work onsite 3–4 days per week, split flexibly between our Santa Cruz, CA and West Menlo Park, CA offices, with at least 1 day per week in Santa Cruz. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Ultrasound or echocardiography experience, strongly preferred. Fluoroscopy or X\-ray experience is also valuable, including 2D/3D registration or digitally reconstructed radiographs. * Experience tracking catheters, needles, surgical tools, or continuum robots in images. * Sensor fusion and state estimation, such as Kalman filters or factor graphs. * System identification or learned dynamics for control, including residual models on top of physics. * Robotics software experience with ROS/ROS2 and on\-device inference under latency constraints (ONNX, TensorRT). * Data platform and MLOps experience, including practices like dataset versioning and experiment tracking. * Medical device or safety\-critical background, including validating ML under FDA design controls. * Experience as an early ML engineer on a team, setting up the tools, data practices, and evaluation that others build on. * Publications at venues such as MICCAI, IPCAI, CVPR, ICRA, or IROS. ### **Why join us:** * We offer a fun, fast\-paced, collaborative environment where you will be working on transformational technologies in the cardiac healthcare space. * We offer outstanding benefits with medical, dental, and vision covered at 100% for you and your family, as well as flex time off. * We thrive in our work\-hard, play\-hard environment. Bring your bike or running shoes if you’d like or just be ready to enjoy a fun office outing. We enjoy time inside the office and out! We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: Chamberlain Group (CG) is a global leader in intelligent access and Blackstone portfolio company. jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: ***Ensuring Chart’s Success…*** ------------------------------- “Cooler By Design” – Chart’s core business is centered around the design and fabrication of cryogenic equipment; so you can see where we get our tagline from, right? Well, yes and no – see, we think the products we design and build are pretty cool too. Also, we’re problem solvers. Customers don’t come to Chart with an equipment specification, they come to Chart with a challenge. That’s where you come in, because someone has to figure it out – all the way from conceptual design to installation and commissioning of equipment on\-site. Chart’s mission is to provide full solutions across the Nexus of Clean™ – clean power, clean water, clean food, and clean industrials. The diverse applications we service echo our commitment to sustainability – from providing full hydrogen solutions across the value chain, offering small and industrial scale carbon capture solutions to customers globally, creating water treatment systems responsible for treating 4\.5 billion gallons of water per day in the U.S. and delivering clean water to over a billion people worldwide, providing equipment and solutions for mission critical space launches, decarbonizing the marine industry, and electrifying the mining space. Chart even contributes to the food and beverage industry by making some of your favorite carbonated beverages possible – If nitro coffee or nitro ice cream is your thing – well, that’s Chart technology too (and it’s also cool)! We are looking to add a **Process Engineer** to our team in **Orem, UT**. We would consider candidates who are able to work out of our office across the US, including Allentown, PA, Lacrosse, WI, Orem, UT or The Woodlands, TX. The Process Engineer begins to take direct engineering responsibility for the conceptual design of Chart process technologies to meet customer requirements. This person must work well within a small team environment while preparing process information deliverables for the basic engineering design package. This position requires someone who is comfortable operating autonomously with open\-ended tasks. You will have the opportunity to interact with every part of the technology development from design of new and novel equipment and experiments to detailed large\-scale equipment design, sourcing, and operation. It is intellectually engaging work on complex, unique, and novel problems. ***What Will You Do?*** ----------------------- * Support process development for the innovative Cryogenic Carbon Capture™ technology through Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, and Aspen EDR * Simulate steady\-state and transient/dynamic processes to describe performance and generate heat and material balances * Work with clients and other engineers to develop feasibility, preFEED, and FEED studies to design Cryogenic Carbon Capture plants * Prepare process equipment data sheets and equipment lists * Prepare Process Flow Diagrams * Assist in the development of Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams * Assist in the development of wiring and loop drawings and control system architectural drawings for internal research and development work * Provide process data to mechanical engineering counterparts and key vendors for equipment sourcing * Check process engineering work performed by other Process and Process I Engineers * Assist in the preparation of Start\-up and Operating Manuals * Participate in experimental work and prototype operation * Some travel – 10% or less * Develop and implement industrial\-grade process control, including model predictive controls and human\-machine interfaces, for highly integrated prototype and commercial processes (optional, but preferred) ***Your Physical Work Environment Will Require…*** -------------------------------------------------- The ability to frequently sit for extended periods of time, stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms. This position is occasionally required to sit, climb, balance, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Lifting of 50 pounds may be required. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Duties include lengthy visual requirements on computer monitors. ***Your Experience Should Be...*** ---------------------------------- * Working knowledge of ASPEN Plus/HYSYS and/or similar process simulation software, including dynamics simulation * Knowledge of chemical engineering first principles, especially thermodynamics and heat/mass transfer and ability to apply those principles to real\-world systems * Proven teamwork skills * Sound organizational skills for completing tasks as scheduled * Strong communication skills both verbal and written for the purpose of explaining challenges and solutions internally, and presenting externally * Good interpersonal skills to successfully interface other engineering disciplines and customers **We prefer candidates that also have the following:** * 2 to 5 years of process engineering experience (or educational equivalent) * Computer programming expertise in one or several of C\+\+, C\#, Java/JavaScript, or Python * Knowledge of cryogenic process technologies which can include cryogenic air separation, natural gas liquefaction, hydrogen liquefaction, helium processing and liquefaction, etc. * Knowledgeable in natural gas processing technologies * Some experience and interest in control system and human machine interface software * Understands basic applicable engineering/electrical/safety codes ***Our Benefits Package...*** ----------------------------- * Medical, dental and vision insurance * Employer contributions to an HSA account * Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * Basic life insurance with the option to purchase supplemental individual, spouse and dependent child coverage * Up to two weeks of paid family leave 401k retirement savings plan including a company match * ***Competencies*** ------------------ Supporting Organizational Goals Driving Projects to Completion Acting Decisively Championing Customer Needs Thinking Globally Managing Resources Learning Quickly Critical Thinking Acting with Integrity Displaying Technical Expertise Driving Continuous Improvement Evaluating and Implementing Ideas Driving for Results

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure
jobs.description: We're looking for a **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** to build and scale the infrastructure that powers our AI\-driven warehouse intelligence platform. This is a deeply technical role at the intersection of machine learning, computer vision and distributed systems. You'll design scalable GPU compute clusters, build robust orchestration pipelines, and optimize model serving for low\-latency inference at scale. You'll work closely with our research scientists, computer vision engineers, and product teams to bridge the gap between experimental models and production\-ready systems that operate across diverse warehouse environments. We've found tremendous value in collaborative problem\-solving, thus our team works from our SF office three days a week. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Build end\-to\-end ML pipelines — from data ingestion and preprocessing through model training, evaluation, and deployment — and integrate them into core product workflows. * Train, evaluate, deploy and optimize state\-of\-the\-art machine learning models in the cloud using platforms and inference optimization techniques, including VLMs and VLAs. * Establish monitoring, benchmarking, and evaluation frameworks to ensure model performance and reliability in production environments. **Required Experience** ----------------------- * B.S. / M.S. in Computer Science, Robotics, or similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * 3\+ years in machine learning— developing, scaling, deploying, and optimizing large\-scale ML systems from data to model. * Track record of deploying machine learning models in production environments. * Experience with training and/or deployment of ML models in the computer vision domain. * Strong programming skills in Python. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Experience using orchestration systems (Flyte, Temporal, Airflow, or similar) for ML and data pipelines. * Proficiency with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, DeepSpeed, Ray) and model serving platforms (TorchServe, TensorFlow Serving, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, or similar). * Deep understanding of state\-of\-the\-art machine learning models such as auto\-regressive transformers and familiarity with inference optimization techniques (TensorRT, quantization, custom kernels). * Experience with C\+\+ or CUDA programming for GPU acceleration. * Comfortable with distributed messaging and compute systems (Kafka, gRPC, ROS2, or similar). * Prior experience working at autonomous vehicles or robotics companies. **Equal Opportunity Statement** We’re an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. **Benefits** At Claryo, we offer a competitive benefits package that supports your health and well\-being, including — top\-tier medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k with employer matching, parental leave, and unlimited vacation.
