jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** Across Clayco, people have built their own AI tools to get through the document\-heavy parts of their work — reviewing submittals, finding the right procedure, pulling history off a past project. Nobody asked them to. The work is tedious, the tools were available, and no one had given them a better option. That appetite is both the opportunity and the problem. We run governed agents on a Snowflake semantic layer today, with far more of the work ahead of us than behind. The gap is between what people will build for themselves and what we can actually stand behind. You will close it. This role builds the AI applications Clayco employees use in their daily work — governed, supported, and good enough that the private versions stop being worth the trouble. **The Specifics of the Role** * Build governed AI applications that make the ad\-hoc tools people built for themselves unnecessary * Build retrieval over our internal knowledge base: procedures, training content, project history, platform documentation * Turn our domain model into working retrieval boundaries rather than a diagram * Evaluate model and approach choices against real Clayco work rather than public benchmarks * Set the prompt and context engineering standards the engineers after you will inherit * Build inside our agent registry and identity model, not around it **Requirements** * **You have shipped this to real users.** Retrieval and document intelligence in production, with people depending on it; not a prototype that impressed a steering committee. * **You evaluate honestly.** You know whether a system works because you tested it on real tasks and looked at where it failed. If you have ever shipped something you knew was not ready, you know why this matters. * **You can work with the people who do the work.** Sitting with a project engineer, watching them review a submittal, and understanding why the obvious automation would be wrong. * **You are comfortable early.** This pillar is being built. You will have architectural latitude and fewer people to ask than you would somewhere established. * Nice to have: construction or AEC background, Snowflake Cortex, n8n, document extraction at scale, experience consolidating shadow tooling into something supported. **Some Things You Should Know** * Our clients and projects are nationwide – Travel will be required. * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! * This position is classified as a safety\-sensitive role in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. Candidates selected for this position will be subject to a comprehensive background check, which includes mandatory drug testing. **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Network Infrastructure
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer on the Network Infrastructure team to own the networking backbone of our multi\-cloud, application, and corporate infrastructure that every other engineering team at Commure relies on. This is a horizontal team supporting multi\-product infrastructure, and the network layer is yours to design, build, and operate end\-to\-end: * Multi\-cloud network foundation and IaC * Hybrid and on\-prem connectivity * Kubernetes and service networking * Edge, load balancing, and DNS * Network security and zero\-trust access * Network observability * Network automation using GitOps The stack today runs on public cloud (GCP, AWS, and Azure), with all infrastructure defined as code (Terraform and controller\-based). Argo CD drives deployment; Helm handles application packaging; Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry power observability. Networking is an active build\-out toward cloud\-native patterns (Kubernetes\-native networking, eBPF, Gateway API, service mesh), and the shape of it is yours to define. jobs.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
jobs.description: Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award\-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world\-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country. Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture! Credit Acceptance makes vehicle ownership possible for consumers other lenders decline, through a dealer network, an originations and servicing platform, and pricing and decisioning models refined over decades. The technology estate underneath this business was built project by project over a long period, and modernizing it is the largest engineering opportunity at the company. As the Distinguished Engineer, you are the senior\-most individual contributor in Technology, reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer. You will set the multi\-year technical strategy for the company while staying close enough to the code and systems to remain credible — this is not an architect role that reviews designs from a distance, nor a strong engineer role that goes deep in a single domain. Two things sit at the center of the job: the target architecture for the enterprise, and the architecture for running AI agents across it. You will not own a team; you will own the hardest technical problems the company has, and get them resolved by convincing the people who do own the teams. **Outcomes and Activities** * **Enterprise target architecture:** Convene the principal and staff engineers who own each domain to define the end\-state architecture across originations, servicing, marketplace, data, and AI, and use it to drive the multi\-year plan. Ensure every component has a defined interface with stated inputs and outputs, every unmade decision has a written principle standing in for it, and the document states honestly how close the organization is to the end state. Publish the architecture, including the tradeoffs that were rejected and why. * **Agentic AI architecture across the enterprise:** Own the enterprise agent architecture spanning servicing and collections, the dealer side, originations, and internal engineering and back\-office workflows, built on one common foundation rather than one stack per team. Establish a governed way for agents to discover and call business capabilities, data, and tools, using the Model Context Protocol as the integration layer. Define an identity and authorization model that treats an agent as a first\-class actor with its own least\-privilege entitlements, along with observability, evaluation, and cost controls that work consistently for every agent. Set policy on what an agent may decide independently versus what stays with a person, and define where that line moves and on what evidence. Design the architecture to produce an examiner\-ready record of what each agent saw, recommended, and touched, and set the evaluation and adversarial testing approach that makes agent outcomes defensible. Ensure the same foundation and controls apply to agents built by outside firms on the company's behalf. * **Migration off on\-premises infrastructure:** Own the technical strategy for migrating transactional and analytical workloads off on\-premises infrastructure to the company's strategic targets — AWS for transactional workloads and Databricks for analytical workloads — determining what lifts and shifts, what replatforms, what gets re\-architected on the way versus after, and what the steady\-state cost looks like. Own the resilience and recovery architecture for the target state. * **Data platform architecture:** Set the architecture for change\-data\-capture\-based ingestion, streaming where warranted, and a modern warehouse with no job\-scheduling dependency, moving the organization from largely batch analytical data movement to real time. Help settle the open question of who owns the transactional and analytical data models. * **Real\-time decisioning, model serving, and experimentation:** Architect for pricing and credit model and scorecard updates that drop in as a layer rather than requiring a multi\-quarter rebuild, and for an experimentation platform that supports orders of magnitude more concurrent experiments than a conventional release process allows. * **Marketplace and search architecture siness implications. * **Enterprise Problem\-Solving:** Ability to solve enterprise\-wide problems where no precedent exists and to own cross\-team shared infrastructure. * **Strategic Independence:** Ability to define and execute technical strategy for the entire organization, partner closely with executives, mobilize resources, and drive consensus across stakeholders at all levels. * **Visionary Leadership:** Bold strategic thinking paired with curiosity, ingenuity, and resourcefulness; recognized industry\-level thought leadership and a commitment to lifelong learning. * **Customer and Market Insight:** Company\-wide expertise in customer needs, using deep customer and market understanding to shape product and technical strategy and anticipate the impact of industry trends. * **Technical Writing:** Ability to produce architecture documentation clear and complete enough for others to act on independently. * **Executive Communication and Influence:** Ability to build consensus and influence direction across organizational and executive boundaries without formal authority. * **Talent Development:** Ability to raise the technical bar of engineers across the organization, including staff and principal engineers who are not direct reports. **Target Compensation:** A competitive base salary range from $232,500 \- $341,000\. This position is eligible for equity and annual cash bonuses. Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role\-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications. Candidates who reside in the following major metropolitan areas may be eligible for a premium on top of the posted range based on their specific zone: San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York City, Los Angeles and San Diego. INDENGLP \#zip \#LI\-Remote **Benefits** * Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work **Our Company Values:** To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be: * Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions * Respectful by collaborating and actively listening * Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self\-awareness and making quality decisions * Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage * Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting **Expectations:** * Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines * All other duties as assigned * Attendance as required by department **Advice** ! We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application! **P.S** . We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk! Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent. Credit Acceptance is dedicated to providing a safe and inclusive working environment for all. As part of our Culture of Compliance, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and value our culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of the person’s age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, criminal history, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** Crossfield Technologies is hiring a Senior Network Engineer to design, install, and maintain reliable networks for small and mid\-sized business clients in the Austin area. You will take ownership of network design and implementation, resolve complex technical issues escalated by the help desk, and support junior engineers as they develop their skills. The role involves both remote troubleshooting and on\-site client work, so you should be comfortable managing technical problems independently and explaining your decisions clearly. **What You'll Do** * Design network layouts covering routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, and wireless connectivity. * Install and configure network equipment at client sites and remotely. * Investigate outages, connectivity problems, and performance issues escalated by the help desk. * Review network monitoring alerts and identify issues that need attention before they affect clients. * Plan and carry out firmware updates and other network changes with appropriate care. * Maintain accurate technical documentation, configuration records, and network diagrams. * Explain incidents, their causes, and proposed solutions to clients and colleagues in straightforward language. * Guide junior engineers through troubleshooting and network configuration tasks. * Coordinate on\-site visits and technical work across client locations in the Austin area. * Participate in the on\-call rotation and respond to assigned support escalations. **What You'll Bring** * At least five years of professional network engineering experience. * Practical knowledge of routing, switching, and VLAN design. * Hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting firewalls and wireless network controllers. * Experience installing and supporting network infrastructure in business environments. * The ability to diagnose complex network problems methodically. * Strong written documentation skills, including the ability to create clear network diagrams. * A careful approach to configuration changes, updates, and incident resolution. * The communication skills needed to explain technical issues without unnecessary jargon. * A willingness to visit client sites around Austin and participate in an on\-call rotation. **How We Work** We value engineers who take responsibility for their changes, keep documentation current, and communicate clearly when a problem occurs. You should be able to explain what happened, what you did to resolve it, and whether any further action is needed. As a senior member of the engineering team, you will also help junior colleagues develop sound troubleshooting habits and follow consistent technical practices. **Working Schedule** **Regular hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM **Additional requirement:** Participation in an on\-call rotation **Work location:** Austin, Texas, with on\-site client visits as required **Hiring Process** The selection process consists of three stages: * **Phone interview:** Discuss your network engineering background, technical experience, and approach to client support. * **Practical troubleshooting exercise:** Work through a network issue in a lab environment and explain your diagnostic process. * **Engineering team meeting:** Discuss your technical judgement, documentation practices, and approach to working with other engineers. **How to Apply** Submit your resume and a short description of a network you built, improved, or repaired. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two\-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on\-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments. This is a **Sr. Software Development Engineer II** (SDE) role in the **CTIO** team that is bringing multiple AI\-based strategies together into an integrated capability on our next\-generation sensor (lightweight agent) across macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms. The Sr. SDEs in the team own the design and development of the features that put AI on the endpoint: operationalizing machine learning models inside the sensor, building the data pipelines that collect, transform and deliver sensor telemetry for model training, evaluation and on\-device inference, and integrating those capabilities with the core sensor features. jobs.title: Platform Engineer L2
jobs.description: **About Curative** Curative is building the future of health insurance with a first\-of\-its\-kind employer\-based plan designed to remove financial barriers and make care truly accessible: one monthly premium with $0 copays and $0 deductibles\*. Backed by our recent **$150M in Series B funding** and valuation at **$1\.275B**, Curative is scaling rapidly and investing in AI\-powered service, deeper member engagement, and a smart network designed for today’s workforce. Our north star guides everything we do: **healthcare only works when people can actually use it**. That belief drives every decision we make: from how we design our plan, support our members, to how we collaborate as a team. If you want to do meaningful work with a team that moves fast, experiments boldly, and cares deeply, Curative is the place to do it. We’re growing fast and looking for teammates who want to help transform health insurance for the better.**About the Platform Team** --------------------------- The Platform team's mission is to create a highly productive environment for application developers to experiment and ship new business features and systems. We own the cloud infrastructure, developer experience tooling, CI/CD, and shared platform services that the rest of engineering builds on. Our primary stack is **AWS, OpenTofu, Python, and Go**. **The Role** ------------ As a Platform Engineer (L2\), you'll own meaningful pieces of our infrastructure end\-to\-end — designing, deploying, and maintaining services that other engineers rely on every day. You'll work on projects on roughly 4\-week horizons, ship infrastructure changes with minimal day\-to\-day guidance, and steadily deepen your specialization in cloud architecture, reliability, and developer tooling. This role is a good fit if you've shipped production infrastructure at one or more prior organizations, have a working grasp of IaC fundamentals, and want to grow your platform engineering craft on a team that takes developer experience seriously. This is a fully remote position. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Deploy and maintain infrastructure with OpenTofu, with a focus on fault tolerance and operational simplicity. * Own the lifecycle of services and subsystems — design, deployment, production support, and ongoing improvements. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines so application teams can ship safely and quickly. * Investigate and resolve moderately complex infrastructure and performance issues, developing structured troubleshooting habits along the way. * Integrate security and compliance considerations — including HIPAA — into infrastructure decisions. * Participate in architecture design discussions, and help engineers across the org navigate cloud and automation frameworks. * Contribute to broader platform reliability improvements and process optimization across engineering. * Take on small\-scale project leadership: scoping work, managing timelines, and coordinating with teammates. * Participate in the on\-call rotation for systems your team owns. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * A few years of professional experience as a software, platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineer, including time at more than one organization. * Hands\-on experience with a major cloud provider; AWS preferred. * Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code — OpenTofu, Terraform, or equivalent. * Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines. * Proficiency in at least one of Python or Go, and willingness to work in both. * Solid fundamentals in networking, storage, and monitoring. * Ability to debug production issues independently and communicate clearly about what you found. * Comfort participating in an on\-call rotation. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, finance) with compliance requirements like HIPAA. * Exposure to Kubernetes (EKS) or other container orchestration. * Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus). * Background in developer experience or internal platform work. **Perks \& Benefits*** Curative Health Plan (100% employer\-covered medical premiums for you and 50% coverage for dependents on the base plan.) + $0 copays and $0 deductibles (with completion of our Baseline Visit ) + Preventive and primary care built in + Mental health support + One\-on\-one care navigation + Chronic condition programs (diabetes, weight, hypertension) + Maternity and family planning support + 24/7/365 Curative Telehealth + Pharmacy benefits * Comprehensive dental and vision coverage * Employer\-provided life and disability coverage with additional supplemental options * Flexible spending accounts * Generous PTO policy plus 11 paid annual company holidays * 401K for full\-time employees * Generous Up to 8–12 weeks paid parental leave, based on role eligibility.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Curium** Curium is the world’s largest nuclear medicine company with more than a century of industry experience. We develop, manufacture and distribute world\-class radiopharmaceutical products to help patients around the globe. Our proven heritage combined with a pioneering approach are the hallmarks to deliver innovation, excellence and unparalleled service. With manufacturing facilities across Europe and the United States, Curium delivers SPECT, PET and therapeutic radiopharmaceutical solutions for life\-threatening diseases to over 14 million patients annually. The name ‘Curium’ honors the legacy of pioneering radioactive researchers Marie and Pierre Curie, after whom the radioactive element curium was named and emphasizes our focus on nuclear medicine. The tagline ‘Life Forward’ represents our commitment to securing a brighter future for all those we serve: An enhanced quality of care for our patients. A trusted partner to our customers. A supportive employer to our valued team. **Summary of Position** ----------------------- We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data platforms, and analytical data products. Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, or similar cloud platforms is highly desirable. **Work Schedule:** M \- F 8am \- 5pm. real\-time data pipelines. + Build reliable ETL/ELT processes for structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data. + Integrate data from databases, APIs, SaaS applications, files, and event streams. + Develop and maintain cloud\-based data lake, lakehouse, and data warehouse solutions. + Work with technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Spark, SQL, and cloud storage. + Implement reusable data engineering frameworks, patterns, and standards. + Support data platform modernization and migration initiatives. * Data Modeling \& Data Products: + analytics, and machine learning. + Support domain\-oriented data products within a data mesh operating model. * Data Quality, Governance \& Security: + Implement data validation, quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting. + Support data cataloging, metadata management, lineage, and data ownership. + Implement appropriate security, access controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements. + Establish monitoring and operational processes for production data pipelines. * Performance \& Cost Optimization: + Optimize data pipelines, queries, storage, and compute workloads. + Apply appropriate partitioning, clustering, caching, and workload\-management techniques. + Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, scalability, reliability, and total cost of ownership. * Collaboration \& Delivery: + Partner with architects, data scientists, analytics engineers, BI developers, application developers, and business stakeholders. + Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. + Participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, code reviews, and Agile delivery. + Create technical documentation and operational runbooks. + Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering best practices. + Must maintain operational compliance with US and international regulatory agencies and guidelines (i.e. FDA, DEA, EU, HC, TGA, PIC/S, ISO, USP, NRC, cGMP, etc.). **Requirements** ---------------- * Must have Experience / Skills: + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. + 5\+ years of professional data engineering experience. + Strong SQL and database development skills. + Experience developing production\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines. + Proficiency in Python, Scala, Java, or similar programming language. + Experience with cloud data platforms and cloud storage. + Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehouses, data lakes, and/or lakehouses. + Experience with Git, CI/CD, testing, and deployment practices. * Nice to have Experience / Skills: + Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric. + Experience with Apache Spark / PySpark and distributed data processing. + Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. + Experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Event Hubs, or Kinesis. + Experience with orchestration tools such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, or similar. + Experience with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or other open table formats. + Experience implementing data mesh, domain\-oriented data products, or federated data architectures. + Experience with data catalog, lineage, governance, and observability platforms. + Experience supporting AI/ML data workloads. + Industry certifications or training in data engineering, cloud platforms, master data management, analytics, or project management. + Experience with pharmaceutical regulatory guidelines, including electronic records and signatures, data integrity, cGMP, FDA 21 CFR Parts 11, 210, and 211, EU Annex 11, MHRA, and GAMP 5\. + Additional languages a Plus **Working Conditions:** * This position will work in typical office conditions with extensive time using computer equipment. * Close attention to detail required. * Willingness to work in a team\-based environment. * May be required to sit or stand for long periods of 8\+ hours a day while performing duties. * Must possess good hand\-eye coordination; close attention to detail is required. * Willingness to complete safety training within allotted timeframes, and work in a team\-based environment. * The position deals with many deadlines. Must be able to work outside of regular work hours, including off shift, weekend, and holiday work as business needs require. **Disclaimer** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a seed\-stage AI company, backed by a top\-tier venture firm, building the ad layer for the AI era: interactive brand experiences embedded natively into apps and websites. Its ads are generated dynamically in real time and personalized to every single user, so every impression is hyper\-relevant. The recommendation stack is already live, serving ads across millions of daily interactions, reaching tens of millions of users, with millions in annualized ad spend. Dozens of AI\-generated playable mini\-game and video ads run in production inside major AI apps, built on the company's own playable engine and editor, and its ad SDK (Swift, Kotlin, React, React Native) is live in top App Store and Google Play apps. The team is small and based in San Francisco, with multiple prior exits and experience from leading tech and finance companies. ### **About the Role** The Applied AI Engineer owns the engine that makes real\-time, personalized ads possible: agents that generate playable mini\-games, short\-form video, and every variant in between on the fly, then learn from how they perform across millions of daily interactions and millions in annualized ad spend. This is a full\-stack applied AI role spanning model selection, agent orchestration, and production infrastructure, with direct business impact at every layer. The architecture isn't defined yet, and this hire helps define the approach. The agents plug into a recommendation stack that is already serving ads in production, and every ad they create is served to real users and measured against real advertiser dollars. The stack runs on GCP, Redis, MongoDB, and Temporal. The role comes with ownership, equity, and a direct line to what ships. ### **What You'll Own** * **Playable generation agents:** Agents that turn an advertiser or app brief into a working, on\-brand HTML5 playable ad. * **Automated QA:** Checks that catch broken playable builds before a human does. * **Video generation pipelines:** Multimodal pipelines that produce short\-form video ads and variants across formats, hooks, and styles using frontier image and video models. * **Real\-time personalization loop:** Connect generation to the recommendation and ranking engine so each user gets creative made for them, read what wins (engagement, CTR, installs, ROAS), and feed it back so every impression gets more relevant. * **Agent infrastructure:** Orchestration, evals, and reliability so all of this runs in production at scale, not just in a demo. ### **What's Already Live** You inherit a working system with real traffic, not a blank slate: * A recommendation stack already serving ads across millions of daily interactions, reaching tens of millions of users with millions of dollars in annualized ad spend * Dozens of AI\-generated playable mini\-game and video ads running in production inside major AI apps, built on the company's own playable engine and editor * A proprietary ad SDK (Swift, Kotlin, React, React Native), live in top App Store and Google Play apps ### **Must\-Have** * Strong applied AI experience: has built and shipped an LLM, multimodal, or agentic system in production, beyond simple API wrappers. * Backend depth across infra, data, and serving end\-to\-end, not just the model layer (GCP, Redis, MongoDB, Temporal). * Comfort with ambiguity: the architecture isn't defined yet, and this hire helps define the approach. * Bias toward shipping, suited to an early\-stage company that moves fast and figures things out. ### **Key Details** * **Location:** San Francisco, CA (in\-person) * **Employment:** Full\-time * **Experience:** 4\+ years * **Salary:** $200,000 – $250,000 USD per year, plus equity * **Visa Sponsorship:** Not available ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Equity * Ownership and a direct line to what ships ### **Interview Process** * Interview with the CTO * Take\-home assignment * Work trial * Offer

Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team. **About the Team** When a Fortune 500 C\-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real. Your counterpart is the C\-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision\-making models that make a top\-down transformation feel safe to bet on. You hold that relationship from the first pre\-sales conversation through the life of the account. The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard\-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent. These are the largest, most complex enterprises in the market. The ones that require deep customization, real judgment, and a partner who can operate at the highest level. This is not a standardized implementation role, and it is not an account management or customer success role. **About the Role** This role owns the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of AI solutions for Decagon's customers, serving as the primary technical and strategic owner. You earn trust with the customer's leadership team, scope a solution that solves their problems, and then build the working AI agent. You are the direct owner for each account's agents end\-to\-end, partnering with our Strategic Account Directors, Agent Strategy Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers to scale the agent in production and grow it into a core part of how the customer's company runs. It is a rare combination: the executive influence of a top strategy consulting leader, the instincts of a product builder, and the ownership of a founder. If you have ever wanted to build the solution instead of hand off the recommendation, this role was designed for you. You own the outcome end to end, on the highest\-stakes accounts in the market, with all of Decagon's cross\-functional teams behind you. This is a senior individual contributor role. You are trusted to make high\-stakes decisions independently and own outcomes, gaining leverage by directing forward deployed engineers and partner teams who own a share of the execution. **In this role, you will** * Own the technical win on Decagon's largest strategic opportunities, partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineers and Forward\-deployed engineers to build working AI agents that turn sophisticated, skeptical buyers into signed customers. * Serve as the executive partner to the C\-suite of Fortune 500 companies, defining and driving their AI transformation roadmap and owning the relationship from first conversation through production and expansion. * Design, build, and optimize enterprise\-grade AI agents in production, going deep on each customer's workflows, pain points, and goals. * Turn the frameworks and playbooks you develop into reusable assets that scale across accounts and feed directly into Decagon's product roadmap. * Direct Forward\-deployed engineers and partner teams to deliver at scale while you stay accountable for the outcome. * Run tight feedback loops into Product and Engineering, shaping the product based on what you learn on the front lines of our most demanding deployments. **Your background looks something like this** * 3\+ years of experience owning ambiguous, high\-stakes outcomes and earning the trust of senior executives. This includes engagement managers, project leaders, and senior managers from top consulting firms, as well as product managers, founders, and forward\-deployed or solutions roles at high\-growth technology companies. * A builder's instinct. You want to design and build the actual solution, not just diagnose the problem or manage someone else who builds it. * Strong technical acumen. You can understand and shape AI agent designs and hold your own in a technical conversation with both engineers and executives. * Executive presence and a track record of becoming a trusted advisor to senior decision\-makers at large, complex organizations. * Comfort operating in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape the solution as much as you implement it. **Even better** * A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree, or equivalent hands\-on technical experience. * An MBA, or equivalent experience at the intersection of business strategy and technology, is a plus. * Experience selling, deploying, or advising on enterprise software or transformation programs at the Fortune 500 level. **Compensation** $150K – $200K \+ Offers Equity **Benefits** We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance and Disability Benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension) * Parental Leave * Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot * Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance * Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave) *These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.description: Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience in software development using Python and C\+\+. * Experience with machine learning (ML) hardware accelerators, ML compiler stacks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, XLA), and kernel development. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * PhD degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 2 years of experience with full\-stack system development for hardware accelerators. * 2 years of experience with collaborative, hyper\-scalar software development and engineering best practices. * Experience scoping, planning, and executing projects towards team goals in ambiguous environments. **About the job** ----------------- We are building a next\-generation compute platform for AI inference workloads, with an emphasis on memory technologies, Hardware (HW) acceleration, and Software (SW)/HW codesign. We are looking for enthusiastic engineers to join the project. This is a coding role for engineers who like to take initiative and get things done, with a focus on ML compiler stack and inference infrastructure. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Direct full\-stack Software (SW) role, focusing on ML compiler and inference infrastructure. * Design and develop ML compiler stack to bridge AI workloads and low\-level Hardware (HW) operators. * Design and develop SW infrastructure to enable high performance inference. * Drive SW/HW codesign, kernel optimization, performance tuning, and debugging. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Software Engineer
jobs.description: Defibtech is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Software Engineer responsible for production tools, databases, platforms, and test station software used in the manufacture of medical devices, which are deployed both on site and at Defibtech’s contract manufacturers. This role is primarily focused on software design and maintenance to support new products, sustain products, and make process improvements to our production tools and systems. This role is based onsite at our Branford, CT manufacturing location, hybrid capable. **Core Responsibilities:** * Supports and implements updates on\-site and at contract manufacturing sites to support Defibtech production systems. * Develops and maintains production tools and systems, which are used to interface with Defibtech devices and test equipment, program and test the devices, generate labels, and automate recording of test data. Software development is inclusive of coding, sandbox testing, documentation, writing and executing test protocols, and managing release of the code through the Engineering Change process, all according to quality and regulatory requirements. * Performs test station environment and database qualifications and supports verification and validation testing as required. * Serves as central contact for production and pilot test station setup and troubleshooting. * Generates and executes data queries in support of production investigations. * Participates in cross\-functional teams and facilitates the transfer of development projects into the manufacturing production test environment. * Identifies and implements improvements in both database and software development processes and develops and implements new software for new product rollouts, as required. * Supports and leads investigations, including identification of root cause and implementation of corrective or preventative actions using various Defibtech processes (CAPA, PAF, SCAR, etc.). * Creates and manages documentation utilizing Defibtech’s Change Control process, including ECR/ECO, station specifications, documents, and test protocols. * Demonstrates Defibtech’s values on the job. Promotes and participates in continuous improvement. * Actively supports compliance of Company operations to all applicable laws, regulations and standards, good business practices and company documented procedures (including but not limited to FDA, Quality Management Systems Regulations, safety regulations, and applicable statutes). **Qualifications / Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related degree and at least 5 years of relevant experience OR the equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience. * PC hardware, Windows OS, and peripherals experience required. * Preferred candidates will have experience in a Manufacturing / Test support environment, embedded software, and/or SQL Server, Visual Basic, C\# or similar experience. * Medical Device product/industry experience including development operating under ISO 13485, highly preferred. * Ability to operate independently, lead project initiatives related to manufacturing, make decisions, influence outcomes, and drive tasks to successful completion. * Ability to establish and support hardware platform interface and peripherals communication using software applications is desirable. * Strong written and oral communication skills to accurately convey issues and information. * Ability to multi\-task and work in a fast paced, high\-volume environment. **Work Environment and Physical Demands:** * Work environment is based within office and light manufacturing setting. * Light work that includes moving objects up to 20 lbs; frequent sitting, walking, and standing. **Compensation:** * $92,000 \- $151,000 per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and other job\-related factors. **Benefits:** * Defibtech offers a comprehensive benefits package including health and wellness benefits, company\-paid disability \& life insurance, and 401k with company matching contribution and more. * Defibtech promotes a challenging, collaborative, and friendly culture that is centered around our values and mission. * Defibtech is supportive of work balance, providing company gatherings to add fun and generous paid time off and flexibility for employees to manage time and responsibilities. * Defibtech is committed to empowering and supporting our employees in their philanthropic efforts through donation programs and time off for volunteerism. *The above description of core responsibilities and qualifications is intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.* *Defibtech is committed to a diverse workplace and is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and E\-Verify Company. We provide fair and equal employment and advancement opportunities for all employees and candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.* *All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, drug screen, verification of legal right to work in the U.S., and in some cases, a credit check. A credit check will be administered when a prospective employee will be working in Finance, or where duties may involve handling of funds, accounts, or cash. A Motor Vehicle (MVR) check will be administered when a prospective employee will be regularly driving on Company business.* *Defibtech endeavors to make www.defibtech.com accessible to all users. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description: Business Title: **Program Manager** Location: **Hybrid** Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust **Position Summary** Definitive Innovative Solutions (DIS) is seeking a **Program Manager** to lead enterprise IT operations and modernization for our customers across cloud infrastructure, application development, cybersecurity, data management, identity and access management, and accessibility. You will serve as the primary contractor point of contact for DIS and clients, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and alignment with customer priorities. This hands\-on leadership role combines program management expertise with technical judgment to guide multidisciplinary teams, sustain reliable operations, and deliver secure, accessible, and cost\-effective solutions **Duties and Responsibilities** * Serve as the primary contractor interface with the COR and designated government stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, responsive issue resolution, and customer satisfaction. * Lead architects, engineers, developers, cybersecurity specialists, accessibility professionals, and support personnel in an integrated SecDevOps environment. * Contribute technical expertise within your area of specialization and coordinate specialists to resolve architecture, operational, security, and delivery issues. * Develop and maintain the Program Management Plan and integrated master schedule, including tasks, milestones, deliverables, staffing, dependencies, risks, and government review periods. * Manage contract execution within authorized scope, funding, and staffing levels. Coordinate proposed changes with the COR and Contracting Officer through established processes. * Direct workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, coverage, and succession planning to maintain qualified staff and uninterrupted services. * Manage program budgets, labor utilization, estimates, forecasts, invoices, and cost reconciliation. Track actual and projected expenditures by project, contract line item, accounting number, and task. * Maintain management dashboards covering delivery progress, resource utilization, financial performance, cloud consumption, and cost\-optimization opportunities. * Conduct biweekly status meetings and submit monthly status reports by the fifth business day. Ensure timely agendas, meeting minutes, decisions, and action tracking. * Maintain the program risk and issue register, assign mitigation owners, escalate unresolved concerns, and coordinate government review of risk\-acceptance requests. * Coordinate development sprints, infrastructure maintenance, application releases, and approved migrations while managing dependencies and protecting ongoing operations. * Ensure changes follow approved architecture, configuration\-management, change\-control, and release\-management processes. * Integrate cybersecurity, privacy, human\-centered design, Section 508 accessibility, and quality reviews into planning, development, testing, and operations. * Coordinate security assessments, authorization support, vulnerability remediation, POA\&M tracking, incident\-response activities, and required reporting with responsible technical leads. * Implement the Quality Control Plan, monitor agreed service levels, and drive corrective actions. Ensure verification and validation activities maintain the required independence from development. * Ensure deliverables are complete, accurate, reviewed, and submitted for government acceptance. Maintain operational documentation, technical artifacts, and performance evidence in approved repositories. * Identify opportunities for automation, shared services, process improvement, and emerging technology evaluation. Present recommendations and oversee implementation following government approval. * Manage transition\-in, knowledge transfer, and transition\-out activities, including transfer of documentation, assets, responsibilities, and operational knowledge. * Coordinate with our clients service providers, vendors, other contractors, and program stakeholders to resolve dependencies and support enterprise service delivery. * Manage subcontractor performance, deliverables, staffing, and contractual obligations to ensure integrated program execution. * Other duties as assigned **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, plus at least 10 years of IT experience. * Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or a comparable program/project management credential. * Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams responsible for enterprise cloud operations, application development, and modernization. * Experience managing federal IT programs, including government stakeholder engagement, contract deliverables, staffing, financial management, and performance reporting. * Experience with SecDevOps and Agile delivery, including sprint coordination, release planning, configuration management, and operational support. * Working knowledge of cloud architecture, containerized applications, APIs, identity and access management, and data services sufficient to guide technical discussions and manage delivery risks. * Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and privacy requirements, including FISMA, the NIST Risk Management Framework, FedRAMP, and assessment and authorization processes. * Understanding of Section 508 accessibility and its integration into the system development lifecycle. * Experience developing integrated schedules, budgets, forecasts, resource plans, risk registers, and management dashboards using project and financial management tools. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive briefings, technical reporting, and cross\-functional issue resolution. * Ability to satisfy applicable background investigation, credentialing, training, and system\-access requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's in Information Technology, computer science, or a related field and at least 12 years of IT experience. * Experience supporting federal civilian agency. * Familiarity with ITIL service\-management practices and CMMI process\-improvement approaches. * Experience establishing or transitioning multidisciplinary delivery organizations while maintaining service continuity. * Experience with cloud cost management, operational automation, and government\-approved AI or emerging technology evaluations. **Why Join DIS** Our culture is the heartbeat of our success. We believe that innovation doesn't just happen, it's cultivated through curiosity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. Our team is made up of passionate professionals who thrive in a dynamic environment where ideas are valued, creativity is encouraged, and growth is a shared journey. ***Innovation at the Core*** We foster a culture where innovation is not just a buzzword, it's a mindset. From daily stand\-ups to strategic brainstorming sessions, we create space for experimentation and bold thinking. Our teams are empowered to challenge the status quo, explore emerging technologies, and develop solutions that push boundaries and deliver real impact for our clients. ***People\-First Philosophy*** We invest in our people because we know they are our greatest asset. Through continuous learning opportunities, mentorship programs, and cross\-functional collaboration, we help our team members grow both personally and professionally. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe that the best ideas come from inclusive, empowered teams. ***Agility and Ownership*** Our culture embraces agility and accountability. We encourage initiative, reward problem\-solving, and support a fail\-fast, learn\-faster approach. Every team member is trusted to take ownership of their work and contribute meaningfully to our mission. ***Collaboration Without Borders*** Whether remote or in\-person, we maintain a strong sense of connection and community. We use modern tools to collaborate seamlessly across teams and time zones, ensuring that innovation and communication flow freely. Definitive Innovative Solutions, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Definitive Innovative Solutions, LLC will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another.

infrastructure and high\-density rack solutions * Design and develop mechanical and thermal components for air and liquid\-cooled systems, leveraging 3D Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) tools to create system\-level performance * Collaborate with and influence technology partners, suppliers, manufacturing, quality, and tooling teams to create robust designs while improving scalability, and data sheets * Experience driving complex, fast\-paced product development programs **Desirable** * Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or related field * Experience jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com **Job summary** **This position is for the SSL Store, powered by DigiCert** We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, TLS and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. The platform is a TypeScript monorepo: Fastify and Express services, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL and Redis, queues and workers on AWS, deployed to Kubernetes through Terraform, Helm, and Azure DevOps pipelines. It also carries a legacy .NET estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of AI\-assisted features and internal tooling. You will own features end to end, from schema and API through UI, pipeline, and production. We work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before **What you will do** * Design, build, and ship features across the full stack: Fastify or Express APIs, Next.js and React frontends, MySQL schemas and migrations, SQS\-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them. * Own services in production: observability with Sentry and Grafana, on\-call participation, incident root\-causing, and the follow\-through fixes. * Build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter. * Maintain and incrementally retire legacy .NET and Python components, moving behavior into the TypeScript platform with parity verified rather than assumed. * Extend CI/CD and infrastructure: Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker images, Helm charts, and Terraform for EKS, RDS, SQS, and related AWS services. * Integrate third\-party and partner APIs (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build AI\-backed features where they genuinely improve the product. * Review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and AI\-generated code alike. * Mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room. **What you will have** * 6\+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js, including a modern API framework (Fastify preferred, Express acceptable) and a React framework (Next.js preferred). * Production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. Depth in a single language is not enough for this role. * Solid relational database skills on MySQL or Postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, and transaction and locking behavior. * Comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence\-led debugging in production. * Security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene. * Clear written communication. You can explain a design, a trade\-off, or an incident to engineers and non\-engineers. **Nice to have** * Hands\-on AWS (compute, queues, storage, secrets) and the ability to read and change Terraform. * Containers and Kubernetes at a working level: writing a Dockerfile, reading a Helm chart, debugging a failing pod. * CI/CD pipeline work in Azure DevOps or similar, plus Cloudflare or AWS WAF experience. * Grafana, Sentry, or equivalent observability tooling beyond basic dashboards. * Experience with PKI, TLS, or certificate lifecycle management, or with monitoring and scanning products (uptime, vulnerability, DNS or email security). * OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect implementation experience, especially multi\-tenant identity providers. * C\# and .NET, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home. * Python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling. * Large\-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them. * Building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, or agentic workflows in a product context. **Benefits** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP) * Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Life and disability coverage * Flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable) * Health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs * Employee Assistance Program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families * Education assistance and professional development opportunities * Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources * Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts * Internal rewards and recognition platform (Motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues * Business travel insurance and global employee support programs To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. Resumes or CVs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered. DigiCert is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. In compliance with applicable federal and state laws, DigiCert prohibits discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, veteran's status, status as a qualified person with a disability, or genetic information. Individuals from historically underrepresented groups, such as minorities, women, qualified person with disabilities, and protected veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. \#LI\-IW1

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ Docusign is seeking an experienced full\-stack software engineer to expand on its anti\-abuse strategies for protecting our customers and infrastructure against attack. The ideal candidate will have experience working on high\-scale distributed systems in a service\-oriented architecture. The team is part of the Docusign Platform organization and will build technology to help identify and block suspicious behaviors around our applications and services. Our team is looking for a talented individual with a passion for customer and infrastructure security. You will be helping define the vision and approach to fighting bots, spam, fraud and denial of service threats that are always changing. This position will demand critical thinking skills and a desire to analyze the patterns of abusers and turn that analysis into systems, including machine learning models, that can evaluate risks in real\-time. Your background will show that it involves strategy, delivery, and implementation in past roles and academic settings. Docusign is a global company, so a successful candidate will have the ability to work across different teams and geographies. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Engineering. **Responsibility** * Architect, implement and maintain some of Docusign's highest scale services * Build APIs to power the next generation of Docusign's customer multi\-screen experiences that are responsive, highly performant and Al driven * Drive developer efficiencies through engineering best practices, automation, and CI/CD * Work with world class telemetry systems to work through complex problems and solve them with data * Think through how systems will scale and fail as they grow * Take complicated problems and break them down into bite sized pieces, then ship every few weeks to get there * Work throughout the stack, from network protocols to database performance and back **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. **What you bring** ------------------ **Basic** * 5\+ years of software development experience with a Bachelor's degree or 3\+ years of experience with a Master's degree * Experience with backend languages (C\#, Go, Java, Node.js) and frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript) * Experience querying and modifying data in relational databases * Experience consuming SOAP and RESTful web service APIs * Professional experience leveraging Al\-assisted development tools (for example, Al code\-completion, Al code\-generation, or Al\-powered refactoring) as part of the software delivery lifecycle **Preferred** * Experience debugging high\-priority production issues * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Node.js development experience * Experience using Al\-assisted tooling to triage issues, analyze logs, and propose remediation steps for complex integration problems * Experience contributing to team guidelines or enablement around safe and effective Al usage in engineering workflows **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $140,100\.00 \- $206,775\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure (MDX)
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ DoorDash's MDX team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared foundation that ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo rely on to build and run ML\-powered products. We work across the full ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, serving, and monitoring. Our mission is to increase the velocity and reliability of ML\-driven business impact across the company. A central pillar of that work is agentic infrastructure. We are building systems that let agents accelerate and operate the ML workflow itself, including auto research, where agents explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and self\-healing systems that detect, diagnose, and remediate failures in ML pipelines and production models with minimal human intervention. **About the Role** ------------------ You will join a small, high\-leverage team building the agentic layer of DoorDash's ML infrastructure. You'll design and build the systems that let agents accelerate how ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo develop, ship, and operate models. That includes auto research systems that explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and agentic developer support that helps ML engineers move through training, evaluation, deployment, and debugging faster. You'll own well\-scoped components end to end, from design through production, working across agent orchestration, tooling and integrations with our ML platform, evaluation of agent behavior, and observability. This role is ideal for an engineer with a strong backend foundation who is excited to apply AI agents to real engineering workflows, learns quickly, and wants to grow into technical leadership in a fast\-moving area where model capabilities, tooling, and best practices change month to month. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Build agentic systems that increase the velocity of ML development across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, helping ML engineers get from idea to production model faster. * Design and implement infrastructure that lets agents propose, run, and evaluate modeling experiments. * Build agentic developer support for the ML lifecycle, such as agents that help engineers set up training jobs, debug failing pipelines, review model deployments, and navigate our platform. * Develop evaluation and observability for agent behavior, so we can measure whether agents are actually helping, catch regressions early, and build the trust needed to give them more autonomy. * Work with production standards in mind, including reliability, safety guardrails, cost controls, monitoring, and clear playbooks, so that agentic workflows can run against real ML systems. * Partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to understand where their time goes and turn those workflows into durable, reusable platform capabilities. * Grow quickly in a fast\-moving area, with the chance to shape how agents are used to build and operate ML systems at a company of this scale. **We're excited about you because…** ------------------------------------ * B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent * 2\+ years of industry experience in software engineering * Hands\-on experience building ML infrastructure in production including feature engineering and feature stores, data pipelines for ML, training and experimentation platforms, model evaluation, deployment, serving and inference, or monitoring * Strong backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems * Experience operating systems in production, including testing, observability, debugging, and reliability * A good understanding of how ML engineers and data scientists work, and a track record of building platforms, tools, or services that make them more productive * Ability to take ambiguous, well\-scoped problems from idea to production, and to learn quickly in a fast\-moving technical area * Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across the software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring, and releasing software ### **Nice To Haves** * Experience building LLM\-powered applications or AI agents, including tool use, orchestration, or MCP servers, in production or on substantial projects * Experience with agent evaluation, LLM observability, tracing, or building eval harnesses * Experience with ML platforms or MLOps tooling (e.g., Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, Airflow) * Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) * Experience building developer tools, internal platforms, or self\-serve infrastructure * Experience with guardrails, safety, or cost controls for LLM systems **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
