Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only We used Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. jobs.description: **ABOUT eGENESIS** ------------------ eGenesis is a clinical\-stage biotechnology company developing human\-compatible engineered organs to address the severe global organ shortage. The Company’s proprietary genome engineering platform enables extensive, multiplex gene edits to remove key biological barriers, add protective human transgenes, and inactivate endogenous retroviruses. EGEN\-2784, a genetically engineered porcine kidney, is the Company’s lead program and is currently being evaluated in a multi\-patient Expanded Access study at MGH. eGenesis is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. At eGenesis, our core values—innovation, collaboration, compassion, resilience, and passion—are at the center of how we work. We engineer hope and bring passion to everything we do. We collaborate and learn from one another, combining diverse expertise to tackle complex challenges. We innovate boldly, pushing boundaries and science to new heights. where no pig organ has gone before. With resilience, we navigate challenges and celebrate progress together. And in all we do, we lead with compassion—for our patients, our people, and our pigs. ### **POSITION SUMMARY** eGenesis is looking for a Manager, IT Operations, based in our Cambridge, MA office with three days per week onsite, to run day\-to\-day technology operations across our four sites in Massachusetts, Wisconsin and Indiana. You will report to the Associate Director, Information Technology \& Cybersecurity, and will own IT service delivery, endpoint and identity management, site infrastructure, and the performance of our managed service providers and support vendors. Occasional travel to our other sites is expected. This is a hands\-on role. You will administer core systems and work escalated issues yourself, and you will also direct our external partners and hold them to their service commitments. Employees at every site should get fast, effective support, and our operations have to hold up to the standards of a regulated environment — our labs and clinical programs depend on this infrastructure running well. The role includes participation in off\-hours incident response for critical outages and occasional planned maintenance outside business hours. ### **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Lead day\-to\-day IT operations and service delivery across all four eGenesis sites * Manage the service desk in Freshservice, including queue management, prioritization, escalation handling, and quality of support * hardware provisioning and recovery * Support endpoints (Windows and macOS), mobile devices, printers, conference rooms, and site infrastructure * Support laboratory instrument workstations, connected lab systems, and lab software, coordinating with lab operations teams and instrument vendors * Coordinate incident response for outages and service disruptions across internal staff and vendors, and security operations, audits, and compliance activities * Manage vendor contracts, quotes, purchase orders, renewals, and invoice review for IT services, hardware, and software * Maintain accurate asset inventory, software and license records, documentation, and runbooks * Lead operational projects such as office buildouts, hardware refreshes, and system rollouts from planning through verification * Support the rollout, administration, and user enablement of approved AI tools in partnership with IT leadership * Track and report service metrics, risks, and recurring problems to IT leadership with recommendations * Serve as a liaison between IT and other business units for operational needs ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** * A minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in Information Technology, with at least 2 years managing service delivery, vendors, or a support function * Demonstrated experience overseeing managed service providers and technology vendors, including SLA monitoring, escalation management, and contract accountability * Strong experience administering Microsoft 365 (Office, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive), Entra ID, and Intune, including building and Wi\-Fi, VPN, and firewalls * Experience administering an IT service management platform (Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar) and managing to defined SLAs * Experience supporting office\-based and remote employees across multiple sites * Strong project management skills, including handling multiple projects concurrently and meeting deadlines * Exceptional communication, problem\-solving, and customer service skills, with the demonstrated ability to collaborate with stakeholders at all organizational levels ### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * A This individual will be responsible for designing systems architecture, setting installation plans, and setting pacing at the beginning of a project. This individual will also be responsible for designing automatic temperature control and energy management systems, which includes producing control schematics, wiring diagrams, setting sequences of operation, programming, and billing material lists based upon customer needs and/or project plans and specifications. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: About Us: At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward\-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy\-as\-a\-Service sector. We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success. Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success. Overview: **Position Purpose:** The Senior Product Manager is the accountable owner of a technology platform within ENFRA’s portfolio of software products, including AI\-powered tools and operational workflow systems. Where the Product Manager executes against a defined roadmap, the Senior Product Manager sets it: identifying which operational workflows are worth transforming, framing the problem, building the case, and driving it through delivery and adoption with minimal direction. Our users are engineers, analysts, modelers, and field staff working in highly technical domains, and our products are built by software engineers. The Senior Product Manager is comfortable working across both, drawing requirements out of subject matter experts and shaping them into specifications the technology team can build against. This role partners closely with the product leader for its business area on portfolio strategy, mentors Product Managers and Business Analysts, and is the recognized face of its platform to the teams that use it. Responsibilities: **Duties \& Responsibilities:*** Serve as the single accountable owner for an assigned platform: set the roadmap, hold decision authority over the backlog, accept or reject delivered work, and answer for the product’s outcomes. * Drive both strategic and tactical work independently, from multi\-quarter direction down to writing the story. * Maintain a discovery runway ahead of the engineering team, so that upcoming work is researched, specified, and ready before it is needed. * Develop the UI and UX of roadmap items directly, using AI\-assisted design tools to move from concept to interactive prototype quickly, and use those prototypes to validate direction with users before engineering work begins. * Hold the separation between forward\-looking product decisions and immediate delivery concerns, resisting the pull to be consumed by in\-sprint engineering issues at the expense of what comes next. * Act as the visible owner of the platform to its users: lead demos, release communications, and recurring user meetings. * Lead requirements development end to end (elicitation, analysis, specification, and validation) and raise the standard of requirements quality across the product team. * Personally conduct user research and usability testing with technical staff and synthesize findings into decisions. * Identify and pitch opportunities to modernize data\-heavy operational workflows through AI and application development, including sizing the opportunity and defining success measures. * Define and instrument product telemetry, and use adoption and usage data to evaluate whether shipped features changed the workflow they were meant to change. * Drive launch, enablement, and adoption, including the internal change management required to move teams off legacy processes. * Mentor Product Managers and Business Analysts on discovery techniques, written specifications, and stakeholder communication. * Resolve ambiguity and conflicting stakeholder priorities without escalating every decision upward. * Collaborate with product, development, engineering, and project teams across the business Qualifications: **Required Qualifications:*** A minimum of five years of related experience is required of product management experience, including full ownership of a product or platform rather than individual features. * Demonstrated ability to operate independently across both strategic and tactical work, setting direction and executing on it without close supervision. * Hands\-on experience running user research and usability testing, and genuine interest in continuing to do so rather than delegating it. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted design tools (for example Claude Design or Magic Patterns) to produce wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes without depending on a dedicated designer. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor level of detail and technical depth to the audience. * Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements from subject matter experts in a technical discipline outside of software, and translate them into buildable specifications. * Experience transforming manual or legacy processes into modern, app\-based workflows, including the adoption work that follows launch. * Experience delivering AI\-powered features or automation (LLM integration, intelligent document processing, workflow automation), with a working understanding of what these systems can and cannot do reliably. * Comfort presenting directly to end users, including running demos and fielding unscripted questions about the product. * Excellent stakeholder management, including the ability to say no, manage competing priorities, and build credibility with technical users. * Strong analytical skills, with comfort working directly in product and operational data. * Experience with agile development processes and working closely with engineering teams throughout delivery. * Detail oriented, comfortable with multiple concurrent projects in a fast paced environment, and willing to work outside the defined scope when necessary. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Bachelor' Degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering Four years of directly related experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. * Experience mentoring or formally leading product managers or business analysts. * Experience building and maintaining a design system, or working within one to keep prototypes consistent with an established component library. * Experience in the energy\-as\-a\-service sector, energy efficiency, sustainability, AEC, or another engineering\-services industry. * Working understanding of building systems, energy and sustainability methodologies, or comparable technical domain knowledge. * Technical background sufficient to read a data model, follow an API discussion, and reason about system constraints. **Travel Requirements:*** 0\-15% travel required for this position **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment:** The following physical requirements and work environment characteristics are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. In accordance with applicable laws, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. Physical Activities:* Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods * Climbing stairs * Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods * Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers * Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned **Environmental Conditions:*** Quiet environment **Physical Demands:*** Light work that includes adjusting and/or moving objects up to 20 pounds Pay Range: USD $91,449\.00 \- USD $122,080\.50 /Yr. conferences, team meetings, and other activities. **Successful candidates must reside within commuting distance to Greenbelt, Maryland.** **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, develop, integrate, and test integration, verification, validation, and maintenance. * Develop software for real\-time spacecraft applications operating on embedded processors and flight\-qualified operating systems. * teams. * Support software integration activities with spacecraft avionics and communications hardware. * Develop and maintain software documentation, test procedures, verification reports, and technical memoranda. * Investigate software anomalies and support troubleshooting efforts during integration and test activities. * Support Independent Verification \& Validation (IV\&V), Software engineering processes utilizing industry\-recognized standards. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience supporting NASA, DoD, NOAA, or commercial spaceflight programs. * Flight software development jobs.title: Business Group Director-Engineering, Hydrology & Design-Southeast Region
jobs.description: **Environmental Science Associates (ESA) is a 100% employee\-owned environmental consulting firm. We plan, design, permit, mitigate, and restore for projects across our communities, infrastructure systems, open spaces, and wildlands. We are 50 years strong in 21 offices across California, the Pacific Northwest, and the Southeastern United States.** Environmental Science Associates (ESA) seeks an experienced engineering business leader to guide and grow our established Southeast team of engineers and licensed professionals in Environmental Hydrology and Design (EH\&D). Working with the Regional Director, you will build, develop, and lead a high\-performing engineering business group and be accountable for its operational and financial performance. You will develop people, expand client relationships, and guide delivery of multi\-benefit projects that restore ecosystems and help communities manage flooding and changing coastal environments. This role can be based in a hybrid arrangement from ESA's Tampa, Orlando, Boynton Beach, Sarasota, or Pensacola offices. We are also open to remote candidates in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Georgia, South Carolina, and North Carolina. ### **Who You Are** You are an engineering or environmental design leader with demonstrated experience managing a consulting business unit. You enjoy developing people, building client relationships, and converting project acquisitions into work the team can deliver successfully. You use business data to guide staffing, utilization, pricing, and financial performance, address problems early, and hold project managers accountable while helping them succeed. You are approachable, decisive, and generous with your knowledge. You bring the technical judgment to guide complex work, mentor future leaders, welcome different perspectives, and protect the trust and employee\-owner engagement that make growth sustainable. **Required qualifications:** ---------------------------- * A bachelor's degree in engineering, hydrology, landscape architecture, or a related field. * At least 15 years of relevant professional experience, including at least five years leading a business group or equivalent team with responsibility for people, project delivery, and business performance. * A demonstrated record of managing staff workshare and utilization, reviewing scopes and fees, aligning staffing and pricing with delivery needs, and achieving project multiplier and profitability goals. * Demonstrated success winning and retaining clients, developing strategic capture plans, and leading proposals. * Managing projects and coaching project managers in financial performance. * Technical depth in engineering, hydrology, coastal and/or freshwater habitat restoration design, geomorphology, or a related field, with the ability to lead specialists across disciplines and connect engineering decisions with ecological function, community needs, and implementation costs. * Experience guiding complex engineering design projects from concept through final design and construction support, including coordination of technical studies, design plans, specifications, cost estimates, and permitting. **Desirable qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Professional licensure or registration in Florida appropriate to your discipline. * Strong Southeast client and teaming relationships. * Experience reviewing RFPs, scopes of work, and client contracts to identify project or contract risk. * A master's degree in a relevant field. * Experience with nature\-based solutions, coastal hazards, or flood and stormwater management, the Gulf Coast, the Atlantic Southeast including USVI and Puerto Rico, or the Mid\-Atlantic. * Experience taking complex design projects from concept through final design and construction support; guiding technical review, coordinating geotechnical, structural, hydraulic, and coastal specialists, and connecting engineering decisions with ecological function, community needs, and implementation costs. **What You Will Do** ==================== Coastal engineering, restoration, and resilience are priorities for ESA's growth in the Southeast. You will guide an established team through its next stage of growth, strengthen technical and project management depth, and pursue new opportunities with the support of existing client relationships, ESA's national market leaders, and our firm\-wide EH\&D practice. Florida is the foundation for this growth, with opportunities extending into Georgia, the Carolinas, Texas, and the wider Gulf Coast. Your group will connect engineering design with biological resources, aquatic sciences, water quality, quantitative ecology, environmental planning, and permitting specialists. Together, these services support municipal and water infrastructure, transportation, energy and aviation projects, and coastal resilience, adaptation and restoration programs. You will work with the Regional Director and firm\-wide EH\&D practice leader to se ical quality and project delivery** ------------------------------------------------ * + Serve as Project Director or senior technical advisor on strategic assignments. Guide quality reviews and multidisciplinary coordination from early planning through implementation, with engineering review provided by appropriately licensed professionals. + Collaborate with the Senior Principal Engineer, other business group directors, and practice leaders to apply ESA's quality standards and connect regional engineering work with environmental science, planning, and regulatory expertise. **Our work in the region** ========================== Our Southeast teams combine engineering, natural systems expertise, and nature\-based solutions on projects such as: * Fowl River Shoreline and Marsh Stabilization and Restoration in Alabama, using thin\-layer placement of dredged material, timber wave screens, and nature\-based designs to stabilize shorelines and restore marsh spit habitat. * Rock Creek Ponds Ecosystem Restoration in Hillsborough County, Florida, integrating restoration planning, permitting, engineering plans, and construction support to restore agricultural lands to coastal wetlands, including freshwater marsh, saltern, and mangrove tidal creek habitats. * Philippe Park Living Shoreline in Safety Harbor, Florida, combining results from ESA's coastal conditions analysis, nature\-based shoreline stabilization design, permitting, and construction monitoring to reduce erosion and enhance oyster and mangrove habitat. **What's Special About ESA** Joining ESA means becoming part of a close\-knit team of environmental professionals who contribute to outstanding projects, improve environmental stewardship, and advance a more sustainable and resilient future for our communities and wild places. At ESA, we provide benefits such as medical, dental, and vision insurance (paid at 70% for you AND your family), annual allocations of company share through our ESOP, a 401(k) plan with company match, and paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays, to name a few. We also provide specific programs whether you want to further your technical expertise, sharpen your business acumen, or help lead the next generation of employee\-owners. We want to support you in reaching your career goals through tuition reimbursement, professional development bonuses, and attendance at conferences. **Who We Are** We are a 100% employee\-owned environmental consulting firm who values diversity and inclusion and celebrate the differences that make each of us unique. Our culture is built on mutual respect, recognizing that our variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives leads to better solutions, which fosters our continued success for our employee\-owners and clients. In accordance with ESA's duty and responsibility to provide and maintain a safe workplace that is free of known hazards and to minimize the exposure to potential hazards, any employee who works from an ESA office or conducts any other in\-person ESA work\-related activity is required to submit their proof of vaccination status or have received an approved exemption and accommodation in states which this applies. **Please note: We do NOT accept unsolicited resumes from agencies** **If you are an applicant with a disability that requires a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability—or unable to use—the online application system and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact our Human Resources Department via email:** **humanresources@esassoc.com** **for assistance.** **Please include the following in your message so we can promptly address your request:** * **Full name** * **The best method to contact you (phone number and/or email address)** * **Title of Job Position Applied** * **Description of your accommodation request** ***ESA is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. (EOE M/V/F/D)***

jobs.title: AI Technical Lead (Principal Engineer)
jobs.description: **AI Technical Lead** **Location:** Cambridge, MA / Hybrid *(This role requires working in\-office 3 days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.)* **About us:** EverQuote is a leading AI\-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real\-world impact and do the best work of your career, you've found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you. **About the role:** As our Technical Lead, you will design and build a new kind of product: an insurance marketplace that AI agents use to shop on a person's behalf. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from the models and how they run to the MCP server and tools that other AI platforms connect to. This is a hands\-on senior role on a small team, and the decisions you make early will shape what agentic insurance shopping looks like before the market arrives. You own the technical architecture for the agent: where the model's reasoning runs, how we tune and serve it, how we keep cost and speed under control, and how the whole system stays reliable. We intend to run and tune our own open\-weight models rather than depend only on hosted APIs, so we control cost, speed, and behavior as volume grows, and owning that is central to this role. You own the MCP server, the tools, and the data the agent works with, and you set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You are the person who decides, with testing to back it up, how this is built, and then builds it. **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture: decide where the agent's reasoning runs, which models we use, how they are packaged, and how AI platforms connect to us, and back those calls with testing. * Build and tune the models: fine\-tune open\-weight models for our use, and decide when tuning, retrieval, or prompting is the right tool. * Stand up the serving and infrastructure: deploy the agent and MCP server so they are reliable, fast, and affordable to run, with versioning and a way to roll back. * Build the testing into the system: programmatic eval sets, guardrails, and monitoring for quality, drift, cost, and speed, so we catch problems before agents do. * Design the data model and tools with the AI product lead: the request and response payloads, the reasoning we expose, and the trust signals. * Set the engineering patterns and standards the team builds on, and keep the code and architecture documented. * Keep cost and speed honest: watch what inference costs, and make the trade\-offs that keep it sustainable as volume grows. * Work in the open. Help publish our code, architecture, and findings. * Mentor the engineers on the team and give leadership clear, regular visibility into technical progress and risks. **What You Bring:** * Deep, current, hands\-on experience in the AI and LLM space. You work on this every day, not from the sidelines. * Real experience with open\-weight models: you have fine\-tuned them (LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, or similar) and run them yourself, not just called a hosted API. * Experience owning an LLM system in production: you have served models reliably, pinned versions, rolled back a bad change, and explained why the bill moved. * Enterprise\-level design and architecture experience, with a track record of leading large, ambitious projects and delivering them. * Strong grasp of evaluation and guardrails: building eval sets, catching failure modes, and monitoring quality, drift, cost, and speed. * Fluency with the serving and ops stack: model serving, containers and orchestration, and monitoring, on at least one major cloud. * Strong communication. You can explain a technical trade\-off to an engineer and to a non\-technical leader, and lead with data. * Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action in a space where the standards change month to month. **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years in engineering, with senior or lead ownership of complex technical systems, including hands\-on work in machine learning or LLMs. * A track record of leading large, ambitious projects with a small team and delivering them. We care more about what you have shipped and the judgment you showed than the revenue the project generated. * Hands\-on fine\-tuning and deployment of open\-weight or open\-source models, with real production experience. * Enterprise design and architecture experience for complex, high\-reliability systems. * Strong Python, Rust, and fluency with the modern LLM stack (serving, retrieval, evaluation, monitoring). * Strong strategic thinking paired with methodical execution. You can set the technical direction and then deliver it. * Excellent communication across all levels of an organization, technical and non\-technical. * A history of teamwork and a bias for action. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant's job\-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. The base salary for this full\-time hybrid role is $202,800\-$238,600\. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in variable cash bonus programs, equity, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility which are designated by role. Your recruiter can provide more details about additional compensation components, such as OTE structure, bonus targets, or equity, during the hiring process. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must have current, unrestricted work authorization in the United States. EverQuote is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy or a pregnancy\-related condition, veteran or military status, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, upon request. For more information, visit https://investors.everquote.com and follow on LinkedIn.

jobs.description: **Your Future Evolves Here** Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Job Description** **Position Summary** The Senior Software Engineer leads the design, development, and deployment of complex features in the web user experience for the Evolent Platform. This role builds high\-performance React and Next.js (TypeScript) features and works closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions. This individual drives the technical direction of features, contributes to front\-end architecture discussions and long\-term planning, and mentors junior engineers to foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. The role is expected to use approved AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered. **AI\-Assisted Engineering Expectations** Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI\-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards. **Key Responsibilities** **Design and Development** * Lead the design, development, and deployment of complex front\-end features in React and Next.js, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and maintainability. * Build Server and Client Components that follow the team’s rendering and caching standards, including read\-your\-writes behavior for decision forms. * Implement backend\-for\-frontend (BFF) endpoints and integrate with .NET (C\#) and Python (FastAPI) services, and Entra ID / OpenID Connect authentication. * Build data\-heavy screens, including large grids, PDF and document viewers, rich\-text editors, and workflow wizards, using component libraries such as KendoReact or MUI. * Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions. * Drive the technical direction of features, contributing to front\-end architecture discussions and long\-term planning. **Agentic User Experience** * Build streaming user interfaces (SSE) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative UI using the Vercel AI SDK, assistant\-ui, and CopilotKit over the AG\-UI protocol. * Implement human\-in\-the\-loop flows that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations, including Pydantic AI tool\-approval interrupts. * Implement robust handling for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including retries, timeouts, resumable streams, and clear status messaging. * Contribute to the AG\-UI event contract and shared\-state design with the agent team. **Engineering Excellence** * Conduct thorough coding reviews, provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to best coding practices. * Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. * Build accessible components that meet WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 AA and Section 508 and resolve accessibility defects. * Write component and end\-to\-end tests using Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright. * Identify and implement improvements to CI/CD pipelines, supply\-chain controls, and OpenTelemetry instrumentation. * Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working to ensure high availability and reliability of the user experience. **AI\-Enabled Delivery** * Utilize approved AI\-assisted engineering tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities. * Evaluate and validate AI\-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness. * Continuously identify opportuniti alidation processes for AI\-assisted solutions. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, including 3\+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript. * Hands\-on experience with Next.js, including Server and Client Components, server\-side rendering, and streaming. * Experience building streaming or real\-time user interfaces using Server\-Sent Events or WebSockets. * Experience building data\-heavy enterprise screens using component libraries such as KendoReact (Telerik) or MUI. * Experience integrating front ends with REST APIs and backend services, including the backend\-for\-frontend pattern. * Experience implementing authentication with Entra ID (Azure AD) and OpenID Connect. * Strong knowledge of WCAG 2\.1/2\.2 AA and Section 508, with experience building accessible applications. * Experience with Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright. * Experience with Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and Git\-based workflows, including pull requests. * Strong, daily use of AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot. * Ability to work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team of technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, present to stakeholders, and write detailed documentation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with agentic UI frameworks and protocols such as AG\-UI, CopilotKit, assistant\-ui, or the Vercel AI SDK. * Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop experiences for AI agents, including approval and override workflows. * Familiarity with Python and Pydantic AI. * Experience with FHIR R4; Da Vinci Prior Authorization Support (PAS) a plus. * Experience consuming events from Azure Service Bus or similar message brokers. * Experience with Kubernetes (AKS) and OpenTelemetry. * Experience with C\# and .NET. * Experience integrating AI services, models, or agents into production applications. * Healthcare domain experience, including handling PHI under HIPAA. **Education** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. **Technical Requirements:** We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router. **Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.** The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

jobs.title: Web Development & Maintenance Provider
jobs.description: ### **Request for Proposals:** ### **Web Development \+ Maintenance Provider** Issued October 16, 2026 Proposals due Friday, October 30 5:00 PM ET Washington, DC **At a glance** **Issuer:** FAS (Federation of American Scientists) **Engagement:** Enhancements to FAS.org, heatagenda.us, cri.fas.org, essentialdata.us, followed by an optional ongoing maintenance retainer. **Term:** December 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027 for the enhancement project. A maintenance retainer may follow at FAS’s option. **Budget:** Not to exceed $14,500 for initial 6\-month engagement **Proposals due:** Friday, October 30, 2026, 5:00 PM ET **1\.Background and Strategic Foundations** ------------------------------------------- The Federation of American Scientists (FAS) is seeking a new provider of web development and maintenance services to lead an update of our current website. FAS is a nonpartisan 501(c)(3\) that has around 60 FTEs, a network of Senior Fellows and Advisors, and is supported largely by philanthropy. We are looking for a WordPress developer with strong design judgment who will learn how FAS works and recommend improvements to our main website and growing number of sister sites. If the initial project goes well, we expect to continue with the same provider for ongoing maintenance and future enhancements. Current website environment Bidders should use the following to estimate effort. FAS will share additional details with bidders on request. * **Platform:** WordPress 7\.1\.3; Custom theme; Page builder: Standard Wordpress with some custom blocktypes, including TablePress * **Hosting:** Gravitate. Hosting costs are not in the scope of this RFP. * **Original site build**: And–Now, 2023\. Current maintenance is provided by Gravitate, who will be available for handoff. * **Content volume:** approximately \~150 pages and 5,703 posts/publications; 1,140 staff and fellow bio pages. * **Key plugins and integrations:** YoastSEO (trial), TablePress plus custom dataviz embedding with Tableau and Datawrapper, Google Analytics 4, Meta Box \+ Meta Box AIO, Relevanssi Premium, SAR Friendly SMTP, Akismet Anti\-spam, Headers Security Advanced * **Existing microsites:** heatagenda.us and cri.fas.org, and essentialdata.us, plus legacy subdomains like nuke.fas.org, sgp.fas.org. * **Brand guidelines and design source files:** PDF available here. **2\. What we are asking you to do** ------------------------------------ **Scope of work** ----------------- All work applies site\-wide to FAS.org, heatagenda.us (static site), cri.fas.org (static site), essentialdata.us unless stated otherwise. For each item, the "Done when" line describes what FAS will accept as complete. The provider may recommend changes to these items during discovery; the approved plan (see Timeline) becomes the binding scope. ### **Base scope (required)** **A. Photo, video and data visualization components.** Reusable WordPress blocks or templates for carousels, image grids, video embeds and featured data visualizations, consistent with the current design language. * *Done when:* FAS staff can add and edit these components on any page or post without developer help, and they display correctly on mobile. **B. Social media integration.** Display of FAS social content on the homepage, staff and fellow bio pages, and publication pages. Platforms: Instagram, LinkedIn, X. Bidders should state whether they propose embeds or automated feeds, and note any third\-party API or subscription costs. * *Done when:* Content from the named platforms appears on the specified page types and updates without manual work, or with a documented manual process FAS approves. **C. Microsite template and navigation.** A reusable template for program microsites \[bidder to recommend , with consistent navigation between microsites and FAS.org. * *Done when:* FAS staff can launch a new microsite from the template, and one pilot microsite (highlighting our ‘Future of Science’ work), is live. **D. Miscellaneous improvements.** Ability to update footer (currently we lack ability to add social platforms or other outward links; CMS/WordPress\-managed redirects (currently we have to ask developers to do this; visible tags on publications * *Done when:* These items are present or alternative solutions are operational on FAS.org. ### **Optional items (price each separately)** FAS will decide which of these to fund during the planning phase, based on cost and remaining budget. * **Search across microsites**: a single search that returns results from FAS.org and all microsites. * **Bulk tag editing** in the WordPress admin. * **Google Analytics 4 improvements**: pass publication date and other post metadata to GA4; an analytics dashboard for staff. * **Data visualization**: improved DataWrapper embedding or native charts and tables in WordPress. * **Footnotes for publications**: ability to include “sidenotes” or “margin\-notes” (i.e. footnotes that don’t interrupt the reading experience). ### **Requirements that appl adlines. * FAS will provide staging and admin access, brand assets and content within \[5] business days of the provider's request. Delays on FAS's side extend the schedule accordingly. * We expect the provider to recommend better approaches when they see them, including telling us when a request is a poor use of budget. **Budget and pricing** FAS's budget for the base scope is not to exceed **$14,500**, as a fixed fee. Proposals should include: * A fixed fee for the base scope, broken down by phase and by item (A through D), with estimated hours and hourly rates. * A separate fixed price for each optional item. * Proposed maintenance pricing after May 2027: monthly retainer, hours included, what is covered (for example, WordPress core and plugin updates, security monitoring, backups, small content fixes), response times, and the hourly rate for work beyond the retainer. If a bidder believes the base scope cannot be delivered within the budget, the proposal should say which items or features should be reduced and why. **Payment schedule.** 20% on FAS approval of the plan; 50% on staging approval of all base\-scope features; 30% on final acceptance. Optional items are invoiced on acceptance. **Bidder qualifications** ------------------------- * Demonstrated WordPress development experience, including custom blocks and templates. * Past work for nonprofits, think tanks or policy organizations. * Both design and development capability in\-house: the ability to design components and then build and deploy them. Bidders who plan to use subcontractors must name them. **Proposal requirements** ------------------------- Submit a single PDF (maximum 10 pages, excluding team bios and appendices) to jwilson@fas.org by Friday, October 30, 2026, 5:00 PM ET. Include: * **Cover letter** signed by an authorized representative, naming the proposed project lead. * **Understanding and approach.** How you would address the base scope, and how you would extend the existing design language rather than replace it. * **Workplan.** Activities, milestones and dependencies by phase, consistent with the timeline above. * **Team and capacity.** Named individuals and their roles, and the project lead's expected hours per month on this engagement. * **Work samples.** Links to 3 to 5 live websites you designed or built, preferably WordPress sites for nonprofits or policy organizations. * **Case studies and references.** Three relevant client case studies and three client references FAS may contact. * **Pricing,** as described in Budget and pricing. * **Disclosures.** Current or recent work for organizations that closely overlap with FAS's mission or audience, and any other potential conflicts of interest. **Evaluation criteria** ----------------------- **Criterion** **Weight** Understanding of FAS's needs and fit with our working style 25% Design quality, based on work samples and case studies 25% Technical approach and WordPress capability 15% Team quality and committed capacity 15% Budget realism and value, including maintenance pricing 20% FAS may invite finalists to a 60 to 90 minute interview with the Chief of Staff, Communications Associate Director, Digital and Design Senior Manager. **RFP schedule** ---------------- RFP Released October 16, 2026 Proposals Due October 30, 2026 by 5:00 pm ET Finalists Interviews November 5 \- November 20, 2026 Selection Announced November 25, 2026 Contract Executed On or before December 4, 2026 Project Kickoff Week of December 7, 2026 **Terms** --------- * FAS will own all code, designs and other work product created under this engagement, and will receive full access to source code and credentials at handoff. * FAS may reject any or all proposals, request clarifications, or negotiate scope and price with any bidder. * FAS will not reimburse costs of preparing proposals. * Proposals will be kept confidential and used only for this selection. * The selected provider will sign FAS's standard services agreement. 94ORpnHfSs

jobs.title: Junior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Flexi Software is hiring Junior and entry\-level Full\-Stack Software Engineers to help build the next generation of our platform. You will work across C\# services and modern web front ends built with Node.js, React, and Next.js, backed by Microsoft SQL Server, and you will build, test, and deliver enterprise\-grade software for financial institutions. We are looking for engineers who embrace an AI\-empowered software development lifecycle. At Flexi, AI is part of how we design, code, review, test, and document. You will work with agentic tools every day, and you will learn to direct them with good judgment, verify what they produce, and hold the result to the standards our banking, insurance, and financial services customers depend on. Your primary focus will be delivering our next\-generation web platform. On a limited basis, you may also work on Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C\+\+ and C\#, which gives you broad exposure to how enterprise software evolves. This role is a strong starting point for an early\-career engineer who wants to grow quickly, learn from experienced engineers, and ship real software at scale. This is a hybrid position, working in person with the team in our Atlanta, GA office. **About Flexi** Flexi Software has been a trusted provider of accounting solutions for over 30 years, offering both cloud\-based and on\-premise software purpose\-built for organizations with the most complex accounting requirements — multi\-entity and intercompany accounting at scale. Our comprehensive suite includes modules like General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Fixed Asset Management, Project Accounting, Workflow Automation, Financial Reporting, and Budget Software. Serving industries including banking, insurance, financial services, credit unions, healthcare, and business process outsourcing, Flexi is renowned for its robust features, flexible deployment options, and exceptional customer support. In January 2025, Flexi was acquired by Quality Standard, a permanent capital holding company that acquires and grows fintech and govtech software businesses with a long\-term ownership mindset. Quality Standard is actively investing in Flexi's people, product, and operations. Flexi's office is located in Atlanta, GA. Quality Standard is headquartered in New York, NY. **Roles and Responsibilities** * Build, test, and deliver full\-stack features for Flexi's next\-generation platform, working across C\# back\-end services and APIs and Node.js, React, and Next.js front ends * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code, including unit and integration tests, as part of every change you ship * Work with Microsoft SQL Server: write queries and stored procedures, design tables, and learn to tune for application and database performance * Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily across design, coding, code review, testing, and documentation, and learn to direct them effectively * Review and verify AI\-generated code with care, owning correctness, security, and quality for everything you commit * Take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback, to build skill and uphold team standards * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release practices so changes move to production safely and often * Build with the security, reliability, and data integrity expected of enterprise financial software, including input validation, error handling, and audit\-friendly design * Investigate and resolve defects, tracing issues across the front end, services, and database * Write and maintain technical documentation, including API documentation and developer notes * Partner with Product, QA, and senior engineers to turn requirements into shipped customer\-facing software * Contribute on a limited basis to Flexi's legacy Windows desktop solutions in C\+\+ and C\#, while next\-generation web platform delivery remains your primary focus, and learn how the new platform integrates with these existing products and our DevOps environment * Grow your skills through mentorship, pairing, and regular feedback, and share what you learn about AI\-assisted development with the team Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent practical experience, such as a bootcamp, internship, or substantial project work * 0–3 years of professional software development experience; internships and strong personal or academic projects count * Working knowledge of C\# and the .NET platform, including object\-oriented programming fundamentals, and a willingness to work in legacy C\+\+ and C\# Windows desktop code on a limited basis * Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with hands\-on experience building applications in React * Experience or coursework with Node.js and Next.js, including routing, server\-side rendering, and API routes * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, with exposure to Microsoft SQL Server preferred * Familiarity with building and consuming REST APIs * Experience with Git and a collaborative, pull\-request\-based workflow * Active, hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in your own work, with a clear sense of when to trust their output and when to question it * A solid grasp of software testing fundamentals, including writing unit tests * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Clear written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to ask good questions and take feedback well **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, or Web API development * Experience with Vite, modern build tooling, and component libraries or design systems * Experience delivering web applications in a B2B software environment using modern AI\-accelerated tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, including prompt and context engineering for coding tasks * Exposure to automated testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, Jest, Playwright, or Cypress * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and containerization * Exposure to AWS or Azure cloud platforms * Interest in or exposure to secure coding practices, including OWASP guidance * Experience with ERP, accounting, financial, or other enterprise systems of record, especially B2B enterprise software, and prior experience in the financial services industry or financial accounting **Personal Characteristics** * AI\-curious and AI\-forward; you actively use AI tools in your own work, enjoy experimenting with agentic workflows, and share what works * Rigorous about quality; you treat AI output as a draft to be verified, not a result to be trusted blindly * A builder; you like turning an idea into working software and seeing it used * Eager to learn; you ask questions, seek feedback, and improve quickly * Hands\-on and persistent; you stay with a hard bug until you understand the cause * Security\- and detail\-minded; you understand that accuracy and data integrity matter in financial software * Collaborative and low ego; you work well with engineers, QA, and Product * High integrity and sound judgment; trusted with sensitive customer and product information * Positive attitude and sense of humor; work is way more fun with people you enjoy! **What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months** * Fully onboarded to Flexi's codebase, tooling, and AI\-assisted development workflow, and contributing confidently * Shipping production\-ready features and fixes across the C\# back end, SQL Server, and the React/Next.js front end * Delivering well\-tested work that passes review with steadily fewer corrections * Using AI tools effectively and responsibly, with changes that are verified, secure, and understood * Contributing meaningfully to code reviews, tests, and documentation * Understanding how the new platform fits with Flexi's existing C\+\+/C\# Windows desktop products and delivery pipeline, and contributing to them when needed * Developing a clear growth plan with your manager and mentor, with growing independence on well\-defined tasks Flexi provides excellent benefits including paid holidays and paid time off, a 401(k) Plan with company match, health and dental insurance, life and disability insurance, and a vision discount plan. **Location:** Hybrid • Atlanta, GA area only Only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Any offer of employment will be contingent upon positive criminal background check. No phone calls, please. Principals Only. Drug\-free workplace. M/F/V/H EEO

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it We're looking for passionate \& experienced technologists, strong communicators, and those with a commitment to continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be proficient in frontend engineering with ability to contribute to backend when necessary. We're looking for the confidence to propose pragmatic solutions to complex problems and be eager to learn from and educate others as a Senior Software Engineer working for our Sportsbook domain. You will be working with the FanDuel Sportsbook application, providing our customers with a best\-in\-class experience as a frontend proficient Software Engineer. You'll play a pivotal part in making our platform highly usable and will write clear, scalable, and high\-quality code. You will work continuously to improve architecture and processes to improve quality and efficiency. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play Your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them and when it is not. Your solutions are pragmatic. You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an Engineer unfamiliar with the system can understand. You limit the use of short\-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You make appropriate trade\-offs, re\-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc). * You work on project ideas with stakeholders, and peers. * You own parts of product and technology and strive to become a subject matter expert. * You write simple and extendable code following standards and best practices. You test your code thoroughly. * You utilize AI\-powered tools to maximize efficiency. * You help balance customer requirements with the team requirements. * You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric/COE reviews. * You classify, store, and handle data in accordance with FanDuel policies. * You track security risks and mitigate and/or escalate them in a timely manner. * You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. * You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve the team software and processes. * You work to resolve the root cause of complex problems, leaving software better and easier to maintain than when you found it. * You mentor and help new team\-mates on how your team's software is constructed, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture. * You foster a constructive dialogue and seek resolutions in a professional way. * You help recruit and interview for your team. * You estimate stories/tasks accurately and deliver them in time. * On\-call rotation where required. You provide excellent customer support on behalf of Technology. * You keep yourself up to date with market standards, and open\-source frameworks. * Most importantly, you are: humble, pragmatic, self\-managed, thirsty for knowledge, never satisfied and always challenging the norm. You demonstrate responsibility for the state of the code you both inherit and produce. **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * Degree in Computer Science, related field, or equivalent work experience. * 5 or more years of Software Development experience in creating and maintaining mobile applications with experience in React and React Native. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and core web technologies (HTML and CSS) * A fundamental understanding of data structures and algorithms with experience working with backend for frontend (BFF) architectural patterns. * Proficient with prompting AI\-powered development tools Claude or Cursor to accelerate coding workflows, improve code quality, and increasing efficiency. * Experience working with cloud\-based infrastructure and technologies, preferably AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS). * Experienced with optimization utilizing monitoring and alerting tools like DataDog or Sentry. * Experience working with CI/CD pipeline tooling, preferably Jenkins or Buildkite. * Familiarity with Git, GitLab, Atlassian suite preferred. * Experience with unit testing, testing tools, integrating testing and best\-quality practices into an SDLC. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included. FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com. ***The applicable salary range for this position is $138,000 \- $181,000 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short\-term or long\-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.*** ***It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.*** \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer, Data Storage - Core
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. Platform Storage is a core platform engineering team specializing in stateful infrastructure (PostgreSQL/RDS, Kafka (MSK), MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Elasticache/Valkey) for Fanatics Betting \& Gaming. We own database and streaming reliability for dozens of product engineering teams, acting as both platform builders and embedded technical partners. Our core toolset is Python, Terraform, and SQL, with a focus on self\-service tooling, GitOps managed infrastructure, and hands\-on ownership of production systems. **About the Role** Fanatics Betting \& Gaming (FBG) is seeking a Staff Platform Storage Engineer to join our Platform Storage team, based in the United States. This role owns a critical slice of our core platform infrastructure, including a portfolio of production PostgreSQL databases and our Kafka/MSK streaming platform, and acts as the embedded platform liaison for the product teams built on top of them. As a Staff Engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, leading complex database and streaming infrastructure initiatives, setting standards for reliability and performance, and acting as the go to technical resource for schema design, query performance, and incident response across the teams you support. **Responsibilities** * Own database liaison responsibility for a portfolio of production PostgreSQL/RDS instances — query review, schema change approval, performance tuning, and incident triage for the teams built on top of them. * Operate and evolve our Kafka/MSK streaming platform: topic lifecycle management via GitOps, cluster health across environments, and CDC (Debezium) pipeline reliability. * Build and maintain self\-service tooling that lets product teams provision database and streaming resources without a manual ticket queue. * Drive platform stability projects — operator/version upgrades, root\-cause fixes for recurring operational issues, and proactive capacity/cost optimization across the database and streaming fleet. * Act as the technical escalation point for cross\-team incidents where the root cause traces back to shared platform infrastructure (replication lag, connection exhaustion, CPU/throughput issues). * Represent Platform Storage in cross\-org infrastructure initiatives and standardization efforts. * Mentor engineers and participate in on\-call rotations. **What You Bring** * **Strong, hands\-on Python — a primary tool of the role, not incidental. 5\+ years using Python day\-to\-day is a strong signal.** * 8\+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or database engineering, with deep hands\-on experience operating and running PostgreSQL (RDS) in production at scale — this is an infrastructure\-ownership role, not an application\-development role that happens to use Postgres. * Strong experience operating Kafka (MSK or self\-managed) in production, including topic management and CDC/event\-streaming pipelines. * Strong SQL fluency — comfortable diagnosing query performance issues and reviewing schema changes for teams you don't sit inside of. * Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). * Experience owning production database reliability across multiple downstream teams simultaneously — able to prioritize across a portfolio, not just one system. * Strong cross\-team communicator; this role is equal parts infrastructure engineering and technical partnership with the teams you support. **Nice to Have** * Experience with GitOps\-managed Kubernetes operators (Strimzi or equivalent) for stream infrastructure. * MongoDB or DynamoDB operational experience. * Experience with pgbouncer, connection pooling, and query\-level performance diagnostics. * Prior work on platform cost optimization initiatives at multi\-cluster scale. * Exposure to regulated or high\-availability environments (gaming, fintech, or similar). **Who Thrives Here** * Operates with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, leading complex initiatives with limited direction. * Comfortable influencing without authority and driving technical clarity in ambiguous problem spaces. * Communicates effectively across regions and time zones (US, UK, Ireland). * Cares about platform reliability, developer experience, and long\-term system health. Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ \#LI\-VG1 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*
