jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - LLM Observability
jobs.description: **What We’re Building** Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200\-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023! If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases. **Who We Are** We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers. **How We Work** We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1\. \#LI\-Remote#### **Little more about the team:** The team builds observability for AI in Honeycomb. We help customers see what their agents are doing, what those agents cost, and where errors happen. We also give them insight into individual conversations so they can debug them. We're bringing LLM and agent observability together, and we own both the data foundation and the product experiences built on top of it. You'll work in a small, cross\-functional group of engineers with a dedicated product manager and designer, shipping features customers use in production. If you want to define how people understand and debug AI systems, this is the team for you. #### **What you’ll do in the role:** * Own end\-to\-end development of AI observability capabilities, from ingestion to in\-product visualizations. * Architect and evolve the data model and infrastructure that let us observe agents and their ecosystems across the Honeycomb product. * Build systems that analyze and surface AI\-specific signals, such as cost, token usage, errors, and anomalies. * Collaborate with product and design partners to make sure what we build is usable, intuitive, and unlocks meaningful user workflows. * Teach best practices for exploring and understanding AI system behavior across conversations and workloads. * Iterate through fast feedback loops and experimentation, and share both wins and failures. #### **What you’ll bring to the role:** * Significant software engineering experience, with a record of shipping and owning features end to end. * Experience shipping customer\-facing features at a SaaS company, beyond internal tooling. * Full\-stack range, with proficiency in backend development (Go and/or Python) and frontend development (TypeScript and React). * A track record of working closely with product managers and designers. * Regular, hands\-on use of AI tools in your day\-to\-day engineering work. * Experience being on call. You'd join our rotation after about 90 days. * A track record of navigating ambiguity in a fast\-moving field where requirements shift and experimentation is a core part of the job. * Bonus: Experience building LLM or agent\-powered features in production. * Bonus: Hands\-on experience with observability tooling, such as OpenTelemetry. Base Salary based on level of experience $183,340 \- $206,000 USD **What you'll get when you join the Hive:** * A stake in our success \- generous equity with employee\-friendly stock program * It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are \- our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience * Time to recharge with unlimited PTO * A distributed\-first mindset and culture (really!) * Home office, co\-working, and internet stipend * Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents * Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood * Annual development allowance * And much more... **Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time.** Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work. **Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:** We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you: * All communications will come from an **@honeycomb.io** email address + We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—**never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo**. * Our recruiting process will **never** ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to: + Social security or tax identification numbers + Credit card numbers + Bank account information **Diversity \& Accommodations:** We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams. We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know. As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback. **Privacy Notice:** If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes. For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice. If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact privacy@honeycomb.io. Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.title: Advanced AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: As an Advanced AI Software Engineer at Honeywell, you will design, develop, deploy, and own advanced AI/ML and Generative AI capabilities that power enterprise software applications and products. You will apply deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, and software engineering to build secure, scalable, reliable, and production\-ready AI solutions. You will provide technical leadership across the AI software development lifecycle, from architecture and experimentation through evaluation, deployment, observability, optimization, and production support. You will collaborate closely with software, product, data, cloud/platform, cybersecurity, and architecture teams to translate complex business requirements into robust AI\-powered solutions. You will report directly to our Director of Engineering, and you’ll work out of our Phoenix, Arizona location on a hybrid work schedule. Note: For the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work onsite 100% M\-F. **YOU MUST HAVE** * 4\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML engineering experience, including designing, developing, deploying, and supporting AI/ML and Generative AI solutions in production environments. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with modern AI/ML technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, agentic AI prompt/context engineering, embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, Transformers, and AI/ML frameworks. * 4\+ years of experience architecting and delivering production AI/ML applications, including APIs/microservices, cloud deployment, model/LLM evaluation, automated testing, observability, performance optimization, security, scalability, and cross\-functional technical delivery. 5\+ years of software engineering/programming experience, with strong hands\-on proficiency in Python and experience with at least one additional programming language such as C\+\+ or Java, developing scalable, maintainable, production\-quality software. * **WE VALUE** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field. * Advanced experience with AI/ML frameworks and ecosystems such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies. * Experience with enterprise\-grade vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies. * Experience with Azure AI services/Azure AI Foundry and/or Google Gemini/Vertex AI and cloud\-based AI infrastructure. * Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience building automated deployment pipelines using CI/CD, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and MLOps/LLMOps practices. * Experience with AI observability, model/application telemetry, prompt and model versioning, evaluation pipelines, and production quality monitoring. Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI security, data privacy, model risk, prompt\-injection mitigation, content safety, and enterprise AI governance. * **BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL** In addition to a competitive salary, leading\-edge work, and developing solutions side\-by\-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Learn more (https://benefits.honeywell.com/) The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Job Posted: October 14, 2026 **About Honeywell Technologies** Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. **THE BUSINESS UNIT** Honeywell Technologies Process Automation helps customers run complex industrial operations more safely, efficiently, and reliably. From automation and control systems to cybersecurity, digital solutions, and operational optimization, we enable critical industries to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve their sustainability objectives. **Key Responsibilities** * Architect, design, develop, and deploy production\-grade applications and software platforms using Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and agentic AI technologies. * Design and implement advanced architectures, prompt and context\-management strategies, embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, reranking, and knowledge\-retrieval pipelines. * Build AI agents and multi\-step AI workflows, including tool/function calling, orchestration, memory/context management, and integration with enterprise applications and data sources. * Optimize AI workloads for latency, throughput, scalability, token consumption, infrastructure utilization, and cost. * Design and implement cloud\-native AI solutions and integrate AI services with existing enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and software architectures. * Provide technical leadership in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, technical trade\-off analysis, and engineering best practices. * Drive engineering standards for software quality, automated testing, CI/CD, security, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and operational readiness. * Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate business problems into technically feasible AI solutions and measurable outcomes. * Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on AI/ML architecture, software engineering practices, troubleshooting, and production deployment. Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **How you move is why we’re here. ®** **Now more than ever.** Get back to what you need and love to do. The possibilities are endless... Now more than ever, our guiding principles are helping us in our search for exceptional talent \- candidates who align with our unique workplace culture and who want to maximize the abundant opportunities for growth and success. If this describes you then let’s talk! HSS is consistently among the top\-ranked hospitals for orthopedics and rheumatology by U.S. News \& World Report. As a recipient of the Magnet Award for Nursing Excellence, HSS was the first hospital in New York City to receive the distinguished designation. Whether you are early in your career or an expert in your field, you will find HSS an innovative, supportive and inclusive environment. Working with colleagues who love what they do and are deeply committed to our Mission, you too can be part of our transformation across the enterprise. **Emp Status** Regular Full time **Work Shift** **Compensation Range** The base pay scale for this position is $101,500\.00 \- $154,750\.00\. In addition, this position will be eligible for additional benefits consistent with the role. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be determined based on various factors, including but not limited to: scope of role, level of experience, education, accomplishments, internal equity, budget, and subject to Fair Market Value evaluation. The hiring range listed is a good faith determination of potential compensation at the time of this job advertisement and may be modified in the future. **What you will be doing** ========================== HSS’s Transformation Office (Atlas), was created to answer a hard question: How do we harden and optimize how HSS delivers care today — more efficient, more resilient, more scalable — and use those capabilities as the foundation for new business built on what HSS knows better than anyone? At HSS, we are transforming musculoskeletal healthcare through intelligent, scalable data and technology solutions. Our Enterprise Data \& Analytics teams empower everyone across HSS – including clinicians, researchers, financial and operational teams – with timely, trusted insights, intelligent technology, and data\-enabled workflows that enhance patient care and organizational performance. We operate in cross\-functional Product\-Oriented Delivery (POD) teams, leveraging modern platforms to turn data, AI, and technology into action. Alongside the data and AI products that power HSS internally, we turn HSS's clinical expertise and intellectual property into commercial products for health systems, partners, and patients — B2B and B2C offerings competing in a market that AI is reshaping in real time. We are seeking a Product Manager to build in that environment. In this role, you will own data and AI products end to end, prototype with AI as a first instinct rather than an afterthought, and lead a matrixed team of engineers, designers, business analysts, and domain experts from problem to shipped outcome. You will help define not just what HSS builds, but how product gets built in an AI\-native organization. **Who Will Love This Work** * **A product thinker and AI\-native builder** who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by turning complex business problems into practical data, AI, and technology solutions. You think beyond a single feature or application and look for opportunities to create capabilities that can scale across HSS. You don't wait for a spec or a sprint to see if an idea works; you build a working version with AI and put it in front of users. * **An insight\-to\-action thinker** who understands that the value of data is not simply producing an answer. You are focused on how products generate insights, how insights change decisions, improve workflows, and create measurable value for the organization. * **A product\-led adopter** who thinks about the full experience of a product – from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. You build onboarding, guidance, feedback loops, and other mechanisms into products so that new capabilities become part of how people work. * **A curious technologist** who stays close to what is emerging in AI, data, analytics, and technology, technically fluent enough to understand what is possible, challenge assumptions, and help translate new capabilities into practical solutions. * **A bias\-toward\-action operator** who moves from question to evidence quickly. You would rather ship a prototype on Thursday than debate a slide deck for a month, and you treat every release as a chance to learn. * **A market\-aware strategist** who tracks how AI is transforming product strategy across healthcare and technology. You understand customers, competitors, and the shifting definition of what a product can do. * **A technical partner** who is fluent in git, the software development lifecycle, and modern data and AI architectures — credib ctly where it speeds the team up. * Treat data as a product: partner with data engineers on data models, data quality, lineage, and semantic and metric layers so the products built on top of them are accurate and trusted. * Shape B2B and B2C products built on HSS intellectual property — conduct customer and market discovery, analyze the competitive landscape, and contribute to go\-to\-market, pricing, and packaging recommendations. * Track emerging capabilities in generative AI, agentic AI, and data platforms, and translate them into concrete product opportunities and changes to how the team works. * Build systems that scale your impact — reusable agent workflows, prompt libraries, product templates, and automated reporting — and teach teammates to use them. * Apply responsible AI and data governance practices — evaluation, guardrails and HIPAA\-aligned handling of PHI — in every product you ship. * Communicate decisions, trade\-offs, and results clearly to stakeholders and leaders, telling the story behind the data, not just the data itself. **What Success Looks Like** * You own at least one product area within a POD and are the clear point of accountability for its outcomes. * You take an idea to a working prototype in front of real users within days, not weeks. * You ship 1–2 validated major releases per quarter, each with defined adoption or impact metrics. * You build at least one reusable AI workflow or system that your team adopts. * Your teammates are measurably faster and more AI\-fluent because of what you build and share. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of experience in product management, data, AI, technology, digital transformation, or a related field, with experience delivering solutions across multiple technologies and business functions. * Hands\-on daily use of AI tools to build and work — including AI coding agents to produce working prototypes — jobs.title: Senior Associate Engineer, Quality
jobs.description: **Job Overview** ---------------- The Senior Associate Quality Engineer provides Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, and Supplier Quality support for manufacturing locations. The Senior Associate Quality Engineer conducts internal quality controls to ensure established quality procedures and standards are followed. This role conducts routine quality analysis and tests/inspections of a quality control program, where duties and tasks are standardized. This role also monitors and records inconsistencies with quality procedures and standards. This individual prepares standard quality analyses and recommends necessary quality procedure changes. This role supervises the quality activities of the Business Unit, ensuring the maintenance of certifications objectives and procedural requirements of Canadian Standards Association (CSA), product certification of Underwriters Laboratories (UL), and compliance with the established Quality System as required by the International Standardization Organization (ISO) 9001\-2015 / ISO 17025\. **A Day In The Life** --------------------- Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by: * Monitoring, auditing, and evaluating production processes. * Creating and maintaining Quality Assurance programs throughout the production operations. * Working on ISO Documentation and Revisions. * Managing Calibration Systems, Tooling, and Instrumentation. * Leading and participating in problem solving and troubleshooting activity for electro\-mechanical and mechanical devices. * Leading and participating in the internal audit program. * Supporting new product development activity including PFMEA, DFMEA, Quality Planning, Measurement Systems design and deployment. * Identifying and addressing issues regarding control of material or supplier nonconformances. **What will help you thrive in this role?** ------------------------------------------- Bachelor’s Degree in Quality, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (required) 3\-5 years of Quality Engineering experience in a manufacturing environment (required) Ability to perform Capability and Measurement Systems Analysis Proven skills in problem solving and product investigation Familiarity with statistical analysis and data analysis tools Experience writing and revising procedures, work instructions, forms, visual aids, etc. Experience working within an ISO 9001\-2015 / ISO 17025 registered, or equivalently certified QMS (required) Fluent in written and verbal English and Spanish languages. **Hubbell Incorporated** Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. **Hubbell Electrical Solutions** Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- **The Opportunity** Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Sr. AI/ML Engineer to join our Data and Analytics department. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Machine Learning and AI team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests. **Who We Are** At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest\-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues. As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers. **Why Now?** This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception. **How We Care for Our People** What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious *100 Best Companies to Work For®* list since 2013\. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong. We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include: * Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally * Flexible work schedule * Work\-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on\-site fitness center * A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption * Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match **Who You Are** As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results\-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally. **The Role** The Senior AI/ML Engineer builds and operates the shared platforms that AI product engineering teams use to develop and run AI applications, agents, and models. This is a hands\-on role focused on reliable, reusable, self\-service capabilities that cut duplicated effort and shorten the path from experimentation to production, with internal engineering teams as the customers. The role delivers scalable AI/ML platforms, including runtimes, orchestration, tool and enterprise system integration, evaluation, and observability, and the real\-time serving systems delivered as APIs: supporting products including recommendation engines, information retrieval and search, and other ML and AI backends. Shared services include inference, model deployment pipelines, feature stores, and embedding and vector search services, covering the model and agent lifecycle from versioning through deployment and monitoring. System design is central: defining service boundaries, APIs, and data flows, and making sound tradeoffs across scalability, latency, reliability, security, and cost. The engineer contributes directly to architecture, Python development, code reviews, and production problem solving across AWS and GCP, partnering with product engineering, data, infrastructure, and security teams. Success is measured by adoption and reliability of the platform and by how consistently product teams ship to production. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Experience Required:** * 7\+ years of software engineering experience in cloud\-based environments, with a focus on AI engineering, machine learning engineering, platform engineering, or distributed systems, including hands\-on ownership of production services. * Demonstrated experience designing, developing, deploying, and operating shared platforms, reusable services, or developer tools consumed by multiple engineering or data science teams. * Strong experience with end\-to\-end system design, including translating technical requirements into architectures, APIs, service interfaces, integration patterns, and production implementations. * Experience building and operating production AI or machine learning systems, including agent\-based applications, model serving, deployment, evaluation, monitoring, or enterprise integrations. * Experience working independently on complex technical problems, making engineering tradeoffs, and taking accountability for services from initial design through production operations and ongoing improvements. * Experience collaborating across engineering, data, infrastructure, security, and product teams to deliver scalable and reliable technical solutions. * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience * Strong system design skills, including distributed systems, service boundaries, APIs, design patterns, data flows, and engineering tradeoffs across reliability, performance, scalability, security, and cost. * Strong Python development skills, including experience building production services, reusable libraries, APIs, SDKs, and developer tools. * Experience developing AI agent systems using agent runtimes, orchestration frameworks, tool integrations, memory and context management, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and observability. * Experience with shared AI infrastructure, including real\-time and batch inference services, embedding services, vector databases, model deployment pipelines, and feature stores. * Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals and lifecycle capabilities, including model training and serving, registration, versioning, validation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and explainability. * Experience with AWS and GCP, including strong hands\-on production expertise in at least one. Familiarity with managed AI and machine learning services such as Vertex AI, Gemini, or equivalent technologies. * Experience with Docker, container orchestration, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and CI/CD practices for building and operating production services. * Experience with SQL and batch or streaming data processing architectures. Familiarity with PySpark, streaming ingestion, online feature serving, or distributed data processing preferred. * Experience with service and AI observability, including logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and agent or LLM evaluation tools such as Datadog, Arize, or equivalent technologies. * Familiarity with agent interoperability and tool integration protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A), or equivalent frameworks preferred. * Experience with recommender systems, ranking systems, forecasting, experimentation platforms, or real\-time decisioning systems preferred. The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all\-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary. **We welcome you:** Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better. The salary range for this position is $133,200 \- $173,000 The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate. *We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.*

jobs.title: R&D Test Engineer - Long Beach, CA
jobs.description: **About Us** Hydrafacial is a global category\-creating company focused on bringing innovative products to market and delivering beauty health experiences by reinventing our consumer’s relationship with their skin, their bodies and their self\-confidence. This is the perfect opportunity to work with some of the best leaders in the industry while you gain the global and strategic experience to add to your professional toolbox. **Job Description:** **WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS** ------------------------- No SkinHealth Systems prototype advances without being tested — and the Test Engineer is the engineer who owns that gate for every active hardware development program. From early feasibility characterization to pre\-verification bench testing, this role designs the test methods, builds the fixtures, executes the protocols, and generates the compliant documentation that gives design engineers the data they need to make sound decisions. Covering mechanical assemblies, fluid delivery systems, electromechanical subsystems, handpieces, and energy\-based modalities across the Hydrafacial platform and next\-generation device lines, the Test Engineer is the technical foundation on which SkinHealth Systems' product development confidence is built. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** ------------------ * Serve as the primary test engineer for all R\&D prototypes across active development programs, designing and executing engineering test protocols that evaluate performance, functionality, safety, and reliability against defined design requirements. Conduct hands\-on bench testing including pressure and flow characterization, electrical safety screening, mechanical load and fatigue testing, thermal performance evaluation, and first\-article comparative assessments. * Develop novel test methods to close gaps in test coverage as new prototype configurations, device modalities, and functional subsystems are introduced across the R\&D program portfolio. * Lead root cause investigation and failure analysis on prototype anomalies and out\-of\-spec results, applying structured methodologies (5\-Why, Ishikawa) and communicating findings to design engineers to drive improvements. * Author test protocols, test reports, engineering evaluation memos, and laboratory notebooks in compliance with SkinHealth Systems design control procedures, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, and applicable standards including IEC 60601\-1 and ISO 14971\. * Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, firmware, systems, Quality, and Regulatory teams to align testing strategy with program milestones and support design transfer and qualification planning. * Perform other duties as assigned. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** -------------------------- **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in product testing, test engineering, or R\&D engineering within a regulated industry, with direct experience testing physical hardware prototypes. * Demonstrated ability to independently develop test protocols, execute test programs, and generate compliant test reports for complex electromechanical systems. * Proficiency with bench\-level instrumentation including pressure gauges, flow meters, multimeters, oscilloscopes, data acquisition systems, and power supplies. * Experience with fluid system testing including pressure characterization, leak detection, and flow measurement. * Working knowledge of medical device design controls including 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, and ISO 14971\. * Practical experience with failure analysis techniques and structured problem\-solving methodologies. * Strong technical writing skills with the ability to author clear, complete, and audit\-ready test documentation. **Preferred** * Experience testing electromechanical medical devices or capital equipment in a medical aesthetics, dermatology, or consumer health device environment. * Familiarity with electrical safety testing standards including IEC 60601\-1 and EMC standards (IEC 60601\-1\-2\). * Proficiency with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD tools for fixture design. * Experience coordinating with external test laboratories for third\-party compliance or verification testing. * Exposure to FMEA methodologies (Design FMEA, Use FMEA) and risk management processes under ISO 14971\. * Ability to safely work with systems involving high voltage, pressurized fluid, elevated temperatures, or optical energy in a controlled laboratory environment. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS OF THE JOB** ------------------------------------ * Bench\-centric R\&D role requiring sustained periods of hands\-on prototype testing, fixture operation, and instrumentation work. * Must be able to stand and work at benches for extended periods during test execution, fixture builds, and failure analysis activities. * Ability to lift and handle prototypes, test fixtures, and equipment weighing up to 35 lbs. * Must comply with all laboratory safety protocols, PPE requirements, and standards applicable to the work area. * Exposure to systems involving pressurized fluid, electrical energy, elevated temperatures, or mechanical loading as part of routine test activities; all work performed in a controlled, safety\-compliant environment. **We mean it when we say you’ll LOVE this role.** Base Pay: $95,000\- $110,000/ annually \+ bonus This is a full\-time, 100% on\-site position based in Long Beach, California **What else can you expect with Hydrafacial?** PERKS! Benefits include: Medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, FSAs, HSAs, accident insurance, pet insurance, company\-paid life and AD\&D insurance, company\-paid long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off (PTO), and paid holidays. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue\-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of Hydrafacial's total rewards package for our employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, long\-term incentives based on level, paid time off, and region\-specific benefits. Come grow and GLOW with us! Hydrafacial is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Hydrafacial does not accept unsolicited assistance or resumes/CVs from third party search firms. No fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by our company as a result of an agency referral or CV/resume submitted by a search firm to any employee at our company without a valid written search agreement. If we need additional support, we will be sure to reach out directly to one of our preferred providers. Please no phone calls or emails.

jobs.title: Staff AI DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? Previous experience managing transitions from traditional to AI\-augmented development practices. * \#LI\-HYBRID The estimated base salary range for the Staff AI DevOps Engineer role based in the United States of America is: $141,600 \- $212,400\. We offer a wide range of benefits as innovative as our work, including access to genomics sequencing, family planning, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits, and paid time off. jobs.description: **\*\*This is a hybrid role and requires work on\-site with our clients.** **About Infinitive:** Infinitive is a data and AI consultancy that enables its clients to modernize, monetize and operationalize their data to create lasting and substantial value. You will work on project teams with senior engineers, architects and business analysts, writing production Python, PySpark and SQL code that moves data from source systems into tables the client's analysts and data scientists use every day. The client location is McLean, Virginia.**What you will do** ==================== * Build and maintain batch and incremental ETL pipelines in Databricks using Python, PySpark and Spark SQL. * Ingest data from relational databases, APIs, flat files and cloud storage (Amazon S3, Azure Data Lake Storage) into Delta Lake tables. * Implement bronze, silver and gold layers following medallion architecture patterns. * Write and tune SQL for transformations, data validation and reporting tables. * Add data quality checks, handle schema changes and troubleshoot failed jobs. * Schedule and monitor workloads with Databricks Workflows, working within Unity Catalog permissions. * Tune Spark jobs for performance and cost, including partitioning, file sizing and cluster configuration. * Use Git for version control, take part in code reviews and contribute to CI/CD pipelines. * Document pipelines, source\-to\-target mappings and runbooks so client teams can run what you build. * Join client meetings to clarify requirements, report status and walk through your work. **What you bring** ================== * 1 to 3 years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks on a professional or substantial academic project. * Working proficiency in Python for data processing. * Experience building transformations with Apache Spark and PySpark (DataFrames and Spark SQL). * Strong SQL, including joins, window functions, CTEs and aggregations. * Understanding of ETL concepts such as incremental loads, slowly changing dimensions, dimensional modeling and data quality checks. * Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud). * Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort explaining technical work to non\-technical We consider ourselves the bank a technology company would build—empowered to use artificial intelligence (from machine learning to generative AI) to transform everyday banking into real\-time, intelligent products that help customers improve their financial well\-being. We’re all\-in on the cloud and are a leader in the adoption of open source. We build our own products and release them with a speed and agility that allows us to get new customer experiences to market quickly. We’re going boldly where no bank has gone before. And, as a founder\-led company, we are centered in our mission to help customers succeed. **The Role \| General Responsibilities** We’re seeking a Senior Manager, Product Strategy, to support strategic priorities for the Consumer Product (CDX) leadership team under Emily Roberts. jobs.title: Technology Strategy Director
jobs.description: Posted Date 10/15/2026 Description At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose. #### **Position Overview:** Freddie Mac is seeking a hands\-on AI engineering leader to serve as Director within the Single\-Family Acquisitions (SFA) division, reporting to the Sr. Director of GenAI Engineering \& Enterprise Rules Platform. This role owns the technical core of SFA’s AI Systems Solutioning, including Agent Engineering \& Design. This includes (1\) the overall design and execution of AI Systems development from Ideation \& Business casing to Specification creation \& execution through deployment, (2\) the evaluation harnesses and graded assessment sets that determine whether an agent or AI System is ready for production, and (3\) the operating layer that keeps agents accountable after go\-live. The role is approximately 70% hands\-on architecture and code and 30% leadership of a GenAI engineering efforts and platform and vendor delivery partners. The Director is forward\-deployed by design. The role partners with the divisional GenAI PMO, Enterprise Operations \& Technology (EO\&T), and Digital Experience, and works alongside the Enterprise Business Rules platform team so that agent\-driven and rule\-driven decisioning share a common domain vocabulary, evaluation approach, and traceability model. **Our Impact** Freddie Mac was established by Congress to provide liquidity, stability, and affordability to the U.S. housing market. Within Single\-Family Acquisitions, our technology platforms and decisioning systems are foundational to ensuring loans sold to Freddie Mac meet eligibility, credit risk, and regulatory requirements at scale. **Your Impact** This role is a player / coach model. You will establish the engineering discipline that lets SFA move agentic workflows from pilot to production and keep them there: durable orchestration, accuracy that is measured rather than asserted, and operational transparency that satisfies both business owners and model risk oversight. Then use it. The capabilities built here—retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and monitoring—become the shared substrate that every SFA use case inherits, so each delivery makes the next one faster. Building knowledge graphs that represent how the business functions and designing their use, matters. **Leadership** * Lead GenAI engineering efforts, execution, and delivery partners under a single delivery model, while remaining the senior hands\-on engineer * Stand up a forward\-deployed engagement model (build, consult, advise, monitor) that embeds AI engineers alongside SFA business teams and is accountable both for what reaches production and for how it behaves afterward * Institutionalize spec\-driven development as the team’s way of working: specifications, acceptance criteria, and evaluation targets are written before build loops begin, so every capability is auditable from intent through implementation * Establish and maintain the team’s pattern library—reusable kickstarters, skills, and reference implementations—built daily with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Amazon Kiro, OpenCode) under the spec\-driven workflow * Partner with the divisional GenAI PMO on capability roadmaps, prioritization, and enablement; with EO\&T on reference architectures and platform standards; and with Digital on product ownership and delivery practices * Mentor engineers on agent design, evaluation discipline, and production operations; serve as a credible technical voice with senior leadership on agentic readiness **Transformation \& Delivery** * Architect and deliver a durable agentic workflow platform: a workflow engine with persistent state, declarative agent configuration so new agents onboard without engine changes, tool and API integration, and agent interoperability (MCP, agent\-to\-agent handoffs) * Design a shared domain graph—a unified knowledge and service layer—as the common vocabulary across agents and rules, enabling validation across workstreams without coupling them to each other * Build the assessment harnesses and graded datasets that gate promotion: scored runs, full trace capture, and regression checks; use the same harnesses to drive prompt iteration and model selection across providers * Establish hybrid retrieval (vector plus graph) over a governed document substrate—Seller/Servicer Guide, policy, and procedural content—with docs\-as\-code ingestion and approvals, so every new use case inherits ingestion, guardrails, and observability * Engineer the post\-launch operating layer: trace analysis linking agent decisions back to source documents and prompt versions, token and cost telemetry per agent run, SLO dashboards (latency, cost, throughput), drift detection, and handoff packages (runboo valent tracing and observability tooling) * Knowledge graph and hybrid RAG experience at production scale with Neo4j, vector search, and governed document corpora * Track record of spec\-driven development: writing the specification and acceptance criteria first, then building with AI coding assistants against them * Production Python; TypeScript/React a plus; AWS (Bedrock) or Azure * College degree or equivalent experience; advanced studies preferred * Financial services or mortgage domain experience strongly preferred **Keys to Success in This Role** * Forward\-deployed instinct: comfortable embedding with business teams and staying in the code * Insists on demonstrating value of AI Systems delivered * Plans before building: treats the spec and the evaluation set as first\-class deliverables, not afterthoughts * Systems thinker who designs for the next use case, not just the current one * Clear communicator with engineers, business owners, and executives * First 12–18 months, success criteria includes: * + Agentic workflow platform in production with at least two SFA use cases (credit risk, quality control) running on shared orchestration * + Evaluation harness and release gates adopted as the standard for all SFA agent promotions * + Observability layer live—trace lineage, cost telemetry, SLO dashboards—with runbooks handed to business owners * + Shared domain graph in use by both agentic workflows and the Business Rules platform * + Measurable reduction in time\-to\-production for new agentic capabilities **Current Freddie Mac employees please apply through the internal career site.** We consider all applicants for all positions without regard to gender, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, physical and mental disability, pregnancy, ethnicity, genetic information or any other protected categories under applicable federal, state or local laws. We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. A safe and secure environment is critical to Freddie Mac’s business. This includes employee commitment to our acceptable use policy, applying a vigilance\-first approach to work, supporting regulatory mandates, and using best practices to protect Freddie Mac from potential threats and risk. Employees exercise this responsibility by executing against policies and procedures and adhering to privacy \& security obligations as required via training programs. **CA Applicants:** Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the *Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance* for Employers and the *California Fair Chance Act.* Notice to External Search Firms: Freddie Mac partners with BountyJobs for contingency search business through outside firms. Resumes received outside the BountyJobs system will be considered unsolicited and Freddie Mac will not be obligated to pay a placement fee. If interested in learning more, please visit www.BountyJobs.com and register with our referral code: MAC. Time\-type:Full timeFLSA Status:Exempt Freddie Mac offers a comprehensive total rewards package to include competitive compensation and market\-leading benefit programs. Information on these benefit programs is available on our Careers site. This position has an annualized market\-based salary range of $209,000 \- $313,000 and is eligible to participate in the annual incentive program. The final salary offered will generally fall within this range and is dependent on various factors including but not limited to the responsibilities of the position, experience, skill set, internal pay equity and other relevant qualifications of the applicant. jobs.title: AI Principal Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The AI CoE Principal Software Engineer will report to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department. This role is the most senior individual contributor on the team and the technical owner of the enterprise AI engineering foundation, including the semantic router, model and harness hosting, the enterprise AI gateway, and the AI operations layer used across the business. The role is responsible for setting AI engineering architecture and standards and then building them, carrying a multi\-year capability roadmap from discovery through prototype, validation, and production scale. Primary duties include designing and building the shared AI platform and semantic routing layer; product inference and personalization, partnering with AI\-Ops on monitoring, evaluation, and governance guardrails; building secure, compliant AI integration patterns for a regulated financial services and health and benefits environments; leading agentic pipeline and multi\-agent orchestration work; delivering production AI services for CoE\-enabled business functions; developing reusable reference architectures for other engineering teams; managing AI unit economics; prototyping emerging AI capabilities; mentoring senior and lead engineers; and partnering with security, risk, compliance, and data governance. This role does not have direct reports. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Architect, build, and operate the shared enterprise AI platform, including core semantic data, model, harness, and hosting capability used across developer and in\-product personalization use cases. * Design and maintain intelligent request routing using semantic analysis and deterministic logic to direct requests to the best\-fit LLM, internal tool, or agentic pool, using cost, latency, and privacy as routing criteria. * Partner with AI\-Ops to enable metric\-based reporting, quality, performance, and drift monitoring across live systems, build model evaluation harnesses, and establish governance guardrails for safe AI use at scale. * Design and implement secure, compliant AI integration patterns appropriate for a regulated financial services environment. * Build and scale agentic pipelines and multi\-agent orchestration across the software development lifecycle, from pilot through measured engineering capacity across product teams. * Deliver production AI services supporting document intelligence and claims adjudication, conversational and voice self\-service, call intelligence, fraud and anomaly detection, and regulatory monitoring. * Develop reusable reference architectures and standard patterns so other engineering teams and embedded consultants can build AI solutions without rebuilding the foundation. * Evaluate unit economics for AI workloads, including cost per transaction, token and inference spend, latency budgets, and build\-versus\-buy and self\-host\-versus\-vendor decisions. * Identify and prototype emerging AI capabilities relevant to the business and technology roadmap, including fast, focused feasibility spikes with clear recommendations. * Lead hands\-on training sessions and pair directly with engineering teams on new development methods and prototype or pattern adoption. * Monitor the AI landscape and translate findings into roadmap recommendations on what to pilot, what to watch, and what to decline. * Set technical direction and standards for embedded AI consultants and the coaching network to scale AI delivery capacity beyond the CoE. * Mentor senior and lead engineers across business units, review AI designs, and serve as the escalation point for complex agentic and integration issues. * Partner with security, risk, compliance, and data governance teams to support safe and compliant AI delivery. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science. * AI Practitioner Certifications are a plus * 12\+ years building and operating production software, including 4\+ years delivering production AI/ML systems and 2\+ years of LLM or agentic systems in production, with a track record as the most senior technical owner of an enterprise\-scale platform. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Architecting and operating production agentic workflows as state machines, including branching logic, retry and recovery paths, and precise control over multi\-step process flow. * Deep fluency with AI\-assisted development environments such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or ONA, with a track record of driving adoption and measured impact across engineering teams. * Semantic routing and model orchestration, including embedding\-based intent analysis, deterministic fallback logic, and policy\-based model selection across multiple providers on cost, latency, and privacy criteria. * Observability and AI Ops for non\-deterministic systems, including distributed tracing, behavioral analysis, usage and quality metrics, drift detection,  and staff engineers, and communicating trade\-offs to executive stakeholders. * Ability to own a multi\-year capability roadmap, moving work from discovery through prototype, production validation, and scale against defined business metrics. * Ability to move fluidly between abstract system thinking and tactical, incremental delivery while managing stakeholders and delivering against a critical path. * Financial services, healthcare benefits, or other regulated industry experience preferred, with HSA/FSA, claims, custody, or payments domain exposure especially valuable. * Knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks preferred, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, model risk management, SOC 2, or HIPAA control environments. * Experience with rapid prototyping and feasibility assessment in an R\&D or innovation capacity preferred. * Experience facilitating technical learning sessions or pairing with engineers at varying skill levels preferred. * Multi\-agent system design experience preferred, including role assignment and coordination, agent\-to\-agent conversation patterns, and code execution loops for iterative problem solving. * API and integration experience across REST, event\-driven, and MCP patterns preferred, including integrating AI into systems of record and workflow platforms. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. Develop and execute unit, integration, and system\-level tests to verify software functionality and performance. Proficiency with Git or an equivalent modern version control system, including branching, merging, and collaborative development workflows. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated software build, test, and integration processes. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. Ability to write clear, maintainable, and well\-documented software. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with embedded software development on Linux\-based platforms. Familiarity with navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, inertial navigation systems (INS), GPS/GNSS, or other PNT technologies. Familiarity with Python or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping, test automation, and data analysis. Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, embedded system integration, or field testing. **Benefits Summary:** Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits Dynamic and collaborative work environment Employee ownership Medical, dental, and vision care plans Paid time\-off and parental leave programs Group term life insurance 401(k) retirement plan Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – WordPress, WooCommerce & Google Cloud Integration
jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer – WordPress, WooCommerce \& Google Cloud Integration **Company:** Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC (JLT) **Platform:** JLT Innovation Platform (JLT IP) **Compensation:** $4,000 per month ($48,000 annualized) **Location:** Remote / United States **Position Type:** Contract – Ongoing, Launch \& Post\-Launch Support **Department:** Software Engineering \& Digital Infrastructure About Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC (JLT) is a U.S.\-based logistics, engineering, manufacturing, distribution, and e\-commerce company developing an integrated digital platform to support domestic and international commerce. Our JLT Innovation Platform (JLT IP), powered by WordPress and WooCommerce, is being developed to connect customers, innovators, vendors, manufacturers, and businesses with products and services through a scalable digital marketplace. As JLT expands its product catalog, digital operations, and sales channels, we are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to lead the technical integration of WordPress, WooCommerce, Google Cloud, Google Search Console, Google Merchant Center, and associated data infrastructure. Position Overview The Senior Software Engineer will be responsible for completing the technical configuration of JLT IP during its commercial launch and maintaining its functionality, performance, security, and scalability after launch. The successful candidate must possess strong experience with WordPress backend development, WooCommerce product management, Google Cloud Platform, API integration, technical SEO, structured product data, database optimization, and e\-commerce automation. This position requires a hands\-on engineer who can independently diagnose technical problems, implement reliable solutions, and build systems that support product discoverability, customer acquisition, order processing, and long\-term platform growth. Key Responsibilities1\. WordPress \& WooCommerce Engineering * Maintain and optimize the JLT WordPress and WooCommerce environment. * Develop, troubleshoot, and improve custom PHP functionality, plugins, shortcodes, and backend integrations. * Maintain compatibility with Elementor Pro and the existing JLT interface. * Optimize product pages, product variations, categories, attributes, SKUs, descriptions, prices, inventory, and images. * Resolve technical problems affecting product selection, shopping carts, checkout, shipping calculations, and payment integrations. * Improve WooCommerce API performance, database queries, caching, and platform reliability. * Maintain customer, innovator, vendor, and employee registration workflows with appropriate authentication and permissions. 2\. Google Cloud Platform Integration * Audit and correctly configure the Google Cloud environment for JLT IP. * Manage Google Cloud projects, APIs, IAM access permissions, credentials, quotas, and service configurations. * Configure secure Google OAuth authentication for the JLT customer and platform registration systems. * Establish reliable communication between WooCommerce, Google services, and approved third\-party APIs. * Implement appropriate cloud infrastructure for automation, integration workloads, monitoring, and data processing. * Configure logging, error monitoring, security controls, cost alerts, and cloud performance optimization. * Maintain secure management of API keys, access tokens, and service credentials. 3\. Google Search Console \& Technical SEO * Audit and optimize the connection between the production JLT website and Google Search Console. * Configure XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical URLs, redirects, and indexing controls. * Diagnose indexing errors, duplicate content, crawl problems, and technical SEO issues. * Prevent staging and development environments from appearing in public search results. * Implement and validate structured data, including Product, Offer, BreadcrumbList, and applicable MerchantReturnPolicy and shipping information. * Ensure WooCommerce product titles, descriptions, images, availability, prices, and structured data remain consistent. * Improve Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, site performance, and Googlebot accessibility. * Coordinate with JLT's existing SEO plugin and eliminate conflicting or duplicate metadata. 4\. Google Merchant Center \& Product Feed Automation * Establish and maintain the connection between WooCommerce and Google Merchant Center. * Configure automated synchronization of eligible products using supported WooCommerce integrations or the Merchant API. * Map product identifiers, titles, descriptions, images, GTINs where applicable, brands, pricing, shipping information, availability, and variations. * Diagnose rejected products, missing attributes, feed errors, and Merchant Center policy or data\-quality issues. * Configure product data updates so inventory and pricing remain synchronized. * Support Google free listings and readiness for paid Google Shopping campaigns. * Implement re xperience with WordPress and WooCommerce development. * Strong PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, and REST API skills. * Demonstrated experience integrating Google Cloud Platform services. * Experience with Google OAuth 2\.0 and secure authentication workflows. * Practical experience with Google Search Console, Google Merchant Center, and e\-commerce technical SEO. * Familiarity with WooCommerce product schemas, variable products, product feeds, and inventory synchronization. * Experience implementing Google product structured data and resolving validation issues. * Experience with Git, staging environments, production deployment, debugging, and database optimization. * Ability to work independently and communicate complex technical issues clearly. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Google Merchant API, Google Ads, and Google Analytics 4\. * Experience with Google Sheets API and Apps Script. * Experience with Hostinger, Elementor Pro, Stripe, and Rank Math or comparable SEO plugins. * Experience building custom WordPress authentication and registration systems. * Experience with high\-volume WooCommerce product catalogs. * Experience with cloud monitoring, Cloud Run, serverless integrations, or comparable systems. * Experience connecting e\-commerce platforms to Meta, TikTok Shop, and external marketplaces. Launch \& Post\-Launch Deliverables The selected engineer will be expected to complete defined milestones: **Milestone 1 – Technical Audit \& Infrastructure** Review the existing JLT IP backend, production website, WooCommerce database, integrations, Google Cloud environment, and current SEO configuration. Produce a written technical assessment and prioritized implementation plan. **Milestone 2 – Google Search \& Product Integration** Complete Search Console configuration, verify production sitemap accessibility, address indexing barriers, validate product structured data, and implement reliable WooCommerce product synchronization with Google Merchant Center. **Milestone 3 – E\-Commerce Optimization** Improve product variation handling, checkout functionality, product imports, inventory accuracy, media data, and API reliability. Resolve critical launch defects. **Milestone 4 – Cloud Configuration \& Automation** Complete the required Google Cloud configuration, secure OAuth workflows, automated product data operations, monitoring, and technical documentation. **Milestone 5 – Post\-Launch Maintenance \& Growth** Provide ongoing support, performance improvements, security maintenance, integration monitoring, incident resolution, and scalable improvements to JLT IP. Compensation \& Work Expectations Compensation is **$4,000 per month**, equivalent to $48,000 annually if the engagement continues for 12 months. This is a continuing contract opportunity, beginning with defined launch deliverables and transitioning into ongoing post\-launch development and platform maintenance. Monthly compensation will be associated with an agreed scope of work, milestone reviews, reporting expectations, and documented technical deliverables. Applicants must be comfortable working with an active e\-commerce environment and taking responsibility for production\-quality engineering work. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit: * An updated resume or professional portfolio. * Examples of WordPress and WooCommerce integrations completed. * Relevant experience with Google Cloud, Google Merchant Center, or Google Search Console. * Experience automating large e\-commerce product catalogs. * A brief explanation of how they would approach integrating WooCommerce product data with Google's ecosystem. * Their availability and proposed working arrangement. **Company Website:** https://jlogisticsandtrade.com **Jay Logistics \& Trade LLC (JLT)** *Engineering Innovation. Connecting Global Commerce.* Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $50,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance Experience: * Google Cloud Functions: 6 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward. Johnson Controls International (JCI) is looking for an AI Platform Engineer to join the AI Engineering \& Platforms team. This role focuses on building, automating, securing, and operating the enterprise landing zones and shared services that enable AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agent\-based solutions across JCI. You will work across cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, DevOps, networking, security, observability, and service operations. The role is platform\-first: creating reusable capabilities, governed deployment patterns, and reliable self\-service experiences for AI engineering, data science, product, and business teams. **How you will do it** **Enterprise AI Landing Zones \& Cloud Platform Engineering** * Build and operate secure, scalable AI landing zones and shared platform services, primarily on Azure and increasingly across AWS. * Develop reusable infrastructure modules and deployment patterns using Terraform and Terragrunt, with consistent configuration across development, test, and production environments. * Provision and support Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Container Apps, App Services, Function Apps, Key Vault, Azure Container Registry, Storage, Cosmos DB, Redis, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and supporting services. * Contribute to AWS AI/ML platform capabilities using services such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, API Gateway, Lambda, S3, IAM, and associated networking and security services. * Design platform services so new capabilities can be onboarded through repeatable modules, documented standards, and approved deployment patterns. **AI Gateways, Model Access \& Runtime Services** * Build and operate governed access to foundation models and AI services through Azure API Management and equivalent cloud gateway patterns. * Implement authentication, authorization, secrets management, rate limiting, quotas, routing, retries, circuit breakers, usage tracking, and cost controls for model and API consumption. * Support pay\-as\-you\-go and provisioned\-throughput model deployments, model upgrades, endpoint lifecycle management, capacity planning, and controlled access for consuming teams. * Enable secure hosting patterns for APIs, agents, containerized workloads, scheduled jobs, and event\-driven services using managed cloud platforms. **Automation, CI/CD \& Developer Enablement** * Create and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure deployment, validation, policy checks, application hosting, and controlled releases. * Build automated testing for Terraform modules, platform services, networking, security controls, and deployment smoke tests. * Create sample projects, templates, reference implementations, runbooks, and onboarding documentation that help teams adopt the platform safely and quickly. * Work with consuming teams to troubleshoot platform access, networking, identity, certificates, private endpoints, deployment, and runtime issues. **Security, Governance, Reliability \& Operations** * Implement private networking, managed identities, Entra ID integration, RBAC, least\-privilege access, secrets management, logging, auditability, and secure\-by\-default configurations. * Partner with Cybersecurity, Cloud Engineering, Networking, Enterprise Architecture, AI Governance, and service owners to move solutions from development into supported production environments. * Build dashboards, alerts, health checks, monitoring, and operational metrics for platform availability, model usage, cost, capacity, and service quality. * Participate in incident response, root\-cause analysis, problem management, platform maintenance, change management, and continuous improvement. * Support platform request, approval, provisioning, documentation, and handover processes, ensuring solutions remain supportable and compliant. **Collaboration \& Engineering Standards** * Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, solution architects, product teams, and cloud specialists to translate use cases into reusable platform capabilities. * Contribute to architecture reviews, technical design decisions, backlog refinement, sprint delivery, code reviews, and platform roadmap planning. * Promote engineering practices focused on automation, reliability, security, maintainability, cost awareness, and clear technical documentation. **Qualifications \& Skills** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in cloud, DevOps, platform, SRE, infrastructure, or MLOps engineering roles. * Hands\-on experience building production Azure solutions using Terraform and Azure DevOps. * Strong knowledge of cloud networking, private endpoints, DNS, identity, RBAC, managed identities, secrets, and secure service\-to\-service connectivity. * Experience with containerized and managed application platforms such as Azure Container Apps, App Services, Functions, Docker, or Kubernetes. * Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, deployment controls, monitoring, alerting, and operational support for production services. * Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * Ability to diagnose complex infrastructure, networking, authentication, certificate, deployment, and runtime issues. * Clear communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work across engineering, architecture, security, governance, and product teams. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, or similar managed AI services. * Experience designing or operating API gateways using Azure API Management, including policies for authentication, routing, throttling, retries, observability, and usage controls. * Experience developing reusable Terraform modules and working with Terragrunt, remote state, module versioning, and environment promotion patterns. * Experience with enterprise landing zones, hub\-and\-spoke networking, private cloud services, policy enforcement, and multi\-subscription or multi\-account environments. * Experience operating AI or ML platforms, including model endpoints, capacity, quotas, evaluation services, vector search, RAG infrastructure, or agent runtimes. * Working knowledge of cloud cost management, service reliability, incident management, and platform product thinking. **Nice to have** * Experience with AWS platform engineering, including Bedrock, SageMaker, API Gateway, IAM, Lambda, S3, VPC networking, Terraform, or Terragrunt. * Experience with multi\-cloud AI gateway, model\-routing, or centralized model\-access patterns. * Knowledge of LLMOps, agent orchestration, MCP, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, model evaluation, safety, or observability patterns. * Experience with OpenTelemetry, SIEM integration, dashboards, load testing, resilience testing, or performance engineering. * Exposure to ServiceNow\-based request and fulfilment processes, CMDB, application onboarding, or enterprise architecture approval processes. * Relevant certifications such as Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Azure DevOps Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect, or Terraform Associate. * Experience supporting global teams and services across multiple regions, time zones, and regulatory environments. **Mindset** * Platform\-first engineer who looks for reusable solutions rather than one\-off deployments. * Security\-conscious and comfortable balancing delivery speed with enterprise controls. * Operationally minded, with a focus on reliability, supportability, automation, and continuous improvement. * Pragmatic problem solver who can work through ambiguity and evolving cloud and AI technologies.
