jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Front End - NY
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== At Justworks, you'll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset \- our people. We're helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We're data\-driven and never stop iterating. If you'd like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we'd love to hear from you. We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. Our Values If this sounds like you, you'll fit right in. **Senior Software Engineer, Frontend** **Department** ============== Engineering **Who You Are** =============== You've been building web applications for a while now and are comfortable ramping up on an existing product quickly. You're an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others. * **Openness** \- Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You're curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others. * **Grit** \- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You're committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude. * **Integrity** \- Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You're honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example. * **Simplicity** \- Be like Einstein: "Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler." **Qualifications** ------------------ * Minimum of 7\+ year experience in Frontend development * Mastery of JS/HTML/CSS and at least one framework such as React, Vue, etc * Working knowledge in at least one server side language, such as Ruby, Python, Golang, etc **Technologies Used** * JS, TS, Vue 3, Vite, PostCSS, Playwright, Node, Fastify, Golang, Mysql, AWS, Git The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $188,000 \- $242,000 per year. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-SM1 Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location. jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer - Level 1
jobs.description: **Customer Support Engineer \- Level 1** ======================================== **About K Group Companies** --------------------------- K Group Companies is a locally owned and operated master integrator headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, with a proud history dating back to 1980\. We support customers across the United States by delivering innovative, high\-quality technology solutions across managed IT, physical security, and integrated services. As a third\-generation, family\-owned business, we’ve built our reputation on long\-term relationships, trusted expertise, and a commitment to doing things the right way for our customers and for each other. We believe great work happens when people feel connected to their purpose, their team, and their growth. **Why K Group Companies?** At K Group Companies, culture is built on long\-standing relationships, both with our customers and with each other. Our team is made up of people who take pride in solving problems, supporting one another, and delivering work that reflects the standards we’ve built our reputation on. Whether it’s designing secure environments for customers, supporting critical IT infrastructure, or collaborating across teams, we operate as one organization working toward shared success. We also believe work should be fulfilling and enjoyable. From friendly gaming competitions in our Team Zone arcade to grabbing lunch together in the community, we value connection and teamwork just as much as technical excellence. **What you can expect here:** * A family\-owned company with deep roots in West Michigan * A trusted advisor culture built over 40\+ years of relationships * The opportunity to work across diverse, real\-world technology environments * A team\-oriented culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, and pride in workmanship * A workplace where people genuinely know and support each other ***We believe we are better together, and that belief shows up in everything we do.*** ***Work Authorization Requirement:*** *Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.* ***This role is 100% onsite in Grand Rapids, Michigan.*** *No third\-party recruiters, agencies, or C2C arrangements.* **Role Overview** ----------------- The Customer Support Engineer \- Level 1 sits on K Group’s Network Operations Center team and owns day\-to\-day break/fix service delivery for our client base. The role is positioned between Help Desk Level 2 and Systems Engineer Level 1, carrying more technical responsibility than a tier\-two queue with more structure and mentorship than a full systems engineering seat. This is a customer\-facing role. Success is measured by resolved tickets, clear communication, and clients who feel supported throughout the process. K Group is a Microsoft\-focused managed service provider and a physical security integrator. This role supports both sides of the business. Candidates are not expected to arrive with expertise in every area, and structured cross\-training is provided. The position is intended as a development path toward Systems Engineer Level 1\. We are looking for a candidate with established experience who is actively working toward that next level. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- #### **Break/Fix \& Service Delivery** * Own service tickets from intake through resolution, maintaining accurate status, documentation, and time entry throughout the ticket lifecycle. * Troubleshoot and resolve endpoint, application, identity, connectivity, and server\-side issues across a diverse client base. * Triage and prioritize work based on client impact and contractual service levels. * Escalate to Systems Engineering when an issue exceeds the scope of the role, providing complete context, logs, and troubleshooting history. #### **Microsoft Systems Administration** * Administer and support Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive. * Manage identity and access in Entra ID and on\-premises Active Directory, including accounts, security groups, group policy, conditional access, and MFA. * Support Windows Server environments, including file and print services, DNS, DHCP, patching, and routine health checks. * Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot endpoints through Intune, including compliance policies, application deployment, and Autopilot provisioning. **Monitoring, Tooling \& Infrastructure Support** * Work daily within RMM and monitoring platforms, responding to alerts, validating agent health, and executing scripted remediations. * Review infrastructure and application logs to identify root cause. * Perform network troubleshooting across VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and VPN connectivity, including reviewing firewall rules and routing tables. * Support backup and endpoint security platforms by verifying job status, investigating failures, and confirming remediation. **Physical Security \& Low Voltage Support** * Provide remote support for physical security systems, including IP video surveillance, door and card access control, and nurse call platforms. * Troubleshoot device connectivity, controller communication, credential and permission issues, and client software access problems. * Support field technicians during on\-site work by verifying configuration, confirming device communication, and resolving system\-side issues remotely. * Coordinate with manufacturer support and internal engineering resources when escalation is required. * Develop and maintain working proficiency in K Group supported physical security platforms. Cross\-training is provided for candidates without a prior background in these systems. **Customer Experience** * Communicate ticket status proactively so clients are not required to request updates. * Translate technical detail into clear, actionable language for non\-technical stakeholders. * Represent K Group professionally on calls, remote sessions, and on\-site visits. * Identify recurring issues and raise them to leadership as candidates for permanent resolution. **Documentation \& Continuous Improvement** * Maintain accurate client documentation covering configurations, network detail, and site\-specific conditions. * Contribute to the internal knowledge base to support consistent service delivery across the team. * Participate in on\-call and after\-hours rotation as scheduled. **What Success Looks Like in Year One** --------------------------------------- To be defined collaboratively with leadership. Initial indicators may include: * Consistent ownership of an assigned ticket queue, with response and resolution times meeting or exceeding service level agreements. * A measurable reduction in escalations to Systems Engineering for issues within the scope of the role. * Escalations submitted with complete documentation and accepted without rework. * Working proficiency in supported physical security platforms, developed through cross\-training or existing experience. * Positive client feedback and demonstrated ownership of complex service situations. * Documented progress against a development plan toward Systems Engineer Level 1\. **Experience \& Qualifications** -------------------------------- * 3 to 5 years of experience in help desk, desktop support, or MSP service delivery. * Working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange Online, and Windows Server. * Hands\-on experience with Intune or a comparable mobile device management platform. * Daily working experience with RMM and remote monitoring tooling. * Ability to review system and application logs, firewall configurations, and routing tables in support of troubleshooting. Advanced network expertise is not required. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to remain composed in high\-pressure client situations. * Willingness to cross\-train into physical security and low voltage systems support. * Interest in advancing toward a Systems Engineer Level 1 role. * Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to client sites within the West Michigan region. **Bonus qualifications:** * Direct experience with IP camera platforms, card access control systems, or nurse call systems. * General low voltage knowledge, including structured cabling and device installation. * Experience supporting healthcare or senior living environments. * Microsoft certifications such as MS\-900, AZ\-900, or MD\-102, or networking certifications such as CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+. * Familiarity with ConnectWise Manage or a comparable PSA platform. * PowerShell scripting at a working level.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer AI-Native Development
jobs.description: **Job Title: AI\-Native Staff Engineer – SN** **Location: 100% Remote** **Employment: W2** ========================================================================================== **Role Overview** ----------------- This role operates within an AI\-native delivery model where engineers use Claude to generate large volumes of production\-bound code across the full stack, then own, review, and make that code production\-ready. The Staff Engineer (AI) is a senior individual contributor who also guides a small team and is responsible for building production software using AI\-native development workflows as part of a small, focused AI\-Native team. This role works closely with other team engineers to rapidly design, implement, test, and iterate on high\-quality software. AI Orchestrators (another term used for AI Engineers) are strong engineers who use AI tools as a first\-class part of their daily engineering workflow to accelerate development, improve testing, and shorten feedback loops. **This role is not focused on training AI models or building machine learning pipelines.** It focuses on building software efficiently, safely, and at high quality using AI\-assisted engineering practices. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. AI\-Native Software Development** * Build and enhance production\-grade software applications using AI\-assisted development workflows. * Translate product and technical requirements into working, maintainable software. * Use AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, and documentation. * Review, validate, and refine AI\-generated code to ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability. ### **2\. Application Design and Implementation** * Design and implement clean, well\-structured APIs, services, and application components. * Contribute to scalable backend systems and full\-stack solutions as required by the team. * Apply sound engineering judgment to balance speed, quality, and long\-term maintainability. * Participate in design discussions and technical reviews within the team. ### **3\. AI Orchestration and Workflow Execution** * Orchestrate the effective use of AI tools across development activities, including: + Code generation and refactoring. + Test creation and validation. + Debugging and issue analysis. + Documentation and design artifacts. * Follow and help refine AI\-native engineering standards established by the Tech Lead. * Contribute feedback and improvements to AI\-assisted workflows and development practices. ### **4\. Collaboration and Team Execution** * Collaborate closely with the AI\-Native Tech Architect(s) to implement architectural and engineering best practices. * Work effectively within a small AI\-Native team to deliver features end\-to\-end. * Coordinate with adjacent teams as needed for integration, dependencies, and shared services. * Communicate technical issues and trade\-offs clearly to engineering and product stakeholders. **Technical Skills and Requirements** ------------------------------------- * **AI\-Assisted Development Tools:** Experience with Claude, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent AI coding tools is required. * **Programming Language:** Java. * **Database Design:** Experience with Oracle and PostgreSQL. * **Software Engineering:** Experience building production\-grade software across backend services, frontend components, APIs, workflows, and test code. * **AI\-Native Engineering Practices:** Ability to use AI tools effectively for code generation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation, while ensuring production readiness. **Additional Notes** -------------------- * AI\-tooling experience is required. * Code generation spans backend services, frontend components, APIs, workflows, and test code. * The role emphasizes production software engineering using AI\-assisted development practices rather than AI model training or machine learning pipeline development.

credential management, incorporating retry, error handling, and rate\-limiting patterns. * Data Quality \& Reliability: Configure pipeline monitoring, alerting, schema validation, and reconciliation jobs. * Data Product Delivery: Partner with the Data Product Owner, data modelers, architects, and platform teams to translate product requirements, metric definitions, data\-quality expectations, and support governance and audit requirements. * Technical Mentorship \& Standards: Conduct code reviews, establish reusable coding templates, and mentor team engineers on best practices for data engineering and version control. **Required Technical Skills** * SQL \& BigQuery: Advanced SQL proficiency with hands\-on BigQuery experience managing datasets, partitioning, clustering, views, schema updates, access controls, and query optimization. * Data Pipeline \& Orchestration: Proven experience designing and running production ELT/ETL pipelines, state management, incremental loading, and workflow scheduling with Cloud Composer or Apache Airflow. * Programming \& Scripting: Strong hands\-on programming skills in Python and Bash shell scripting for container and pipeline workflows. * Experience implementing automated data\-quality controls, reconciliation, observability, alerting, failure recovery, and production support. * Security \& Governance: Experience applying access controls, secure credential handling, lineage, auditability, and data\-governance requirements within a regulated or highly governed environment. **Preferred Technical Skills** * Containerization: Experience packaging and running lightweight workloads using Docker, Cloud Build, and Cloud Run. * Developer Telemetry: Prior experience building reporting data models around software engineering tools, such as Jira, ServiceNow, GitLab. * Streaming \& Event Ingestion: Familiarity with event\-driven data ingestion using Pub/Sub or Apache Beam / Google Cloud Dataflow. * Analytics \& AI Readiness: Familiarity with engineering, operational, productivity, quality, cost, risk, or AI\-related data. **Work Experience \& Education** * Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Relevant Experience: 5\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience building production cloud data pipelines and data warehouse solutions. * DevOps / CI/CD Experience: 2\+ years of practical experience integrating automated testing, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD deployment workflows. **Core Competencies** * All KeyBank employees are expected to demonstrate Key’s Values and abide by Key’s Code of Conduct. **Physical Demands** * General Office \- Prolonged sitting, ability to communicate face to face in person or on the phone with teammates and clients, frequent use of PC/laptop, occasional lifting/pushing/pulling of backpacks, computer bags up to 10 lbs. **Work Location Category** * Hybrid (2\+ days) COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $80,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 annually. Placement within the pay range may differ based upon various factors, including but not limited to skills, experience and geographic location. Compensation for this role also includes eligibility for incentive compensation which may include production, commission, and/or discretionary incentives. cases on the Now Platform * Familiarity with ITIL practices and how they map to ServiceNow processes * Experience with DevOps pipelines and Git\-based source control practices for ServiceNow **Work schedule**: Monday–Friday, daytime, onsite at our La Crosse campus. jobs.title: SDET I
jobs.description: **ABOUT LVT** LVT is redefining how businesses operate in the physical world, moving beyond traditional security solutions to deliver AI\-driven, actionable intelligence that makes sites smarter, safer, and more secure. Since pioneering our first mobile, solar\-powered units, our commitment to scrappy, hands\-on innovation has made us an established leader and one of the fastest\-growing companies in intelligent site technology. We are building the next generation of solutions—from our physical units in the field to a powerful Agentic AI platform—that allows our customers to gain unprecedented visibility and control over safety, compliance, and operations. This is your chance to join a cutting\-edge team that isn't just watching the world change, but actively building the technology that is changing it. We’re a team that’s focused on growth and innovation, and we’re proud that our crew, products, and leadership are being recognized for it. * **A Top\-Tier Growth Company:** Named one of the *Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies 2025* and *\#10 on the Inc. 5000 Rocky Mountain Regional* list for 2025\. * **Innovative Leadership:** Our CEO, Ryan Porter, was named an *EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025*, and our CTO, Steve Lindsey, was inducted into the *Silicon Slopes CTO Hall of Fame* in 2024\. * **Product \& Software Excellence:** We were named one of *The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies of 2023* and are a winner of the *Security Today Govies Award* for 2025\. ### **ABOUT THIS ROLE** As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET I), you will join our Software Quality team to ensure the elite performance and reliability of LVT’s intelligent site technology. You will sit at the intersection of development and quality, contributing to automated frameworks and executing sophisticated test strategies that challenge our systems' limits. This is an opportunity for a high\-potential engineer to influence the stability of a rapidly scaling AI platform while working alongside a world\-class engineering team. This role is based in\-office out of our Headquarters in American Fork, Utah. ### **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** * Maintain and scale automated test frameworks to ensure high\-velocity software delivery without compromising quality. * Develop and execute comprehensive automated and manual test cases that validate complex system behaviors across our platform. * Collaborate deeply with developers and product managers to identify critical test requirements and edge\-case scenarios early in the lifecycle. * Rigorous identification, documentation, and tracking of defects, working cross\-functionally to drive rapid resolutions. * Uphold and advocate for test automation best practices, methodologies, and modern tooling within the engineering org. * Analyze complex test results and troubleshoot failures to provide actionable insights for continuous architectural improvement. * Proactively monitor emerging testing technologies to enhance our coverage of hardware\-software integrations. * Adapt quickly to shifting priorities in a high\-growth environment, ensuring quality remains a competitive advantage. ### **OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE** * Technical Foundation: 1–3 years of experience in coding, test planning, and debugging within a professional software development environment. * Automation Expertise: Hands\-on experience with modern test frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Pytest. * Language Proficiency: A foundational understanding of Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. * Lifecycle Knowledge: Proven experience navigating rapid development and release cycles (CI/CD) and integrating tests into GitHub Actions. * Analytical Mindset: A proactive problem\-solver who doesn't just find bugs but understands the "why" behind system failures. * Growth\-Oriented: A self\-motivated learner who thrives on feedback and is eager to master new technologies in the AI and IoT space. * Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical risks to both engineering peers and stakeholders. * Bonus Points: Experience with AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, Appium for mobile testing, or testing integrated hardware/software systems. **BENEFITS** We believe you do your best work when your whole life is supported. We invest in our crew’s health, families, and financial futures with a benefits package designed to support you inside and outside the office. Full\-time benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO. ***LVT IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.*** *All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. All candidates must pass a drug screening and background check upon employment. Some roles may also require passing a federal background check and fingerprinting. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, and/or to perform essential job functions, please reach out to your recruiter.*

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** LakeFusion is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to build and scale our real\-time API to enterprise production workloads. This is a deeply technical role focused on building resilient, fault\-tolerant, high\-throughput distributed systems that bridge enterprise backends with high\-performance Python microservices and data lakehouse platforms.A critical dimension of this role: we ship into customer environments. You won't just write code that works on our infrastructure — you'll build systems robust enough to run across Azure, AWS, and customer\-managed Kubernetes clusters where you don't control the network, the identity provider, the observability stack, or the operator. That requires a particular kind of engineering discipline: defensive design, strong observability, minimal environmental assumptions, and thorough testing under failure conditions. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Scale the real\-time API: Own the architecture and implementation of our high\-throughput, low\-latency API built in Python/FastAPI and deployed on Kubernetes. * Maintain enterprise core: Develop and maintain core enterprise backends using .NET / C\#, ensuring seamless interoperability between .NET services, FastAPI microservices, and NoSQL datastores. * Build for resilience and fault tolerance: Design for graceful degradation under upstream failures, rate limits, partial outages, and retry storms. Eliminate silent failure modes. * Engineer for autoscaling: Tune Kubernetes autoscaling behavior (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) to handle bursty production workloads across diverse customer environments. * Optimize NoSQL data stores: Architect and optimize MongoDB collections, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and asynchronous database connections for low\-latency queries. * Build streaming integrations: Develop streaming pipelines and background execution workflows that sync data between service, transactional, and analytical layers. * Integrate Lakehouse analytics: Connect backend APIs with Databricks compute, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog to expose real\-time analytics and data pipelines to downstream consumers. * Design for portability: Architect services that ship into customer environments and work reliably without serverless dependencies, with customer\-controlled identity, restricted network egress, and varied observability stacks. * Own performance: Profile, benchmark, and optimize for latency and throughput. Understand and tune the full stack — from FastAPI event loops and .NET memory management through connection pooling, caching, and downstream service calls. ‍ **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of backend engineering experience building production\-grade services and microservices. * 4\+ years of deep Python expertise, with hands\-on mastery of FastAPI, ASGI server tuning (uvloop/Uvicorn), async event loops (asyncio), Pydantic, and performance profiling. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in .NET Core / .NET 6\+ (C\#), building RESTful APIs, Dependency Injection architectures, Entity Framework Core, and enterprise backend components. * 4\+ years of experience working with MongoDB, including schema design, aggregation pipelines, index tuning, and asynchronous drivers (Motor, PyMongo). * Strong Kubernetes experience, particularly around autoscaling (HPA, KEDA), resource allocation, containerization (Docker), and production deployment patterns. * Resilience and fault\-tolerance engineering: circuit breakers, retries with backoff and jitter, bulkheads, timeouts, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns. * Deployment portability experience: you understand how to write software that runs in environments you don't control and can adapt to restricted network egress and custom identity providers. * Strong observability instincts: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry), and the discipline to make systems debuggable from the outside. * Excellent technical communication, with experience collaborating across distributed engineering teams. ‍ **Nice\-to\-have** ------------------ * Databricks experience: Familiarity with Databricks Connect, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, or MLflow integrations. * Experience with event\-driven architectures and streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS EventBridge). * Experience deploying into enterprise customer environments with strict security/compliance constraints (customer\-managed identity, private networking, private endpoints). * Experience with dual\-paradigm data access patterns bridging SQL and NoSQL/Document databases. **About LakeFusion** -------------------- LakeFusion is the modern Master Data Management (MDM) company. Global enterprises across industries ranging from retail to manufacturing and financial services rely on the LakeFusion platform to unify, govern, and deliver trusted data entities such as customers, products, suppliers, and employees. Built natively on the Databricks Lakehouse, LakeFusion creates a single source of truth that powers analytics and AI. LakeFusion enables organizations worldwide to accelerate innovation with trusted and governed data.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Console
jobs.description: Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. * Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue or San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday. **About the Role** The console is where every service Lambda sells meets the human user at the customer. It is the place where disparate products can come together to create a unified experience that solves a customer problem. Conversely, it is also the place where a cloud most easily becomes hard to use, because each service is built by a different team at a different time, and every one of them arrives with its own idea of what a resource is called, where it lives, who is allowed to touch it, and what a customer should do next. The customer does not experience a portfolio of services. They experience one product, and they judge us on whether it holds together. This role owns that product. You own the console as a single surface, with one navigation model, one identity and permissions story, one set of interaction patterns, and one vocabulary, across On\-Demand GPU Instances, reserved capacity, 1\-Click Clusters, bare metal, storage, networking, Managed Kubernetes, billing, and support. Every service team ships into that surface, and the standards are yours to set. Your job is to make the whole thing feel like it was designed on purpose, which means writing the standards down, reviewing the work against them, and being the person who says no when a service wants to solve a problem in a way that only makes sense from inside that team. Three very different people have to succeed here. A machine learning researcher wants a graphics processing unit (GPU) in minutes and should never have to learn cloud vocabulary to get one. An infrastructure engineer runs large clusters, lives in the application programming interface (API) and the command line, and needs the console to agree exactly with both. A platform engineer is building their own service on top of Lambda for their own users, and needs the console to make clear what their teams can see, spend, and change. The hard part of the role is that these three pull in different directions, and the surface cannot be quietly bent toward whichever one showed up in the last customer meeting. Great product managers at Lambda are defined by three things: insight, influence, and execution. Insight means you look at the data, determine what it means for customers and business, and then figure out what to do about it. But, a great idea doesn't mean anything in a vacuum. That is where influence comes in. Influence means you take that idea and get others to want to buy into it; you win over engineers, designers, executives, and partners without relying on authority. But a great idea that everyone is excited about doesn't matter unless it is delivered to customers. Execution means you work with the right people to get the idea launched, then measure and iterate. We hire product managers who learn new domains fast and reason rigorously from evidence. Deep experience owning a customer\-facing console for a cloud or developer platform is highly desired. At Lambda, we don't work in silos, we work together, each bringing our particular crafts, to build the best customer experience as one team. This role is where that commitment is tested most often. Be clear\-eyed about the starting point. Several of the standards this role depends on do not exist yet, so the first year includes writing them and building the design and front\-end engineering partnership that keeps them alive. This is a role for someone who wants to establish the function, not inherit it. If you have held a cloud console together across a growing portfolio and want to do it while the portfolio is still being built, we'd love to hear from you. We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and skills, and we are excited to hear from candidates who can bring unique perspectives to our team. If you do not exactly meet this description but believe you may be a good fit, please still apply and help us understand your readiness for this role. **What You'll Do** * **Own the Whole Surface:** Hold the product definition for the console as one product, decide what belongs in it and what does not, rank and sequence the work, and be honest about what Lambda is not doing this year and why. * **Set the Patterns and Hold Them:** Define the navigation, identity, permissions presentation, resource naming, states, errors, and empty screens that every service uses, write them down clearly enough that a team can build to them without asking you, then establish and run the review that console work pas te it down well enough that people can disagree with it precisely, and keep owning the decision after it is made. **You** * Have 10\+ years of product management experience, including owning a customer\-facing console, dashboard, or developer surface for a cloud, infrastructure, or developer platform. * Have shipped interaction patterns, a design system, or a surface standard that teams you did not manage adopted and kept using after you stopped pushing, and can describe how you actually got them to. * Have taken a set of separately built product surfaces and made them behave like one product, and can say what you consolidated, what you left alone, and why. * Understand cloud infrastructure well enough to reason with engineers about identity, permissions, quotas, regions, capacity, telemetry, and billing, and about what should and should not be exposed to a customer. * Understand access control models for organizations, teams, projects, roles, and API keys well enough to design how they are presented, because this is where a console either works for a platform team or does not. * Able to define iterative plans that move an organization from the current state towards the desired outcome. * Have made one product serve both a first\-time user and a daily operator without turning it into two products. * Have used research and instrumentation to settle a disagreement about a user experience, and are comfortable being the person who brings evidence to a room full of strong opinions. * Can turn ambiguous customer, technical, and commercial inputs into product definition that multiple teams execute against. * Communicate plainly, write well, say no clearly, and team on a component library, design tokens, or a shared application shell. * Experience owning documentation or in\-product guidance as part of the product rather than as a handoff. * Experience with accessibility standards and with making an infrastructure product usable under them. * Experience with a console that had to serve both a human and an automated caller, and opinions about what that costs. **Salary Range Information** The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. jobs.title: Product Engineer, AI & Automation
jobs.description: **Position:** Product Engineer, AI \& Automation **Department:** Digital Experience **Role Overview:** The Operational Efficiency team works with departments across the organization to reduce manual effort in daily operations. This role is the team's primary builder. You will take processes that are currently slow, repetitive, or error\-prone and turn them into working automations, applying AI capabilities where they fit the problem. Most of your time will be spent building: writing code, connecting systems, designing and testing agents, and maintaining what you have already shipped. Requirements will reach you as problems rather than finished specifications, so you will work directly with the teams whose processes you are automating to understand how the work is performed before deciding what to build. We are looking for someone with five or more years of experience who has delivered automations that people depend on daily and who has supported them over time. **What you’ll get to do:** *Build* * Design and build automations across operational workflows, including data movement, document handling, reporting, intake and routing, and notifications. * Connect existing systems using REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, and integration platforms, working within the organization's current technology stack wherever possible. * Build components that use large language models where they are the right tool for the problem, including extraction from unstructured documents, classification, routing, summarization, and drafting. Design the prompts, test them against representative data, and define the accuracy required before launching. * Determine where human review is required, set confidence thresholds that route uncertain cases to staff, and define what happens when the model produces incorrect output. * Handle supporting work with the same care as the build itself, including data validation, idempotency, credential management, environment separation, and documentation sufficient for another engineer to take over. *Define and scope* * Work with department leads to document current\-state processes and identify automation candidates, quantifying the time and cost each process consumes today. * Assess feasibility and recommend alternatives when a process change or a configuration change in an existing system would solve the problem more effectively than a new automation. * Translate operational needs into technical requirements and divide work into phases that deliver value early. * Set clear expectations with stakeholders on accuracy, exception handling, and scope. This matters especially for AI\-assisted steps, where acceptable error rates should be agreed in advance. *Own and maintain* * Own each automation through its full lifecycle, including monitoring, response when upstream systems change, iteration as processes evolve, and retirement once it is no longer needed. * Build in monitoring and alerting so that failures surface quickly instead of going unnoticed. * Maintain documentation and runbooks so that support does not depend on a single person. * Track and report impact, including hours returned, error rates, cycle time, and usage. *Support and enable others* * Train and support staff who want to build simple automations on their own, extending the reach of the team. * Contribute to the team's standards and patterns, including guidelines on what organizational data may be sent to external AI services. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years of professional experience building automations, integrations, or internal tools. * Strong Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript skills, with experience writing code that other engineers have maintained. * Substantial experience with REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, and system\-to\-system integration. * Hands\-on experience building with large language models, including prompt design, structured output, and methods for evaluating output quality. * Working knowledge of SQL and experience with inconsistent or incomplete operational data. * Proven ability to work with non\-technical stakeholders, including gathering requirements, managing expectations, and supporting adoption. * Good judgment about which processes are appropriate for candidates for automation, and which are not. *Preferred* * Experience with integration or workflow platforms such as Workato, Make, n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, Airflow, or Temporal. * Experience with document processing, OCR, or extraction from unstructured sources. * Experience in a comparable operational environment where automations touch finance, HR, or customer\-facing workflows. * Familiarity with data governance and access controls in environments that handle sensitive records. **What is Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts?** Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Inc. (LCPA) is a cultural and civic cornerstone of New York City. We believe the arts play an important role in our lives: they nourish our hearts and minds, teach us valuable lessons and critical skills, and help us create community. We are resolved not to lose sight of what connects us, and we hope you will consider joining our talented, diverse team. **We are:** 1\. The manager of the 16\-acre Lincoln Center campus * We are one of eleven amazing resident arts organizations 2\. A leading Arts Presenter. * We curate numerous programs and performances, showcasing music, dance, and more 3\. An Education Hub. * We have reached 20 million students, educators, principals, and community members **Who are our people?** LCPA is a team of dreamers, collaborators, and entrepreneurs who use unique platforms in the heart of New York City and beyond to advocate for the transformative impact of artistic experiences. Lincoln Center People imagine and create in concert with this mission by founding President John D. Rockefeller III \- "The arts are not for the privileged few, but for the many. Their place is not on the periphery of daily life, but at its center." We welcome applicants from all sectors who agilely solve problems, show up as they are, and can't stop innovating. **What’s the news?** *Recent and Upcoming Programming* * **Lincoln Center Reveals 25/26 Season Featuring Jeanine Tesori as Visionary Artist** * **Kyle Abraham's 20 Years of Urgency at Lincoln Center Rose Theatre** *Campus Happenings* * **Lincoln Center Gets $50 Million Gift to Promote Contemporary Dance** * **The new JFK terminal will show iconic artworks from MoMA, the Met and Lincoln Center** *Legacies of San Juan Hill* * **WNYC: Lincoln Center Celebrates 'Legacies of San Juan Hill** * **Lincoln Center Launches San Juan Hill Project Digital Hub To Remember the Lost Urban Neighborhood** **Who is our President and CEO?** Dr. Mariko Silver **Join us!** It is the policy of Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts, Inc., to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, marital or civil partnership/union status, familial or caregiver status, alienage or citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, military or veteran status, genetic information, predisposition, or carrier status, unemployment status, domestic violence, sexual violence, or stalking victim status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. LCPA is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. *If you require reasonable accommodation in locating open positions, completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to Abigail Worsnip at (212\) 875–5324\.*

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Applied AI Evaluation
jobs.description: **About Litmus** ---------------- AI agents are starting to do real work across the economy, and the companies deploying them have no reliable way to know whether they can trust them. Litmus is building the system that lets every enterprise measure how its agents perform, understand why they fail, and make them better, starting with evaluation and building toward agents that improve on their own. Litmus was founded in August 2026 by Sidharth Srinivasan, who built and led AI evaluation at Box after Box's CEO recruited him out of Stanford CS. We've raised $5M from Pear, BoxGroup, Workbench, and Emergence, alongside the CEO of Box, the co\-founder of Dropbox, and senior executives from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. **The role** ------------ **Figure out what "good" means for AI agents doing real work, and prove it.** You'll design how we measure agents in domains where there's no answer key, and make sure the numbers can be trusted. It's research\-leaning, hands\-on work that ships to customers. You'll work on: * Verifiers and graders for knowledge work with no ground truth * Making simulated environments and tasks faithful to the real world * Knowing when you've tested enough, and when a score means something * Turning what works for one customer into something the product does automatically Why it's exciting: * Nobody has written the playbook for measuring agents in real work yet. You'll write it. * Real agents in high\-stakes domains, not academic benchmarks. * Measurement, not capability: whether agents are actually useful, and how anyone would know. **You might be a fit if** ------------------------- * You've built evals, benchmarks, verifiers, reward models, RL environments, or synthetic data pipelines for LLMs or agents * You think like a researcher about whether a number means anything, and you write production code to find out * You've chosen risk before: founder, founding engineer, early employee, or a small, high\-output team * You typically have 2–6 years of experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in non\-code domains like legal, finance, healthcare, or enterprise work * Post\-training experience (SFT, RLHF, RLVR) * Statistics for evaluation, benchmark design, or published eval research **Probably not a fit** ---------------------- * Eval dashboards or observability tooling with no hands\-on eval design * Model training with little interest in evaluation **What we offer** ----------------- * Founding equity and competitive cash * One of the first hires, working directly with the founder and customers from day one * A say in how agent quality gets measured across the industry * A beautiful office in FiDi * Breakfast, lunch, and dinner * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Equinox membership or a fitness stipend * Essentially unlimited budget for AI tools and tokens * Relocation support if you're moving to San Francisco

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Operator Tools
jobs.description: MarginEdge is seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to join our new Operator Tools team — the group responsible for helping restaurants understand and control their costs, and ultimately manage their restaurants better. The team organizes around problems that define a restaurant's costs and operating workflows. We worry about things like what restaurants spend to bring goods in the door and the ordering workflow behind it; what it costs for the restaurant to make a dish and the recipe and prep workflows that produce it. We take the data a restaurant already has and turn it into insights and automations that drive savings, while giving operators hours back in their week. We believe that a number sitting in a report has limited value; helping operators turn those numbers into action is our job. MarginEdge’s Operator Tools are part of a broader SaaS solution built for restaurant operators by restaurant operators. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a problem area end\-to\-end. That means you are accountable for an outcome, not a feature list: you determine what is worth solving, work with the team to define the best solution, get it built and launched, and then evaluate the impact. You will work closely with external stakeholders — restaurant owners, GMs, head chefs, managers, accountants and bartenders — and translate their pain points to the MarginEdge engineering, design, operations, sales, and marketing teams. The ideal candidate has a “buck stops here” mentality, where you take responsibility for ensuring that all the stakeholders are put in a position to succeed, and you proactively anticipate the concerns of both customers and your team. **MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology** As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service, partially because that’s where so many of our team come from (including everyone on our Business Development team), but also because we believe it is just the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant, and the goal of making the magic just a little easier for operators by taking the complex (read: very annoying) back office tasks off their plate, while empowering them with real\-time data. Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture\-backed and serve 12,000\+ restaurants across the US and Canada. We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them. We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees. **What type of responsibilities will I have?** * Own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for your problem area. Partner with leadership to define success, make prioritization decisions, and communicate the strategy and trade\-offs. * Build a deep understanding of restaurant operators and their workflows through regular customer interaction, qualitative research, and product data, and represent that understanding in product decisions. * Validate problems and solutions before making significant investments. Use lightweight tests, prototypes, and pilots to reduce uncertainty, and be willing to change direction when the evidence warrants it. * Use data throughout the product lifecycle. Be able to investigate usage and workflow patterns yourself, partner with Data on what needs to be collected, and measure whether launches actually drove the intended outcome. * Lead product development in close partnership with Design and Engineering, from exploration and prototyping through delivery, balancing customer value, usability, feasibility, and quality. * Understand the competitive and market landscape well enough to know where we are differentiated, where we are exposed, and where there are unmet operator needs. * Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Operations on positioning, enablement, rollout, and post\-launch feedback. * Take on ambiguous, early\-stage opportunities and bring them to a point where the company can make an informed decision about whether and how to invest. * Be the product expert and accountable owner for your area, providing context and direction when customer issues, product questions, feature requests, and new opportunities arise. * Communicate strategy, decisions, trade\-offs, and results clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. * Raise the bar for product practice across the team through mentoring and by improving how we approach discovery, writing, decision\-making, and measurement. **What qualifications or skills are required?** * 3\-6 years in product management or a related business or technical role (business analyst, product owner, software engineer). * A willingness to roll up your sleeves and spend t erience taking a product from zero to one, not only iterating on an established one. * Experience with hardware products and mobile applications. * Restaurant experience. * Experience building, designing, or otherwise working with software for restaurant owners and operators. **Compensation:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$135,000–$150,000** annually. Where a candidate falls within that range depends on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus opportunities and our comprehensive benefits package. **What’s it like to work for MarginEdge?** Imagine the fun of a great restaurant \- surrounded by a team of people (including some that you help to manage!) who care about hospitality, care about quality, and care about each other \- then subtract the long nights, weekends, drunk customers at the bar...et voila, MarginEdge! We work hard, we work fast and we fuel our work with a commitment of transparency from leadership, straight talk and trust between teams. We believe that the best people do their best work when they feel empowered \- so whether you are remote or in our office (likely eating a catered lunch from our clients in our baller, brand new penthouse HQ in Ballston) you get to work with your manager to call your shot on what works best for you. Did we mention it has a full commercial kitchen and is walking distance (covered walking, that is) from the metro? **Benefits (Shut the Front Door, They are Amazing)** In order to fuel this rocket ship, we need to build a team as passionate about our work and product as we are. We believe that top talent (that’s you!) should feel deeply connected to their work, appreciated for the time they give to building our organization and have the balance necessary to give their best during work hours and all those after\-hours too. We do this by offering a suite of kick ass benefits not only to be competitive and catch the eye of super smart people (that’s you again!) but also provide the foundation for a career you love and a life outside of work you love just as much. * Unlimited Paid Time Off (and we mean it, we encourage your healthy work life balance!) * Medical, Dental, Vision, and Short/Long\-Term Disability Insurance (preventative care for the win) * Health Savings Account with employer match (dependent upon your medical plan selection) * Commuter benefits with employer contribution (excluding limos and helos \- for now) * Generous Life Insurance Plan * Short\- and Long\-term Disability * Company\-Paid Holidays * 401(k) and matching * Stock Options to buy into everything we are doing to support this industry * 12\-week fully Paid Parental Leave * Lunch catered twice a week at our HQ in Arlington (we exclusively cater from our clients, too! * A wellness program that sponsors healthy activities such as step challenges and provides discounts to gyms and fitness classes. ***Check out our 100% “Recommend to a Friend” rating from anonymous employee reviews on*** ***Glassdoor******.*** ***Oh, and our recognition in the Washington Post as a*** ***top small businesses*** ***to work for in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025!*** ***And most important, what our customers think about our work on*** ***Capterra*** ***and*** ***G2 Crowd.*** **Our Fine Print is Bold:** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran, marital, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. You be you. While we are proudest of our commitment to exceptional culture and creating a truly excellent work environment, we see our benefits as an extension of that belief. Our benefits package is designed to be exceptionally competitive and a reflection of our commitment to a best\-in\-class workplace for all.

jobs.title: Application Security Consultant - DAST
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ A career with us means you’ll work alongside exceptional people and be empowered to reach your professional and personal goals. Our employees are at the foundation of what enables MassMutual to deliver on our purpose to help people secure their futures and protect the ones they love. We embrace the idea that we all are stronger and better through our support for one another. We strive to create a culture where employees feel valued and are celebrated for who they are. **Job Description** ------------------- Application Security Consultant \- DAST Enterprise Cyber Security Full Time, Springfield \- MA **The Opportunity** We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Application Security Consultant to advance our application security initiatives, with a particular emphasis on dynamic application security testing (DAST). You will own and mature how we test running applications and APIs for exploitable weaknesses, drive secure development practices, and implement solutions that protect our systems and data from evolving threats. The role partners with development teams, security architects, leadership, and other stakeholders to embed security into every stage of the software development lifecycle. **The Team** Our Application Security team keeps MassMutual's software applications secure through rigorous assessment and proactive development team engagements. We work closely with security architects, DevOps engineers, and software developers, while our core focus is identifying and verifying vulnerabilities — including hands\-on dynamic testing of running applications and APIs — implementing security best practices, and helping development teams remediate. Our backgrounds span software engineering to red teaming, and we value continuous learning, innovation, and collaboration. **The Impact** Your key responsibilities will ensure applications are resilient against emerging threats, reducing the financial and reputational damage of security incidents. * Own and advance our dynamic application security testing (DAST) program — selecting, deploying, configuring, and maintaining DAST tooling across our web application and API estate. * Design and run authenticated dynamic scans against complex applications, including session handling, multi\-step workflows, single\-page applications, and REST/GraphQL APIs. * Integrate DAST into CI/CD pipelines and pre\-production environments so dynamic testing runs continuously rather than as a point\-in\-time exercise, and define the thresholds that gate a release. * Triage, validate, and tune DAST output — eliminating false positives, confirming exploitability through manual verification, and translating findings into actionable remediation guidance for development teams. * Complement automated dynamic testing with manual techniques to identify, risk\-assess, and prioritize application\-level vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) that scanners alone do not surface. * Conduct in\-depth security assessments, including vulnerability scanning and code review. * Conduct detailed threat modeling to identify attack vectors and potential weaknesses, and use the results to focus dynamic test coverage where risk is highest. * Collaborate with security architects to design secure application architectures aligned to industry best practices, ensuring secure coding practices are followed and security controls are built into software designs. * Partner with our SDLC Council to develop and maintain secure coding standards that empower developers to integrate security into their own workflow. * Partner with DevOps teams to implement security controls within CI/CD pipelines for automated, seamless deployment of secure code. * Maintain the broader application security testing toolchain, including static analysis (SAST) and software composition analysis (SCA), alongside DAST. * Evaluate third\-party software and APIs for security compliance, including dynamic testing of externally sourced components where appropriate. * Support incident response for application security events, providing rapid identification and mitigation guidance. * Ensure compliance with applicable security regulations, frameworks, and industry standards. * Use reporting tools to communicate vulnerability and code\-defect risk to MassMutual's cyber assets through metrics (KPIs, KRIs, OKRs), enabling team leaders and executive leadership to make risk\-based prioritization decisions. * Educate developers and stakeholders on secure coding practices and on interpreting and acting on dynamic test results. * Stay current on security threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends, and apply them to improve our security strategy. **The Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree * 8\+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development. **The Ideal Qualifications** * Deep, hands\-on expertise with DAST tooling (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Invicti, Acunetix, StackHaw ifics of the assistance you need. California residents: For detailed information about your rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), please visit our California Consumer Privacy Act Disclosures page. MassMutual will accept applications on an ongoing basis until such time as a candidate has been offered employment. The job description includes the main duties of this position, which may evolve over time. You may be required to perform other duties not listed. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. Salary Range: $137,800\-$180,800 **Award\-Winning Culture** -------------------------- MassMutual is guided by a single purpose: We help people secure their future and protect the ones they love. As a company operated for the benefit of our members and participating policyowners, we are defined by mutuality and our vision to provide financial well\-being for all Americans. It’s more than our company structure — it’s our way of life. We are a company of people protecting people. Our company exists because people are willing to share risk and resources and rely on each other when it counts. We strive to build a thriving community where everyone is valued, included, and feels that they belong. At MassMutual, we Live Mutual. **How We Work** --------------- MassMutual’s flexible workplace approach combines the importance of connecting in person and the flexibility of working remotely. Our hybrid model puts collaboration first with employees coming in at least three days per week to our spectacular campus settings and also enjoying the flexibility of remote Fridays, company\-wide remote weeks, and a bank of flexible remote weeks to use throughout the year. **Benefits for the whole you (and your loved ones)** ---------------------------------------------------- There’s more to your life than your job and there’s more to your aspirations than a paycheck. We take a holistic view of compensation and benefits that provides the flexibility to create a healthy balance in your life for work, family, and community. We offer the benefits you’d expect, like medical, dental, 401(k), and generous vacation time, but we also offer ones you might not expect, like three paid days for volunteering, a $1,250 annual Well\-Being Wallet, and up to 320 hours of caregiver leave. Explore some of our offerings below. ### **Paid Time Off** * In addition to generous vacation time, paid holidays, and flexible holidays, MassMutual offers 'take care' time to care for yourself or someone you love—whether for physical illness or mental health. ### **Health \& Well\-Being** In addition to top\-line medical and dental coverage, personalized mental health solutions, on\-site and virtual health coaching, and much more, MassMutual reimburses employees up to $1,250 per year for eligible expenses supporting mental, physical, and financial well\-being. ### **Financial Well\-Being** In addition to competitive salaries and bonuses, educational assistance programs, and much more, MassMutual offers up to a 10% total 401(k) benefit, consisting of a 5% company match and a 5% annual contribution. ### **Taking Care** MassMutual offers generous maternity and parental leaves, as well as bereavement leave to mourn the loss of a loved one (and the employee defines 'loved one'). In addition, we offer up to 320 hours of caregiver leave to help employees support loved ones in times of need. ### **Giving Back** MassMutual offers three paid days for employees to volunteer with eligible nonprofits of their choice, and the MassMutual Foundation matches employee donation dollars to eligible nonprofit organizations up to $5,000 annually. ### **Commuter Benefits** MassMutual offers a Qualified Commuter Program through which eligible employees can pay qualified workplace commuting expenses with before\-tax dollars, as well as a commuter wallet option for employees based at Boston and NYC campuses.

Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end\-to\-end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life\-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.Our teams build the cloud platforms and data services that power Microsoft Security, helping customers protect complex environments and turn security data into actionable insights. Our work spans scalable distributed services, platform infrastructure, and large\-scale data processing, alongside graph\-based capabilities. We partner with product managers, security researchers, and engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and performant capabilities, with a strong focus on customer needs and the health of our production services.We are looking for a Software Engineer who is curious, collaborative, and motivated by challenging technical problems and customer impact. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will design, build, test, and support well\-defined features in cloud services, data pipelines, or platform tooling. You will gain hands\-on experience with distributed systems, secure development, and live\-site operations while strengthening your engineering judgment through feedback and code reviews. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** * Designs and implements well\-defined components of cloud services and platform tooling, with guidance from experienced engineers, to deliver scalable and reliable security capabilities for customers. * Builds data\-processing pipelines and service integrations that enables reliable processing and exchanges of security data across products, services, and customer scenarios. * Collaborates with product managers, security researchers, and partner engineers to understand requirements, test ideas, and uses feedback to turn customer needs and research insights into production capabilities. * Writes clean, maintainable, well\-tested code using secure development practices, with attention to error handling, data correctness, privacy, and tenant isolation. * Uses telemetry and debugging tools to investigate production issues and improve reliability, performance, and resource efficiency, while learning safe deployment and live\-site practices. * Participates in design and code reviews, communicates progress and blockers, and improves development, testing, and deployment workflows through feedback and automation. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python * + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical field AND 1\+ year(s) technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python. * + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python. + OR equivalent experience. * Experience building, testing, and debugging backend services or data\-processing pipelines using technologies such as C\#, Java, or Python. * Familiarity with data structures and algorithms, and exposure to distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, databases, or graph processing. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, for coding, testing, or debugging, while reviewing and validating AI\-generated output and following data\-handling policies. * Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, such as identities, permissions, vulnerabilities, or attack paths, and an interest in building secure services that address customer needs. jobs.title: Systems Studies Engineer
jobs.description: **Systems Studies Engineer I** **Join the MEPPI Team!** The Power Systems Engineering Division (PSED) at Mitsubishi Electric Power Products, Inc. (MEPPI) serves as the company’s engineering and consultancy arm that helps grid operators, utilities, generators, and major energy users plan, design, and solve complex power\-system challenges. Our specialty is delivering tailored services that uncover insights beyond the surface and proactively address technical and commercial risks. Our focus is delivering dependable, low\-friction project outcomes, reducing uncertainty around system reliability, schedule, compliance, complexity, stranded capital, and reputational exposure. MEPPI is seeking a **System Studies Engineer** with a focus on **Electromagnetic Transients (EMT) studies** to join our growing consulting team. This position provides an opportunity to work on technically challenging projects involving substation equipment, transmission and distribution systems, renewable energy integration, energy storage systems, HVDC, FACTS, and inverter\-based resources. The successful candidate will perform advanced simulation studies, develop detailed system models, analyze results, and prepare recommendations for power system owners. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys analytical problem\-solving, simulation\-based engineering, and continuous learning in the evolving power industry. **What You’ll Do:** * Perform power system studies with focus on insulation coordination, circuit breaker ratings, design verification, harmonics, short\-circuit analysis, and grounding. * Develop and validate simulation models using EMTP, PSCAD, ASPEN OneLiner, CAPE, and other industry\-standard tools. * Analyze the performance of transmission systems, substations, renewable generation, BESS, HVDC, FACTS, and other converter\-based resources. * Execute studies from model development through analysis and reporting while maintaining high technical quality and meeting project schedules. * Prepare and present technical reports and recommendations to internal and external customers. * Stay current on industry standards, grid planning practices, interconnection requirements, and emerging power system technologies. * Contribute to technical papers, conference presentations, and industry publications. * Support MEPPI divisions on equipment and application engineering projects. **What You’ll Bring:** * Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in electrical engineering with 0\-2 years of experience through internships and/or co\-op programs with emphasis on electric power engineering, or equivalent education and experience. * Basic knowledge of electric power systems, equipment operation, and control. * Intermediate interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills required to communicate with customers and employees. * Ability to work in a team environment and on multiple projects simultaneously. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to change within a fast\-paced business environment. * Familiarity with the following programs, modeling tools, and scripting languages is a plus: + Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, and related + ATP, EMTP, EMTP\-RV, PSCAD, MATLAB, ASPEN, CAPE, and CDEGS + MATLAB, Java, Python, and others * Intermediate knowledge of industry standards and guides (NESC, NERC, IEEE, IEC, and CIGRE). **What’s in It for You:** * **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** + MEPPI pays up to 90% of the cost for medical, dental, and vision plans. * **Retirement Plans:** + 401(k) match of up to 4%. * **Generous Paid Time Off:** + Earn vacation after just 90 days, plus enjoy 12 paid holidays annually. * **Career Growth:** + Access to professional development programs and educational assistance. * **Employee Perks:** + On\-site fitness center (Warrendale, PA), wellness program, profit sharing, and employee discounts. **Why MEPPI:** As a proud U.S. affiliate of Mitsubishi Electric, MEPPI powers critical infrastructure and rail transportation solutions across North America. We value collaboration, innovation, and people because we know that our greatest asset is our team. Join us and help shape a future where talent and technology thrive. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** MEPPI is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and ensure fair consideration for every candidate. **Notice to Agencies and Search Firms:** We do not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Submissions without signed agreements become the property of MEPPI, and no fees will be paid.

jobs.title: Lead Web Proxy & AI Security Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description: We are seeking an engineer to accelerate enterprise AI adoption by building, integrating, and optimizing secure access to approved AI tools and model endpoints through web security gateways, proxy infrastructure, and AI security controls. This role sits at the intersection of AI platform engineering, network/security architecture, and developer enablement. The engineer will design and operate the technical controls that allow employees and applications to use sanctioned LLMs safely, reliably, and with acceptable performance. This includes secure routing, policy enforcement, DLP integration, model access governance, observability, and latency optimization across secure web gateways, CASB, API gateways, reverse proxies, and related control planes. In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Principal Cyber Security Engineering position at the Vice President level, which is part of the job family responsible for providing specialist cyber expertise and creating solutions that protect the organization's systems and networks against actual and potential security threats and vulnerabilities. Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world. **What you'll do in the role:** * Design and implement secure access patterns for enterprise AI services behind secure web gateways, AI gateways, proxies, and cloud security controls. * Enable access to sanctioned LLMs and AI applications while blocking or restricting unsanctioned services. * Partner with security, infrastructure, legal, risk, and application teams to onboard AI use cases in a controlled manner. * Build traffic\-routing, authentication, and policy\-enforcement mechanisms for user\-to\-AI and app\-to\-AI interactions. * Integrate DLP, data classification, logging, redaction, token filtering, and content inspection into AI traffic flows. * Optimize latency, throughput, reliability, and user experience for AI access paths traversing security gateways. * Develop guardrails for prompt/response inspection, data exfiltration prevention, tenant isolation, and approved use enforcement. * Implement monitoring and alerting for model usage, blocked events, policy violations, response times, error rates, and adoption metrics. * Support evaluation and rollout of technologies such as secure web gateways, CASB, SSE/SASE, AI gateways, API management, and service mesh controls. * Create reusable patterns, reference architectures, and onboarding playbooks for AI application teams. * Perform root\-cause analysis for performance bottlenecks, access failures, and policy conflicts affecting AI use cases. * Contribute to standards for AI access, third\-party model connectivity, secrets management, and auditability.
