jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, MyWave Agentic CoE \| MYWAVE.ai \| Remote** **MyWave.ai \| Partner with us** MyWave is a universal agentic AI platform. MyWave Create generates and deploys secure, governed agents in conversation, drawing on ontology best practice across 27 industries, and runs them across the whole enterprise estate \- SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP Business One and non\-SAP systems of record such as Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce and ServiceNow. We are SAP certified on BTP, work with Joule and extend it, and smooth RISE and GROW with agents that solve the edge cases and complex processes standard SAP doesn't fit. Our customers are global enterprises. Our route to market runs through around 70 SI and SAP partners globally, as well as direct. We have offices in the USA, UK, India, Australia and New Zealand and a growing virtual team across every time zone. **In this position...** **Deploy agents with partners. Transform the nature of work in SAP estates. Teach partners to do it themselves.** The MyWave Agentic Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global team of forward deployed engineers. The CoE works with partners and their end customers to deploy MyWave and the agents it generates, then transfers the skills so the partner can build, govern and run agents on their own. This role reports into the Agentic CoE and is a member of a growing virtual team. You will be based in the central to east coast USA and cover the US and EMEA time zones. Your partners are SAP SIs, GSIs and resellers and their customers running SAP ECC, S/4HANA (on\-premise, private and public cloud) and SAP Business One, together with the third\-party systems around them. Deployments range from RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP programmes to on\-premise estates where the customer wants to modernise with agents now rather than wait for migration. You do not need to arrive as an agentic AI expert. You need to arrive as a strong SAP technical consultant or architect who understands how ECC and S/4HANA work under the hood \- APIs, OData, BAPIs, IDocs, BTP \- and who wants to go deep on MCP, A2A and agent generation. We will train you in AI and MyWave. This is a hands\-on role for someone who would rather sit with a partner and get an agent running on a real system than work behind a ticket queue. **What You'll Own...** **Partner enablement and onboarding** * Own the technical onboarding of new partners in your time zones: get MyWave Runtime and MyWave Desktop stood up in their environment, connected to SAP ECC, S/4HANA or SAP Business One through the MyWave MCP servers, and through to their first successful agent run. * Run the partner\-ready checklist by screen share before enablement starts, so every partner arrives at training with a working environment. * Deliver the technical training modules to partner consultants: environment setup, SAP connection, MCP servers and InfoPlugins, A2A, roles, policies and the Supervisor, troubleshooting. Run the hands\-on labs and answer the questions that go beyond the slides. * Be the first point of contact for partner setup and connection issues in your time zones: diagnose, talk the partner through the fix, and hand anything deeper to the CoE and infrastructure teams with a clear write\-up. **Deployment with partners and their customers** * Work alongside partner delivery teams on customer deployments: landscape discovery, agent generation in MyWave Create, connection to the systems of record, roles and authorisations, policies and rules, Supervisor configuration, operating mode (autonomous, human\-in\-the\-loop or mixed) and go\-live. * Deploy in RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP programmes, in hybrid migrate\-faster scenarios, and in on\-premise ECC and S/4HANA estates. * Connect the surrounding estate \- Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday and similar \- through APIs, MCP and A2A, and reason about how data and authorisations flow between systems. * Stay close through first go\-live and protect the reference. **Technical presales support** * Support the Partner Director, Presales and partner sales teams as the technical authority in the room: discovery of the SAP landscape, architecture and security answers, demonstrations on the customer's own processes, and proofs of value. * Scope pilots with partners: environment options, prerequisites, what the agent reads and writes, where governance sits and a realistic timeline. **CoE contribution** * Build reusable assets for the CoE: reference architectures, deployment runbooks, demo agents, MCP and InfoPlugin patterns and Academy content. * Feed what you learn in the field back to Product and Engineering \- patterns partners hit, gaps in documentation and tooling, defects with enough detail to act on. * Sanity\-check each new MyWave Runtime and Desktop release on a typical SAP partner setup before it goes out. Our Test and Quality Lead owns release testing; you are the field check, not the test gate. * Share US and EMEA patterns with CoE colleagues in the other regions. **What Makes You a Great Fit...** **SAP and integration** * 8\+ years as a technical consultant, solution architect or integration lead on SAP ECC and S/4HANA, with the proven ability to learn a new platform fast and go deep on it. * Hands\-on with SAP integration and extension: REST and OData APIs, BAPIs and RFCs, IDocs, SAP BTP (Integration Suite, SAP Build, CAP), authorisations and how data flows between systems. * Exposure to SAP Business AI, Joule and Joule Studio, or the appetite to learn them quickly. * Understanding of RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP \- the migration paths, what changes for the customer and where the gaps and edge cases sit. * Working knowledge of SAP Business One (Service Layer, Web Client, Web Extensions) is a strong plus. If you do not have it, you will need to show us how you would get there quickly. **Technical plumbing** * Comfortable with the plumbing around it: REST APIs and JSON, OAuth, OIDC and SAML SSO, TLS certificates, Docker, Windows and macOS. You can read a config file, follow a log and know what a port conflict looks like. * Understanding of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) or equivalent tool integration. Hands\-on experience is a plus, not a prerequisite \- we will train you. * Able to reason about governance: roles, authorisations, policy boundaries, audit, and what must stay deterministic when writing to a system of record. **People** * Good interpersonal skills. Warm, confident and patient. You can take a partner consultant from a broken install to a running agent without making them feel stupid, and you can hold your own with an SAP architecture team. * Clear written communication. Your write\-ups need to be good enough that a colleague in another time zone can act on them without a call. * Comfortable working in a virtual, multi\-time\-zone team and flexing your hours to cover EMEA mornings and US afternoons. * Based in the central to east coast USA with the right to work, and able to travel to partner sites and industry events in the US and EMEA. **Bonus Points...** * SAP certifications (S/4HANA, BTP, Integration Suite or architecture). * Hands\-on work with LLM tooling \- Azure OpenAI, agent frameworks, MCP servers, A2A. * Experience inside a large SI's SAP practice or an SAP partner, and an existing network in the SAP ecosystem. * Experience with SAP PartnerEdge and the SAP Store. * Exposure to regulated industries and compliance frameworks (SOX, IFRS, GDPR) and how they constrain automation. * Spanish or another European language. **How to Apply** To apply, please email your CV and a brief note describing the most interesting SAP integration or deployment problem you have solved to careers@mywave.ai. Use the job title as the subject line of your email. If you have a recording of yourself demonstrating software or walking through a technical solution, we would also love to see it. Our team moves quickly. The interview process will include a conversation with our Chief Product Officer, a practical session in which you walk us through a customer landscape and how you would deploy an agent into it, and a meeting with the Agentic CoE team. Pay: $98,600\.00 \- $119,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

Our developers are responsible for software services and deliverables that support the processing of billions of transactions for hundreds of thousands of merchants every year. These applications have to be efficient, reliable, redundant, secure, highly\-available and scalable. A background in the development of accounting or billing systems is preferred for this specific role. AI\-assisted development is core to how we build at NMI. Our engineers work with Claude and Cursor every day, and we expect you to use them fluently: to move faster, to raise quality, and to spend more of your time on the problems that need human judgement. ### **About NMI** NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one\-size\-fits\-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future. ### **How We Work \- Our Core Values** * **Be a Good Person, It's Simple.** We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus * **Align, Trust \& Go.** We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together \- holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum. * **Raise the Bar.** Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain core billing and invoicing systems using C\# and PHP technologies. * Use AI\-assisted development tools, specifically Claude and Cursor, as a core part of your daily engineering workflow across design, implementation, testing, refactoring, and comprehension of large existing codebases. * Remain fully accountable for everything you ship: review AI\-generated code with the same rigor you apply to any other contribution, verifying correctness, security, performance, and maintainability and development processes. * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to proactively identify and resolve issues. * Optimize database queries and system architecture to handle growing merchant and transaction volumes. * Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive payment and merchant data and ensure compliance with PCI DSS standards, including when working with AI development tools. * Communicate project status, risks, and technical decisions effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, and QA teams to ensure successful product releases. * Identify, assess, and mitigate risks, including security risks, throughout the software development lifecycle. * Provide feedback and resolutions to escalated support issues. * Research and evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve system performance and developer productivity. ### **Minimum Requirements:**  timization, and performance tuning. * Strong knowledge of security and compliance best practices (e.g. OWASP, PCI). * Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to mentor others, contribute to a strong team culture, and work with others across teams to move projects forward. * Experience designing and architecting scalable, distributed systems with consideration for performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions. * Proven track record of code reviews and maintaining code quality standards. * Proven ability to jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Start with the data pipeline, range across the full stack, and help take a mature, revenue\-earning platform to the next level, with AI at the center of how you build.*** About Northern Light Northern Light provides the world's most sophisticated machine learning\-powered competitive intelligence platform for market research. For over 25 years, we've been helping Fortune 1000 enterprises make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions through our award\-winning SinglePoint knowledge management platform. Our clients include global leaders across technology, pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, and life sciences who depend on us to transform fragmented data into strategic clarity. We're a company that takes pride in our compulsive drive to provide exceptional client support. We wake up each day ready to tackle the challenges of knowledge management and we never stand still. Our recent innovations include generative AI capabilities, machine learning insights, and advanced competitive intelligence automation. The Product: Search Over Content Nobody Else Has Assembled SinglePoint is an enterprise search and market\-intelligence platform. We license content from a large number of publishers and research vendors, combine it with each customer's own internal documents, normalize all of it, enrich it, index it into per\-customer search databases, and serve it through a customer\-specific portal with search, analytics, NLP enrichment, and AI summarization and Q\&A. Our customers are research and strategy teams at large enterprises. When they can't find something, it costs them a decision. The Opportunity Northern Light is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to start in our content pipeline and grow into ownership across the full platform. The pipeline brings in content from well over a hundred vendor feeds, makes it consistent, and makes it searchable for every customer. From there, the whole platform is open to you: services, search, AI features, and the customer portals. It all works, it earns real revenue, and it's ready for its next chapter. We're looking for someone who sees a 25\-year\-old platform as an opportunity, reaches for AI tools by default, and gets genuinely excited about making something proven dramatically better. What You'll Do * Build and maintain ingestion for new vendor feeds and new customers, from the vendor's delivery quirks through to documents appearing in a customer's search results. * Shape how vendor content is transformed into a consistent, reliable format customers can trust. * Migrate legacy pipelines onto the current stack, including an ongoing Perl\-to\-Python effort and a newer move toward containerized, contract\-bound services. * Help replace convention\-driven job scheduling with explicit, durable workflows. * Track down production content problems and fix them at the root. * Bring AI into the pipeline itself, using ML, NLP, LLMs, and AI tooling to classify, enrich, and validate content, and to speed up how we build and migrate. * Work across the full stack, from back\-end services to the customer portals (PHP and React/TypeScript), following problems and ideas all the way from the vendor to what the customer sees. Who We Hire: AI\-First Builders Who Finish What They Start You can take a task that isn't fully specified, go find the missing context yourself, and drive it until it is running in production, verified against the behavior it replaced, and the thing it replaced is switched off. Not “my part is done.” Done. Transforming a mature system takes creativity and energy as much as rigor. We want someone who brings fresh ideas, shares them freely, and makes the people around them better. What We're Looking For * **A track record of delivering production software.** Things you built that real users depend on, and that you kept running. * **Comfort in code you didn't write.** Much of this estate is older than the people working on it. You can read an unfamiliar system, form an accurate model of it, and change it safely. * **Strong data pipeline instincts.** You build pipelines that are reliable and repeatable, and you can prove a new one matches the old one before you cut over. * **Operational comfort.** Containers, CI/CD, and enough production instinct to know whether your change is actually live. * **An AI\-first way of working.** You use AI coding assistants, LLMs, and agents every day, and you have ideas about where they can make a pipeline smarter. * **Collaborative energy.** Small team, big ambitions. You share ideas freely, write down what you learn, and make the people around you better. * **Judgment about scope.** You know when to fix the root cause and when to ship the narrow thing and record the debt. Languages: No Language Requirement What runs here today is mostly Python, Rust, PHP, and React, plus some long\-lived Perl. New backend work is mostly Python and Rust; the portals are PHP and React. We don't require any of these on your résumé. We hire for judgment, for the ability to pick up whatever the problem happens to be written in, and for finishing. If you have been strong in two or three languages, you'll be fine in ours. One honest note: you will read Perl in this job. You don't have to love it. You do have to be willing. Helps, But Not Required * Building with LLMs, embeddings, or AI agents in production * Web crawling and scraping at scale (Scrapy or equivalent) * Search and information retrieval: indexing, relevance, faceting * Durable workflow engines such as Temporal or Airflow * Rust * Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform * PHP * Working with licensed third\-party data feeds Job Details **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Location:** Hybrid in the Boston, MA area, with regular time at our Somerville office, Eastern Time working hours. **Work authorization requirements:** Must be authorized to work in the United States (unfortunately, we cannot sponsor visas). Why Join Northern Light * Join a company shaping the future of competitive and market intelligence. * Work with a collaborative, high\-performing team that values creativity, experimentation, and measurable results. * Put AI at the center of how you build, with the room to bring new ideas into a platform customers already rely on. * Range across the full stack, from vendor feeds to the customer\-facing portals. * Competitive salary, benefits, and professional growth opportunities. * Regular team offsites and opportunities for cross\-functional collaboration. Working at Northern Light Northern Light is based in the Boston, MA area. Northern Light is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Northern Light SinglePoint, LLC participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I\-9 information to confirm employment eligibility for all new hires. For more information, visit www.e\-verify.gov. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Director - Application Development
jobs.description: **About the Company:** Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross\-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners. Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations. Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. ### **I. The Mission** You will lead a world\-class engineering organization responsible for our core Fintech and Banking portfolios. You aren't just a leader; you are a **technical visionary** who ensures our systems are reliable and fast. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and elite engineering execution, pioneering an **AI\-first development culture (AIDLC)** to set a new industry standard for productivity. As the **Director of Application Development**, you will function as a high\-impact technical executive. This role is designed for a technologist who can manage large\-scale portfolios, lead multi\-disciplinary teams (Front\-end \& Back\-end), and navigate the complexities of the **Fintech and Banking** sectors. You are expected to be a "technologist first"\- a leader who can sit in an architectural review or a deep\-dive debugging session and add immediate value, while simultaneously presenting digital transformation roadmaps for your portfolios. The Director of Application Development will serve as a pivotal leader within the Netspend Product \& Technology organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Leader. This highly visible Senior leadership role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in building and scaling consumer products. The Director of Application Development will shape the long\-term technology vision, drive SaaS\-first engineering excellence, and ensure our product's solutions remain the industry benchmark for innovation, reliability, and customer value. This leader will inspire high\-performing global teams and foster strong cross\-functional partnerships. **II. The Core Mandate** ------------------------ **1\. Strategic Technical Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * **The Bridge:** Act as the primary interface between business units and engineering. You will translate high\-level commercial objectives into executable technical strategies. * **Portfolio Oversight:** Manage a comprehensive portfolio of applications, ensuring that cross\-functional teams are aligned, unblocked, and delivering high\-value features. * **Agile Transformation:** Lead the evolution of the engineering org into a high\-performing, fast\-paced Agile environment, optimizing for both speed\-to\-market and system stability. **2\. Technical Depth \& Innovation (AIDLC)** * **Hands\-on Guidance:** While not required to write daily production code, you must possess the technical depth of a former Solution Architect or Dev Lead. You will guide teams through complex technical hurdles and ensure code quality standards. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering:** A core focus will be the AIDLC (AI\-driven Development Life Cycle). You will be expected to implement AI tools and frameworks to drastically enhance team productivity and developer experience. * **Cloud Strategy:** Direct the architecture and migration initiatives within the AWS ecosystem, ensuring cost\-efficiency, scalability, and security. * **Move Fast with Stability:** Transition teams into high\-performing, autonomous units that ship code daily without compromising the integrity of financial transactions. * **Metric\-Driven Results:** Define and track KPIs that correlate engineering output with actual business revenue and user engagement. **3\. Organizational Mentorship** * **Leader of Leaders:** Provide direct mentorship and career development for Senior Managers and Associate Directors. * **Culture of Excellence:** Foster an environment of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical curiosity. * **Bottom\-Up Leadership**: Empower Senior Managers and Associate Directors to take extreme ownership. Foster a culture where the best ideas win, regardless of hierarchy. **III. Educational \& Foundation (Mandatory)** ---------------------------------------------- * **Academic Excellence:** **B.Tech** **/ B.E.** from a reputed, top\-tier institute or a **Master of Computer Applications (MCA)**. **IV. Experience \& Skills** ---------------------------- * **Years of Experience:** **12\+ years** in Software Development with a progressive track record of leadership. * **Domain Expertise:** Deep experience in **Fintech and Banking** (High\-volume transactions, security protocols, regulatory compliance). * **Full\-Stack Vision:** Proven experience leading both **Front\-end and Back\-end** initiatives simultaneously. * **Technical Stack:** Strong foundational knowledge in modern microservices, distributed systems, and **AWS Migration**. * **Communication:** Elite communication skills; able to influence senior business stakeholders and inspire junior engineers. **High\-Weightage Qualifications** ---------------------------------- * Demonstrated success in using **AI to enhance team efficiency** (e.g., LLM\-integrated workflows, automated code synthesis, or AI\-driven testing). * Experience transitioning legacy banking systems into modern, cloud\-native architectures. * A "Consultative Mindset": The ability to analyze problems from a first\-principles perspective and drive data\-backed decisions. **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** ------------------------------------- * **Operational Efficiency:** 30% improvement in development velocity via AIDLC tools. * **System Reliability:** Maintaining 99\.99% uptime for critical banking portfolios. * **Talent Retention:** Reducing attrition among high\-potential Senior Managers and Directors. * **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** High NPS from business partners on the "transparency and predictability" of the delivery pipeline. **V. Why This Role?** --------------------- This is a rare opportunity to build an engineering org within the high\-stakes world of Finance. You will have the budget of a Tier\-1 firm and the autonomy to rewrite the rules of how software is built using AI.

jobs.description: **About the Company:** Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically\-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking a hands\-on **Staff Software Engineer** to take ownership of our core card **authorization platform.** This high\-throughput, low\-latency platform processes real\-time debit and prepaid transactions over **ISO 8583** for major networks including Visa, Mastercard, Pulse, and Fiserv. Because every request operates under strict latency budgets, high availability, and PCI DSS compliance, every millisecond counts—and every failure carries direct financial impact. In this role, you will lead a team of talented engineers, drive the architectural evolution of our network connectivity and authorization services, and continue to write production\-grade code. You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for platform upgrades, network certifications, and production incident management. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Technical Leadership \& Team Management** ------------------------------------------- * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 5–8 software engineers. * Set coding standards, conduct architectural design reviews, perform code reviews, and foster technical excellence. * Serve as the technical owner and primary point of contact for production health, network certifications, and platform upgrades. **Core Architecture \& Engineering** ------------------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain high\-throughput, low\-latency Java/Spring Boot microservices covering authorizations, financial transactions, advices, reversals, and stand\-in processing. * Manage long\-lived client/server TCP connections to card networks, ensuring robust handling of sign\-on/sign\-off, echo tests, request/response matching, and automatic failovers. * Architect distributed transaction boundaries ensuring data consistency across Oracle, Kafka, JMS, and downstream services through idempotency, compensation/saga patterns, and reversal handling. * Implement resilient concurrency models: tune thread pools and executors, control backpressure, execute row\-level/distributed locking, and eliminate race conditions on balances and card states. * Build fault\-tolerant systems using resilience patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, time limiters, retries, and graceful degradation). **Platform Modernization \& Security** -------------------------------------- * Drive platform modernization initiatives, including Spring Boot 2\.7 3\.5 / Jakarta EE migration, removing legacy RMI/JMX remoting, and containerizing microservices for Kubernetes deployment. * Collaborate with Security and HSM teams to integrate EMV cryptogram processing (ARQC), CVV/dCVV/CVC3 validation, and HSM key management. * Maintain strict PCI DSS compliance across all services (PAN masking, sensitive authentication data protection, secure logging, and secrets management). **Operations \& Stakeholder Engagement** ---------------------------------------- * Define SLIs/SLOs and create comprehensive dashboards and alerts using Dynatrace and Splunk. * Lead incident response efforts, drive root\-cause analysis (RCA), and implement permanent remediations. * Partner with Product, Network/Scheme partners, QA, and Operations to navigate card network mandates, network certifications, and release schedules. **Requirements \& Qualifications** ---------------------------------- **Must\-Have Skills \& Experience** ----------------------------------- * **Experience \& Leadership:** 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years leading engineering teams or driving technical architecture. * **Core Java Mastery:** Expert\-level proficiency in Java (11/17\+), deep understanding of java.util.concurrent, JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and memory analysis. * **Spring Framework:** Extensively hands\-on with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud microservices (Config, OpenFeign, Actuator, Security). * **Distributed Transactions \& Systems:** Proven expertise in transaction management trade\-offs (2PC/XA vs. Saga pattern, outbox pattern, idempotent consumers/producers, and delivery semantics). * **Database \& RDBMS:** Deep relational database skills (Oracle preferred), including JDBC transaction isolation, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, deadlock analysis, and SQL query tuning. * **Messaging \& Event Streaming:** Real\-world experience with event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (Avro, Schema Registry) and/or JMS (ActiveMQ). * **System Resilience:** Hands\-on experience implementing resilience frameworks (Resilience4j or similar) for high\-availability systems running thousands of TPS. * **DevOps \& Quality:** Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/Jenkins), Gradle, static code/security analysis (SonarQube, SAST, Trivy), and test automation frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito). * **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical trade\-offs for engineers, product leads, and executive leadership. **Good\-to\-Have Skills** ------------------------- * **jPOS Framework:** Experience with **ISOMsg,** custom packagers, channels (PostChannel, BaseChannel), **ISOMUX/QMUX, ISOServer,** and Q2 configuration. * **ISO 8583 Specifications:** Hands\-on experience with Visa Base I, Mastercard MIP/Debit, Pulse, or Fiserv STAR/Accel specifications (messages 0100/0110, 0200/0210, 0400/0420, 0800 network management, DE55 EMV TLV data). * **Observability Tools:** Advanced usage of Dynatrace (PurePath, Smartscape, DQL) and Splunk (SPL query generation, alerting, dashboards). * **Advanced Concurrency:** In\-depth familiarity with ReentrantLock, StampedLock, distributed locks (ShedLock, Redisson), Java 21 Virtual Threads, and Micrometer metrics integration. * **Card Payments Domain:** Understanding of EMV chip/contactless flows, stand\-in processing, settlement, chargebacks, HSM integration (Atalla, Thales payShield), and key management (KEK, ZPK, key blocks). * **Infrastructure \& Rules:** Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (MSK, IAM), and business rules engines (Drools, Jess). **Education** ------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience). * Direct experience in the Payments, Fintech, or Banking domain is strongly preferred. * **10–15 years** of professional experience in designing, coding, developing, and scaling high\-throughput, enterprise\-grade Java/J2EE applications. * **3\+ years** of hands\-on experience in a technical lead or architectural capacity—driving system design, leading 5–8 engineers, and setting coding/quality standards. * **Proven track record** of architecting low\-latency, mission\-critical distributed systems operating under strict SLAs and high concurrency.

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer, Signal-Path Performance & Modeling
jobs.description: **About Neurophos** =================== The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach. Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large\-scale AI inference. We’ve assembled a world\-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others. Join us and shape the future of computing! **Location:** Austin, TX. Full\-time onsite position. **Reports To:** Chief Systems Engineer **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Position Overview** --------------------- We are seeking a highly skilled Systems Engineer to own the quantitative, end\-to\-end performance model of our optical vector\-matrix multiplication (OVMM) engine. This role is the technical center of Systems Engineering's performance\-modeling focus area: you will lead the end\-to\-end modeling, analysis, and architectural definition of high\-speed communication and signal\-processing systems. In this role, you will build and maintain the link and power budgets; quantify impairments and non\-idealities across the optical, analog, and digital domains; develop mathematical and behavioral models; define the hardware and algorithmic techniques required to meet aggressive system\-level performance targets; and determine how accuracy, throughput, and power trade against one another as the architecture evolves. You will spend most of your time running system\-level simulations and translating them into defensible allocations the rest of the organization can design against. If you have deep communication\-theory and signal\-processing intuition, are fluent in turning a signal chain into a quantitative model, and want to be the person who can answer "where does the system actually lose its margin," this role will let you define the performance envelope of a first\-of\-its\-kind computing platform. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Primary Responsibilities** * **Signal\-Path Architecture Ownership:** Own and define the architecture of the high\-speed communication and signal\-processing system that converts the digital data stream into an optical signal and back—spanning digital signal processing, D/A and A/D conversion, and the analog/optical signal conditioning surrounding them on both the transmit and receive sides. Define the blocks and processing stages that comprise this system and specify the requirements for each. Negotiate block\-level requirements with the photonic and mixed\-signal implementation teams who build to this architecture. * **Link \& Power Budget Ownership:** Own and maintain the end\-to\-end optical and electrical link/power budget for this signal path, keeping it synchronized with the as\-designed and as\-measured hardware as the architecture evolves. * **Signal\-Path Modeling:** Build and maintain the reference behavioral model of the full TX–channel–RX signal path, capturing optical, analog, quantization, and algorithmic effects with the fidelity needed for architecture decisions and requirements allocation. * **Accuracy \& Performance Allocation:** Allocate NMSE/SNR/SNDR targets across optics, analog, quantization, and algorithmic domains, and update those allocations as component and architecture choices change. * **Impairment Analysis:** Characterize and model optical, analog, and digital impairments—noise, distortion, jitter, quantization effects, crosstalk, mismatch, and nonlinearity—and quantify their impact on system\-level accuracy. * **Throughput \& Efficiency Trade Studies:** Analyze the impact of TX/RX channel configurations and architectural options on TOPS, TOPS/W, and latency. Balance the complexity, risk, and time\-to\-market of proposed architectural solutions. * **Monte Carlo \& Time\-Domain Simulation:** Develop and run statistical (Monte Carlo, corner) and time\-domain simulations to quantify design margin and manufacturing robustness. * **Model\-to\-Measurement Correlation:** Correlate model predictions with laboratory and silicon measurements; when measured performance does not match simulation, isolate the source of the discrepancy and refine the architecture, model, and allocations accordingly. **Secondary Responsibilities** * Represent this system's architecture in roadmap and planning discussions. * Supply quantitative performance data, both predicted and measured, to support other efforts across Neurophos (e.g., customer\-facing technical discussions). * Support calibration accuracy\-budget definition with sensitivity analysis. * Collaborate with analog, photonic, digital, and software engineers to keep subsystem designs consistent with the architecture and its performance targets. * Mentor engineers in system modeling, communication theory, and architecture/trade\-study methodology. * Contribute to intellectual property creation, including invention disclosures and patents. **Qualifications** ------------------ * **Degree:** MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or a closely related field, with emphasis on communication theory, signal processing, or mixed\-signal systems. * **Experience:** 7\+ years of professional experience in communication systems architecture, link\-budget/signal\-chain modeling, or performance modeling of optical or high\-speed electrical communication systems. Demonstrated ownership of system architecture definition is highly preferred. Time spent pursuing a PhD beyond the MS counts toward the years of experience above. * **Communication Theory \& Signal Processing:** Deep knowledge of modulation formats, equalization, synchronization and estimation, quantization effects, and coding\-gain concepts, and how each factors into an end\-to\-end performance budget. * **System Modeling:** Expert\-level proficiency in Python (NumPy/SciPy) and/or MATLAB/Simulink for behavioral modeling, Monte Carlo simulation, and statistical/time\-domain analysis. * **Link Budget \& Noise Analysis:** Experience with optical or high\-speed electrical link budgets, including the ability to allocate impairments across components and predict the system\-level impact. * **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication, with the credibility to negotiate requirements with implementation teams and to defend an architectural position to technical leadership. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Experience with coherent or direct\-detection architectures, or high\-speed SerDes/networking standards (Ethernet, PCIe, OIF\-CEI). * System\-level modeling of high\-speed data converters (ADC/DAC), including quantization, sampling, and multi\-device synchronization effects. * Familiarity with Cadence Virtuoso and Spectre sufficient to validate behavioral models against circuit\-level simulation. * Hands\-on laboratory characterization or silicon/system bring\-up experience. * Familiarity with photonic integrated circuits, silicon photonics, or optical transceiver systems. * Experience carrying a signal\-path architecture across multiple product generations. **What We Offer** ================= This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in an innovative startup redefining the future of AI hardware. Work on game\-changing technology at the intersection of photonics and AI as part of a collaborative, brilliant team. You’ll contribute to a platform that redefines computational performance and accelerates the future of artificial intelligence. Come help us bring this transformative technology to the world. **Benefits** ------------ Join a team that invests in your future and your well\-being. At Neurophos, we offer: * 100% coverage of base health plan premiums for you and your dependents, plus HSA contributions. * Unlimited PTO. No rigid vacation banks, just a focus on delivery. * 401(k) matching and stock option opportunities to ensure our success is your success. * Full suite of voluntary benefits, including Dental, Vision, Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance. * Personalized Benefits. Choose the plans that fit your life and take the cash back for those that don’t. Compensation Range: $245K \- $285K

AI\-assisted engineering is a core competency and is used throughout the software development lifecycle. jobs.title: Manager, Foundation Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Nextpower is the leading provider of intelligent, integrated solar tracker and software solutions used in utility\-scale and ground\-mounted distributed generation solar projects around the world. Contribute to the growth of Nextpower’s Design Services team by supporting process improvement and team development efforts. * **Required Skills/ Expertise** * Bachelor’s degree in Structural or Civil Engineering (or equivalent). * Minimum 8 years of experience in structural engineering, ideally within the EPC solar industry. * Hands\-on experience in Structural analysis and design, including dead, live, snow, wind, and seismic loads, design of steel and concrete structures, and development of construction documents. * Advanced proficiency in Structural and Geotechnical analysis software (Risa 3D, Staad \& Lpile). * Experience in static and dynamic structural analysis of solar tracker structures * Experience with single foundation design and A\-frame type of foundations * Experience with Earth Truss foundations system and preparing complete foundation package. * Strong knowledge of engineering standards, codes, and other applicable state and federal guidelines, including but not limited to IBC, ASCE, ASTM, AISC, AISI and ACI. * Professional Engineering (PE) license in multiple states * Experience in Software Development, Machine Learning, and/or Artificial Intelligence preferred. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve design challenges. * Team\-oriented and self\-driven professional with excellent communication and collaboration skills. accountability. * Timely completion of design and permitting requirements to support network construction schedules. * Stronger collaboration between design, field engineering, construction, network engineering, and operations. * Established workflows, standards, and repeatable processes that support long\-term network growth. **Job Classification:** * Engineering * Exempt **Work construction sites, uneven terrain, and other hazards associated with fiber infrastructure projects. * The noise level may vary depending on the work environment. **Physical Demands:** * Ability to jobs.title: Director of Applied AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Director of Applied AI Engineering** -------------------------------------- **North \- Remote (US)** ------------------------ *Let’s go North, together.* Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. From credit card processing to back\-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions. **Job Summary:** ---------------- The Director of Applied AI Engineering will build and lead North's Applied AI team: a hands\-on group that takes AI capabilities from prototype to production inside real business workflows. evals, benchmark datasets, human\-in\-the\-loop validation, and production readiness criteria. * Manage production operations alongside Cloud and Data engineering, overseeing CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, latency, and inference cost optimization. **What We Need From You:** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent deployed, solutions, or professional services engineering) * 2\+ years building and shipping production systems on top of large language models (LLMs), including at least one agentic or conversational in code\-level AI SDKs and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AWS Strands Agents), selecting optimal tools rather than relying on no\-code builders. * Knowledge of core building blocks of production AI applications: tool/function calling, RAG, vector search, structured outputs, conversation and state management, and the judgment to favor deterministic workflows when appropriate. * Cloud engineering skills (preferably AWS), including deploying agents on managed services (e.g., Bedrock AgentCore), containers, IAM, networking, and cost optimization. * Track record deploying and maintaining production AI systems, driving robust CI/CD, tracing, incident response, and latency/cost controls. * Experience making evaluation part of the build cycle, including test sets, regression design) aligned with financial regulations (Model Risk Management, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA). **What we offer:** ------------------ We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a *life well lived,* both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include: * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Coverage * Flexible Paid Time Off * 401(k) \+ Match * Mental Health Support \& Well\-Being Program * Paid Maternity \& Paternity Leave * Education Assistance * Company\-funded Lifestyle Spending Account **Salary Range:** **$207,000\-290,000 USD** ------------------------------------------- *Pay within this range varies by work location and on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Manufacturing Engineer** **Why Join Oilgear** At Oilgear, we design and manufacture high\-performance hydraulic systems that power some of the world’s most demanding industrial applications. Our employees play a critical role in our success, and we are committed to providing a safe, collaborative, and growth\-oriented environment. At Oilgear, you’ll work with advanced technology, contribute to meaningful products, and be part of a team that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. **Summary** The Manufacturing Engineer is primarily responsible for improving and supporting manufacturing processes, equipment, tooling, work methods, and production performance for Oilgear hydraulic products. Approximately 80% of the role is focused on manufacturing engineering, including process improvement, production support, tooling and fixture development, manufacturing documentation, cost reduction, quality improvement, and new product or process implementation. Approximately 20% of the role supports product design and engineering activities, including CAD updates, design\-for\-manufacturability reviews, engineering changes, and product improvement. The position works closely with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, and shop\-floor personnel to develop practical, safe, repeatable, and cost\-effective manufacturing solutions. **Essential Responsibilities and Duties** **Manufacturing Engineering \& Production Support \- Primary Focus** * Provide hands\-on engineering support to production personnel to resolve manufacturing and assembly issues involving processes, drawings, tolerances, materials, tooling, fixtures, equipment, and product performance. * Develop, improve, and standardize manufacturing methods, work sequences, routings, bills of operations, work instructions, and process documentation within applicable ERP/MRP systems. * Evaluate manufacturing processes and identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, productivity, repeatability, lead time, material flow, labor utilization, and cost. * Design, develop, specify, and implement tooling, fixtures, gauges, workholding, and other manufacturing aids that improve production efficiency and product quality. * Support machining and assembly operations by evaluating equipment capabilities, cutting tools, workholding, process parameters, CNC\-related manufacturing needs, and production methods. * Analyze production problems and lead structured root cause and corrective action activities using methods such as 5 Why and 8D. * Partner with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and production employees to implement sustainable corrective actions and prevent recurrence of manufacturing issues. * Support plant layout, equipment placement, work\-cell design, material flow, and utilization of manufacturing space. * Evaluate and recommend new equipment, manufacturing technology, tooling, and process changes; assist with technical justification, implementation, validation, and training. * Develop manufacturing estimates, process requirements, and production methods for new or revised components using existing Fremont capabilities whenever practical. * Support supplier and process qualification activities related to manufactured components, tooling, equipment, and production processes. * Maintain accurate manufacturing documentation and ensure process changes are effectively communicated and implemented on the shop floor. **Continuous Improvement, Cost \& Quality** * Lead or support continuous improvement and cost\-reduction projects focused on manufacturing efficiency, scrap, rework, cycle time, throughput, tooling, material usage, and labor utilization. * Use production data, quality information, observations, and employee feedback to identify manufacturing constraints and improvement opportunities. * Support quality and safety requirements by ensuring manufacturing methods, tooling, equipment, and documentation meet applicable company and regulatory standards. * Participate in cross\-functional problem solving related to nonconforming product, recurring manufacturing issues, warranty concerns, and process capability. * Promote Lean manufacturing principles and practical shop\-floor improvements that support safe, efficient, and repeatable production. **New Product Introduction \& Manufacturing Readiness** * Represent Manufacturing Engineering during new product introductions, product transfers, and significant engineering changes to ensure manufacturing requirements are considered before production release. * Review new and revised products for manufacturability, assembly, tooling, equipment, inspection, process capability, and production readiness. * Coordinate prototype, pilot, and first\-build activities from a manufacturing perspective; identify production issues and drive corrective follow\-through before full release. * Develop or update manufacturing processes, tooling, routings, work instructions, and training requirements need . * Communicate project status, manufacturing concerns, technical recommendations, and implementation plans to appropriate stakeholders. * Work closely with vendors, suppliers, internal engineering resources, and other Oilgear locations as needed to support manufacturing projects and product transitions. * Stay current with manufacturing technologies, machining and assembly practices, tooling, Lean methods, and engineering practices applicable to Oilgear operations. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a closely related engineering field. * Experience in a manufacturing environment through professional employment, internship, co\-op, or other applied engineering experience. * Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, machining and/or assembly operations, tooling, fixtures, process documentation, and production problem solving. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, specifications, tolerances, and 3D models. * Experience or demonstrated proficiency with 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks or Inventor. * Ability to work effectively with shop\-floor personnel and translate engineering requirements into practical manufacturing solutions. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, organization, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Two or more years of manufacturing engineering experience in an industrial equipment, precision machining, hydraulic, or similar manufacturing environment. * Experience with CNC machining, cutting tools, workholding, fixture design, assembly processes, or manufacturing equipment. * Experience with Lean manufacturing, process improvement, cost reduction, time studies, work measurement, or production flow. * Experience supporting new product introduction, manufacturing transfers, process validation, or first\-build activities. * Experience with hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, fluid power systems, or similar engineered products. * Experience using ERP/MRP, PLM, or engineering document\-control systems. **What We Offer** * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid holidays * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options * Employer\-paid life and disability insurance * Optional hospital, critical illness, and accident insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Safety shoe reimbursement program * Safety glasses reimbursement program * Tuition assistance up to $5,000 per year **Scope and Flexibility Statement** This job description outlines the general duties and requirements of the position and is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Responsibilities may change or be added based on business needs. **Equal Employment Opportunity and Accommodation Statement** The Oilgear Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Applicants or employees requiring accommodation may contact Human Resources. **Employment Status Statement** Employment with The Oilgear Company is at\-will. This means that either the employee or The Oilgear Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. Nothing in this job description or any other Company document should be interpreted as a contract of employment, an offer of continued employment, or a guarantee of employment for any specific duration.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Olive Systems partners with fast\-growing AI and technology companies across the United States to help them build and scale their engineering teams. We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real\-world technical solutions. Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies. Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies. **This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.** **What You’ll Do** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements. Your responsibilities may include: * Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions. * Designing, developing, and deploying production\-ready applications and systems. * Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products. * Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies. * Making architectural and technical decisions independently. * Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams. * Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities. * Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment. **Who We’re Looking For** We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. You might currently be a: * Forward Deployed Engineer * Senior / Staff Full\-Stack Engineer * Founding Engineer or Technical Founder * AI / Applied AI Engineer * Solutions Architect with hands\-on development experience * Senior Software Engineer with end\-to\-end product ownership **What matters most:** * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience. * Proven track record of building and shipping production systems. * Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish. * Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade\-offs. * Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Background in early\-stage startups or fast\-paced product environments. * Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations. **Our Hiring Process** **1\. Initial Technical Evaluation** We’ll invite you to a short AI\-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience. We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems. No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions. **2\. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities** When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps. Depending on the company, additional technical interviews or assessments may be required. **Location \& Work Setup** We work with technology companies hiring across the **United States**. Opportunities may be fully remote, hybrid, or onsite, depending on the company. Specific location, compensation, employment arrangements, and work authorization or sponsorship requirements vary by opportunity. **Why Join Our Network?** Instead of applying to multiple companies individually, you can complete our initial evaluation once and be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available. Our goal is to connect experienced engineers with companies where their technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and career ambitions are a strong match. **Interested?** Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. If your experience aligns with what our partner companies are looking for, we’ll contact you with the next steps. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Detection & Discovery
jobs.description: ### **Strength in Trust** OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down—it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. ### **The Challenge** Enterprises need dependable visibility into both the data they hold and the AI they use. OneTrust's Detection \& Discovery team owns and actively maintains Data Discovery and Data Catalog capabilities while expanding discovery of AI models, agents, and related cloud resources. Customers rely on these systems to find, understand, and govern assets across complex environments. This role is intentionally balanced between strengthening the Data Discovery and Data Catalog pipeline and advancing AI Detection \& Discovery. You will provide hands\-on technical leadership across both: sustaining and improving mature production capabilities while building the next generation of AI discovery. ### **Your Mission** ### **Data Discovery \& Data Catalog** * Own the technical evolution and ongoing maintenance of Data Discovery and Data Catalog services and modules, including production support for capabilities customers depend on. * Lead a major engineering\-quality initiative to reduce technical debt, address critical issues, and modernize the code and architecture without compromising customer stability. * Improve the stability, reliability, performance, and operability of the end\-to\-end discovery and catalog pipeline, from scanning and ingestion through cataloging and downstream use. * Identify and deliver practical opportunities to apply AI across discovery and catalog workflows, improving automation and customer value where it makes sense. ### **AI Detection \& Cloud Discovery** * Design and build Java services, APIs, and reusable connectors that discover AI models, agents, and related resources across cloud and AI platforms. * Translate provider APIs, identity models, and resource structures into secure, consistent discovery contracts and normalized inventory data. * Advance continuous, scheduled, and incremental discovery so changes to discovered assets are reflected accurately and promptly. * Enable secure discovery across customer accounts, projects, subscriptions, and regions, and partner with AI Governance teams on asset and lifecycle integrations. ### **Production Support \& Reliability** * Participate in customer\-facing production\-support calls for Data Discovery and AI Governance, including issues involving customer\-managed or on\-premises components. * Troubleshoot complex issues across Java services, Linux environments, Kubernetes deployments, cloud integrations, and network connectivity; partner with Support, Operations, and engineering teams to mitigate customer impact. * Drive incidents from investigation through root cause and durable corrective action, using findings to improve product stability, supportability, and documentation. ### **Technical Leadership** * Set architecture and lead multi\-quarter initiatives from design through production adoption; make pragmatic build\-versus\-reuse decisions. * Establish a high bar for code quality, design reviews, automated testing, and production readiness. * Improve observability and operational maturity; use incident patterns and operational metrics to drive systemic improvements. * Collaborate with Product, UX, Security, Platform, and customer\-facing teams; mentor engineers and influence practices beyond your immediate projects. ### **You Are** A hands\-on technical leader who can balance investment in new capabilities with stewardship of mature, business\-critical software. You bring sound judgment to complex systems, work comfortably across architecture and implementation, and help teams deliver improvements without losing sight of reliability and customer impact. ### **Your Experience Includes** * 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on development in Java and the Spring ecosystem. * A track record of designing and delivering distributed, cloud\-native services and APIs used in production at enterprise scale. * Experience owning and evolving production software, including technical\-debt reduction, critical issue resolution, and improvements to stability and reliability. * Hands\-on experience debugging production services in Linux   AI Foundry, or Vertex AI. * Experience with Java workflow orchestration frameworks such as Temporal, connector frameworks, or developer automation. * Experience with Kafka or other messaging technologies, CI/CD, and production operations for cloud\-native services. * Familiarity with AI governance, security, privacy, compliance, or other regulated enterprise domains. ### **Where we Work** We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. ### **Benefits** As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers. ### **Resources** Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: * OneTrust Careers on YouTube * @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram ### **Your Data** You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview**.** You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com. ### **Our Commitment to You** When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

jobs.title: Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description:** Open Energy Solutions Inc. (OES) is an early\-stage services and software development company that is enabling utilities and utility vendors to enhance power system operations through the development and implementation of distributed intelligence and enabling technologies. OES is modernizing the electric grid through real‑time simulation, advanced distribution modeling, and cutting‑edge DER integration. **Role Description:** OES is seeking a Power Systems Engineer to bring technical skills and utility\-industry expertise to operational technology projects. OES’ primary functions are around technology solution development and utility consulting services, and this individual will play an instrumental role on a multidisciplinary team of IT/communications specialists, developers, electricians, and project managers, providing technical expertise and industry acumen. This role sits at the intersection of research and practical field application, offering a rare opportunity to be a valuable contributor in cutting\-edge power systems work deployed in real utility environments. In the role, the candidate is expected to wear several hats: technical solution designer, client subject matter advisor, power systems analyst, and modeling/simulation engineer. This is a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, so the individual must be responsive, creative, and able to manage priorities across multiple projects. **Responsibilities:** * Support power systems engineering operations, including distribution feeder modeling, equipment wiring, and fault analysis * Develop, configure, and parameterize simulation models representing distribution feeders including microgrids and DER inverters * Perform power system transient studies and detailed equipment modeling using industry\-standard software tools * Provide technical support for hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) simulations, applying power systems engineering fundamentals * Apply IEEE 1547 (Standard for Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources with Associated Electric Power Systems Interfaces) requirements to DER interconnection studies and testing * Support operation of medium voltage devices including reclosers (one and three phase), voltage/current sensors and capacitor banks with voltage zero\-crossing switching * Perform distribution capacity planning, system design, and peak demand forecasting * Clearly communicate results to internal stakeholders and clients by preparing detailed written reports/presentations describing analyses performed and proposed solutions developed * Apply power systems expertise to design, develop, and test solutions from proof of concept through production **Qualifications:** * BS in Electrical Engineering with 2\-4 years of relevant experience or a MS or PhD in electrical engineering with an emphasis on power systems.
