jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com. **About the Role** ------------------ Community Intelligence is a new engineering team at OpenGov, based in our Boston office, chartered with bringing next\-generation physical\-world sensing and AI\-based detection into our Community Operations suite. Rather than treating sensing as an external add\-on, this team builds the pipeline and integration layer that make it a native, foundational capability across our products. As a founding Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that turn raw sensor data into structured records, condition assessments, and automated workflows across multiple products. You will make real technical calls with incomplete information, evaluating emerging sensing technologies, reconciling third\-party data against our own systems, and sequencing a rollout across a multi\-product suite. You will also set patterns the rest of the team builds on. AI\-native tooling is expected to be embedded in your workflow. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * Design and build the sensing\-platform connector/adapter layer that maps LiDAR\- and imagery\-derived asset detections into OpenGov Products * Architect the automated detection\-to\-case pipeline that turns a sensing detection into a properly routed record in the right product's workflow engine, complete with photo evidence, GPS coordinates, and a severity score. * Evaluate, integrate, or build the computer\-vision and LiDAR\-fusion models this requires, including the technical path for consolidating with or extending EAM's existing Vision AI microservice (rd\-capture). * Design the data model and storage layer for a continuously updated spatial data that all five Community Operations products read from and contribute to. * Own the technical design for a tiered sensing\-ingestion model (satellite, fleet\-vehicle camera, full LiDAR survey) supporting different refresh cadences, accuracy levels, and price points. * Partner with engineering and product leads across OpenGov products to sequence the sensing layer's roadmap against each product's asset taxonomy and compliance requirements. * Write clear technical design docs that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit. * Establish testing, monitoring, and data\-quality standards appropriate to a system whose outputs feed regulatory and safety\-relevant workflows, including ADA compliance and FEMA reimbursement documentation. **Qualifications \& Preferred Experience** ------------------------------------------ * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross\-system integrations end\-to\-end in a production SaaS environment. * Experience building or integrating computer\-vision, LiDAR, or geospatial data\-processing pipelines; comfort with point\-cloud or 3D spatial data is a strong plus. * Strong data\-modeling and API/connector design skills, able to reconcile a third party's data schema against multiple existing internal data models without resorting to one\-off custom logic. * Experience with geospatial systems (PostGIS, spatial indexing, coordinate reference systems) preferred. * Comfortable operating with incomplete information and ambiguous vendor integration paths; makes and defends build\-vs\-integrate calls. * Experience partnering across multiple product teams and translating a strategic technical vision into a scoped, sequenced delivery plan. * A track record of shipping systems where data accuracy carries real compliance or safety consequences (regulatory, infrastructure, or public\-sector systems) is a strong plus. * Proficient in AI\-native engineering workflows: can direct AI tooling for scaffolding, test generation, and code review while retaining ownership of architecture and correctness. * Excellent written communication; can produce technical design docs that align stakeholders across five product teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **How This Level Is Differentiated** ------------------------------------ The following competency behaviors distinguish this level from adjacent ones: * Owns a technical domain end\-to\-end with full accountability for outcomes, from architecture through production operation. * Operates with strategic awareness across multiple downstream product teams; makes strong technical calls with incomplete vendor and data information. * Sets technical direction and milestones for the sensing\-integration roadmap; influences cross\-functional partners without formal authority. * Establishes patterns, like the connector/adapter approach, that other engineers and products reuse, elevating the work of the broader team. * Expected to embed AI\-native tooling in their own workflow and model its effective use for teammates joining the team. **Why OpenGov?** ================ **A Mission That Matters.** At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. **Opportunity to Innovate** The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. **A Team of Passionate, Driven People** This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. **A Place to Make Your Mark** We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. **Benefits That Work for You** Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: * Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions * Professional development and growth opportunities * A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches. Compensation Range: $205K \- $227K

jobs.title: AI Solutions Developer
jobs.description: **AI Solutions Developer** ========================== Full\-time · Remote (US) P3 Adaptive is an AI and data consultancy built on Microsoft technologies: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft 365, and Azure. We're hiring a software engineer to build AI applications across client engagements, our own products, and reusable tools for our consultants. In this role, you'll partner with clients and the consultants who know their data, work through the problem together, and build the software that solves it, whether that's an agent that answers questions about company data or an app that takes a repetitive task off someone's plate. **Why this job is different** ============================= **You'll know why you're building it.** Every project starts with a client problem we think we can solve or a tool our own team needs. Each solution is built for that client's situation. If it stops making sense, we change course. **We're honest with clients.** We don't sell anyone the wrong thing. Ever. When something isn't a good fit, we say so. **Direct client contact.** You'll be on the call with clients from the first conversation through go\-live. Nobody in between translating requirements. Real conversations with real people about real problems. **AI is how we work.** You'll use coding agents like Claude Code and Codex every day. They'll write a lot of the code. You pick the right tool for the job, decide what gets built, check that it works, and own what ships. **Remote, with a life.** We're fully remote in the US and overlap for a few core hours on weekdays. Working faster doesn't mean working more. We mean it about having a life outside work. **What you'll actually do** --------------------------- **The consulting work:** * Leading client conversations to understand the business problem behind the request, then translating it into what to build. * Keeping projects on track: raising risks early, keeping each milestone demonstrable, and flagging scope changes the moment you see them. * Training client teams so they can own and run what you build. * Spotting the next problem worth solving for a client and bringing it to your account team. * Demonstrating solutions to colleagues and clients. You'll explain how they work, answer questions about their limitations, and discuss what's needed to put them into use. **The engineering work:** * Building and maintaining AI applications and agents, taking features from a prototype through testing and deployment. * Connecting applications to Power BI semantic models, Fabric data, and other business systems through APIs, with appropriate sign\-in and access permissions. * Investigating bugs and performance problems, checking AI responses against the underlying data, and improving application reliability. * Creating examples, templates, and documentation so other people can use and maintain what you build. * Trying new AI tools on practical problems and sharing what's worth using and why. We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring things out and brings ideas of their own. You'll have support and code review from the team, with responsibility for the work you take on. Independent experimentation matters here, and so does knowing when to ask a question or work through a problem with someone else. **What you need** ----------------- **Consulting Skills** * You care as much about business impact as technical polish. * You can translate a client's frustration into a technical and human solve. * You're comfortable presenting to a C\-suite or a front\-line manager, with the professional presence clients trust with their business. * Clear communication. You can explain a technical decision to another developer and describe what an application does to someone who doesn't write code. **Engineering Skills** * Three or more years of software development experience, including maintaining applications after launch. * Experience building web applications with React and TypeScript, including connecting interfaces to APIs and working with application data. * Hands\-on experience developing software with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. You can provide useful context, guide the work, review changes, and verify the results. * Solid programming fundamentals. You're comfortable using Git, reading unfamiliar code, and tracing problems through an application. * An understanding of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric concepts, including how data is organized and modeled for reporting and analysis. Hands\-on experience with these products is welcome but isn't required. * Familiarity with the Microsoft ecosystem and the basics of cloud services, authentication, and permissions. **Nice to have** Experience with Next.js, Python, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Graph, or MCP would be useful. Previous consulting work or experience building tools for other developers would also help. **What we offer** ----------------- * **Base salary:** $125\-150k * **Full benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, life, 401k * **Remote work:** US\-based team. Your home office wherever makes you happiest * **Professional growth:** Time built in to try new tools on real problems and share what you find. People here want to see you grow, and they'll jump in when you're stuck **Our values** -------------- We hire for the same five values in every role at P3: * **Reliable.** You do what you said you'd do, and what you ship keeps working. * **Adaptable.** The tools change every month. You change with them, and you change course when a project stops making sense. * **Proactive.** You flag a problem the moment you see it, and you fix the small things before anyone has to ask. * **Invested.** You care whether the client's business actually gets better. * **Direct.** You say plainly what works, what doesn't, and what you don't know yet. **About P3 Adaptive** --------------------- We've been modernizing organizations' relationship with data since 2010\. We pair deep technical skill with business sense, and we skip the deck theater and the jargon. Our teams are small, senior, and hands\-on, and work doesn't pass through a chain of handoffs. We're building on top of the AI wave. If you want to build the AI that changes how companies use their data, we're ready to meet you. *P3 Adaptive is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Period.* *This position is open to people authorized to work in the United States. We don't sponsor work visas.*

rotation as needed. * Must be self\-driven and passionate about working in a hands\-on, manufacturing environment. * Must be able to travel as necessary and possess valid documents for travel via air and car. **Preferred Qualifications:** * A minimum of one Internship or Co\-op is preferred, especially in a manufacturing environment. * Obtaining a Bachelor of Science degree in Chemical The successful candidate MUST possess the following Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities: * Solid interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with production team and management. * Ability to learn quickly and put new knowledge into practice. * Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with individuals throughout the company on departmental procedures, policies, practices, and requests for information. * Strong listening, evaluating, and problem\-solving skills. Ability to create alternative solutions and meet deadlines. * Leadership experience or strong leadership skills with the drive to lead others. * Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to network and build relationships with individuals of various experiences and professional levels both within and outside of the company. * Previous work experience as a member of a team, or a strong understanding of the importance of open communication and information sharing between team members. jobs.title: Sr. Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry \- from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI\-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park \& Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com. As a remote\-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day. **The Role** ------------ We work on several systems: our ACME operations management suite, embeddable scheduling and booking widgets, B2B and B2C sales and support tooling, and custom solutions for enterprise operators. The work is technically varied and the stakes are real: operators depend on this software to run their businesses. We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with strong technical depth who is also highly effective with AI\-assisted development. You reason independently about complex systems, find the problems that aren't obvious from the requirements, and use AI as a tool to build faster while owning every decision it informs. That means you know how to break down ambiguous problems, delegate to agents, review their work critically, and course\-correct when things go sideways. You'll join the platform team, working deep in our existing systems, including ACME Core, to make other teams faster and safer, using AI\-assisted development as a force multiplier for your engineering judgment, not a replacement for it. The platform team works closely with DevOps, who own our infrastructure, so this is a backend\-focused role rather than an infrastructure one. Over the past few months, we've seen a step\-function improvement in the reliability and capabilities of long\-running AI agents. We're adapting our engineering practice to match, and we want strong backend engineers who are already building this way and excited to push it further. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Work as part of the platform team, improving the backend systems, tooling, and practices that other teams build on. Feature development is still part of the role where it fits. * Identify automation opportunities across the engineering workflow (repetitive manual work, slow or fragile processes, recurring operational toil) and build the solutions, using AI agents where they help. * Enable other teams: build and maintain shared services, libraries, and APIs, make the right way the easy way, and unblock engineers who depend on the platform through guidance, documentation, and code review. * Own security fixes and dependency updates across our backend systems: triage vulnerabilities, plan and ship upgrades safely in an existing codebase, and make sure they don't break the teams and services that depend on them. * Identify and diagnose performance bottlenecks, and recognize scalability limits before they become production problems. * Reason about concurrency, failure modes, and reliability across APIs and integrations. * Own your services in production: monitoring, debugging, performance, and reliability. When something breaks, you get to root cause and fix it properly. * Contribute to our AI\-first engineering culture, share patterns, document what works, and help the team level up on how we build with AI. * Use AI tools fluently \- Claude Code, Augment or equivalent, to compress implementation time, then critically review everything that comes out of them. AI makes a strong engineer faster; it does not replace technical judgment. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required** * 5\+ years of professional backend development using Java, with a meaningful track record of shipping and operating production systems. * Strong system design: you make sound architectural decisions, think about tradeoffs, edge cases, and what happens when things scale or fail, and you know when a simple solution is enough. * Strong backend fundamentals: API design, integrations, concurrency, failure modes, and service reliability. * Deep understanding of database behavior: data modeling, query design, indexing, and the performance implications of your choices. * Proven ability to diagnose performance bottlenecks and debug complex production issues to root cause, including problems that aren't obvious from the requirements. * Comfortable working in an existing, evolving codebase: you can get up to speed quickly, make safe incremental changes, and leave things better than you found them, without defaulting to rewrites. * Hands\-on, daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent) in a production engineering workflow, as a force multiplier on top of strong fundamentals. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code: catch logic errors, identify security issues, assess maintainability, and own what gets merged regardless of how it was written. * Clear communicator: you can articulate why you made a technical choice, flag when a spec has holes, and disagree constructively. * Interest in Elixir or functional programming languages as we expand our stack **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience building B2B SaaS products, ideally with complex multi\-tenant data models or transactional workflows. * Experience on small, high\-output teams where you've had to make architectural calls without a committee. * Familiarity with frontend development and JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular or modern JS frameworks), enough to collaborate effectively with frontend engineers and understand how your APIs are consumed. * Experience on a platform, internal tooling, or developer\-enablement team, including security patching and dependency upgrades in a large existing codebase. * Background in the travel, hospitality, or experiences industry. **What We Value** ----------------- A few things that define how we build: * Depth first. We value engineers who understand how systems actually behave: databases, concurrency, failure modes, and performance. AI amplifies that understanding; it doesn't replace it. * Judgment over speed. AI compresses implementation time. What differentiates engineers now isn't typing speed or memorized syntax, it's the ability to make the right calls on what to build, how to build it, and when it's not ready to ship. * Ownership. You built it? You own it. That includes AI\-generated code. You know when to use agents and when to do it yourself. * Directness. We want people who ask hard questions, surface problems early, and are willing to push back on a bad spec rather than build it and hope for the best. * Quality as a habit. Peer code reviews, test coverage, and clean APIs are not optional. We move fast, but not by cutting corners on the things that compound. Peek Travel Inc. is an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. If you are unable to apply due to incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at talent@peek.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Senior ASIC Design Verification Engineer (AI Compute)
jobs.description: Who we are Persimmons is building the infrastructure that will power the next decade of AI. Founded in 2023 by veteran technologists from the worlds of semiconductors, AI systems, and software innovation, we're on a mission to enable smarter devices, more sustainable data centers, and entirely new applications the world hasn't imagined yet. Why join us We're growing fast and looking for bold thinkers, builders, and curious problem\-solvers who want to push the limits of AI hardware and software. If you're ready to join a world\-class team and play a critical role in making a global impact, we want to talk to you. What you'll do As a founding Senior ASIC Design Verification Engineer, you will own verification of the AI Persimmons inference chiplet, that runs the smallest to largest AI models. You will partner daily with the design, algorithm and compiler teams to make sure silicon matches its intended feature set and is free of critical bugs before tape\-out. Your primary duties and responsibilities include: * Lead verification planning and execution from subsystem to full chip. Collaborate with the CTO, design and software teams to build test plans that validate implementation against specifications with no significant gaps. * Design and implement UVM testbenches with constrained\-random stimulus, compute reference models, and scoreboards that stay portable from subsystem to chip level and are built for fast debugging. * Drive coverage closure using code, functional, and formal coverage, applying formal verification where it is most effective in the compute logic. * Develop and validate C/C\+\+ firmware tests running on RISC\-V cores to exercise compute features end to end. * Extend verification with FPGA prototyping on Synopsys HAPS, enabling software teams to run small real workloads. * Use AI agents to attack the highest\-cost parts of verification: testbench generation, stimulus creation, regression triage, log analysis, and coverage closure. * Run efficient, automated regressions that conserve EDA licenses, analyze bug trends, and systematically drive bugs to closure, with a passion for finding them early. **Requirements** What You Bring To The Table: * Educational Foundation: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Proven Experience: 5\+ years of hands\-on verification experience spanning test plan development, simulation environment creation, test implementation, and complex debugging across IP blocks, SoCs, and system\-level designs. * Compute Expertise: Verification experience on compute and fabric datapaths. * Technical Mastery: Advanced SystemVerilog/Verilog and UVM, plus C/C\+\+ embedded code development and validation on RISC\-V or similar processors. * Verification Leadership: A track record of scalable verification flows, coverage\-driven strategies, assertion\-based and formal verification, and data\-driven calls on what to cut and what is non\-negotiable before tape\-out. * AI\-Driven Workflows: You have built real AI\-driven workflows, not just chatted with a model. You've written instructions for agents and shipped automation, ideally for regression triage, log analysis, or testbench generation. * Startup Ready: Comfortable leading and being hands\-on in a small, high\-ownership team, staying calm under pressure, and working on site in San Jose. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and benefits package * Flexible PTO * 401k Please note: Our organization does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from external recruiters or agencies. Any such submissions, regardless of form (including but not limited to email, direct messaging, or social media), shall be deemed voluntary and shall not create any express or implied obligation on the part of the organization to pay any fees, commissions, or other compensation. Direct contact of employees, officers, or board members regarding employment opportunities is strictly prohibited and will not receive a response.

jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. #### **What you'll do** As a Partner Solutions Engineer, you'll help strategic partners understand, position, and demonstrate Pindrop's value within their own platforms and customer conversations. You'll work with partner solutions engineering (SE) teams to build clear value narratives and credible demos that show Pindrop in the context of each partner's solution. You'll also provide the technical guidance that makes those demos real. Your focus is building repeatable partner motions so partners lead stronger early customer conversations and bring Pindrop into active opportunities with the right context. * Ask the right questions, recommend best practices, and help partner SE teams connect customer problems, stakeholders, use cases, and outcomes to a clear Pindrop value story. * Teach partners how to position Pindrop within their own platform and customer motion. Explain product functionality, cloud concepts, and integration choices in plain language. * Build and coach tailored demo flows that connect the customer's situation to Pindrop capabilities and expected outcomes, not a standard feature tour. * Lead enablement and practice sessions on value messaging, use\-case positioning, technical integration overviews, demo delivery, and common customer questions. * Prepare partners for early customer meetings, platform demos, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), prospecting conversations, and active opportunities by adapting the story to each audience. * Advise partner technical teams on where and how to place Pindrop application programming interfaces (APIs) within contact center as a service (CCaaS) platforms and adjacent workflows. Help them connect systems for a usable first\-pass demo integration. * Create and configure partner demo tenants, sandboxes, and supporting CCaaS environments for repeatable authentication and bot detection scenarios. * Develop reusable demo scripts, use\-case plays, talk tracks, setup guidance, and integration documentation that improve partner consistency and self\-service. * Identify risks that could derail a partner\-led demo or integration. Bring in the right internal teams and define a practical path forward without taking on production ownership. * Partner with Product and Engineering to turn recurring partner questions, product gaps, and integration needs into actionable field feedback. #### **Who you are** * A translator. You turn customer problems and technical capabilities into value stories, tailored demos, and practical next steps. * A natural coach and facilitator. You're comfortable in front of partner SEs, developers, business stakeholders, and internal teams, and you make each of them better at telling the story. * A pragmatic builder. You keep technical support practical and repeatable, and you know when "ready to demo" is the right bar. * Clear about boundaries. You know when to use a repeatable approach, when to involve a specialist, and when production ownership belongs with Product, Engineering, or implementation teams. * Trusted. Partners and internal teams rely on you to communicate value, technical options, limitations, risks, and handoff points honestly. #### **Your skill\-set** Must\-haves * 3\+ years in sales engineering, partner engineering, solutions consulting, technical consulting, or a comparable customer\-facing technical role in enterprise software. You can show you've turned technical capabilities into clear value narratives and tailored demos. * Experience enabling or coaching technical sellers, partner SEs, or customer\-facing technical teams on positioning and demo delivery, with strong facilitation and presentation skills. * Strong experience with CCaaS platforms such as Five9, Genesys, NICE, Amazon C ons you'll never personally join. * Represent differentiated, category\-defining technology. You'll position solutions backed by deep expertise, proprietary technology, and 300\+ patents, not a commodity product. * Stay hands\-on across the CCaaS ecosystem. You'll work across Five9, Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect, and more, building working integrations rather than slideware. * Operate inside an AI\-first organization. With Innovation as our first core value, you'll be encouraged to use AI to build demos, enablement content, and integration guidance faster. * Influence what we build. Your field feedback goes directly to Product and Engineering and shapes how Pindrop works within partner platforms. * Grow as Pindrop grows. You'll help define a partner motion that's still being built, and grow your career as we scale it. #### **What we offer** As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice\-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer: * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long\-term success. * Remote\-first environment \- giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day. * While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in\-person moments through regular team on\-sites, company\-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. * Generous health and welfare plans to choose from \- including one employer\-paid "employee\-only" plan! * Best\-in\-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution * Low\-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. * Paid Parental Leave \- Including birth, adoptive \& foster parents * + One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! * Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. * Enhanced fertility and GLP\-1 benefits to support family\-building journeys and personalized health needs. * Annual Learning \& Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill\-building, certifications, and continued education. \#LI\-Remote **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed. ### **Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer** Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. jobs.title: GTM Engineer- AI B2B Lead Generation & Automation
jobs.description: PlanITROI is hiring a hands\-on, elite, GTM engineer to build and run our AI\-powered lead generation engine. You build the core AI agents first, then run the campaigns on them every day, turning enterprise buying signals into qualified sales conversations. You might have started in outbound, SDR leadership, demand gen, or growth, then taught yourself to build the agents and automations that do the work. Or you're an engineer who learned B2B prospecting the hard way. Either way, you've personally built systems that booked real meetings, and you can show us how you have been successful. If that's you, we would like to meet you! **About PlanITROI** For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has turned retired technology into financial value for enterprise organizations. Our services cover IT lifecycle management, repair, refurbishment, redeployment, remarketing, reverse logistics, and secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). We operate on reuse\-as\-intended\-use: reuse before recycling, and recycling only when reuse isn't viable. PlanITROI is recognized in Gartner's ITAD Market Guide and is an IAITAM Platinum Sponsor. Our mission is to maximize the financial value of technology while extending its useful life. Every device we recover creates value for clients and gets a second life as affordable technology. **Your mission** Build and run the AI\-powered outbound engine that finds enterprise buying opportunities and turns them into qualified meetings and signed MSAs. Your agents will research 5,000\+ enterprise accounts and reach 250,000\+ contacts. You own it end\-to\-end: signal detection, account intelligence, contact discovery, personalization, multichannel orchestration, CRM integration, experimentation, and measurement. **Build first, then run.** You start by building a few core agents. Then you run the campaigns on them: launching and monitoring sequences, working reply queues, tuning messaging and targeting every week, protecting deliverability, and handing warm conversations to sales at the right moment. Expect most of your time to shift from building to running once the agents are live. **Who we sell to.** Enterprise organizations with 5,000 to 11,000,000\+ employees, mostly knowledge workers (80%\+), complex buying committees, and an existing technology provider. Your challenge: find the right buyer, recognize the right moment, and give them a compelling reason to talk to PlanITROI. **Who you work with.** You report to the Founder \& CEO and the Chief Strategy Officer, and work closely with the VP of Marketing. No layers in between other than support. **What you'll build and own** * **Signal detection.** Ingest, evaluate, and score buying signals such as tech refresh cycles, leadership changes, office moves, M\&A, RFP activity, contract timing, job postings, and social activity. Trigger the right next action while the signal is fresh. * **Buying committee intelligence.** Identify high\-fit ICP accounts, map buying committees, select the best 1 to 5 contacts per entry point, validate contact data, and track changes. * **Personalization and challenger messaging.** Combine account intelligence, signals, persona pain points, account history, and incumbent\-provider context into relevant outreach at scale. * **Multichannel orchestration.** Run email, LinkedIn, voicemail drops, AI calling where appropriate, and human SDR follow\-up as one system, with sequencing, timing, routing, and next\-best actions. * **Objection handling and follow\-up.** Respond intelligently to objections like "We already have a provider," keep conversational context, and escalate to humans at the right moment. * **Performance and optimization.** Measure results by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. Find what's winning, kill what isn't, and run the next experiment. These are capabilities, not six separate agents. You design the architecture, build the agents, integrate the systems, and make them work together. **What you bring** **This role requires a hands\-on builder. You must design, build, and demo production AI agents yourself.** You'll integrate tools like Salesforce, Apollo, and Clay, but using them isn't the role. Building the agents that run on top of them is. You understand both sides: the engineering, and the B2B prospecting strategy that turns agents into a working revenue system. **Must\-haves** * **AI agents that booked meetings.** You've personally built and run AI agents or automated outbound systems that produced measurable B2B meetings, and you have the performance data to prove it. * **Agent engineering.** LLMs, tool calling, reasoning workflows, memory and state, multi\-agent orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls, using LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, n8n, or comparable frameworks. * **Coding and integration.** Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations. * **Enterprise prospecting.** Intent signals, ICP scoring, buying committee mapping, enrichment, personalization, objection handling, and multichannel sequence design. Bonus if you've displaced incumbent providers. * **GTM stack.** Hands\-on with tools like Salesforce, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 6sense or Bombora, and AI calling or voicemail platforms. * **Production operations at scale.** Monitoring, debugging, CRM sync, deduplication, deliverability, compliance, and error handling for systems reaching 250,000\+ contacts across email, LinkedIn, and voicemail without burning domains or accounts. **Nice\-to\-haves** * A background in outbound, SDR/BDR leadership, demand gen, growth, or RevOps before moving into AI and automation. * Experience in IT services, ITAD, or computer hardware, hardware as a service **What success looks like** Your primary outcome is **qualified enterprise meetings** that meet defined ICP, persona, and business\-need criteria. We also track: * **Signal\-to\-meeting conversion.** How well your agents turn buying signals into conversations and meetings. * **Contact precision.** Reaching the right decision\-makers and buying committees. * **Deployment velocity.** How fast a campaign idea becomes a working agent and a live test. * **Multichannel conversion.** Replies, conversations, meetings, and opportunities by signal, persona, channel, and campaign. * **System reliability.** Data accuracy, deliverability, CRM integrity, routing, and compliance. * **Learning rate.** How quickly you find what isn't working, fix the root cause, and scale what is. **How we hire: show us, don't tell us** We hire on proof, not interviews alone. We're not interested in theoretical AI expertise or polished slides about what agents might do. If you qualify, we'll give you a real project to show us how you build. * **Live demo.** Show us AI agents you personally built and deployed for B2B lead generation, and the results they produced. * **Build project.** Build an outbound agent from a campaign premise we give you, using your own tools. * **Live technical session.** Demo your build, work a live account, and walk us through your architecture. Across these stages, be ready to show your architecture, decision logic, prompts, tools, and integrations; how your agents handle exceptions, incomplete data, failures, and human handoff; and real performance data such as meetings, pipeline, or conversion gains. You won't need access to any PlanITROI system or need to buy software. Free tiers and trials are fine. Your work stays yours unless we hire you. If you show work from a past employer, please redact anything confidential. **Ready to build?** If you love hard technical problems and want to build something ambitious, bring your working agents, your results, and your drive. Build the agents. Own the results. Help us grow. **Explore more about us:** PlanITROI.com \| NextraTech.com \| BuyRefurbished.com *PlanITROI is an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination/harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: ASIC Architect, Principal (AI Inference)
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** --------------------- Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip\-to\-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first\-generation Atlas systems are deploying in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders. **Role Overview** ----------------- We're looking for an exceptional Principal ASIC Architect to help define the future of AI inference hardware. You will collaborate across architecture, software, machine learning, systems, and silicon implementation to design next\-generation AI accelerators capable of serving rapidly evolving frontier models. This role requires exceptional technical breadth, balancing mathematical understanding, ML trends, systems architecture, and practical silicon implementation. This may be the single most important technical hire after the Chief Architect. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Architectural Exploration*** Own architectural exploration across the evolving landscape of transformer models, MoE, sparse models, and long\-context inference. * Evaluate emerging techniques including speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV\-cache evolution, sub\-quadratic and linear attention, and state\-space models. * Assess memory architectures, communication architectures, and interconnects for next\-generation accelerators. **Performance Modeling*** Develop analytical models and build simulation frameworks to evaluate architectural tradeoffs. * Estimate latency, throughput, bandwidth, memory and compute utilization, scaling efficiency, power, area, and cost. **Hardware/Software Co\-Design*** Partner closely with compiler, runtime, system software, firmware, ASIC engineering, and ML research teams to align hardware direction with real workload needs. **ASIC Specification \& Roadmap*** Develop architecture documents and define subsystem interfaces. * Evaluate tradeoffs across competing architectural directions and guide the future product roadmap. **Industry Awareness*** Track new LLMs, reasoning models, research papers, hardware competitors, academic research, and emerging algorithms to keep Positron's architecture ahead of the field. **AI\-Enabled Engineering*** Use AI to accelerate research, performance analysis, architecture exploration, simulation generation, and documentation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 15\+ years of experience in ASIC architecture. * Deep expertise in AI accelerator design and high\-performance SoCs. * Hands\-on experience building performance models for memory systems and interconnects. * Strong hardware/software co\-design ability. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with GPU architecture. * A solid grasp of ML systems, distributed inference, and large\-scale serving. * Deep knowledge of transformer internals. * Compiler experience. * A track record of research publications. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Success in this role looks like helping define future Positron architectures and creating a scalable architectural direction that bridges software and hardware, influencing products that remain competitive for years despite rapidly evolving AI models. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Shape the core architecture of Positron's AI inference accelerators at a foundational level, with outsized influence over the company's technical direction for years to come. * Work at the intersection of frontier AI research and silicon implementation, tackling problems few architects in the industry get to own end to end. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $300,000 – $350,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off, so you can truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.description: **Senior Director, Product and Technology** *Location: Remote,* *Application Submission Deadline: November 1, 2026* **About Us** Propel America addresses a broken workforce system that fails both young adults and healthcare employers, sidelining talented individuals from entering healthcare careers and contributing to critical workforce shortages that threaten community health. Traditional college remains financially and logistically out of reach for many, especially young people from low\-income communities, forcing them into a false choice: sacrifice income to pursue an expensive degree or remain in low\-wage work without upward mobility. At the same time, systemic barriers, such as limited exposure to healthcare roles, low visibility of alternative pathways, and a lack of representative mentors, prevent many high school graduates from entering the healthcare field. jobs.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Every moment of every day, people around the world rely on the energy they access through infrastructure built by Quanta. Comprising the largest skilled\-labor force in North America, our employees are highly skilled and innovative, continually working to connect people and power. We’re building the infrastructure that supports the energy transition, and there are more opportunities than ever to be part of our team. Join us and build your career building a brighter future. Imagine what you could do here. We encourage, inspire, and support our people to seize opportunities in our corporate office and with hundreds of our operating companies worldwide that provide solutions for the utility, renewable energy, electric power, industrial, and communications industries. Quanta actively promotes and maintains a culture of belonging where all employees can be themselves, live their values, and find opportunities to succeed. When you join our team, you join a dynamic organization in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is prized. Come find out how our people power modern life. **About this Role** ------------------- The Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (Lead FDE) is a hands\-on technical team lead who guides a small pod of Forward Deployed Engineers through the delivery of high\-impact solutions — from discovery to production — for Quanta’s operating companies. You will own day\-to\-day execution on a single active project at a time, setting technical direction, coordinating the work of 2–4 engineers, and personally contributing to the codebase alongside them. Unlike the Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, who shapes architecture across multiple initiatives, the Lead FDE is embedded in the details of one engagement: translating ambiguous business needs into shipped software, unblocking the team, and serving as the primary technical point of contact for stakeholders. Unlike an individual Forward Deployed Engineer, you are accountable not only for your own output but for the quality, velocity, and coherence of the whole pod’s work. This is a working lead role. You are expected to spend the majority of your time building — writing production code, prototyping with AI\-assisted tooling, and pairing with engineers — while also planning, reviewing, mentoring, and communicating outcomes to business partners. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead a pod of Forward Deployed Engineers through end\-to\-end delivery of a single project, from problem framing to production hand\-off. * Partner directly with business leaders, domain experts, and operating\-unit stakeholders to understand needs and shape scope. * Translate ambiguous requirements into a concrete delivery plan with clear, testable milestones. * Write production\-ready code as a hands\-on contributor on the project, not just as a reviewer. * Make day\-to\-day technical decisions (frameworks, integrations, data models, deployment targets) and escalate architectural calls to the FDEM when needed. * Run code reviews, pairing sessions, and working sessions that raise the team’s technical bar. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, and similar) to accelerate delivery and bring best practices back to the broader FDE team. * Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early — and drive the team through them. * Deploy applications to production and coordinate post\-deployment support, monitoring, and iteration with SMEs. * Mentor Forward Deployed Engineers through pairing, feedback, and targeted coaching on craft and consulting skills. * Document design decisions, reusable components, and lessons learned to support scale and knowledge\-sharing across the FDE practice. * Represent the pod in status reviews, demos, and retrospectives with stakeholders and Data \& AI leadership. * Stay current with emerging AI tools and development practices and pilot their adoption within your project. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * 8–12 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or technical consulting, with recent hands\-on delivery experience. * At least 2 years in a technical lead, tech lead, or senior engineer capacity guiding the work of other engineers on a shared project. * Advanced proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java). * Solid grounding in software architecture patterns, API design, data modeling, and full\-stack or backend delivery. * Fluency in at least one major cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and modern development practices (CI/CD, containers, version control workflows, testing). * Demonstrated experience applying AI tooling (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, vector search, prompt engineering, RAG patterns) in real delivery workflows. * Track record of shipping production software on tight timelines in a consultative or embedded setting. * Experience mentoring engineers and running effective code reviews. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between business stakeholders and engineers and to represent technical tradeoffs clearly. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, Relativity aiR, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change. What We Do At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code; they harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster and shape the future of legal technology. They shape how industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice and continuously evolve our platform using the latest technologies, including cloud\-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling. Our AI powers privacy programs, identifies confidential information, and detects language indicating misconduct. We’re reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation. If you’re passionate about solving hard problems, designing for scale, and building tools that matter, while working in a culture that values transparency, innovation, and shared success, Relativity offers the opportunity to make a measurable difference in the marketplace. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **About the Role** Relativity's design system is moving to UX, and we are building its next generation. You will take it from early build to production and keep it running: making the technical calls inside the library, from module format to how it behaves under micro frontends, and building most of them yourself. The framework is chosen, the first components exist, and it ships through our micro frontend. Your work is the packaging, publishing, CI, testing, and hardest component behavior that turn it into a library teams can depend on. You will also maintain the libraries it replaces while teams move off them. **Job Description and Requirements** * Build and maintain how the library is packaged and published: module format, peer dependencies, the publish path to Artifactory and CDN. * Apply versioning and deprecation practice on every release, and write the migration guides for consuming teams. * Stand up CI, execute visual regression testing, and wire the token pipeline from design token files through to CSS variables. * Test and review components built by designers and coding agents before they merge, and maintain the machine\-readable guidance that agents leverage. * Fix accessibility defects in the code and support the accessibility conformance reporting. * Respond to breaking changes caused by releases and apply fixes through timely patch releases. * Keep legacy libraries in maintenance mode, only addressing major security issues and critical fixes. * Author the component behavior that our React framework library doesn’t provide. Raise the engineering bar of the design system team through code review and pairing with designers who use coding agents. * **Preferred Qualifications** * You have helped maintain a design system that multiple teams depend upon. * You are fluent with AI coding tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor. * You have worked across platform teams. * You have guided a design system migration that included patching what broke for consuming teams. * You can explain packaging decisions to a designer and a design decision to a platform engineer. * You have a strong accessibility practice of creating accessible, keyboard\-navigable, responsive experiences and testing them with screen readers and tools like Axe or equivalent. You have experience working in legacy codebases. * **Minimum Qualifications** * 7\+ years in front\-end or UX engineering. * Deep React and TypeScript experience. * Experience keeping a published package reliable across releases. * Technical leadership on a library or product area. * Ability to turn a technical direction into a working plan and execute on it. * Experience owning build and release tooling for a published package. * Deep experience with semantic HTML, CSS, and accessible component patterns. * Clear technical communication, including in code review. Based in the United States. * **Why We Could Be a Great Fit** * Impactful Mission: *Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It* \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * Engineering Culture: Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * Inclusive Environment: Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * Community Impact: Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * Compensation \& Benefits: Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $126,000 and $190,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

structures teams during the development phase and through the first prototype and flight builds **About You:** * Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, mechanical engineering, or other engineering forming aluminum alloys * New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into a manufacturing, test, and production system with proven success * Experience in managing projects in a fast\-paced environment **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. jobs.title: AI-first Software Developer (On-site)
jobs.description: About the role Retrevr builds AI tools for veterinary practices: an AI receptionist that answers calls and texts, plus a full practice management platform covering scheduling, patient records, charting, pharmacy, labs, and payments. We're hiring a Software Developer to join our small engineering team in Provo. Demand for new features has outgrown what our current team can ship, so we're moving quickly on this hire. You'd be the third developer on the team, which means your work is visible immediately and you'll have real influence over how things get built. Most of our platform was built with AI coding agents, and that's how we keep shipping fast. We need someone who is extremely proficient with AI\-assisted development: you can keep several agents productive at once, give them specs they can actually follow, and catch what they get wrong before it reaches a clinic. Speed with AI matters here, and so does knowing when not to trust it. The work splits between two areas: internal systems our sales team depends on, and the product vet clinics use every day, including the AI inside it. You'll touch both. This role is open to developers with roughly 1–5 years of professional experience. We care more about how you think, how fast you pick things up, and how well you build with AI than about a specific number of years. What you'll do \- Build and ship features end to end with AI coding agents (Claude Code is our daily driver), from React/Next.js UI to Postgres and edge functions \- Work across the clinic side of the product: scheduling, patient charts, pharmacy, labs, and checkout \- Run agent sessions in parallel, each with a clear spec, and review everything they produce before it ships \- Test and harden AI\-written code for security, data integrity, and performance. We handle patient records and payments, so this matters. \- Help build the AI in our product: the voice receptionist, AI\-assisted charting, and an in\-app assistant for clinic staff \- Develop and improve the internal tools our sales team runs on — dashboards, workflows, reporting, integrations \- Deploy and monitor your own work on Vercel and Supabase, and fix what breaks \- Sit down with the sales team, figure out what they actually need, then build it What we're looking for \- Extremely proficient with AI coding tools: you use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar agents every day and can show us exactly how you work \- Strong enough fundamentals to know when the AI is wrong: JavaScript/TypeScript, React, SQL, and auth \- 1\+ years of professional experience building web applications (internships and substantial side projects count) \- Comfort with Git and a pull request workflow \- Clear communication, and a habit of asking questions early rather than getting stuck quietly \- Comfortable with shifting priorities — on a three\-person team, this week's plan sometimes changes \- Able to work on\-site in Provo, UT Nice to have \- Veterinary or healthcare software experience, or time spent working in a vet clinic \- Next.js App Router (server components, server actions) and Vercel deployments \- Supabase: Postgres, row\-level security, edge functions \- Building with LLM APIs, voice AI, or MCP \- Stripe, Twilio, or other third\-party API integrations \- Tailwind CSS \- Testing with Jest, Vitest, or Playwright \- Experience building internal tools or CRM/sales integrations \- Startup or small\-team experience What we offer \- $50,000 – $85,000 per year, depending on experience \- Unlimited PTO \- A real say in technical decisions and the tools we use \- Short feedback loops: what you build goes live in days, not quarters \- Direct access to the people making product and business decisions Hiring process We're moving quickly on this one: \- Short intro call (\~20 minutes) \- Technical conversation with the team, including a walkthrough of something you've built \- A short live session where you build something small with your own AI setup \- Offer We aim to go from first call to decision within about a week. How to apply Apply through Indeed with your resume. In a couple of sentences, tell us how you build with AI (your tools, your workflow, a project you're proud of) and include a link if it's public. No cover letter required. Retrevr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Agent Assist

For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ At Rippling, we’re building an autonomous operating system for work—and Support is one of the clearest places where AI can make work dramatically better. You’ll be joining Rippling AI as a Staff Software Engineer focused on Agent Assist, the AI\-powered product area that helps support reps answer customer questions faster, more accurately, and with more confidence. This is a high\-ownership, lead\-shaped role for someone who can operate across AI, product, systems, and operations: identifying real Support and Support Operations pain points, turning them into product and platform opportunities, and shipping improvements that compound across Rippling AI. This is not a narrow infrastructure role, and it is not a pure product engineering role. The right person will be deeply hands\-on technically while also staying close to operators and customer\-facing workflows. You’ll build a tight loop with Support and Support Ops: understand where reps struggle, form hypotheses, ship quickly, measure impact, and generalize the most successful patterns back into durable AI platform capabilities. You’ll be expected to lead through influence, set technical direction for multiple engineers, and drive ambiguous work from messy operational symptoms to scalable product and platform improvements. The charter is concrete—make Agent Assist meaningfully better for Support reps—but the path is intentionally open\-ended, and you’ll help shape it. **What you will do** -------------------- * Own major technical initiatives for Agent Assist within Rippling AI, from ambiguous problem discovery through production rollout. * Build AI\-powered workflows that help Support reps answer questions faster, more accurately, and with better context. * Partner deeply with Support, Support Operations, Product, AI Infrastructure, and Engineering to identify high\-leverage pain points and turn them into product and platform bets. * Create a rapid operating loop: observe support workflows, form hypotheses, ship improvements, measure outcomes, and iterate weekly. * Convert repeated support questions, failure modes, and operational workarounds into upstream product and platform fixes. * Design systems that make AI assistance reliable, observable, and controllable in high\-stakes customer support workflows. * Build reusable patterns for context, retrieval, tool use, skills, harnesses, and evaluation that can scale beyond Support into broader Rippling AI surfaces. * Lead technical direction for a small group of engineers, including architecture, execution planning, code review, and implementation guidance. * Stay hands\-on in the codebase: write production code, debug issues, review critical paths, and make implementation\-level tradeoffs. * Raise the engineering bar by mentoring senior ICs and helping teams reason more effectively about AI\-native product development. **What you will need** ---------------------- * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of Staff\-level technical leadership and org\-wide impact. * Experience leading complex, multi\-engineer or cross\-functional initiatives where success required influence rather than direct ownership. * Strong systems thinking: you can reason from frontline operational symptoms to root\-cause product, platform, or workflow changes. * Practical AI/LLM fluency, including strong intuition for context windows, retrieval, tool use, skills, harnesses, evaluations, and the tradeoffs involved in building reliable AI workflows. * Strong product judgment and customer empathy, especially in environments where your work materially improved the day\-to\-day experience of operators, customers, or internal teams. * Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where the roadmap evolves as the technology, product, and user needs evolve. * Clear, precise jobs.description: **Company Description** **WHY SAP SUCCESSFACTORS** SAP SuccessFactors is the HCM system of record for some of the world's largest and most complex organizations. Our advantage is not just product breadth; it is the enterprise data foundation that underpins everything we build: workforce, financial, and operational data across every major industry, in 160 countries. No point solution can match it. We are now at the most exciting inflection point in the company's history. Autonomous HCM is real, and it is with customers now. The engineering leader who takes this role will have the platform, the data, the team, and the mandate to build something that matters. **Job Description** **THE OPPORTUNITY** Organizations are navigating one of the most consequential workforce moments in a generation. AI is no longer a roadmap item; it is reshaping how companies manage their people, run their HR processes, and connect workforce decisions to business outcomes. SAP SuccessFactors is at the center of that shift. We are looking for an engineering leader who can make Autonomous HCM, already real and in customers' hands, faster, stronger, and ready to scale globally. This is the role that builds the platform where AI connects every person, insight, and action, across the full HCM portfolio, for the world's largest organizations, in 160 countries. You will report directly to the GM and Chief Product Officer of SAP SuccessFactors and partner closely with product, design, and go\-to\-market leadership to define and execute the engineering strategy. This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain the status quo. It is a role for someone who wants to lead a once\-in\-a\-decade technology transition. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Manage engineering budgets and resource allocation with rigor, balancing sustaining investment, AI innovation, and product development * Own the engineering strategy and execution for SAP SuccessFactors, including HR, talent, learning, workforce planning, employee experience, and the AI and agentic capabilities that run across all of them * Lead and grow a world\-class global engineering organization of 1,000\+ engineers, building a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and relentless customer focus * Drive the delivery of Autonomous HCM, with AI agents that don't just answer HR questions but take action, orchestrate across business processes, connect people data to business outcomes, and provide best\-in\-class AI to solve business problems * Partner with the CPO and product leadership to translate the Autonomous HCM vision into a concrete engineering roadmap with clear priorities, milestones, and accountability * Ensure SAP's enterprise data foundation, the deepest in the industry, spanning workforce, financial, and operational data, powers a new generation of AI capabilities that no standalone point solution can replicate * Drive high\-velocity, high\-quality delivery through modern engineering practices: AI\-assisted development, continuous delivery, DevOps, and rigorous operational excellence * Continuously transform engineering practices, operating models, and team capabilities so the organization remains at the leading edge of technology adoption * Build and maintain SAP's platform extensibility and partner ecosystem, ensuring customers and system integrators can extend and configure solutions to their specific needs * Represent engineering leadership externally with customers, analysts, and partners, communicating the vision and progress of Autonomous HCM with clarity and conviction **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU global teams (500\+ engineers) delivering AI\-powered / AI\-native enterprise SaaS products * Proven track record of leading major technology transitions, ideally including a shift to AI\-native or agentic product architectures, not just incremental improvement * Deep knowledge of modern AI/ML technologies, LLM\-based agent frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data platforms; strong enough to earn credibility with architects and senior engineers * Experience building and shipping AI\-powered / AI\-native enterprise products at scale, from early prototype through GA, EAC programs, and broad customer adoption * Strong product sensibility and the ability to partner with CPO\-level leadership to shape roadmap, not just execute against it * Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent in a highly competitive market * Experience navigating large, matrixed organizations, managing cross\-functional dependencies, influencing without authority, and building coalitions across SAP's global engineering community * Exceptional communicator and influencer, able to speak with clarity to engineers, customers, executives, and the press; comfortable representing  Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement Our company does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults. Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.
