jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: SHAZAM recognizes that financial institutions build better communities, and this drives our passion to strengthen financial institutions. We are a trusted partner to our valued customers providing answers, choice, and innovation with an impeccable level of customer service – a level unmatched in the industry. And here’s the best part \- we’re a national company that offers a small\-company feel, a cultural balance that’s hard to come by but very real at SHAZAM. Your growth and development are top priorities and you’ll be surrounded by talented individuals and postured to make a real difference in the company. As a team member at SHAZAM, you’ll be an essential part of our mission as we work together strengthening financial institutions. ***This is a hybrid position based out of our Johnston, IA office.*** **What we’re looking for:** SHAZAM is looking for a**Software Engineer**to help support and enhance **KinetiCore™** banking solutions,a scalable platform built to help community banks compete, grow and deliver exceptional customer experiences. As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the development, maintenance and improvement of software applications with minimal guidance from more experienced engineers. This position focuses on executing complex foundational engineering practices, writing clear and reliable code, assisting with troubleshooting and contributing to well\-defined tasks throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). **What you'll do:*** Develop and support enterprise applications in a mixed IBM i environment, leveraging both fixed\-format RPG for legacy systems and free\-format RPG for new development and enhancements. * Design production‑quality solutions with attention to maintainability, performance, and long‑term value * Participate in all phases of the SDLC: planning, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance * Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve moderately complex software issues * Collaborate with product partners and cross‑functional teams, clearly communicating technical details and tradeoffs * Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers and junior engineers * Contribute to process and tooling improvements by identifying inefficiencies and proposing actionable solutions * Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, and approaches to solve engineering challenges * Create and maintain clear technical documentation for implemented features * Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and help improve system reliability, scalability, and monitoring * Serve as a subject‑matter expert for a specific application, subsystem, or process * Participate in an on‑call rotation with support and guidance **What you need:*** Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience and proficiency with the programming language RPG * Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a relevant field preferred * Knowledge of Visual Studio Code (VS Code) with IBM i extensions to develop and maintain both fixed\-format and free\-format RPG applications using modern development practices preferred * Experience with AI\-powered development tools, including GitHub Copilot within VS Code, to generate code recommendations, document application functionality, identify improvement opportunities, and support troubleshooting efforts preferred. * Working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and object‑oriented design principles * Familiarity with common software engineering practices including version control (Git), testing, and debugging * Experience using modern development tools and collaboration platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Atlassian Jira, Salesforce) * Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to connect complex concepts and design effective solutions * Clear verbal and written communication skills, especially when discussing technical topics * Self‑motivated with a growth mindset and eagerness to learn new technologies **What’s in it for you:*** A mission\-driven company with a strong sense of purpose * A hybrid work environment that values flexibility and collaboration * Opportunities for professional development and career growth * A culture that values innovation, integrity, and community impact * Excellent benefits: + Health, dental, and vision insurance + 401(k) retirement plan with company match + Flexible spending and health savings accounts + Life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability provided at no cost + Time away from work – PTO, VTO, paid parental leave, and company holidays + Educational assistance Actual compensation is based on various factors, such as geographic location, experience, education, and/or skill level, and is finalized at the time of offer. SHAZAM is an equal opportunity employer, including those with disabilities or status as a protected veteran. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; ITS, Inc./SHAZAM will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment\-based visa). Please be aware that SHAZAM may use an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool to assist in the review and screening of job applications for this position. The AI system is designed to help our team efficiently identify qualified candidates by identifying relevant skills and experience within submitted applications. All final hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

jobs.description: **United States, Houston** -------------------------- **Engineering and Manufacturing** --------------------------------- Embedded Firmware \& Controls Engineer to develop embedded software and control solutions for high\-performance electromechanical systems operating in demanding environments. The role requires strong capability in both real\-time embedded firmware development and motor/control\-system engineering, with responsibility from algorithm development through implementation, integration, and validation. layers, device drivers, and peripheral interfaces * Implement task scheduling, state machines, diagnostics, fault handling, protection, and recovery logic * Develop and integrate communication interfaces and protocols including CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS\-485, or similar * Work with RTOS\-based and bare\-metal embedded systems * Develop configuration, calibration, data logging, boot, and firmware update functionality * Develop unit and integration tests and support structured firmware verification and validation * Debug hardware and firmware using debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic control modes * Develop control strategies for challenging operating conditions including high starting torque, low\-speed operation, stall, stall recovery, load transients, * Analyze control\-loop Qualifications * Strong embedded C/C\+\+ development experience for real\-time systems * Hands\-on experience developing firmware on microcontrollers, DSPs, or similar embedded processors * Strong understanding of embedded software architecture, interrupts, timers, ADCs, PWM, memory, peripheral interfaces, and real\-time execution * Strong understanding of feedback control systems and conditioning, and embedded hardware interfaces * Experience debugging integrated hardware, firmware, and control\-system issues * Ability to analyze measured data and translate test results into jobs.title: Platform / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Do you love solving hard cloud networking and automation problems, and want to own the infrastructure foundation of an innovative global company with the feel of a startup and an amazing culture? SRAM is seeking a Platform / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own our cloud network architecture and our infrastructure\-as\-code foundation. This role sits at the center of everything the platform team runs. You will operate a large multi\-account AWS Control Tower organization (40\+ accounts), design and evolve the network topology that connects it, and author the Terraform that defines all of it. Everything else the team does, from CI/CD to identity to observability, is built on top of those two pillars. You will join a team of 4, reporting to the IT Director, and help carry forward an active 2026 roadmap centered on network egress centralization and continued IaC maturity, alongside observability and app modernization work. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Cloud Networking: * Own cloud networking end to end: design and evolve multi\-account VPC architecture, transit gateway / centralized egress, Route 53, and cross\-account connectivity across a 40\+ account AWS Control Tower organization * Lead the network egress centralization initiative on the 2026 roadmap * Infrastructure as Code: * Own infrastructure as code end to end: author and maintain Terraform modules from scratch, including module design, state management, and reusable patterns other engineers build on, not just consuming existing modules * Continue raising the bar on IaC coverage and module quality across the organization * Platform Governance: * Extend AWS multi\-account governance (Control Tower, Organizations, IAM) across EC2, RDS, ECS, EKS, and Bedrock * Support the observability buildout and the migration of workloads from EC2 to ECS * CI/CD and Identity: * Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines, including OIDC federation * Administer Microsoft Entra SSO * Internal Tooling and Partnership: * Build, extend, and support internal tooling and services, leveraging AWS Bedrock for inference where applicable * Partner closely with engineers across teams to turn infrastructure and networking needs into self\-service, well\-documented tooling * Who Thrives Here: * Communicates clearly and generously; writes good docs, explains tradeoffs, and makes teammates' jobs easier * Gives opinionated, direct guidance but stays genuinely open to pushback * Shares context proactively and treats knowledge as something to spread, not hoard * Is patient, reliable, and easy to build trust with over the long haul **Qualifications** ------------------ * 4\+ years in cloud infrastructure / platform engineering, with hands\-on ownership of production cloud networking (VPC design, routing, egress, cross\-account or cross\-VPC connectivity) at scale * Proven experience authoring and designing Terraform modules from scratch, including module structure, state management, and reuse patterns, not just consuming existing ones * Production AWS experience, ideally within a multi\-account / Control Tower organization * Hands\-on experience with GitLab CI/CD (including OIDC federation) and Microsoft Entra SSO integration * Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: * Proficiency in Python and Bash, with a bias toward automation over manual toil * Solid grounding in identity and access management, secrets management, and observability tooling * A code\-first, no\-lock\-in mindset * Experience with AWS Bedrock or similar managed inference services preferred * Experience building with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow preferred * Prior EC2\-to\-ECS migration experience preferred * Preferred Certifications: * AWS Certified * HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate * Compensation and Benefits: * Starting salary range: $90,000 up to $125,000, based on skills and experience * Annual corporate bonus eligibility based on company and individual performance * Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; life and long\-term disability insurance; generous paid time off ### **About SRAM** SRAM LLC is one of the world's largest suppliers of components to the bike industry. Established in Chicago in 1987, SRAM continues to promote cycling through its products, its advocacy, and its employees who are dedicated to improving the cycling experience. Today, SRAM employs more than 5,000\+ employees, in 20\+ locations, across 10\+ countries. SRAM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **SRC, Inc.** is currently seeking an AI/ML Engineer to join a team building machine learning and generative AI capabilities for defense and national security missions. This is a hands\-on, early\-career engineering role focused on the practical work of turning data into working models: assembling and curating datasets, training and fine\-tuning models, and building the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether a model is actually good enough to field. You will work under the direction of senior engineers and scientists on tasks scoped within larger programs, with increasing ownership of discrete technical tasks as you develop. The work spans classical machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and the rapidly evolving generative AI toolchain, applied to real sensor data and real mission problems in ISR, EW, and advanced sensing. This is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build depth in applied ML on problems where the data is messy, the ground truth is hard\-won, and the results have to hold up under scrutiny. **What You'll Do** * Build, clean, label, and version datasets from real and simulated sources, including handling class imbalance, distribution shift, and sparse or noisy labels * Train, fine\-tune, and benchmark models using standard open\-source frameworks, running experiments as assigned and documenting results clearly * Develop and run evaluation pipelines — task\-specific metrics, held\-out and adversarial test sets, regression suites — and report findings honestly, including negative results * Support generative AI efforts through prompt development and iteration, structured output design, retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines, and comparative evaluation of open\-weight and commercial language models * Assist with parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) and supervised fine\-tuning of open\-weight models for domain\-specific tasks * Implement reinforcement learning experiments in standard environments and instrument them for reproducible measurement * Maintain reproducible experiment tracking, environment configuration, and code hygiene so that results can be regenerated by others * Contribute data, figures, and written findings to technical reports, program reviews, and oral presentations * Collaborate with algorithm engineers and domain experts to understand the sensor data and physical phenomenology behind the datasets you work with **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline and 0\+ years of experience (internships, co\-ops, research assistantships, and substantial academic project work count) * Working proficiency in Python and the core scientific stack (NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn, matplotlib) * Familiarity with at least one deep learning framework, preferably PyTorch * Exposure to the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, Tokenizers) or equivalent open\-source model tooling * Understanding of ML fundamentals: train/validation/test discipline, overfitting and regularization, cross\-validation, and the metrics appropriate to classification, regression, detection, and generation tasks * Comfort with Git\-based collaborative development * Clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to say when a result doesn't hold up **Ways to Stand Out** * Experience fine\-tuning open\-weight language models using PEFT methods (LoRA, QLoRA) or the TRL/Axolotl/Unsloth toolchain * Hands\-on work with RAG systems: embedding models, vector stores, chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation * Familiarity with LLM evaluation practice — LLM\-as\-judge, rubric\-based grading, eval harness design, and the failure modes of each * Experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools (Weights \& Biases, MLflow, DVC) * Exposure to reinforcement learning libraries (Gymnasium, Stable\-Baselines3, CleanRL) or to preference\-based post\-training methods (DPO, GRPO) * Experience with agentic workflows, tool\-calling, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) * Work with non\-natural\-image modalities: RF, radar, SAR, audio, time series, or multimodal data * Containerization (Docker) and experience running jobs on GPU clusters or cloud compute * Master's degree in a related technical discipline **What Sets Us Apart?** SRC, Inc., a not\-for\-profit research and development company, combines information, science, technology and ingenuity to solve “impossible” problems in the areas of defense, environment and intelligence. Across our family of companies, we apply bright minds, fresh thinking and relentless determination to deliver innovative products and services that are redefining possible®. When you join our team, you’ll be a part of something truly meaningful — helping to keep America and its allies safe and strong. You’ll collaborate with more than 1,400 engineers, scientists and professionals — with 20 percent of those employees having served in the military — in a highly innovative, inclusive and equitable work environment. You’ll receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package that includes four or more weeks of paid time off to start, 10 percent employer contribution toward retirement, and 100 percent tuition support. Total compensation for this role is market competitive. The anticipated salary range for this position based out of Dayton, OH is estimated at $70,000 to $96,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities, geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs. SRC offers competitive benefit options, for more details please visit our website.

jobs.description: Job Posting: Application Developer State Water Resources Control Board JC\-534724* Application Developer INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST II $8,625\.00 \- $11,557\.00 per Month New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **10/26/2026** **Application Methods:**Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account) By Mail Drop\-off Print Job Save Job ### **Job Description and Duties** **Please note, the Water Boards do not participate in E\-Verify.** The State Water Resources Control Board’s Division of Information Technology (DIT) has an opening for an Information Technology Specialist II in the Business Operations Support Branch. The position is located at 1001 I Street, 8th Floor, Sacramento, CA 95814\. ***Duties:*** Under the administrative direction of the Information Technology Manager I (ITM I) and consistent with good customer service practice and the goals of the State and Regional Board’s Strategic Plan, the incumbent will provide software and programming support to integrate existing water rights, water diversions, and water quality data with integrated statewide water data platforms and provide application support for agency enterprise web systems. The incumbent works independently and leads the planning and coordination of activities that require developing technological solutions to complex business, scientific, or engineering problems. The technologies used in the agency’s web application systems include Java EE, ASP.Net, C\#, MVC framework, AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery, Java Server Pages, Java Server Faces, Hibernate, Angular, Node.js, REST architecture, JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (JBoss EAP), ArcGIS, JavaScript API, Enterprise Java Beans, IIS, Tomcat, Web Services, MSSQL, Oracle, Azure cloud services, Software as a Service (SaaS), Red Hat Linux (RHL) and Windows Server. This position will primarily focus on .NET and Windows applications. **Additional information:** Candidates must possess essential personal qualifications including integrity, initiative, dependability, good judgment, the ability to work cooperatively with others, and the ability to perform the assigned duties of the class. If the position requires driving, you must possess a current and valid driver’s license. jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **Senior Technical Success Manager** ==================================== **Location:** Remote, Travel as Needed **Reporting to:** Technical Operations Manager At **STN**, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting\-edge solutions, and a security\-first mindset. We provide end\-to\-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future\-ready transformation. As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long\-term impact. Our approach is innovation\-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real\-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology. **Overview** ============ The Technical Success Manager is responsible for the operational, technical, and lifecycle success of assigned managed\-services customers. The position serves as a primary relationship and coordination point between the customer and STN’s Service Desk and Managed Services Operations, Engineering, Project Management Office, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and leadership teams. The Technical Success Manager develops and maintains an informed understanding of each customer’s business, stakeholders, technology environment, managed\-services agreement, support history, active initiatives, asset lifecycle, and upcoming contractual obligations. The role facilitates recurring customer meetings, monitors service performance and escalations, tracks commitments, coordinates ongoing initiatives, supports asset and technology lifecycle planning, and ensures that contract, licensing, warranty, and service renewals are identified and addressed in advance. This is a non\-commissioned role. The Technical Success Manager identifies customer needs and qualified improvement opportunities but transfers solution design, pricing, negotiation, forecasting, and closing responsibilities to the appropriate Sales, Solutions, or contract\-management resources. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Customer relationship and account knowledge** ----------------------------------------------- * Serve as a primary operational point of contact for assigned managed\-services customers. * Build relationships with customer executives, business leaders, technical contacts, department managers, and escalation stakeholders. * Understand each customer’s business operations, critical technology dependencies, supported locations, key vendors, communication preferences, and service expectations. * Maintain an accurate stakeholder map identifying decision\-makers, technical contacts, executive sponsors, renewal owners, and escalation contacts. * Maintain awareness of customer sentiment, organizational change, operational risks, business priorities, and upcoming initiatives. * Represent the customer’s interests internally while maintaining contractual, technical, and operational boundaries. **Customer meeting management** ------------------------------- * Coordinate and attend weekly, monthly, quarterly, and other scheduled customer meetings based on account requirements. * Prepare agendas using ticket activity, service performance, project status, lifecycle items, renewals, open decisions, risks, and upcoming initiatives. * Facilitate meetings or support the designated meeting owner. * Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, dependencies, and follow\-up actions. * Distribute meeting notes and action summaries within the established service standard. * Track customer commitments through completion and escalate overdue or blocked actions. * Assist with monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews, executive reviews, and technology\-planning discussions. **Support ticket and service oversight** ---------------------------------------- * Review open tickets, aging tickets, escalations, recurring incidents, reopened tickets, and customer\-impacting trends for assigned accounts. * Monitor high\-priority and customer\-sensitive issues to confirm ownership, communication cadence, and appropriate escalation. * Follow up on tickets and initiate with Managed Services Operations, who remain responsible for completing the work; keep informed and help move stalled tickets forward. * Help ensure customer\-facing updates are timely, accurate, understandable, and aligned with confirmed technical information. * Identify patterns that may require root\-cause analysis, problem management, technical remediation, training, lifecycle replacement, or project work. * Review relevant SLA performance, ticket volume, response trends, resolution trends, and backlog information. * Avoid b ative, risk, and escalation records current. * Conduct recurring internal account reviews with Service Delivery, Managed Services Operations, Engineering, PMO, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and leadership as appropriate. * Provide leadership with visibility into account health, upcoming renewals, lifecycle exposure, open commitments, escalations, and commercial handoffs. * Use the STN One portal, Atlassian products (Jira and Confluence), the ticketing system, Salesforce, NetSuite, monitoring tools, and other approved platforms according to defined processes. * Support customer onboarding, transitions, offboarding, and material environment changes, and validate that onboarding (G.9\) and offboarding (G.11\) duties are complete. * Identify possible service\-scope misunderstandings or recurring out\-of\-scope requests and route them for review. **Experience \& Qualifications** ================================ **Required** ------------ * Four or more years of experience in an MSP, IT service\-delivery, technical account\-management, customer success, or comparable customer\-facing technical role. * At least two years managing customer relationships, escalations, recurring reviews, or an assigned account portfolio. * Operational working knowledge of networks, servers, cloud services, cybersecurity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. * Experience reviewing support tickets, service metrics, customer escalations, and recurring issue trends. * Experience coordinating technical projects, upgrades, remediation activities, or customer initiatives. * Experience using a PSA, CRM, ticketing system, documentation platform, project system, asset platform, or monitoring portal. * Ability to interpret service descriptions, contract dates, licensing quantities, warranties, and renewal requirements. * Strong written communication, meeting facilitation, organization, documentation, and follow\-through skills. * Ability to communicate credibly with customer executives, business contacts, and technical teams. * Sound judgment regarding when to involve Service Delivery, Engineering, Security, PMO, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Legal, or leadership. **Preferred** ------------- * Direct Managed Service Provider employment experience. * Experience leading monthly service reviews, QBRs, executive reviews, or technology\-planning meetings. * Experience with contract renewals, software licensing, hardware warranties, leases, or vendor services. * Experience developing asset or technology lifecycle plans. * Experience with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, a customer portal, PSA, CRM, RMM or monitoring tools, and IT documentation platforms. * ITIL 4 Foundation, Microsoft Fundamentals, CompTIA, CAPM, Project\+, or similar relevant certification. * Experience working with regulated or compliance\-sensitive customers. **Physical and work requirements** ---------------------------------- * Regular use of video conferencing, collaboration tools, ticketing systems, dashboards, and customer portals. * Ability to participate in meetings across supported customer time zones. * Periodic customer, company, or vendor travel as required by account needs. * Occasional participation in urgent customer escalations outside the normal meeting schedule. * Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law and company policy. **Compensation** ================ * Full\-Time, Exempt * $100,000\-$110,000/year, DOE **Benefits** ============ * Health Coverage – Medical, Dental \& Vision * FSA Health and Dependent Care available • 401(k) Plan * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Observed Holidays Paid * Cell Phone Allowance * Collaborative, growth\-driven culture Candidates must be U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents. We are unable to provide sponsorship at this time. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis.

jobs.description: **Job Description** Sage is looking for an experienced Principal AI Engineer to build AI\-powered solutions that accelerate and automate complex data migration into Sage products. This is a senior, hands\-on technical role for someone who can independently own substantial engineering initiatives, translate ambiguous problems into practical solutions, and take those solutions from concept through production. Qualifications - 10\+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI, or closely related engineering disciplines. - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field from a top\-tier university. - Graduate study or an advanced degree in AI, machine learning, data science, or a related technical field is desirable. - Significant hands\-on experience building and deploying applied data science and/or machine learning solutions. - Strong software engineering skills and experience developing production\-grade systems. - Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, or related AI Ops / MLOps practices is desirable. - Demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver large, technically complex projects. - Strong understanding of data pipelines, data transformation, and working with large or complex datasets. - Experience applying modern AI technologies, including LLMs, to real\-world business problems. - Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving environment with significant technical ambiguity. Perks? We have plenty. - Competitive salaries that landed us top 5% of similar sized companies (according to Comparably) - Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage - 401(k) retirement match (100% matching up to 4%) - 32 days paid time off (21 personal days, 10 national holidays, 1 floating holiday) - 18 weeks paid parental leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy offered 1 year after start date - 5 days paid yearly to volunteer (through Sage Foundation) - $5,250 tuition reimbursement per calendar year starting 6 months after hire date - Sage Wellness Rewards Program ($600 wellness credit and $360 fitness reimbursement annually) - Library of on demand career development options and ongoing training offerings Dig deeper about who we are: - Who is Sage: https://www.sage.com/en\-us/company/about\-sage/ - Life at Sage: https://www.sage.com/en\-us/company/careers/ - Our Values \& Behaviors: https://www.youtube.com/watch?app\=desktop\&v\=vt5JXf\-Gwno\&feature\=youtu.be - How we make a difference: https://www.sage.com/en\-us/company/sage\-foundation/ - Sage Business Cloud \- SaaS for Every Business: https://www.sage.com/en\-us/products/ \#LI\-MT1

As a faith\-driven organization, our Statement of Faith shapes every aspect of our global work. Please take time to review the following link as you consider working with us: https://www.samaritanspurse.org/our\-ministry/statement\-of\-faith/ **What is the opportunity?** ---------------------------- ### ***Respond with Compassionate Action*** We are seeking an **AI Security Engineer** to join our **Information Technology** team in **Boone, NC**. Through humanitarian work, the goal and purpose of Samaritan's Purse are to help people in Jesus' name and share the Gospel of Jesus Christ. In the role of **AI Security Engineer**,you will have the opportunity to: * Maintain a personal, active relationship with Jesus Christ and is a consistent witness for Jesus Christ. * Design, secure, and maintain infrastructure supporting the ministry's AI workloads. Collaborate with cybersecurity and technical teams to implement container and cluster security, workload isolation, access controls, and network segmentation. * Conduct security assessments, threat modeling, and adversarial testing of AI applications, model endpoints, and integrations. Apply emerging threat intelligence and recognized AI security frameworks to identify risks and strengthen controls. * Monitor security alerts, logs, and audit trails across Kubernetes and AI workloads. Develop threat detections, investigate potential incidents, and support incident response and on\-call coverage in accordance with established procedures. * Identify and prioritize vulnerabilities and supply chain risks across the AI stack, including containers, infrastructure components, models, datasets, and tooling. Collaborate with technical teams to coordinate remediation. * Support AI governance by implementing technical controls, maintaining audit evidence, and providing cybersecurity guidance to support acceptable use and secure agent execution. * Other duties as assigned. **What are the qualifications?** -------------------------------- ***Serve with Excellence*** As a qualified candidate, you will have the following skills and experience: * Bachelor's degree in a related field from an accredited college or university and five (5\) to seven (7\) years of related experience and/or training, including demonstrated hands\-on experience securing Kubernetes and production artificial intelligence or machine learning workloads; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * At least one cybersecurity certification in Kubernetes or container security, such as CKS, or artificial intelligence security, such as CompTIA SecAI\+, required; or a general cybersecurity certification, such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, OSCP, GIAC, or similar, combined with demonstrated Kubernetes and artificial intelligence security experience. * Comprehensive knowledge of Kubernetes, container security, and Linux, including RBAC, admission controls, workload isolation, network policies, secrets management, and workload identity. * Comprehensive knowledge of AI security, including generative and agentic applications, model serving, RAG pipelines, and tool integrations, with experience mitigating prompt injections, context poisoning, and data exfiltration. * Thorough knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OpenStack), automation and CI/CD tools (Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins), and cybersecurity solutions (SIEM, EDR, SOAR, DLP, vulnerability and identity management), including scripting and software and AI supply chain security. * 12 credit hours of college\-level Biblical Studies (required); jobs.title: Process Engineer

Our technologies help detect faults, prevent equipment damage, and reduce the impact of power outages. Our mission is to make electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical. Employees contribute to practical, high\-quality solutions used every day, where attention to detail and quality directly support the reliability of the electric grid. **Location:** **West Lafayette, IN** – This position is located in West Lafayette, IN, a welcoming community that combines small\-town charm with the energy of world\-class university town. Home to Purdue University, the area is known for its innovation, strong schools, and vibrant community. Residents enjoy parks and outdoor recreation, local events, diverse dining options, and an affordable cost of living, all while being conveniently located within driving distance of Indianapolis and Chicago. **Competitive pay. integration, and cross\-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot process and equipment issues and improve manufacturing capability. * Develop new lithography processes and execute qualification plans for new chemicals, materials, and process changes. * Lead engineering projects to close process performance gaps, achieve milestones, and deliver measurable improvements in yield, productivity, and cost. * Apply data mining, programming, scripting, and statistical analysis techniques to improve process understanding and engineering efficiency. * Communicate technical findings and present data\-driven recommendations effectively while building strong working relationships across engineering, manufacturing, and support organizations. * Manage multiple projects independently, demonstrate strong technical ownership, and consistently deliver commitments in a high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering or a related technical field. * 4 plus years of experience in photolithography process engineering experience in a high volume mass production environment. * Applied knowledge of photolithography processes, process optimization, overlay and alignment improvement, and critical dimension (CD) variation reduction. * Tools: Experience optimizing process on TEL tracks and ASML Steppers \& Scanners (I Line, KrF, \& dry ArF). * Chemicals: Experience setting up and optimizing Resist process with \& without TARCs or BARCs on existing fab tool. * Metrology: Experience with Overlay on ARCHER tools (DOE), data mining, and process data analysis. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a meticulous, data\-driven approach to process improvement. * Experience identifying process variation, reducing defectivity, improving yield, and addressing process marginalities in a production environment. * Strong communication, project management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Required Skills \& Experience * 5\+ years of experience in **Data Science, Machine Learning, or Applied AI**. * Strong programming experience with **Python** and commonly used data science libraries. * Hands\-on experience developing and deploying **machine learning models** for classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, or recommendation use cases. * Strong understanding of **supervised and unsupervised learning**, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and performance evaluation. * Practical experience with **neural networks and deep learning**. * Experience with frameworks such as **PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras**. * Understanding of neural network architectures including **CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, Transformers**, or similar architectures. * Experience working with **NLP, text analytics, or unstructured data** is highly desirable. * Some hands\-on experience with **Generative AI / LLMs**, including prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG, or LLM\-based applications. * Familiarity with **OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI**, or comparable GenAI platforms is a plus. * Experience with **SQL** and working with structured and unstructured datasets. * Experience using **Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, Matplotlib/Seaborn**, or equivalent tools. * Understanding of **model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, cross\-validation, and model explainability**. * Experience with cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP**. * Familiarity with **ML pipelines, MLOps, model deployment, and monitoring**. * Ability to translate business problems into measurable **data science and machine learning solutions**. Key Responsibilities * Analyze large and complex datasets to identify patterns, trends, and business opportunities. * Develop and optimize machine learning models for business and operational use cases. * Design and implement neural\-network and deep\-learning solutions where appropriate. * Perform feature engineering, data preprocessing, model training, and validation. * Evaluate models using appropriate statistical and machine\-learning metrics. * Experiment with different algorithms and architectures to improve model performance. * Work with data engineers to prepare reliable datasets and scalable data pipelines. * Develop proof\-of\-concepts using **LLMs and Generative AI** for selected business use cases. * Build or contribute to **RAG, embeddings, vector\-search, and prompt\-engineering** solutions. * Collaborate with engineering teams to productionize machine\-learning models. * Monitor model performance and recommend improvements or retraining strategies. * Present analytical findings, model results, and recommendations to technical and business stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Master's degree in **Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field**. * Experience with **Transformers, LLMs, NLP, RAG, embeddings, or vector databases**. * Experience with **Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP**. * Familiarity with **Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Airflow, or CI/CD**. * Experience taking machine\-learning models from **prototype to production**. * Experience working in enterprise environments such as **financial services, retail, healthcare, technology, or manufacturing**. Technical Stack **Languages:** Python, SQL **Machine Learning:** Scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM **Deep Learning:** PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras **AI/GenAI:** LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Search, Transformers **Data:** Pandas, NumPy, Spark, Databricks, Snowflake **Cloud:** AWS / Azure / GCP **MLOps:** MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD **Visualization:** Power BI, Tableau, Matplotlib, Seaborn **Core requirement:** The candidate should be genuinely hands\-on with **traditional machine learning and neural networks**, with **practical exposure to GenAI/LLMs** Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Sonos we want to create the ultimate listening experience for our customers and know that it starts by listening to each other. As part of the Sonos team, you’ll collaborate with people of all styles, skill sets, and backgrounds to realize our vision while fostering a community where everyone feels included and empowered to do the best work of their lives. This position is considered hybrid, allowing for a combination of remote work and in\-office collaboration. Qualified applicants must live within commuting distance of our Boston office location and should expect to be in office 3 days per week. As a Junior CI/CD Engineer, you'll build and maintain the continuous integration and delivery pipeline that helps our software engineers go from ideas to code to a releasable artifact. You'll contribute to and learn about workflow automation, including source control management, automated test frameworks, continuous integration and test execution, quality metrics and reporting, artifact and release systems, and delivery through cloud services. If any of this sounds like fun, read on and let's connect soon. **What You'll Do** CI/CD Engineers work directly with software engineers to create solutions that let them do their best work. You will learn from and contribute to projects including: * Source control management systems (Git) * Automated test frameworks and tooling for applications built on Mac, Windows and Linux (Python, Java and C\+\+) * Continuous integration and deployment systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) * Artifact and release management systems (Artifactory) * Test execution, results and quality gates within the build and release pipeline * Monitoring, dashboards and data visualization of test and performance metrics (Datadog, Tableau, Snowflake) * Internal Python scripts used to package and publish software releases * Cloud infrastructure (AWS), including EKS, EBS and Lambda * Workflow and collaboration tools (GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Slack) **You'll Need** Basic Qualifications * 0\-2 years of experience in a software development, DevOps, build or release engineering role, internship or co\-op * Degree in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or equivalent work experience * Basic programming experience with Python and/or Bash * Familiarity with version control concepts and Git * Exposure to or coursework involving software build systems or scripting * Basic understanding of visualization tools (Datadog) * Eagerness to learn CI/CD tools and workflow automation practices * Excellent written and verbal communication skills Preferred Qualifications * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions * Experience writing or modifying test frameworks (pytest, JUnit or similar) * Exposure to cloud\-based infrastructure (AWS) or containerization concepts (Docker) * Familiarity with Agile project management tools such as Jira * Exposure to Kubernetes, ArgoCD or infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, JCasC) **Inclusion:** Research shows that some candidates may not apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. If you don't have 100% of the skills listed, we still strongly encourage you to apply if interested. **Visa Sponsorship:** Sonos is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role at this time. We ask that applicants be authorized to work for us in country of role posting, both now and in the future. \#LI\-Hybrid Your profile will be reviewed and you'll hear from us once we have an update. At Sonos we take the time to hire right and appreciate your patience. The base pay range for this role based off geographic location is: $93,000 and $115,900 The specific pay offered will depend on the candidate’s geographic location, as well as qualifications and experience. We apply geographic pay differentials based on the cost of labor in the market. Employees in high\-cost locations may be compensated at the upper end of the range, while those in medium or low cost markets may be compensated at the lower end of the range. Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. Please note that compensation details listed in US job postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. We also offer a comprehensive benefits program with choice and flexibility in mind to help support the health, wealth, and overall well\-being of our employees. Regular full time employees in the US are eligible for benefits on day one, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * A 401(k) plan with company matching and immediate vesting * An Open Time Off policy (OTO) so you have maximum opportunity to disconnect and recharge, with no tenure\-based vacation accruals required * 80 hours of sick time upon hire, refreshed annually * Up to 12 paid holidays per calendar year * Sonos offers a generous paid leave program for new parents or to care for a family member with a serious health condition, as well as short\- and long\-term disability for your own medical condition * Company\-paid Disability, Life, and AD\&D Insurance * Voluntary benefits, including Voluntary Life, AD\&D, Accident, and Pet Insurance * Mental health benefits to support your holistic well\-being * A generous employee discount program \& Sonos Radio HD \- on us! Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. Notice to U.S. Job Applicants: Sonos is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. Sonos is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e\-mail to accommodations@sonos.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – Data
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. **Staff Software Engineer – Data** ================================== Do you want to join a team of talented engineers building the next generation of real\-time data platforms that power analytics and data\-driven experiences across PlayStation? As part of our Data Platform team, you will play a key technical leadership role in designing and evolving the Real\-Time Analytics Platform (RTAP), enabling high\-throughput, low\-latency analytics and stream processing at PlayStation scale. The Software Engineers within our Platform Engineering Group design, build, document, and operate large\-scale distributed data platforms that support real\-time and near real\-time analytics across PlayStation. You will solve complex distributed systems challenges, evolve our streaming and analytics architecture, integrate AI\-powered platform capabilities, and improve scalability, reliability, performance, and developer productivity. We're looking for someone who is passionate about distributed systems, real\-time analytics, and building scalable data platforms. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Data Engineering teams to shape technical strategy, influence architecture across organizations, mentor engineers, and help drive the long\-term evolution of PlayStation's data platform. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, and operate large\-scale distributed data systems that power real\-time and near real\-time analytics,, and data\-driven applications across PlayStation. * Lead the architecture and evolution of RTAP's stream processing and analytics platforms, improving scalability, reliability, performance, and developer productivity. * Own critical platform capabilities end\-to\-end from architecture and implementation through production operations, performance optimization, reliability, and lifecycle management. * Build and optimize distributed data services using technologies such as Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, ClickHouse, and Apache Druid to support high\-throughput, low\-latency workloads. * Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate batch and streaming workloads using modern lakehouse architectures and build interoperable, scalable data platforms. * Build AI\-powered capabilities to automate engineering workflows, improve data quality, simplify platform operations, accelerate troubleshooting, and enhance developer productivity. * Establish technical standards and engineering best practices for distributed systems, stream processing, data modeling, query optimization and platform reliability. * Mentor engineers across the organization by reviewing architecture, designs, and code while raising the technical bar through coaching and technical leadership. * Partner with Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Platform Engineering teams to define long\-term technical strategy and deliver scalable platform capabilities aligned with business priorities. * Investigate and resolve complex production challenges involving high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed systems, ensuring high availability and operational excellence. * Participate in the team's production support and on\-call rotation, leading incident response, conducting root\-cause analysis, and implementing reliability improvements that strengthen the platform over time * Evaluate emerging technologies and distributed data platforms, recommending investments that improve scalability, reliability, developer productivity, and cost efficiency. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of experience designing and building large\-scale distributed systems, with expertise in real\-time data processing, analytics, or data platform engineering. * Strong proficiency in **Python**, with experience building production\-grade distributed systems and data processing applications. Experience with **Scala** is beneficial for supporting and evolving existing platform components. * Hands\-on expertise designing and operating large\-scale stream processing applications using **Apache Flink**, **Apache Spark Structured Streaming**, or equivalent distributed streaming technolo g distributed analytics platforms using **ClickHouse**, **Apache Druid**, or equivalent high\-performance OLAP/analytics databases, including query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning at scale. * Experience building and consuming event\-driven data pipelines using **AWS MSK**, **Apache Kafka**, or equivalent messaging platforms, with a focus on developing reliable, scalable data processing applications. * Experience applying **AI/ML techniques and modern AI tooling** to automate engineering workflows, improve data pipelines, simplify platform operations, and enhance developer productivity. * Strong systems design skills with the ability to evaluate architectural trade\-offs across scalability, latency, throughput, consistency, reliability, and cost. * Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture ownership, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical decisions across multiple teams. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with **Databricks**, **Apache Iceberg**, or modern lakehouse architectures, with the ability to design and integrate batch and streaming workloads into scalable, production\-grade data platforms. * Experience building or operating **multi\-tenant, self\-service data platforms** supporting multiple engineering organizations. * Experience collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams across multiple organizations and time zones to deliver shared platform capabilities and drive technical alignment. **Your First 90 Days** **30 Days:** Develop a strong understanding of the platform's architecture, capabilities, engineering practices, and roadmap.Begin contributing to architecture discussions, feature development, design reviews, and production support.Build relationships within the team as well as across the Data Platform organization. **60 Days:** Take technical ownership of a major platform capability or architectural area. Identify opportunities to improve scalability, performance, reliability, or developer productivity.Collaborate with Data Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, and other partner teams on cross\-platform initiatives. **90 Days:** Lead the design and delivery of key roadmap initiatives for the team..Influence technical direction across teams and mentor engineers on distributed systems and platform engineering best practices.Establish clear architectural recommendations for the next phase of the platform's evolution. In 90 days, you will have a detailed understanding of the **Real\-Time Analytics Platform** and its role within PlayStation's broader data ecosystem. You will be comfortable owning complex distributed systems initiatives, partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams, and driving large\-scale solutions from architecture through production delivery. Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Site Reliability Engineer focused on campus reliability, you will design what the campus watches and trusts, technically command cross\-discipline SEVs, and build the guardrails that make the next incident smaller. You are the connective tissue across compute, network, storage, power, and cooling on one of the largest AI training campuses in the world. This role demands calm incident leadership, fleet\-scale observability judgment, and the ability to drive reliability work across software and facility boundaries. We are looking for candidates from power plants, nuclear power plants, data centers, or people who currently work or have worked in facilities like SpaceXSI with power, compute, cooling, and related plant systems. RESPONSIBILITIES: * Own monitoring architecture and signal quality across GPU and host telemetry (DCGM, Prometheus/Grafana) and facility telemetry (BMS, EPMS, DCIM, SCADA, CDU / direct liquid cooling): what we alert on, suppress, and trust. Consume NOC noise\-disposition feedback to drive suppression and redesign. Treat alert noise as a design failure, not an operator failure. * Provide SEV command support: technical incident leadership, bridge coordination with the NOC, paging and escalation (e.g., PagerDuty), and timeline and severity hygiene. * Run blameless postmortems and drive corrective actions to closed, not filed. * Gate high\-risk change: fleet\-scale firmware/BIOS/BMC rollouts (Redfish, canaries, rollback) and SOP/MOP/EOP\-governed work on power and cooling systems through a disciplined change management process. * Lead cross\-functional reliability projects spanning compute, network (InfiniBand/RoCE), storage, and facility signal boundaries, including grey failures that cross those boundaries (e.g., NVLink flapping, thermal throttling, power sequencing). * Partner with Hardware Failure Analysis on systemic failure classes: turn fleet data (MTBF/AFR, repeat\-RMA trends) into monitoring, stop\-rules, and vendor RCA inputs. * Build and maintain playbooks, run game days, and keep cross\-discipline dependency maps current. Own runbook quality jointly with the NOC (SRE designs; NOC operates and corrects). * Define error budgets and availability objectives at campus and service boundaries as adopted by the business. * Participate in on\-call rotations and incident response for SEV\-class events in the Memphis / Southaven data center campus. PROFILE SIGNALS: * Experience in power plants, nuclear power plants, data centers, or facilities like SpaceXSI — current or prior — spanning power, compute, cooling, or related plant systems. * Proven large\-scale incident command experience and calm technical leadership on a bridge. Nuclear control\-room, shift supervisor / Senior Reactor Operator (SRO), Shift Technical Advisor, or Navy nuclear experience counts as incident command. * Demonstrated monitoring and observability design at fleet or campus scale, including alert hygiene, suppression, and signal quality. Treats alert noise as a design failure, not an operator failure. * Cross\-team facilitation and systems engineering depth across software and facility boundaries. SUCCESS MEASURED BY: * MTTD / MTTR trend for SEV\-class events * % of SEVs with a blameless postmortem and closed action items * Alert actionable ratio * Recurrence rate of incident classes * Monitoring coverage of critical dependencies across compute, network, storage, power, and cooling * GPU fleet availability lost to infrastructure events BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of experience in site reliability, systems engineering, plant operations, or large\-scale production operations, preferably in power plants, nuclear power plants, high\-performance computing, or data center environments. * Proven large\-scale incident command experience and calm technical leadership on a bridge, whether from an SRE/NOC bridge or a plant control room. * Demonstrated monitoring and observability design at fleet or campus scale, including alert hygiene, suppression, and signal quality. * Hands\-on experience with at least one of: Prometheus/Grafana, NVIDIA DCGM, or industrial telemetry and controls (SCADA, BMS/BAS, EPMS, DCIM, PLCs, Modbus/BACnet). * Experience working across at least two of: compute, network, storage, power, and cooling / facilities telemetry. * Experience writing and operating playbooks, runbooks, or SOP/MOP/EOPs with a 24/7 operations, control room, or NOC partner. * Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) for automation and analysis, plus general experience in at least one systems language (C, C\+\+, Java, Go, Rust, or similar). Not required to be expert in all of them. * Excellent problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven approach to reliability engineering. * Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams, including NOC, data center operations, hardware failure analysis, and infrastructure engineering. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: * Experience in power plants, nuclear power plants, or other high\-consequence industrial control environments (ICS/OT). * Current or prior work in data centers or facilities like SpaceXSI spanning power, compute, cooling, and related plant systems, including CDU / direct liquid cooling. * Experience in AI/ML infrastructure or supercomputing environments: GB200/NVL72 or H100/H200\-class GPU fleets, NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE, Slurm or Kubernetes. * Fleet firmware and BMC management (Redfish, IPMI), including firmware release validation and staged rollouts. * Reliability engineering methods: MTBF/AFR analysis, reliability\-centered maintenance, grey\-failure diagnosis, and vendor RCA/RMA partnership. * Experience with CMMS (e.g., Maximo) and commissioning / integrated systems testing (IST) and operational turnover. * Hands\-on definition and use of SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets at service or campus boundaries. * Experience running game days, dependency mapping, and closed\-loop corrective action programs. * Familiarity with data center hardware and plant signals (servers, GPUs, networking, power, cooling) in addition to software telemetry. * Prior work in a fast\-paced startup or tech company like SpaceXSI. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Spectral Labs is building foundation models for engineering physical systems. We're looking for an AI engineer to build the systems that put those models to work: agents that read, edit, and generate CAD, the tool interfaces that connect LLMs to our geometry models, and the task\-level evals that decide what's ready to ship. You bring 3–5 years building software with LLMs or other ML models, hands\-on experience with agents and multi\-step LLM systems, and strong Python. Experience scripting CAD tools through their APIs is a big plus. We're excited about people who can make an impact, whatever their background. This is a fully in\-person role at our office in SF. Compensation and equity total $250–350k annually. We sponsor visas end\-to\-end, and benefits include health insurance (with a 100%\-premium option), dental, a 401(k) match, and company\-expensed meals and commuting. **Compensation Range:** $250K \- $350K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform (Mid-Senior Level)
jobs.description: ### **About Sprinter Health** **At Sprinter Health, our mission is reimagining how people access care by bringing it directly to their homes.** Nearly 30% of patients in the U.S. skip preventive or chronic care simply because they can’t get to a doctor’s office. For many, the ER becomes their first touchpoint with the healthcare system, driving over **$300B in avoidable costs every year.** By using the same technologies that power leading marketplace and last\-mile platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most. So far, we’ve supported more than **2 million patients across 22 states, completed 130,000\+ in\-home visits, and maintained a 92 NPS**. Our team of clinicians, technologists, and operators have raised over $125M to date from investors like **a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel** and enjoy multi\-year runway. ### **About the Role** We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer (5\+ years experience) who is passionate about platform engineering and wants to build the foundational systems that enable our engineering organization to scale. At Sprinter, you'll build the infrastructure, internal tooling, and shared services that help engineers develop, deploy, and operate software more efficiently. From improving CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure to building developer tools, automation, and observability systems, you'll own the platforms that make our engineering teams faster, more reliable, and more effective. This is a hands\-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code but is most motivated by improving how other engineers build software. You'll work across application code, infrastructure, and operational systems, solving complex technical challenges that have an outsized impact across the organization. ### **Hybrid \& Office Experience** We operate on a hybrid schedule, working from the office Monday through Thursday, with Fridays designated as work\-from\-anywhere days. We care deeply about work\-life balance and are happy to provide flexibility when life happens. We ask that employees be in the office Monday through Thursday to collaborate with their teams while maintaining flexibility where it matters most. Lunch is provided every day, and the entire team takes an hour to eat together. It's one of the ways we stay connected outside of meetings. You'll usually find us playing a board game before getting back to work. ### **What you will do:** * Design and build internal tools, shared services, and automation that improve developer productivity across engineering teams * Own and improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and infrastructure that enable engineers to ship software quickly and reliably * Build and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure, developer environments, and foundational services that support our growing platform * Improve observability, monitoring, and operational tooling to make our systems easier to debug, maintain, and operate * Develop reusable frameworks, infrastructure components, and self\-service tooling that reduce manual work and accelerate development * Partner closely with engineering teams to identify bottlenecks, improve development workflows, and drive adoption of platform capabilities * Own foundational engineering projects end to end, making pragmatic architectural decisions that balance reliability, scalability, and developer experience ### **What you have done:** * Spent 5\+ years building and scaling backend software, infrastructure, or platform systems in production * Built internal developer tools, automation, shared services, or infrastructure that support multiple engineering teams * Worked hands\-on with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment systems, and production environments * Designed and implemented reliable, maintainable software that improves how other engineers build, test, deploy, or operate applications * Led technical projects end to end, from architecture and implementation through rollout, adoption, and ongoing maintenance * Collaborated across engineering teams to understand developer pain points and translate them into scalable technical solutions * Made technical decisions that balance developer productivity, operational reliability, and long\-term maintainability ### **What gives you an edge:** * You've deliberately built your career around platform engineering, developer experience, infrastructure, or developer productivity * You've built internal platforms, CLIs, frameworks, or self\-service tooling adopted by multiple engineering teams * You've improved engineering velocity through faster deployments, more reliable CI/CD pipelines, or reduced operational overhead * You've worked extensively with AWS, serverless architectures, infrastructure as code, or cloud\-native systems * You've implemented observability, monitoring, or incident management tooling that improved production reliability * You've worked in mid\- or growth\-stage startups (Series A–C) where infrastructure and developer tooling needed to evolve alongside rapid product development * You've measured the success of your work through developer adoption, deployment frequency, system reliability, or improvements in engineering efficiency ### **The Interview Process** **We aim to complete the interview process between 2–3 weeks. It will usually consist of:** * Recruiter Screen (30 Minutes) * Technical Assessment (45 Minutes) * Hiring Manager Introduction (30 Minutes) * Onsite Interview: Systems Design \+ Behavioral Interview \+ Lunch with the Team (3 Hours) * References ### **What we offer** * Meaningful pre\-IPO equity * Medical, dental, and vision plans 100% paid for you and your dependents * Flexible PTO \+ 10 paid holidays per year * 401(k) with match * 16\-week parental leave policy for birthing parent, 8 weeks for all other parents * HSA \+ FSA contributions * Life insurance, plus short and long\-term disability coverage * Free daily lunch in\-office * Annual learning stipend ### **Our Technology Stack** * Serverless AWS (AppSync, DynamoDB, Lambda, Amplify, CloudFormation, Node) * React Native, React Native for Web * GraphQL * TypeScript * JavaScript * Node.js Sprinter Health is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or other protected classes. *Beware of recruitment fraud and scams that involve fictitious job descriptions followed by false job offers.* *If you are applying for a job, you can confirm the legitimacy of a job posting by viewing current open roles on our official**Sprinter Health Careers website**. All legitimate job postings will require an application to be made directly through our official careers website. Job\-related communications will only be sent from email addresses ending in @**sprinterhealth.com**. Please ensure that you're only replying to emails that end in @**sprinterhealth.com**.* Compensation Range: $175K \- $225K

jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm.
