jobs.title: AI Systems Analyst Builder
jobs.description: **AI Systems Analyst \& Builder** *Sticker Pack, Inc. \| Sparks, Nevada \| Onsite, full time \| $70,000 starting salary \| Read the whole post for application directions* **Brief Summary** We make custom stickers and magnets for national parks, gift shops, resort towns, and the tourist shops you wander into on every road trip. There is a decent chance something we printed is on a fridge near you right now. We run two production facilities in the Reno area, our people are genuinely great, and we have decided to build our own software instead of renting someone else's. We are looking for one person who is half analyst, half builder, and fully dangerous with AI. You will figure out how our business actually works, map it, find what the data is telling us, and then build the tools that fix it, with Claude as your daily driver. Some weeks you will be deep in SQL figuring out why reorders dropped. Some weeks you will be shipping a feature the sales team uses the same afternoon. Most weeks, both. Let's be honest about the filter. This is not a job for someone who is "interested in AI." It is for someone who already builds with it every day, knows exactly where it lies to you, and gets a little irritated when a process takes three clicks that should take zero. You do not need ten years of experience. You do need to be very, very good, and hungry to get better. *The good news*: you won't be figuring it out alone. You will work closely with an experienced senior engineer who reviews your work and helps you level up fast. If you read this and thought "finally," keep going. **What Success Looks Like** * First 30 days: you know our stack, our data, and our people, and you have shipped at least one real fix or report that someone on the floor noticed. * First 90 days: our core workflows (quote to order to production to invoice) are mapped with clear entrance and exit criteria, and you own at least one internal tool end to end. * Leadership answers key business questions from a dashboard instead of waiting on a spreadsheet. * Sales and production staff spend measurably less time on admin work because something you built does it for them. * Our SOPs are current, clear, and actually used, by people and by our AI assistant. * Every system you touch is documented well enough that someone else could pick it up tomorrow. **Duties \& Responsibilities** Roughly half analysis and process, half building. The mix will shift week to week. **Process Mapping \& SOPs** * Sit with Sales, Production, and the warehouse to learn how work actually happens, then map it: swimlanes, handoffs, entrance and exit criteria. * Write and maintain our SOPs as clean markdown files. These are not shelf documents. They feed our internal Slack AI assistant, so a good SOP literally makes the whole company smarter. * Keep our data definitions consistent, so "active account" means the same thing in every report and every system. * Turn "that's just how we've always done it" into a system, and explain the why to the people who use it. **Data \& Analysis** * Query, clean, and analyze sales, customer, and production data (SQL, Python, pandas) to answer real questions: churn risk, reorder behavior, rep performance, margin by product line. * Build dashboards and reports that leadership actually opens. * Spot the problem before anyone asks. Bring the owners the number that changes the conversation. **Build** * Design, build, and ship internal tools and features using AI assisted development, on Supabase (Postgres), Vercel, Shopify, GitHub, and Slack. * Improve our internal Slack AI assistant: what it knows, what it can look up, and how well it answers. * Connect systems through APIs and webhooks so data gets entered once and flows everywhere it needs to go. * Review and test what AI writes before it ships. You own the output, not the model. * Follow our review rules: changes to the database, money, customer data, or permissions get a senior review before they merge. **Who You Work With** * *Our systems lead:* your manager and day to day partner. Owns priorities and the big picture on our operations systems. * *An outside senior engineer*: your mentor and reviewer. Weekly sessions for your first 90 days, then regular check ins. Reviews your work on critical systems and teaches you how to make bigger technical calls. * *The owners:* direct access, fast decisions, no committees. * *An outside security firm:* audits our systems on a regular schedule. * *Sales, production, and warehouse teams:* your users. They will tell you when something is wrong. Listen to them. **Desired Qualifications \& Traits** * AI Fluent, Not AI Dependent: builds with Claude (or similar) every day and knows its failure modes cold. Can tell when the model is confidently wrong. * Analytical: validates assumptions with data, not vibes. Comfortable telling the owners the numbers say otherwise. * Process Brain: can walk into a messy workflow, ask the right questions, and walk out with a clear map and an SOP people actually follow. * Systems Thinker: sees how a change to the sales form shows up on the production floor three steps later. * Builder: would rather ship a working v1 on Tuesday than a perfect diagram next month. * Translator: explains technical things to non technical people in plain English, without making anyone feel dumb. * Coachable: takes a hard code review well, asks good questions, and comes back better. **Experience \& Requirements** **Must Have** * Proof you can do the work: projects, analyses, tools, or systems you built and shipped. We care about this far more than your resume. * Strong SQL, plus working Python or TypeScript/JavaScript. * Data analysis experience: cleaning messy data and turning it into a clear answer. * Daily, hands on use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to build real things. * You know why orders and line items live in separate tables. * Able to work onsite in Sparks, Nevada. **Nice to Have** * Process mapping (swimlanes, BPMN) and writing SOPs or documentation. * BI tools and dashboard design. * Understands database architecture and is comfortable using that structure to serve production deployments. * Building LLM agents or retrieval (RAG) systems. * QuickBooks data, Monday.com, or manufacturing and wholesale operations. **Education** A degree is welcome, and not required. Self taught, bootcamp, career changer from ops or finance: all welcome if you can show us the work. **The Fine Print** **What You** ***Won't*** **Get** * A big engineering team. It's you, our systems lead, a senior mentor, and a lot of AI. * A product manager writing your tickets. You will talk to the people who need the thing. * Clean data. You will meet our QuickBooks exports. You will have opinions. * A remote job. We move fast, and fast happens in the same room. * Boredom. **What You** ***Will*** **Get** * Real ownership of systems a whole company runs on, early in your career. * Weekly mentorship from an experienced senior engineer. That's rare. Use it. * $70,000 starting salary, with pay reviews at 90 days and six months tied to the success milestones above, plus health, vision, and dental insurance options. * Nevada: no state income tax, and Lake Tahoe less than an hour away. * Bragging rights: the systems you build put stickers in national park gift shops. **How to Apply** We read every application that follows these instructions, and none that don't. Send the following to *hr@stickerpack.com* : * Your resume. (Short is fine.) * A link to something you built or analyzed: a repo, a git\-hub project, a live app, a dashboard, a write up. In a few sentences, tell us what you did and what the AI did. * Short answers to these three questions: * Tell us about a time an AI tool gave you confidently wrong code or analysis. How did you catch it? * Describe a messy process you turned into a system. What was broken, and what did you build? * Tell us about a time the data said something nobody expected. What did you find, and what happened next? * Don't click the apply button. Follow the directions. **Write those answers yourself.** Use AI for everything else in this job, just not this part. **We can tell.** **What to Expect** A 30 minute intro call. Then a live session with our senior engineer: you work through a real build and a real data question, using your usual AI tools, while we watch how you think. Then a visit to meet the team and see the floor. Fast process, fast answer. Pay: $70,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Parental leave Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI\-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. We have built a highly automated, AI\-forward experience for every client\-facing role, from intake to settlement, and it is one of the leading examples of applied AI in the legal field: Our case teams run at a fraction of the headcount our largest peers need for the same work. The systems behind that result are built in\-house, and you will be one of the people building them. Sweet James is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to own AI features end to end: Learn the work from the people who do it, build the system, measure it, ship it, and run it in production. The systems you will work on read and file documents, pull facts from medical records and police reports, answer questions across a case's full history, and run agents that chase records and draft routine work for staff to approve. You will report to the Lead AI Engineer, who sets the architecture and build plan; you own delivery within it. This is an individual\-contributor seat for someone who drives work forward with urgency and high quality without waiting to be told how, and whose work reaches case teams within weeks, not quarters. Responsibilities * Build: Ship production AI features, including structured extraction, classification and routing, case search, and agents that act with a person approving the result. * Integrate: Connect those features to the firm's systems (e.g., Salesforce/Litify, Microsoft Graph for Outlook and SharePoint, Zoom, Twilio, Retell, DocuSign). * Measure: Build the evaluation sets and tests for your features so every model or prompt change is measured on facts captured, facts missed, wrong answers, cost, and speed before it ships. * Run: Deploy your services as containers on Azure, monitor them, and fix them when they break. * Learn and train: Sit with intake, case management, records, and litigation staff before automating their work, and train them on what you ship. * Document: Write each system down so anyone on the team can run it. Qualifications Required: * Experience: 5\+ years building production software, including 2\+ years shipping LLM\-powered features to real users. * Ownership: A record of taking ambiguous problems to shipped outcomes with little supervision, and of finishing what you start. * LLM craft: Hands\-on work with LLM APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) spanning prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, retrieval, and evaluation. * Stack: Strong Python or TypeScript/Node (both preferred), SQL and Postgres, REST APIs and webhooks, Git, Docker, and cloud deployment (Azure preferred). * Communication: Care with sensitive data and the ability to explain technical work in plain language. Preferred: * Models and tooling: Vector search (e.g., pgvector), evaluation frameworks, and agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol. * Workflow automation: Platforms such as n8n. * Salesforce: APIs and SOQL; Litify a plus. * Voice: Voice AI or telephony (e.g., Retell, Twilio, Zoom). * Documents and industry: OCR and document processing; legal, insurance, or healthcare data Sweet James is an equal opportunity employer. As a leading innovator in tax prep software, TaxSlayer, LLC, has been revolutionizing the way people file their taxes since 1965\. Our employees are among the brightest, most talented group of innovators who work collaboratively to improve our products and exceed customer expectations season after season. Are **you** a TaxSlayer? **Job Summary** --------------- The Principal Data Scientist is a senior technical leader who drives advanced machine learning and data science initiatives across the organization. This role combines hands\-on technical expertise with strategic influence. The Principal Data Scientist owns end\-to\-end delivery of complex ML projects, presents recommendations to leadership, leads technical discussions, and serves as the recognized authority on modeling approaches. The role partners cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Marketing to define and solve high\-impact business problems, with particular focus on fraud detection, customer intelligence, and risk modeling. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Own end\-to\-end delivery of strategic, high\-impact data science projects from problem definition through production deployment, monitoring, and optimization. Lead scoping discussions and present project results as subject\-matter authority. * Develop and deploy advanced machine learning models for fraud detection, risk assessment, anomaly detection, customer segmentation, and churn prediction. Build real\-time scoring pipelines, ensure production reliability, and present model design choices as the authority on their technical merits. * Lead fraud detection initiatives, designing detection algorithms, collaborating with compliance and investigation teams, and continuously improving model performance as fraud patterns evolve. * Evaluate and apply emerging AI and machine learning technologies, including large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and agentic systems, to enhance product capabilities and competitive advantage. * Define and document best practices for model development, testing, and deployment, and present them to stakeholders as the authority on the subject. * Design and build scalable data pipelines, feature engineering frameworks, and reusable modeling infrastructure that accelerate model development and deployment across the organization. * Monitor model performance, data quality, and business outcomes in production. Identify degradation, troubleshoot issues, drive continuous improvements, and present findings while leading discussions on remediation priorities. * Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Marketing teams to define analytical requirements, establish success metrics, and deliver recommendations that drive strategic decision\-making. * Present complex analytical findings and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and business stakeholders with clarity and confidence. Communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences and drive adoption of data\-driven strategies. * Ensure all models and analytical processes comply with regulatory, privacy, security, and governance requirements. Collaborate with compliance and legal teams as needed. * Stay current on emerging data science, ML, and AI trends. Identify, prototype, and recommend innovations that improve customer experience and competitive position. * Contribute to documentation, best practices, architectural decisions, and reusable code libraries that strengthen the organization's data science capabilities. **Your Impact in This Role*** Successful deployment and adoption of advanced ML models that generate measurable business impact (fraud reduction, conversion improvement, risk mitigation, operational efficiency), with results presented clearly to leadership. * Demonstrated ability to identify and execute high\-impact strategic initiatives independently with minimal direction or coaching, and to lead discussions that align stakeholders on complex work to senior audiences. * Demonstrated success leading multiple end\-to\-end machine learning projects from ideation through production deployment and monitoring, including presenting outcomes and leading project discussions with stakeholders. * Proven track record of self\-initiated, high\-impact projects executed with full ownership and minimal oversight. **Skills \& Competencies:** * Very high proficiency in multiple machine learning methods: supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and deep learning. Able to lead method\-selection discussions as the subject matter expert. * Advanced expertise in SQL and Python; strong software engineering fundamentals including version control, testing, code design, and distributed systems concepts. * Strong proficiency in AI technologies, including experience evaluating, fine\-tuning, or deploying large language models (LLMs) and generative AI systems in production. * Strong experience with modern ML operations (MLOps), model deployment, monitoring, and serving in production environments; hands\-on familiarity with cloud platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Strong understanding of statistical analysis, experimentation design, A/B testing, hypothesis testing, and causal inference methodologies. * Experience building real\-time or near\-real\-time scoring systems and production ML pipelines. * Excellent communication skills: ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Strong presentation skills and ability to lead discussions without heavy coaching. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills. Comfortable influencing decisions and driving adoption across Product, Engineering, Finance, and business teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in financial services, tax preparation, SaaS, fintech, or e\-commerce industries. * Hands\-on experience building fraud detection, anomaly detection, or risk modeling systems. **Physical \& Work Environment Requirements** --------------------------------------------- * This is a fully remote role (US\-based only). * Occasional travel within US is required for team collaboration, strategy sessions, and business meetings (estimated 4\-6 times per year). * Work is performed in a standard office environment with remote flexibility. * Must be able to work at a computer for extended periods. **What we offer:** At TaxSlayer we realize the most important aspects in leading our industry are the bright minds behind everything we do. jobs.title: SAP OTC Architect
jobs.description: **About Tessera Labs** ---------------------- Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** ---------------- We are looking for an SAP Order\-to\-Cash Architect to own the OTC domain across several customer engagements at the same time. This is a specialist role, and that is deliberate. Our Principal Solution Architects hold the whole solution; you hold the part of it that most often decides whether a program lands on time — the flow from lead and order capture through pricing, availability, delivery, billing and cash application, and the twenty years of customer\-specific development sitting on top of it. Most of this work is ECC to S/4HANA. Customers come to us with order\-to\-cash estates built up since R/3: pricing routines nobody will touch, user exits in MV45AFZZ that encode rules no one wrote down, custom order types that exist because of a reorganization in 2011, and an output determination setup that only works because of a Z\-program. The job is to tell the difference between a genuine business requirement and an accident of history, and to architect the conversion on that basis — brownfield, selective data transition, or greenfield, and clear\-eyed about what each one costs. You will do that work with Tessera’s AI agents, not instead of them. The platform handles the custom code inventory, the simplification item analysis, the data profiling and a large share of the conversion and reconciliation work. What it cannot do is decide whether a customer genuinely needs four hundred condition tables, or which of six sales document types survives the move. That judgment is the role. Every time you exercise it, we expect it to go back into the platform so the agents are better at it on the next engagement. Two outcomes define the job. The first is a target\-state order\-to\-cash design the customer’s own architects will defend after we step back. The second is that their sales operations, logistics and billing teams use what we built rather than rebuilding the workarounds they had before. The second is what makes the first durable, and it is the measure you will be held to. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Order\-to\-Cash Solution Ownership (40%)** * Own the functional and architectural direction of the order\-to\-cash domain on several concurrent engagements — Sales, Pricing, Availability, Logistics Execution, Billing and Accounts Receivable, together with the credit, tax, revenue and collections processes that hang off them. * Design the target state and the route to it, including the trade\-offs between what the customer asked for, what their current system does, and what will actually create value. * Set the standard for the build: review functional specifications, define the conversion, reconciliation and cutover approach for OTC data and open documents, and hold architectural integrity through delivery rather than signing off and leaving. * Work directly with Forward Deployed Engineers, Tessera AI agents and customer architects, and be the person who can answer an OTC question without scheduling a follow\-up. * Own the integration surface out of OTC — EDI and IDoc flows, tax engines, payment and banking, CRM and commerce front ends, transportation and warehouse systems, downstream finance — and say early when a dependency will not hold. * Be the counterpart our Technical Program Managers come to first on order\-to\-cash, and get a straight answer from. ### **2\. ECC to S/4HANA Assessment and Conversion Architecture (25%)** * Lead order\-to\-cash discovery on ECC estates: custom code and enhancement inventory, interface mapping, data quality, process debt, and what each of those is costing the business today. * Own the SD\-relevant simplification items end to end — credit management moving to SAP Credit Management, rebates to Settlement Management, SD revenue recognition to Revenue Accounting, foreign trade to GTS, output management to BRF\+, the retired status and pri enior client\-facing presence: able to hold a room of customer architects, business owners and finance stakeholders, and to say no to a customer in a way that keeps the relationship. * A record of driving adoption, not just go\-live — evidence that the customer’s teams kept using what you delivered. * Proven ability to work on several engagements at once without losing control of any of them. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences. * Experience working with distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline. * Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Who This Role Is Not For** ---------------------------- If your order\-to\-cash experience is running support tickets and minor enhancements on a stable ECC instance, this is not the role — the work here is architectural and most of it is change. If you have breadth across SAP but have never owned the SD configuration and data model end to end, you would be better placed as a Principal Solution Architect, and we hire for that separately. And if you want one engagement at a time with a scope someone else agreed, you will find this uncomfortable. We are asking for a specialist who is at ease holding several unfinished things at once, and who is willing to have their judgment turned into platform capability rather than kept as personal expertise. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Delivered order\-to\-cash on at least one completed S/4HANA conversion or implementation that went live, not only assessed one. * Experience of more than one route to S/4HANA, and of both S/4HANA Private Cloud and Public Cloud, including what RISE changes about how an engagement runs. * Industry depth where order\-to\-cash is genuinely hard: high\-tech and semiconductor, life sciences, industrial manufacturing, consumer products and distribution, or subscription and usage\-based models. * Exposure to adjacent SAP capabilities — Variant Configuration and CPQ, Transportation Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Global Trade Services, Convergent Invoicing, or SAP Subscription Billing. * Revenue recognition under ASC 606 in an SAP context, including Revenue Accounting and Reporting. * Customer master and Business Partner conversion experience (CVI), including the partner\-function and reconciliation\-account decisions that surface during consolidation. * EDI and B2B integration at volume, and experience with a third\-party tax engine such as Vertex or Avalara. * Prior experience partnering with AI, automation or RPA tooling inside an enterprise delivery context. * SAP Activate or equivalent implementation methodology experience. * SAP certifications, for example S/4HANA Sales or Order Fulfilment. * Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must\-have. **First\-Year Measures of Success** ----------------------------------- * Month 1: Fluent in the Tessera platform. Holding order\-to\-cash on at least two engagements. Trusted by the Technical Program Managers and the Principal Architects on those accounts. * Month 3: A target\-state OTC design agreed and in build on every engagement you hold, with the simplification items triaged, the custom code position understood and the data position quantified. Adoption measured and improving. A steady flow of OTC field input reaching the Tessera platform team. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

**\[Required]** * Advanced knowledge and hands\-on experience with on\-chip AI development. **\[Required]** * Strong understanding of edge model deployment and management. **\[Required]** * Excellent jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer II
jobs.description: **Position:** Infrastructure Engineer II **Job Code:** **Business Unit:** Corporate Shared Services / IT **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Reports to:** VP, Infrastructure **Supervisory Role:** No **Location:** Anaheim, CA **Salary Range:** **Bonus:** Yes **Incentive:** No **About The Change Company** ---------------------------- We take our mission to bank the underbanked seriously, fairly and responsibly. We bring digital\-first banking, lending, and financial services to underserved communities, transforming the financial landscape. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We are a diverse, inclusive, and entrepreneurial organization that values collaboration, innovation, and customer focus. Our experienced leadership team drives growth and long\-term success while serving tens of thousands of customers through responsible lending and banking solutions. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We have an experienced leadership team who have served in various fintech, banking and lending industries. We are a Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) serving 50,000\+ borrowers with over $10 Billion in loans since our CDFI certification. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Join us in building modern, data\-driven platforms that power financial inclusion and innovation. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **About the Role** ------------------ The Infrastructure Engineer II reports directly to the VP, Infrastructure and shares day\-to\-day ownership of the platform our lending business runs on: our Cato Networks SASE fabric and Cisco and Meraki campus network, our identity estate across Okta SSO, Entra ID, and Active Directory, our co\-located data center and virtualization footprint, and the controls that protect borrower non\-public personal information (NPI). This is a hands\-on individual contributor role on a small team. You will own defined areas outright and run changes end to end — design, validation, rollback plan, and documentation — while the VP and senior engineers set overall architecture and review the higher\-risk work. We are looking for someone who has already operated production infrastructure, brings an automation\-first instinct, and has the judgment to know which changes need a second pair of eyes in a regulated, examined environment. **Essential Job Duties / Responsibilities** ------------------------------------------- **Network Infrastructure** * Own day\-to\-day operation of the Cato Networks SASE platform — site and socket health, internet and firewall access policy, ZTNA rules for remote users, and traffic and bandwidth analysis — and design and implement policy changes with peer review. * Own configuration and lifecycle of Cisco and Meraki switching across the colocation facility and corporate offices: VLAN and trunk design, stacking, PoE, port security, firmware currency, and routing changes (BGP, OSPF, and inter\-VLAN) including planning, validation, and rollback. * Own the Meraki wireless environment end to end — site surveys and access point placement, SSID and RADIUS design, channel and power tuning, client troubleshooting, and firmware lifecycle. * Own DNS, DHCP, and IPAM as authoritative records and manage the certificate lifecycle; troubleshoot at the packet level using Cato and Meraki analytics alongside switch\-level captures. * Manage carrier circuits, cross\-connects, last\-mile providers, and bandwidth capacity planning; drive carrier escalations to resolution and evaluate circuit changes against cost and redundancy. **Voice and Collaboration** * Own the Vonage cloud VoIP platform — user and extension provisioning, call flow and IVR design, ring groups, voicemail, device lifecycle for desk phones and softphones, and E911 record accuracy. * Diagnose call quality end to end across LAN QoS, Cato WAN policy, and carrier\-side issues, and drive Vonage support cases through to root cause. **Identity, Single Sign\-On, and Directory Services** * Own Okta administration — application assignments, group and app rules, sign\-on and MFA policies, Okta Verify, and lifecycle rules for joiners, movers, and leavers — and improve those rules rather than only executing them. * Lead SSO onboarding for new applications end to end: SAML and OIDC integration, attribute mapping, SCIM or just\-in\-time provisi ability at a level where you automate real work — parameterized scripts with error handling, not just one\-liners. * Practical security engineering habits: segmentation, patch and vulnerability management, access control, and participation in real incidents. * Availability for on\-call rotation, after\-hours change windows, and incident escalation. * Clear written communication — runbooks, change records, and diagrams, and the ability to explain technical risk and tradeoffs to non\-technical business leaders. * Comfort planning and executing your own change windows, including validation and rollback, and the judgment to know which changes need senior review. * Understanding of the mortgage industry, or of another regulated environment, and the handling requirements for borrower NPI. * Production experience administering a hypervisor platform — VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V, or both — including clusters, storage, patching, and capacity, plus ownership of enterprise backup and restore testing. * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. **Preferred** * Experience in mortgage, banking, or another regulated financial services environment. * Professional\- or specialty\-level certification such as CCNP Enterprise, Microsoft SC\-300 or MS\-102, Okta Certified Administrator, VMware VCP\-DCV, or CompTIA Security\+. * Hands\-on experience with the platforms we run: Okta, Cato Networks, Cisco and Meraki, VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V, Druva, LogicMonitor, or Vonage. * Configuration management and automation tooling — Ansible, Microsoft Intune, or Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager. * Microsoft 365 workload administration — Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams. * Experience leading a discrete infrastructure project end to end: a switch refresh, a colocation move, an SSO migration, or a backup platform change. * Experience serving as a technical contact during SOC 2, GLBA, investor, or warehouse lender examinations. * Scripting against an identity API — Microsoft Graph or the Okta API. * Experience mentoring junior engineers or help desk staff and setting technical Built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, TicketManager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. Our industry\-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post\-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove ROI and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences. TicketManager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including Anheuser\-Busch, Verizon, American Express, Nike, and Visa, as well as Fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the NBA, NFL, NCAA, and NASCAR. If you’re excited about live events, cutting\-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here. **The Role** TicketManager is building its AI and automation infrastructure from the ground up, and we are looking for a partner to build it with. As an AI Automation Engineer, you will work directly with the VP of Enterprise Technology \& AI Strategy to turn AI strategy into working systems: n8n workflows, MCP servers, LLM integrations, chat and voice agents, and AI\-driven engineering automation that makes the whole team faster. This is not a role with a fully written roadmap. Requirements are fluid, projects range from a one\-afternoon automation to a multi\-month platform build, and the technology changes monthly. You will break things and fix them faster, stay endlessly curious, and set your own priorities. When the first three approaches fail, you find the fourth, because we believe there is always a way. Your work will directly shape how TicketManager operates, serves customers, and scales. **Responsibilities:*** Build, maintain, and measure workflow automations in n8n across CRM, ERP, support, and fulfillment systems, from first prototype through stable production * Build, maintain, and measure custom MCP servers that connect Claude and other models to internal systems and data * Build and manage integrations with Claude, Gemini, and other model APIs, including prompt engineering and structured outputs * Design agentic workflows where AI takes multi\-step actions autonomously, and instrument them so we know when they work and when they don't * Build and maintain voice and chat agents for sales and support, and own the development of a full in\-app chatbot * Use AI CLI tools such as Claude Code and Codex daily, and automate code review, testing, QA, and release pipelines * Work with data lakes on AWS and Azure to keep AI systems fed with clean, current data, with security (credential handling, access scoping, audit logging) as a default * Define success metrics before every pilot, track cost, performance, and adoption, and kill what doesn't work fast * Evaluate new models and tools as they appear, and recommend when to adopt, switch, or skip * Present your work to leadership and cross\-functional teams, make the case for the technologies you believe in, and help non\-technical colleagues put them to use **Desired Skills and Experience:*** Bachelor's Degree required; MS in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or a relevant field is preferred * 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in automation engineering, systems integration, or a closely related technical role * Hands\-on experience with AI CLI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar, and with code automation and AI\-assisted code review and QA * Real experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable orchestration tools, plus working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON * Familiarity with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, or similar) and prompt engineering fundamentals * A track record of solving problems nobody handed you a clean answer for; comfortable with fluid requirements and setting your own priorities * Strong communication skills: you can present an idea and persuade others to adopt a technology or approach * Visible evidence of constant learning, such as side projects and experiments you built to teach yourself * Nice to have: experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), or building chat and voice agents (VAPI, Deep Chat, assistant\-ui, or similar) * Nice to have: Python or JavaScript, CI/CD and release automation (GitHub Actions or similar), AWS or Azure data lakes, RAG and vector databases **TicketManager Highlights:*** **Location:** Calabasas, CA (HQ) * **Compensation:** $95,000 \- $125,000 base salary \+ Variable Compensation * **Reports to:** VP, Enterprise Technology \& AI Strategy * **Work** **Expectations**: Role is In\-Office, Monday\-Friday * **Retirement:** 401(k) \& Company Match * **Health Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision \& Chiropractic * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO * **Interview Process:** Multistage interview process with senior leaders across TicketManager to ensure strong alignment on role scope and expectations. * **Events:** Quarterly live event credits (we practice what we preach!), monthly happy hours, and volunteering * **Perks:** Fun, collaborative, in\-office culture at our HQ with catered lunches and big company perks with the autonomy of a high\-growth startup * **Recognition:** Inc. 5000 fastest\-growing private company by Inc. Magazine six years in a row. Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work by Inc. Magazine, The LA Business Journal, and Sports Business Journal * 4\.5 out of 5 Glassdoor rating * Used by over 4,000 globally known companies including \~15% of the Fortune 500 BeVi1QHdDC

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Content Systems
jobs.description: Job Description Software Engineer \- AI Content Systems TrueLearn \| Fully Remote About TrueLearn At TrueLearn, we help medical professionals provide the best possible care for their patients. Our learning science–driven platform supports clinicians at every stage of their careers, from board preparation through continuing education. The work we do touches the people who touch patients — which means every line of code, every model, and every experiment we ship has the potential to ripple outward into better care, better outcomes, and better lives. We are looking for a software engineer to help build the AI\-integrated content system at the center of our next\-generation platform. All TrueLearn content is authored, organized, and validated by learning scientists and practicing clinicians. The system we’re building puts AI to work alongside them, generating, reviewing, and improving content under expert supervision. You’ll own meaningful pieces of that system and its integration into the learning platform. The Role Early, foundational work on a consolidating platform. We're replacing a landscape that grew up in pieces with a single next\-generation system. The decisions made now are the ones everything else will be built on top of. We are building a deeply intelligent, human\-supervised, adaptive learning platform that responds to each learner’s unique needs in real time, empowering them to master their domain. Achieving this visionary goal requires a foundation built on technical excellence and thoughtful engineering, beginning with these essential building blocks: * AI\-forward, full\-stack development. We are building a sophisticated, adaptive engine using TypeScript and Next.js. You’ll be crafting the robust full\-stack architecture that supports high\-velocity AI integration, translating complex learning science into reliable, scalable software. * Editorial workflows as the foundation of intelligence. Our content models aren’t just storage—they are the training ground for our AI. You will design intuitive, structured workflows that allow subject matter experts to collaborate seamlessly with AI, ensuring our system remains both human\-supervised and machine\-ready. * A culture of rapid experimentation. We believe the best path to an adaptive learning future is paved with brave experimentation. You will be encouraged to test new approaches, use AI agents to accelerate velocity, and view failures as essential data points in our journey to build something truly transformative. You’ll own features from design through production and make technical calls within your area. You’ll work alongside senior engineers who will push on your thinking as much as you push on theirs, and on a team where asking questions is a sign of engagement, not a gap. How we work. We build with AI coding agents as partners. Our repo has maintained agent context, a doc\-gardening skill that keeps it current, MCP tooling, and instrumentation to measure whether any of it is actually helping. We expect you to use agents to the fullest in your own work and to bring what you learn back to the team. When you find a bottleneck in how we work, we'd rather you tell us and help fix it than work around it quietly. See first\-hand the impact of your work * Investigate ambiguous problems and communicate what you find. The most impactful work starts with curiosity * Notice what's slowing the team down and do something about it. Flaky test, undocumented setup step, a review cycle that keeps stalling. The fix is welcome even when nobody asks * Write tests, review PRs, and prepare design proposals. Ask the naive question that turns out to be the right one What We're Looking For * 4\+ years of professional experience building and shipping web applications, with production experience in TypeScript and React. You've worked on software real users depended on, and you can walk us through what you built and why. (Own the Outcome.) * Engineering discipline that doesn't loosen when the work speeds up. AI to  * A steep growth curve and the drive behind it. We care more about trajectory than credentials. Tell us about something you taught yourself because the work demanded it, a problem you stayed with longer than was comfortable, or a skill you have now that you didn't a year ago. We're hiring for who you'll be in two years as much as who you are today. (Always Learning.) * A real interest in the users and the mission. Our editors, medical experts, and learners depend on this system every day. The best engineers here get curious about how they work, care about the experience, and notice friction others have accepted as normal. You don't need a healthcare background, but you should care that this work matters. (Help Others Succeed.) * Strong written and verbal communication. On a remote team, writing is the primary currency for building trust. You take ownership of clarity — in PR descriptions, proposals, and updates — and you can facilitate a cross\-functional conversation where everyone leaves aligned, regardless of technical background. * Experience shipping AI features to production. You’ve built product features on top of LLMs that real users depend on, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with non\-determinism, structured outputs, prompt and context design, latency and cost, and the question of how you actually know it’s working. (Lead with Evidence.) Nice to Have None of these are required. Any of them will get our attention. * Building LLM evals, or observability tooling for AI features. * Building MCP servers or agent tooling * Direct experience with a headless CMS (such as Payload, Sanity, Strapi, Contentful, or Directus). * Experience with Lexical, ProseMirror, Slate, TipTap, or another rich text editor framework — especially building custom nodes. * Postgres experience, and comfort with migrations in a deployed environment. * Experience with editorial or publishing workflows — drafts, versioning, approval states, audit history. * Experience with Docker, AWS (ECS, S3\), or CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with feature flags and incremental rollout. * Accessibility experience, or a track record of caring about it. * Exposure to healthcare, medical education, edtech, or other domains where accuracy carries real stakes. Compensation and Benefits The base salary range for this role is $120,000–$135,000, plus a 10% annual target bonus. Where an individual offer lands within that range depends on geographic location, relevant experience, and overall fit for the role. We offer a competitive benefits package, including: * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited paid time off * Paid holidays and parental leave * Fully remote work with computer and peripherals provided * Professional development support * Life and disability insurance Why This Role The content pipeline is the constraint on our business. We’re rebuilding that pipeline around an established CMS framework while integrating AI\-assisted generation into the editorial workflow. You’d be helping write our playbook for this transition. You’ll join early enough to shape the platform. While the core is in production, most future functionality—including integrated AI features—has yet to be built. This role evolves toward the center of our core platform and AI strategy. You'll do it with a team that wants to work the way good teams should work: with trust, candor, rigor, humor, and with each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we'd love to talk. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Build the Technology Behind Medical Imaging \- This role is not hybrid or remote, must be able to work in office in Bloomingdale, IL location. Are you an experienced embedded software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems at the intersection of firmware, electronics, and motion control? Del Medical is looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to help develop, improve, and support the embedded systems powering our medical imaging equipment. This is an opportunity to take meaningful technical ownership of real\-world products, work closely with electrical and mechanical engineers, and see your engineering solutions move from development into production. We are particularly interested in engineers who understand what happens below the application layer—people who can write efficient firmware, debug hardware\-software interactions, and develop dependable embedded solutions rather than relying exclusively on high\-level software frameworks. What You'll Do * Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware using C and/or C\+\+. * Develop bare\-metal firmware for microcontroller\-based systems and real\-time applications. * Design and improve motion\-control functionality involving motors, encoders, sensors, and actuators. * Implement and troubleshoot communication protocols, including CAN/CANopen, RS\-232, I²C, SPI, and Ethernet. * Collaborate with electrical engineers on PCB bring\-up, electronic interfaces, and hardware\-software integration. * Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, and other diagnostic equipment to identify and resolve complex technical problems. * Develop software verification tests, investigate failures, and improve system reliability. * Document software architecture, interfaces, requirements, testing, and engineering changes. * Support prototype development, production troubleshooting, and ongoing product improvements. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and product engineering teams. What We're Looking For Required qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Typically 7\+ years of professional embedded software or firmware development experience. * Strong proficiency in embedded C and/or C\+\+. * Demonstrated experience with bare\-metal programming and microcontroller\-based systems. * Hands\-on experience debugging electronic hardware and firmware integration issues. * Experience with embedded communication interfaces and protocols. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently own technical assignments and deliver maintainable, reliable software. Highly desirable experience: * Motor control, motion\-control systems, encoders, feedback loops, or real\-time control. * Medical devices, diagnostic imaging, industrial controls, or other reliability\-critical products. * Altium Designer, PCB development, and electronic schematic interpretation. * RTOS development, firmware update mechanisms, automated testing, or hardware diagnostics. * Familiarity with medical\-device software lifecycle, risk management, verification, and quality requirements. What Makes This Opportunity Different? * Meaningful technical ownership: Contribute directly to embedded systems used in medical imaging equipment. * Hands\-on engineering: Work with actual electronics, firmware, motors, and integrated systems. * Cross\-disciplinary collaboration: Work alongside electrical, mechanical, and product engineering professionals. * Visible impact: Help improve product functionality, reliability, and serviceability. * Competitive compensation: Earn $100,000–$150,000 annually based on demonstrated expertise. Benefits: * Competitive salary based on experience and knowledge * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * STD, LTD, Life and AD\&D Insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match. * Paid time off, including holidays and vacation. * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. Who Will Succeed Here? You are a hands\-on engineer who enjoys understanding how systems work, diagnosing difficult problems, and building solutions that last. You are comfortable working independently, but you also know how to collaborate with engineers from different disciplines. You take pride in code quality, sound engineering decisions, technical documentation, and seeing a project through to completion. Candidates whose experience is limited to application\-level software development without hands\-on embedded firmware or hardware integration experience are unlikely to be a fit. Apply Today If you have embedded firmware, electronics, and motion\-control experience to make a difference, we want to hear from you. Please submit your résumé highlighting your embedded development experience, microcontroller platforms, communication protocols, and a few examples of challenging technical problems you have solved. Del Medical is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications and applicable law. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you require sponsorship at all now or in the future to work in the United States? Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Test Engineering Manager** **Department: Manufacturing Test Engineering (MTE)** **Location:** **Newark, CA** ============================================================================================================== **Position Summary** -------------------- Unigen is seeking an experienced Test Engineering Manager to lead its Test Engineering team in an electronics manufacturing environment. This role will oversee the development, implementation, and optimization of Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) test processes, with a focus on Functional Testing, In\-Circuit Testing (ICT), and Flying Probe Testing. The Test Engineering Manager will provide technical leadership, manage engineering resources, establish test strategies, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure robust test coverage, manufacturing readiness, and consistent product quality. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in PCBA testing, proven engineering team management experience, and a track record of improving test efficiency and manufacturing yields. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **1\. Test Engineering Leadership** * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Test Engineers, establishing technical priorities, project timelines, and performance expectations. * Define test engineering strategies, standards, and best practices across manufacturing programs. * Manage engineering resources and project deliverables to support production requirements and customer commitments. **2\. PCBA Test Strategy and Development** * Oversee the development, implementation, validation, and maintenance of PCBA testing solutions, including Functional Test, ICT, and Flying Probe Test. * Guide the development and optimization of test programs, test fixtures, test procedures, and test methodologies. * Ensure test solutions provide adequate coverage of product requirements and manufacturing quality expectations. * Evaluate test equipment, platforms, and technologies to improve test capability and production performance. **3\. New Product Introduction (NPI) and Production Support** * Partner with NPI, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Design Engineering, and Program Management to establish test requirements and ensure production readiness. * Oversee test strategy development during new product introduction, engineering builds, and production ramp\-up. * Lead engineering\-level troubleshooting of complex test failures, yield issues, and recurring manufacturing defects. * Drive root\-cause analysis and corrective actions to improve test reliability and manufacturing performance. **4\. Continuous Improvement and Quality** * Drive improvements in first\-pass yield, test coverage, test cycle time, false failure rates, and retest rates. * Analyze test data and manufacturing trends to identify opportunities for process improvement. * Ensure test processes align with customer specifications, quality requirements, and applicable industry standards. * Standardize test engineering documentation, validation procedures, and troubleshooting practices. **5\. Cross\-Functional and Customer Collaboration** * Collaborate with internal stakeholders and customers to resolve technical issues and align test requirements with product specifications. * Coordinate test engineering priorities with production schedules, NPI milestones, and customer deliverables. * Communicate technical risks, project progress, and improvement initiatives to management and relevant stakeholders. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. * 8\+ years of experience in test engineering, preferably within an EMS, PCBA, or electronics manufacturing environment. * 3\+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams. * Strong expertise in PCBA Functional Testing, In\-Circuit Testing (ICT), and Flying Probe Testing. * Demonstrated experience overseeing test program development, test fixture design, test validation, and test process implementation. * Strong understanding of electronic circuits, PCBA design, component\-level troubleshooting, and manufacturing test methodologies. * Experience supporting NPI, production ramp\-up, yield improvement, and high\-volume manufacturing. * Proven ability to lead technical projects, develop engineering talent, and manage competing priorities. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The opportunity** Unity is building a robust, near real\-time reporting platform that powers critical analytics and decision\-making across our ecosystem. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help architect and implement the distributed data systems that drive this platform at scale. In this role, you'll design and build high\-throughput, low\-latency data processing pipelines that power reporting used by internal teams and external customers. You'll operate at the intersection of distributed systems, stream processing, and cloud\-native infrastructure — ensuring correctness, reliability, and scalability in a high\-volume production environment. This is a high\-impact role where engineering rigor, architectural clarity, and production ownership matter. **What you'll be doing** * Own the end\-to\-end attribution pipeline. You will be a core engineer on the team responsible for getting attribution data right — from the moment a user interacts with an ad to the signal landing accurately in our data warehouse and in the hands of our ML and Reporting teams. This means owning a portfolio of high\-throughput, latency\-sensitive services and streaming pipelines that operate at the center of Unity's mobile advertising infrastructure. * Build and operate real\-time ad event processing. You will design, build, and operate the online services that receive ad interaction events from mobile SDKs and other partners, process terabytes of data at scale — including enrichments, transformations, and privacy operations — and deliver signals to external and internal partners in real time. * Lead our architectural modernization. A significant part of your work will be an active migration, replacing a legacy event\-handling layer with a modern gRPC\-based service. This is greenfield development within a production system, requiring careful design with backfill and failover behavior while preserving data accuracy throughout the cutover. * Improve low\-latency data services. You will improve the caching layer that serves data on every ad request within strict latency budgets, and own the persistence layer that links auction, fill, placement, and gamer identities together across the ad lifecycle. * Build and maintain critical ad serving infrastructure. You will build and own multiple services that support ad serving — including negative targeting and block listing — across the team's service portfolio. Responsibilities include logging, tracing, and authentication; a Kafka\-backed caching framework; health check and readiness probe infrastructure; and Docker\-based integrations. * Drive data health monitoring and quality. You will own real\-time monitoring of data health, detecting anomalies, event delivery rates, and data quality signals as they happen. You will also build and maintain the batch data pipeline jobs that produce daily datasets in BigQuery. * Collaborate across ML, Reporting, and external partners. You will be the team that ML modeling, Reporting, and external partners rely on for timely and accurate signal reporting. When something goes wrong, you will lead the investigation and recovery. **What we're looking for** * Strong foundation in distributed systems and systems design * Hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale data processing systems * Deep understanding of streaming concepts: exactly\-once semantics, watermarking and event\-time processing, stateful stream processing, checkpointing and recovery, and backpressure handling * Production experience with frameworks such as Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, or similar technologies * Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala * Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow for stream and batch coordination * Strong understanding of cloud\-native architectures and distributed infrastructure including Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud platforms **You might also have** * Experience migrating legacy systems to modern architectures in production environments **Additional information** Zone A: $210,300 \- $273,400 USD Zone B: $187,200 \- $243,300 USD Zone C: $165,600 \- $215,200 USD *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Pricing
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team:** Upstart’s Core Pricing team drives key initiatives that directly influence our revenue streams, unit economics, and product strategy. The team builds and evolves the common systems used to translate underwriting insights into accurate risk and profitability decisions for every loan we originate, while enabling a seamless borrower experience across products. As a **Senior Software Engineer on Core Pricing**, you will design and build scalable, reliable systems that power pricing decisions across Upstart’s products. In close partnership with engineering, data science, product, and business teams, you will own meaningful technical projects, improve the architecture and reliability of our pricing services, and help translate complex modeling and business requirements into durable software capabilities. **How you’ll make an impact** * Design, build, and evolve high\-performance, real\-time pricing systems that support critical lending decisions across Upstart products. * Own complex engineering projects from technical design through delivery, balancing scalability, reliability, correctness, and speed of iteration. * Partner with data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate modeling and business requirements into reliable software solutions. * Identify and implement architectural improvements that increase the flexibility, maintainability, observability, and resilience of pricing services. * Contribute to technical standards for system design, testing, monitoring, and operational excellence within the Core Pricing team. * Support other engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing while contributing to sound technical decisions across the team. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or its equivalent, plus **4 years of software engineering experience**. * Experience writing production software in Python and working with Java, Kotlin, or another strongly typed programming language. * Experience designing, building, and operating scalable APIs, distributed systems, or microservices in a cloud environment such as AWS or GCP. * Experience owning the technical design and delivery of complex software projects from development through production. * Experience building production systems with requirements related to scalability, latency, reliability, or correctness. **Preferred Qualifications** * Knowledge of fintech, financial systems, financial mathematics, statistics, machine learning platforms, or decisioning systems. * Experience working on business\-critical systems that affect revenue, profitability, risk, or core product outcomes. * Experience with distributed systems, cloud\-native architecture, platform engineering, continuous integration and deployment, or infrastructure as code. * Experience partnering with data science and product teams to productionize models, decisioning logic, or experimentation capabilities. * Ability to work effectively across engineering and non\-engineering teams on technically complex initiatives. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and  Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $166,900—$230,900 USD At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). Canada \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $153,000—$190,000 CAD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer.
