jobs.title: Billing Systems Architect
jobs.description: **About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)** ====================================== Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get: * Predictable performance, even at scale * Secure, compliant environments by default * Real\-time observability and profiling built in * Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds * AI\-ready features that plug directly into your stack The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow\-the\-sun\-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. Our values: We make a positive impact. ✨ We aim for the stars. We care for each other. **Impact of a Billing Systems Architect** ========================================= As an Enterprise Billing Systems Architect at Upsun, you are the technical anchor of our billing infrastructure, playing a vital role in ensuring our revenue operations, pricing structures, and financial integrations run seamlessly as our business scales. Picking up primary ownership from our implementation partner, you serve as the dedicated technical lead bridging Finance, Product, and Engineering. You're deeply analytical, systems\-minded, and collaborative—someone who thrives on translating complex business, pricing, and accounting rules into reliable system logic. Working downstream from our core engineering and data mediation teams, you ensure the integrity of our Quote\-to\-Cash (Q2C) platform while continuously optimizing platform performance and automation. Beyond day\-to\-day platform administration, you contribute to the long\-term evolution of our billing architecture—supporting new pricing model launches, complex usage rating schemes, and financial system integrations. Your attention to detail, technical versatility, and cross\-functional mindset ensure our revenue pipeline remains scalable, compliant, and friction\-free. **What to expect** ================== * **Billing Infrastructure \& Administration:** Serve as the hands\-on technical owner of our BillingPlatform environment, configuring catalogs, price cards, usage rating rules, and automated invoice schedules. * **System Operations \& Maintenance:** Own ongoing platform health, including system updates, pricing launches, recurring bill\-run troubleshooting, sync exception handling, and root\-cause issue resolution. * **Data Ingestion \& Analysis:** Utilize SQL to perform data validation, rating engine auditing, and operational reporting while collaborating with Engineering to receive mediated usage data (e.g., via DigitalRoute or Kafka). * **Integrations \& API Management:** Maintain and optimize clean, API\-driven integrations connecting BillingPlatform to upstream CRMs (e.g. Salesforce), downstream ERP/GL tools (e.g., NetSuite), and payment gateways (e.g., Stripe). * **Revenue Recognition Alignment:** Partner closely with Accounting to ensure system rating rules, revenue schedules, and general ledger mappings satisfy ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance standards. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Gather technical and operational requirements directly from Accounting, Finance, Sales Ops, and Product teams, translating their vision into sustainable platform configuration. * **Data Integrity \& Migration:** Maintain billing data continuity and manage subscription data updates or migrations without disrupting ongoing financial operations or revenue recognition flows. **What you bring** ================== * **Q2C Platform Experience:** Proven hands\-on experience configuring and administering enterprise Quote\-to\-Cash or billing platforms (e.g., Zuora, Salesforce Revenue Cloud/CPQ, NetSuite Billing, Aria Systems, or BillingPlatform). * **Data \& Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency with SQL for querying and auditing billing data, alongside a solid grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, and ETL workflows. * **Modern Pricing Expertise:** Experience supporting complex SaaS or infrastructure pricing models—such as PLG, hybrid commitment\-plus\-usage, tiered rates, and consumption\-based/metered billing. * **Revenue Recognition Knowledge:** Practical understanding of rev rec fundamentals (ASC 606 / IFRS 15\) and how accounting rules dictate billing engine design. * **Cross\-Functional Communication:** Ability to bridge technical language and financial business logic, effectively collaborating with engineering teams and accounting stakeholders alike. * **Problem Solving \& Troubleshooting:** A methodical approach to diagnosing system sync errors, rating anomalies, and integration edge cases to ensure operational continuity. **Bonus points** ================ * Experience with DigitalRoute mediation software or Kafka event\-stream data intake * Previous exposure to cloud infrastructure, PaaS, or developer\-platform usage metrics * Background supporting system migrations from implementation partners into internal teams **Where we hire** ================= At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend \- it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in **Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States**. Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. **How we hire** =============== We know that a great hire won't meet every requirement that we've outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance. You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you're looking for in your future working environment. * 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition * 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Senior Director, FP\&A and IT) * 60 Minutes with Team (Engineering team) * 60 Minutes with Team (Finance team) * 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO) *All roles require background checks.* **What we offer** ================= **A product you can believe in** \- Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud **B Corp**. **An Award\-Winning Workplace** \- We've been recognized by Forbes' Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France's Best Workplaces for Women. ️ **A culture that values your voice** \- Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution. **A global team** \- Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives **Benefits and perks** \- Make the most of what matters to you Flexible PTO Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA) Company stock options Professional development budget Office equipment budget ‍️ Wellness budget Annual team gatherings Internet reimbursement Inclusive parental leave ✈️ Remote work travel program **You belong here** =================== At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

jobs.description: **Position Title:** Full Stack Engineer **Location:** Remote — EST Time Zone **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Salaried Exempt **Schedule:** Monday–Friday **About the Opportunity** Cascadience, a VIABILITY Company, is building **Volio**, an innovative AI\-powered digital companion designed to support neurodivergent individuals, including people with ADHD, Autism, and Anxiety. Volio is evolving into an engaging student companion that combines AI\-powered support, intelligent scheduling, long\-term memory, and gamified experiences to help reduce cognitive overload and support independence. jobs.title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer** **San Jose, CA, USA** **12 Months** **$70/HR on W2 OR $80/HR on C2C** **Any visa is fine** **Need candidates who are in California. W2 candidates are encouraged to apply.** Client is an AI\-enhanced security processor company redefining the control and management of every digital system. The company builds silicon\-rooted security and management chips — including the TCU (Trusted Control/Compute Unit) — for AI data center infrastructure, combining platform security, BMC/firmware, and on\-chip AI for real\-time threat detection and dynamic power/thermal management. **Job Description** **About the role** We’re looking for an ML engineer who works across the full stack from model to silicon — comfortable optimizing training and inference performance on GPU/AI\-accelerator infrastructure, building or tuning models, and adapting model and inference\-engine design to the constraints of the underlying chip and its NPU. You’ll move fluidly between algorithm work, systems\-level software, and infrastructure work, closing the loop end\-to\-end rather than owning just one layer of the stack. This is a rare chance to work the full cycle of AI silicon, from model down to chip — something most ML engineers at large companies never get access to. **What you’ll do** * Optimize training and inference performance across GPU and AI\-accelerator infrastructure, including MLOps pipelines * Design, train, and evaluate ML models (deep learning, LLM, CV, or recommendation systems) and take them into production * Harden and extend NPU cores (e.g. building on an open RVV/tensor core like CoralNPU) into production silicon * Build or optimize inference engines and serving runtimes against real hardware constraints — latency, memory, and power * Work below the application layer where needed — BMC firmware, embedded Linux, or RTOS (e.g. Zephyr) — so AI features run reliably on real systems * Build automated test/verification harnesses that close the loop for AI\-assisted RTL/DV, hardware bring\-up, or manufacturing test * Apply ML to security — AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security work * Collaborate closely with RTL/hardware, firmware, and QA teams to ship AI features end\-to\-end, from training through deployment and monitoring **Requirements:** * 8\-10\+ years of hands\-on AI/ML experience; Master’s required, PhD preferred * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML infrastructure and performance — GPU clusters, distributed training, inference\-serving optimization, MLOps pipelines * Model / algorithm development experience — designing, training, and evaluating ML models * Experience taking models into production — feature engineering, data pipelines, deployment * AI chip / hardware\-aware ML experience — optimizing inference engines for a specific chip, or adapting model architecture/quantization to chip constraints * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least 2 of the following 5 specialty areas — we don’t expect all five: – **NPU / AI\-accelerator —** hardening or extending an NPU core into production silicon, mapping models onto MAC/tensor\-engine constraints, or NPU\-aware RTL/DV work – **Systems / Sys\-level software —** BMC firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS (e.g. Zephyr), or other low\-level system software – **Inference engine / runtime —** built or materially optimized an inference engine or serving runtime against real hardware constraints – **Test / verification harness —** built an automated harness that closes a loop, e.g. an agent\-driven RTL/DV test runner or a hardware bring\-up / MFG test harness – **Cyber security —** AI\-driven log/intrusion analysis, AI\-assisted penetration testing, or firmware/hardware security

jobs.title: Critical Facilities Engineer, NA (Data Center)
jobs.description: **About Vantage** ================= Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. **This is a evergreen req for future openings \- timeline for talent conversations is TBD. We are collecting applications for future conversations.** **Site Operations Department** The Site Operations Department is responsible for the overall health of all mechanical and electrical systems, building maintenance, and performance of all data modules in our data centers. The team is staffed 24 x 7 onsite with Critical Facility Engineers (CFEs) on each shift. This team is the face of Vantage to our customers and the first line of defense regarding the uptime of our campus as well as the performance of our customer installations. Using a Critical Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to plan and track work needed, the Site Operations department performs all preventative and corrective maintenance. Our culture expects and rewards team performance that engages directly with the customers and the facility infrastructure. This is a team that does most of the actual work versus calling upon vendors. As a result, we provide superior service that is faster and more cost effective. **Position Overview** **This role is onsite in Ashburn, VA. This is an in\-house position.** **Ideally we will be seeking experienced talent for Levels I or potentially II . One with data center, mission critical field service or mission critical military experience highly desired (US Navy, US Air Force, US Army, US Marines, US Coast Guard). These are in\-house and hands\-on roles using your critical thinking talents to troubleshoot and fix equipment vs subbing out the work.** **Electrical and mechanical expertise in a non\-mission critical field service in cross\-industry may be considered, e.g, chiller technician with larger tonnage but non\-critical environments or field service in OEM equipment outside of data center. (Johnson Controls, York, Trane, Daikin, Vertiv, Eaton, Liebert, Toshiba, Delta, CAT, ABB, Samsung, Mitsubishi, Siemens, Petra etc) . We are also able to consider those that are very trainable.** We are looking for a Critical Facilities Engineer who knows what best\-in\-class service looks like and can make that a reality. This role is an important member of our facilities team where we manage some of the most efficient and cost\-effective data center facilities in the industry. The successful candidate for this role will work with a team of other electrical and mechanical\-focused engineers performing maintenance and repair for our data center infrastructure. We take our customer requirements for uptime seriously and keep our facilities maintained to a very high standard to insure uninterrupted service for our customers. If you enjoy working on critical data center systems (UPSs, PDUs, Diesel Generators, ATS equipment and Building Controls), as well as industrial electrical equipment and systems that include power distribution components/wiring, electronic components and lighting systems. If you know the importance of getting it right the first time and not disrupting mission critical data centers. If you enjoy delighting customers with superior service and you have the desire and ability to do so, then please read on! **Essential Job Functions** * Work under limited supervision, both independently and within a team environment * Manage multiple one\-time and/or ongoing projects * Respond to safety and emergency situations and maintain a safe and secure work environment * Use discretion and judgment in organizing workflow and adapting as priorities are modified due to a changing environment * Frequent contact with employees at all levels of the organization; frequent external contact with vendors **Duties** * Operate, perform maintenance and service repairs on critical Data Center systems (UPS, PDU, Diesel Generators, ATS equipment and Building Controls, Chillers, CRAH, ETC) * Develop reliability reports to ensure availability and capacity targets are achieved and maintained with 100% uptime * Coordinate, and oversee all maintenance vendors to ensure personnel safety, protect the Facility’s critical equipment, and maintain power to the critical load * Create required MOPs (Method of Procedure), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and EOPs (Emergency Operating Procedures) to ensure all maintenance activities are performed in accordance to them * Additional duties as assigned by Management **Job Requirements** * Minimum 3 years, 5\+ years preferred, of “hands on” experience with the maintenance and repair of industrial electrical and mechanical systems in mission\-critical facilities t operating, maintaining, repairing, inspecting and testing critical electrical distribution systems, HVAC systems and building management/automation equipment * Ability to read commercial building blueprints and understand electrical single lines and schematics * Knowledge of commonly\-used concepts, practices, and procedures related to mechanical \& electrical systems needed to run data centers * Technical Writing skills and experience; as well as creating, coordinating, updating and/or modifying MOPs/SOPs/EOP’s for critical facilities equipment, to include supporting new systems and researching technical requirements * Work experience in the electrical or mechanical field is highly desired. Strong emphasis on technical skills/training, with intent to obtain license within a reasonable time * May be required to complete formal training in an area of specialty, such as UPS maintenance * Candidates must possess reliable transportation for reporting to work for shifts, or emergencies * Travel is expected to be less than 5%, occasionally for training purposes * Potential employees must complete a background check successfully **Physical Demands and Special Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Ability to stand 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to walk 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to sit 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to climb and balance 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to reach with hands \& arms 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to smell, talk \& hear * Ability to use hands to type, handle \& feel * Ability to reach with hands and arms * Ability to see at close and distance ranges and the ability to see color * Must be comfortable working in a high stress, fast paced environment with shifting priorities * Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, late nights, holidays, and on\-call support * Ability to lift up to 50 pounds 1/3 of the time **Additional Details** * This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD\&D, short and long\-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. * Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. Posting range is $38\-55 / hour for level Is and IIs. **\#LI\-Onsite** **\#LI\-TS1** We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. jobs.title: RF Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **About VectorWave** VectorWave is building the Analog Processing Unit (APU), the world’s first programmable neuromorphic processor that runs AI inference on raw radio\-frequency waveforms pre\-digitization. Conventional RF systems must digitize the signal before any AI inference can occur, fundamentally limiting the latency, power consumption, and performance of wireless edge compute. The APU bypasses these bottlenecks by performing the AI signal processing fully in analog. We are a venture\-backed MIT spinout translating award\-winning research into new wireless products with fundamentally new capabilities. With applications spanning defense (electronic warfare, spectrum awareness, anti\-jam) and commercial wireless (Wi\-Fi and 5G/6G spectrum sharing, interference management), we are building a team of engineers who are excited to transform the future of wireless communications! **The role** The RF embedded firmware engineer role entails designing and developing the programmable systems for VectorWave’s APU. In a multi\-disciplinary effort, you will work closely with the analog hardware RF engineers and RF machine learning engineers to create subsystems that enable the APU to execute programmable signal processing operations and AI functionalities for wireless edge compute. Your work will be integrated with that of the other subsystem designers to advance the APU. **Location:** This is an in\-person, full\-time role at our office in the Greater Boston area. There may occasionally be some travel to conferences. **What you'll do** * Design subsystems for the APU’s programmable edge compute * Choose the components and design circuit systems integrating RF components, memory, and microprocessors * Program the control scheme and interface for the programmable APU subsystem * Evaluate the performance of the programmable APU subsystem against internal and customer KPIs * Work with the RF, machine learning, and system engineers to ensure inter\-system compatibility **What you bring** * Expertise programming and interfacing with ADCs, DACs, and on\-board memory * Experience programming microprocessor units (MPUs) and/or RF system\-on\-chips (SoCs) and/or edge FPGAs * Experience designing and implementing system\-level interfaces between components * Mathematical maturity and mastery of the physics of designed circuits * Experience designing and implementing methods of analog system characterization * Experience implementing environmental hardware stabilization as necessary * A BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field **Nice to have** * An MS or PhD in a relevant field * Published experimental demonstrations of any scalable analog circuitry (e.g. AI hardware accelerators, photonic integrated circuits, quantum hardware) * Development board design experience * Robust system documentation experience * Experience using RF signal processing devices \& components * In\-situ/physics\-aware/back propagation\-free machine learning for AI hardware accelerators * Experience developing physically accurate digital twins to validate hardware designs through math and simulation * Understanding of RF signal processing techniques * RF PCB design \& impedance matching experience **How we work** * **Always be curious.** Sometimes the most profound outcomes come from paying attention to the smallest details. * **Truth guides us.** Honesty and candor are foundational. Don't delay hard conversations, start them. * **Think out loud.** Voicing anything both technical and non\-technical helps us solve problems together. * **Mistakes are expected.** Perfection is impossible when you're building something new. We want to navigate challenges thoughtfully so we can learn and improve. * **Adaptability is essential.** Make the best decision with the information at hand, then be ready to adjust. * **Lean on each other.** As we scale, we aim to maintain our scrappy, small team camaraderie. **Compensation and benefits** Competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus: **The basics** * Medical: UnitedHealthcare Choice Plus, platinum tier. $10 primary care visit. $10 therapy visits. * Dental: Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental Blue. Child orthodontia included. * Vision: Guardian. * Unlimited PTO. **Family matters** * We offer 95% dependent premium coverage. * Plus, we have uncapped IVF support for fertility and family planning. * Coming soon: Twenty\-six weeks of parental leave at 100% of pay for every parent: birthing, non\-birthing, adoptive, and foster. **For life beyond work** * 401(k): we match 100% of the first 6% of pay, dollar for dollar. * Take care of yourself with a $2,000 annual wellness benefit. **Equal opportunity** VectorWave is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. VectorWave participates in E\-Verify. See the E\-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters in English and Spanish.

jobs.title: Senior Workforce AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Join Verisk's Workforce Technology Services organization as a Workforce AI Solutions Engineer. This role partners directly with business stakeholders across the enterprise to identify, design, build, and deploy AI\-powered solutions using approved workforce AI platforms, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, and associated technologies. The position serves as the technical lead and primary owner for a queue of business\-submitted AI solution requests that require light\-to\-moderate implementation effort. The person in this role leads each engagement while remaining directly involved in solution design, development, testing, and delivery alongside a collaborating coworker. Requests may include workflow automation, AI agent development, system integrations, document intelligence, knowledge retrieval, process simplification, and productivity optimization. The role works with a partner team responsible for initial intake and triage so that simple questions, training needs, and requests requiring clarification are handled separately. This position receives qualified requests that need hands\-on technical design and delivery but do not require a large\-scale software development engagement. **Purpose of the Role** * Accelerate measurable business value from enterprise workforce AI investments. * Design and deliver AI\-powered solutions that improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and simplify business processes. * Act as a technical advisor and solution architect for workforce AI technologies. * Establish reusable agents, skills, integrations, MCP components, and solution patterns that can be leveraged across the organization. * Drive responsible AI adoption while meeting enterprise security, governance, privacy, and compliance requirements. **Key Responsibilities** **Request Queue Management and Solution Delivery** * Lead and coordinate delivery activities with the coworker supporting each request, including work allocation, technical direction, issue resolution, and completion accountability. * Manage and prioritize a queue of qualified AI solution requests received from business units across the company. * Partner with the intake and triage function to confirm scope, readiness, ownership, dependencies, and the appropriate delivery path, then lead execution with the coworker assigned to support delivery. * Work directly with requesters to understand business processes, desired outcomes, data needs, risks, and success measures. * Translate business requirements into practical AI solutions using approved platforms and technologies. * Estimate effort, communicate delivery expectations, document decisions, and maintain visibility into request status and outcomes. * Provide appropriate implementation documentation, knowledge transfer, and transition to an ongoing support model. **AI Solution Architecture and Engineering** * Design AI\-enabled workflows, agents, automations, and business process improvements. * Select the appropriate platform and implementation approach based on business needs, technical fit, security, maintainability, and cost. * Build solutions through simple builder experiences, low\-code platforms, and pro\-code development using Visual Studio or Visual Studio Code when needed. * Create reusable design patterns, templates, components, and engineering standards that improve delivery speed and consistency. * Evaluate scalability, observability, supportability, and lifecycle requirements before production use. **Agent, Skill, and MCP Development** * Build and maintain purpose\-specific AI agents, actions, prompts, workflows, and orchestration logic. * Develop custom skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or integrations when platform\-native capabilities are insufficient. * Extend AI platforms using APIs, SDKs, custom connectors, functions, and other approved integration methods. * Apply software development practices such as source control, testing, documentation, release management, and reusable code design. **Integration, Data, and Authentication** * Design secure connections between workforce AI platforms and enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, business applications, and external functions. * Understand and apply modern authentication and authorization patterns, including OAuth, Microsoft Entra ID, application registrations, service principals, managed identities, delegated access, and API\-based credentials. * Partner with application owners, data owners, security, privacy, architecture, and identity teams to establish approved access patterns. * Ensure solutions follow least\-privilege principles and protect enterprise data throughout retrieval, processing, storage, and output. **Platform Expertise and Continuous Improvement** * Maintain strong working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, related APIs, and emerging enterprise AI capabilities. * Understand the strengths, limitations, licensing c ain tradeoffs clearly, build practical solutions, and recognize when a request should be simplified, escalated, or redirected. They are accountable for outcomes, thoughtful about risk, and motivated by improving how employees work. \#LI\-LM03 \#LI\-Remote For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster. At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed. For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best\-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture. We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations. **Verisk Businesses** Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision Claims Solutions — supports end\-to\-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences Property and Restoration Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day\-to\-day workflows the most efficient Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end\-to\-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance Catastrophe and Risk Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to catastrophic events. Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing,relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement Life Insurance Solutions – offers end\-to\-end, data insight\-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group. Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer. Verisk invests in a benefits package for all employees that includes the following: Health Insurance, a Retirement Plan, Disability benefits, and a Paid Time Off program. We offer a competitive total rewards package that includes base salary determined based on role, experience, skill set, and location. All members of the Verisk Analytics family of companies are equal opportunity employers. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, veteran's status, age or disability. jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. We are seeking an **Agentic AI Engineer** to architect and implement autonomous, multi\-agent workflows that go beyond static text generation. You will be responsible for building reliable agentic systems that interface with enterprise databases, execute real\-world APIs, manage long\-term state, and operate safely within strict performance and governance guardrails. You will be responsible for the following but not limited to: * **Agent Architecture \& Orchestration:** Design stateful, multi\-step agentic workflows using reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, Plan\-and\-Solve, Reflection). * **Tool \& API Integration:** Build reliable execution layers connecting LLMs to external systems via REST APIs, database connectors, and protocol standards like **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**. * **Context \& Memory Management:** Implement short\-term and long\-term memory architectures, state persistency, context window optimization, and hybrid RAG retrieval layers. * **Evaluation \& Guardrails:** Establish offline test sets ("golden sets") and real\-time observability pipelines (using LLM\-as\-a\-judge, trace analysis, and latency/cost monitoring) to prevent hallucinations, infinite loops, and unwanted drift. * **Production Deployment:** Containerize and deploy multi\-agent microservices using scalable async patterns, distributed queues, and fallback mechanisms. **What we’re looking for...** You thrive on creating smart, customer\-centric solutions that simplify user interactions and deliver immediate answers. Your expertise allows you to build secure, scalable AI frameworks using established software engineering practices, ensuring smooth integration with downstream enterprise tools. As a trusted engineer, teams rely on you to navigate challenging obstacles in NLP, AI integration, and search relevance. By combining deep technical proficiency in AI with an analytical, collaborative mindset, you will directly enhance our user journey. **You’ll need to have:** * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Experience building **Multi\-Agent Systems** with complex delegation models (human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths). * Hands\-on experience developing enterprise\-grade agentic workflows, multi\-agent topologies, and task orchestration pipelines using platforms such as **LangGraph**, **Google ADK / CES**, **Sierra**, **Decagon**, or similar * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, and generative AI guardrails. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field. * Experience in programming in modern languages (Python, Java, NodeJS) for building custom fulfillment webhooks, microservices, and backend APIs. * Experience implementing Vertex AI Search / Enterprise Search, grounding models, custom data store connectors, and tuning search relevance and rankings. * Experience integrating Google AI solutions with non\-Google enterprise architectures via REST/SOAP APIs, pub/sub messaging, and webhook integrations. * Knowledge of contact center integrations (telephony adapters, CRM platforms like Salesforce/Genesys, and live agent hand\-off protocols). If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $101,000\.00 \- $194,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Join our dynamic team as a Data Engineer and become a vital driver of our data\-driven decision\-making process! In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and architectures that empower our business to leverage big data systems effectively. Your expertise will enable seamless data management, integration, and analysis across cloud platforms and on\-premises environments. We are looking for energetic professionals passionate about transforming complex data into actionable insights through innovative engineering solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies like AWS, Azure Data Lake, Hadoop, Spark, and more, contributing to impactful projects that shape our strategic growth. **Responsibilities** * Develop and optimize ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines using tools such as Talend, Informatica, and custom Python scripts to ensure efficient data flow across systems. * Design and implement scalable data models and architectures for data warehouses using dimensional modeling principles and SQL databases like Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle. * Manage big data systems utilizing Hadoop ecosystem components such as Apache Hive, Spark, and related technologies to process large datasets reliably. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate linked data sources and develop RESTful APIs for seamless data access and sharing. * Build and maintain cloud\-based data solutions on platforms like AWS, Azure Data Lake, and other public cloud services to support enterprise analytics initiatives. * Ensure robust data security, quality, and governance standards are upheld throughout all engineering processes. * Support business intelligence tools such as Looker by preparing optimized queries and dashboards that enable insightful analytics for stakeholders. **Skills** * Extensive experience with cloud databases including AWS services (e.g., S3, Redshift), Azure Data Lake, and other public cloud platforms. * Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, Bash (Unix shell), and Shell Scripting for automation and pipeline development. * Deep understanding of big data systems like Hadoop ecosystem components (HDFS, Hive), Spark for distributed processing, and related frameworks. * Proven ability in designing data models using dimensional modeling techniques for data warehousing projects. * Skilled in SQL query management across various databases including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and cloud\-based SQL databases. * Knowledge of ETL pipeline development tools such as Talend or Informatica for efficient data integration workflows. * Familiarity with business intelligence tools like Looker to facilitate reporting and analytics; experience with RESTful API development is a plus. * Strong analysis skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions within Agile environments. Embark on a journey where your technical expertise fuels innovation! We’re committed to fostering a collaborative environment that values continuous learning and professional growth—empowering you to make a tangible impact through your work every day. ***VForce Infotech is an Equal Opportunity Employer*** *\*We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.* ***Communication Preferences:****“To opt out of future recruiting emails from VForce Infotech, please reply with “Unsubscribe” in the subject line or message body. jobs.title: Director of AI Engineering, Internal Products
jobs.description: Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data\-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally. As the **Director of AI Engineering, Internal Products** at Via, you'll lead an engineering team that builds high\-impact internal products using AI\-native development practices, while pioneering a platform that enables people across the company to create their own software with AI agents. We call these empowered employees "nano engineers."This is an opportunity to shape a new engineering discipline, solve problems across the business, and multiply our capacity to innovate. **About the Role:** * Build products that make our business run better, from internal systems supporting Finance, HR, Ops, Sales and Marketing to tools that help field teams coordinate work, surface operational insights, resolve exceptions, manage resources, and make better decisions in real time * Work closely with the people doing the work, understand their needs firsthand, and turn those insights into products that deliver measurable business impact * Rethink software development in the age of AI, using coding agents, AI\-assisted development, automated testing, and new engineering workflows to accelerate the journey from identifying a problem to delivering a solution * Lead the development of our AI\-powered internal development platform, building the integrations, permissions, infrastructure, testing, deployment, and governance needed to make employee\-created software reliable and useful * Recruit, develop, and lead exceptional engineers, and define the architecture, engineering standards, operating model, and culture that will allow the team to scale its impact * Partner with leadership across the company to identify the highest\-impact opportunities for software and AI, and challenge conventional assumptions about what to build versus buy **About You:** * An exceptional engineering leader with a strong technical foundation and experience building and shipping production software; you've led engineers, made sound architectural decisions, and delivered systems that people depend on * An AI\-native builder who actively explores and uses modern AI coding tools and agents, and is excited to rethink how an engineering team should operate * A pragmatic systems thinker who understands security, permissions, integrations, observability, testing, and maintainability, and knows how to apply the right level of rigor to each use case * A product thinker who cares about the problem being solved, not just the technology, and can turn ambiguous needs into useful products * Comfortable with ambiguity; you're happy to move between strategy, architecture, hands\-on building, and working directly with business teams * An organizational multiplier, excited about enabling other people to solve problems independently **Compensation and Benefits** * Base Salary Range: $250,000 \- $290,000 per year plus variable pay and equity as part of a total compensation package. Final compensation will be determined by the candidate's experience, knowledge, and skills. * Comprehensive health coverage, with low\-cost dental and vision plans. * A 401(k) with company match and vesting. * Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options. * Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks). * 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually. There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride? Via is an equal opportunity employer. \#LI\-CG2

jobs.title: ML Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.description: Viridien ( www.viridiengroup.com ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges. **Job Summary** We are hiring an ML Engineer to build production agentic applications that automate complex geoscience workflows. You will design agent\-based systems, integrate tools and external APIs, implement persistent state management, provide agents with the right context, and deliver well\-tested services with lightweight web interfaces for operators and end users. Beyond implementation, you will help shape what these applications do: which workflows to automate, where people stay in the loop, and how results are presented and verified. You will also be responsible for designing and executing LLM fine\-tuning strategies when model adaptation is required. **About the Team** We work together to Build high\-impact tools and platforms that drive innovation – from scientific seismic algorithms to data visualization tools to intuitive web apps. combining our expertise across regions to drive innovation and impactful results. Our team values collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, and we take pride in supporting each other to achieve shared goals. **Key Responsibilities** * Shape the application logic and user experience: define what a good result looks like, remove what does not help users decide, and make outputs easy to verify. * Design agent workflows with branches, loops, sub\-workflows, and explicit routing, choosing the simplest structure that solves the problem. * Implement human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, and decide which actions an agent may take on its own. * Give agents the right context: tool\-based search over files, logs, code, and databases, using text search, SQL, and semantic retrieval where appropriate. * Ground answers in cited evidence, enforce tool permissions, and guard against prompt injection and unsafe actions. * Integrate tools and external APIs. Handle concurrency, retries, and error paths. * Add database\-backed persistence. Ensure workflows can pause and resume reliably. * Design and execute LLM fine\-tuning strategies when needed: data curation, supervised fine\-tuning with parameter\-efficient methods such as LoRA, preference optimization (e.g., DPO), reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO with verifiable rewards, evaluation sets, and rollback criteria. * Instrument agent runs with tracing and continuous evaluation, making decisions and actions auditable and detecting quality regressions early. * Deliver production\-ready services with automated tests and CI/CD, and expose APIs where other teams or systems need them. * Collaborate with domain experts, product, and engineering. Present clear design docs and trade\-offs. Leverage AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex effectively and responsibly: plan and direct their work, review and test what they produce, and stay accountable for every change that ships. * **Qualifications:** ***Required:*** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Geophysics, or a related field. * Strong academic performance, including a minimum cumulative GPA of 3\.5 on a 4\.0 scale for all earned degrees. Equivalent academic grading systems will be considered for degrees obtained outside the U.S. * Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals, including asynchronous and concurrent programming. * Sound design and product judgment: you can explain why a system is built the way it is, what was left out, and how its quality is measured. * Hands\-on experience building multi\-agent or graph\-based LLM workflows, using established frameworks or custom implementations. * Experience designing how agents find information: tool\-based search over files, logs, and databases, and semantic retrieval with reranking when needed. * Practical LLM fine\-tuning experience: parameter\-efficient methods such as LoRA, dataset preparation and quality assurance, offline and online evals; a working understanding of RL\-based fine\-tuning and reward design. * Experience with tracing and evaluation of LLM applications. * Experience building web services and APIs (e.g., FastAPI), and working with PostgreSQL, Docker, and Git. * Ability to harness AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex: understand how they work, break down tasks, guide their execution, critically review their output, recognize failures, and take ownership of the resulting code. ***Preferred:*** * Experience designing complex agent systems, including task decomposition, parallel execution, result aggregation, and human\-in\-the\-loop orchestration. * Hands\-on experience with LLM post\-training techniques (e.g., DPO, GRPO), including reward design for verifiable outcomes and multi\-step tool use. * Experience running enterprise\-scale applications in production, including retries, idempotency, timeouts, and rate limits. * Prior work in workflow automation; exposure to geoscience or scientific computing is a plus. * Frontend experience building lightweight operator dashboards. **Houston Benefits:** * 401k Retirement Plan \- when you contribute up to 5%, not only will we match that, but we will also add an additional 2% * Free on\-site fitness centre offering group exercise classes * Short\-term disability and long\-term disability coverage at no cost to you * Parental Leave Program allowing mothers and fathers to take time off from work for childbirth, adoption and to bond with your new child * Pet Insurance – options to meet every budget Wellness Program – resources provided to support your personal wellness and participation in activities can earn you $65 quarterly. * **Our Hiring Process** At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond. We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly. We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** Role Summary: Lead Software Engineers are responsible for designing, implementing, and improving software applications and systems. The role involves hands\-on coding, working with data and modern tools to deliver secure, scalable, and high\-quality technology solutions. jobs.title: Database Architect
jobs.description: **Role Scope** -------------- Owns data architecture across multiple domains, with dual focus: (1\) modernizing legacy database systems—particularly large\-scale SQL Server environments with complex stored procedures containing embedded business logic, and (2\) designing AI\-native data infrastructure—semantic data models, vector databases, and RAG architectures that power AI agents and workflows. Establishes patterns for domain\-driven data models, event\-driven data flows, and canonical schemas across relational, NoSQL, analytical, and AI\-optimized data platforms. **The Problem We're Solving** ----------------------------- We have two interconnected data architecture challenges. Legacy modernization: SQL Server stored procedures that have grown to thousands of lines, with business logic deeply embedded in T\-SQL that should live in application services. These procedures are difficult to test, impossible to reuse, and create tight coupling between business rules and data access. They slow down development, complicate domain ownership, and resist modernization efforts. AI data infrastructure: We're building AI agents and agentic workflows that require purpose\-built data architecture—semantic models that capture domain knowledge, vector databases for retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embedding pipelines, and knowledge graphs that give AI systems the context they need to operate effectively. This isn't about bolting AI onto existing data systems; it's about designing data infrastructure that makes AI\-native applications possible. These challenges intersect: the domain knowledge locked in legacy systems becomes training data and context for AI agents. The canonical models we build for modernization become the semantic foundation for AI retrieval. We need database architects who can work across both dimensions—modernizing legacy while building for an AI\-native future. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are seeking a Senior Database Architect who combines deep expertise in legacy database systems with forward\-looking vision for AI\-native data architecture. You'll lead the decomposition of complex stored procedures while simultaneously designing the vector databases, embedding strategies, and semantic models that power our AI agents and workflows. This is an AI\-first role in two senses: you'll leverage AI to accelerate your own work (stored procedure analysis, migration generation, schema documentation), and you'll design the data infrastructure that AI systems depend on. If you're excited about both solving hard legacy database problems and architecting the data layer for AI\-native applications, this role is for you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Legacy Database Modernization** * Analyze and decompose large SQL Server stored procedures (1,000\+ lines) with embedded business logic, creating migration strategies that extract logic into domain services * Design patterns for separating business rules from data access, enabling stored procedures to become thin data\-access layers while business logic moves to application services * Lead refactoring efforts that align database structures with domain\-driven design: bounded contexts, aggregates, and domain events * Implement event\-driven patterns that decouple systems from direct database dependencies: change data capture, outbox patterns, event sourcing where appropriate * Optimize query performance, indexing strategies, and execution plans as part of modernization efforts * Create migration playbooks and tooling that engineering teams can apply to their own stored procedure modernization ### **AI Data Infrastructure \& Semantic Modeling** * Design semantic data models that capture domain knowledge in structures optimized for AI retrieval and reasoning * Architect vector database solutions for RAG implementations: embedding strategies, chunking approaches, similarity search optimization, and hybrid retrieval patterns * Design and implement embedding pipelines that transform domain content into vector representations suitable for AI agent consumption * Establish knowledge graph patterns where appropriate: entity relationships, ontologies, and graph\-based retrieval for complex domain reasoning * Define data architectures for AI agent context: what data agents need, how it's structured, how freshness and consistency are maintained * Design evaluation frameworks for RAG quality: retrieval accuracy, relevance scoring, and feedback loops for continuous improvement ### **Modern Data Platform Architecture** * Design canonical data models and schemas that are flexible, extensible, and aligned with business domain concepts * Architect data solutions across multiple platforms: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB/Cosmos DB, Snowflake, and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Azure AI Search) * Design event\-driven data flows: Kafka\-based event streaming, materialized views, CQRS patterns, and real\-time data synchronization * Establish M capabilities * Familiarity with structured artifact creation for AI consumption: documented schemas, annotated procedures, context files * Vision for AI\-assisted database engineering and ability to build tooling that enables it ### **Technical Depth** * Strong programming skills in at least one backend language (C\#, Java, Python) for building migration tooling, embedding pipelines, and services * Cloud data services experience: Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure AI Search, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or AWS equivalents * Infrastructure\-as\-code for data platforms: Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation * Understanding of domain\-driven design and how data architecture supports bounded contexts * Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and compliance requirements (HIPAA, PCI\-DSS) ### **Preferred Experience** * Background in healthcare, benefits, payments, or similarly regulated industries * Experience building RAG systems or AI\-powered search/retrieval applications * Knowledge graph experience: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar graph databases * Contributions to database tooling, AI/ML data infrastructure, or open\-source projects * Experience mentoring engineers or leading database/data architecture communities of practice **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In 90 days: Completed assessment of priority stored procedure modernization targets and AI data infrastructure needs; delivered first AI\-assisted analysis tooling; established vector database patterns for initial RAG implementations In 6 months: Led decomposition of at least one major stored procedure system; semantic data models and RAG architecture patterns established and being adopted; AI\-powered database engineering tools in active use by teams In 12 months: Measurable reduction in stored procedure complexity across priority systems; AI data infrastructure supporting production agent workflows; recognized as the go\-to expert for both database modernization and AI\-native data architecture **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- Data architecture is being transformed from two directions simultaneously. From the legacy side: business logic buried in stored procedures creates invisible dependencies that resist refactoring. Traditional approaches to database modernization are slow, manual, and error\-prone—but AI can analyze thousands of lines of T\-SQL, identify patterns, and accelerate migrations in ways that weren't possible before. From the AI side: agents and workflows need purpose\-built data infrastructure. The semantic models, vector databases, and knowledge representations you design will determine how effectively AI can reason about our domains. This isn't a nice\-to\-have capability; it's foundational to our AI\-native engineering strategy. You'll work at the intersection of these transformations—solving hard legacy problems while building the data infrastructure that makes AI\-native applications possible. The patterns you establish will shape how we approach data architecture across the enterprise. The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non\-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well\-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section. Pay Range: $165,800\.00 \- $204,400\.00

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About WPP Media** WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. **Role Summary and Impact** This role is within WPP Media, where you will be instrumental in owning production stability, observability, and system health for a mission\-critical global campaign governance and compliance platform. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will operate and improve a system running natively on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will investigate complex production issues, implement minor code\-level fixes in Python, lead root cause analysis, and improve the reliability of distributed systems. Working closely with the EMEA\-based Engineering Tech Lead, Product Owner, and Quality Assurance partners, you will connect production insights with technical roadmap priorities. The opportunity combines hands\-on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) with technical squad leadership. There's an initial monitoring setup to build from, but it's a great opportunity to evaluate what exists, form your own point of view, and define where observability needs to go. From there, you'll shape the future support squad for a dedicated product used across global advertising campaigns, while also owning advanced L2\+ and L3\-oriented support, incident response, and the service\-level and business\-as\-usual work that keeps the system running. **Key Responsibilities** * Own production stability, system health, and observability for a mission\-critical campaign governance and compliance platform running on GCP. * Define and advance the observability strategy using GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, Prometheus, PromQL, and suitable service level indicators and objectives. * Lead incident response, post\-incident reviews, and end\-to\-end root cause analysis, partnering with the EMEA Engineering team on permanent remediation. * Diagnose and resolve complex, intermittent, and high\-priority incidents across application, database, infrastructure, and networking layers. * Read, debug, and implement minor fixes and patches directly within the existing Python production codebase. * Monitor execution flows, performance, data refreshes, automated checks, and recurring compliance reporting to ensure reliable system operation. * Identify opportunities to automate manual support activity, develop and maintain runbooks, and reduce operational toil. * Provide technical leadership to the L2\+ support squad through coaching, knowledge sharing, prioritization, and effective handovers. * Partner with Product, Engineering, and Quality Assurance teams to assess operational risk, improve release and change management, and influence technical roadmap decisions. **Skills and Experience** * Advanced education in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure/platform engineering roles, including meaningful experience operating and troubleshooting production systems at scale. * Deep, hands\-on experience supporting enterprise systems on Google Cloud Platform, including Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Identity and Access Management, and virtual private cloud networking. * Strong, current Python proficiency, including the ability to read, debug, and implement fixes directly within a shared production codebase. * Strong Python and Bash scripting skills for automating support tasks, parsing logs, developing operational tools, and reducing manual effort. * Complex production troubleshooting and root cause analysis experience across distributed systems, including leadership of post\-incident reviews. * High proficiency with GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, Prometheus, and PromQL, including establishing service level indicators and service level objectives. * Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes, particularly deploying, managing, and troubleshooting applications running in Google Kubernetes Engine. * Experience using Terraform for infrastructure as code, tracing infrastructure\-level issues, and identifying improvements to infrastructure management. * Solid querying and troubleshooting experience across Firestore, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. * Experience leading, mentoring, or serving as a technical lead for a squad or technical team, along with strong knowledge of Incident, Problem, and Change Management practices and the software development lifecycle. **Life at WPP Media \& Benefits** Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. This role oversees infrastructure, tooling, and frameworks that support scalable, secure development while driving full lifecycle management across multiple teams. The position champions DevOps practices, cloud cost optimization, and technical excellence to deliver high\-availability systems. Collaborating across functions, the manager mentors engineers, guides architectural decisions, and manages complex initiatives to meet business goals. This leadership role fosters continuous improvement, innovation, and effective stakeholder engagement to advance Walmart’s technology capabilities. About the team: Walmart International Search \& Personalization develops intelligent discovery experiences that enable millions of customers to find and engage with products globally. The team encompasses ML Engineering, Data Science, Data Operations, and Platform Engineering, supporting the entire discovery ecosystem from data pipelines to scalable AI infrastructure. It delivers multi\-market platforms accommodating various languages and customer behaviors through a shared foundation. Engineers address complex challenges in distributed systems, machine learning, and generative AI, advancing toward AI\-native discovery. The team values technical expertise, experimentation, collaboration, and measurable impact on customers and business outcomes.**What you'll do...** --------------------- * Lead platform\-level execution of software and AI/ML systems, ensuring alignment with domain priorities and roadmap milestones. * Oversee shared infrastructure, tooling, and frameworks to support scalable, secure, and reusable development. * Drive full software development lifecycle across multiple teams, promoting DevOps practices and continuous improvement. * Manage cloud cost optimization and enhance automation, telemetry, and tooling to reduce operational friction. * Mentor engineers, guide architectural decisions, and ensure adherence to quality, security, and compliance standards. * Collaborate with stakeholders to define priorities, track milestones, and deliver complex technical initiatives on time. * Foster innovation by identifying opportunities to improve processes, tools, and products continuously. **What you'll bring:** * Extensive experience leading platform engineering teams with a strong focus on software and AI/ML system delivery. * Proven expertise in managing full software development lifecycles, including CI/CD, DevOps architecture, and cloud\-native solutions. * Demonstrated ability to oversee architectural design, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance across complex systems. * Strong project and stakeholder management skills to align technical execution with business goals and roadmap milestones. * Proficiency in cloud financial management and automation to optimize operational costs and improve system reliability. * Effective mentorship and leadership capabilities fostering technical excellence and continuous improvement within engineering teams. * Excellent problem\-solving skills with adaptability to evolving technologies and business priorities. **About Walmart Global Tech** Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. Walmart’s culture is a competitive advantage, and it’s fostered by being together. Working together in person allows us to collaborate, align quickly and innovate with greater speed. We use our campuses to create purposeful connection rooted in deepening understanding and investing in the development of our associates. Our hubs: Walmart is a global company with offices across the United States and around the world. Our global headquarters is in Bentonville, Arkansas, with primary hubs in the San Francisco Bay area and New York/New Jersey. **Benefits:** Benefits: Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance.
