jobs.title: Software engineer, cloud infrastructure
jobs.description: Location San Francisco Type Full\-Time Department Engineering Compensation $166,500 \- $185,000 **About Watershed** ------------------- Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit\-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product\-building, want to work hard at a mission\-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! **The role** ------------ Watershed’s Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the foundational systems that power our product and help every engineer ship safely and efficiently. We own core compute, databases, networking, deployments, and observability, with a focus on production reliability, predictable infrastructure costs, security, and a low\-toil developer experience. Our work spans both operational excellence and high\-leverage platform improvements. Current areas of investment include: upgrading our networking architecture, improving the usability of test environments and deployment systems, evolving our observability toolkit, hardening Watershed’s AI infrastructure as our AI product suite grows, and supporting agentic engineering workflows. **You will** ------------ * Design, build, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure that powers all of Watershed (across compute, databases, networking, deployment systems, and observability) * Contribute to technical planning, design reviews, team processes, and a culture of thoughtful, high\-impact development * Collaborate with product engineers (our internal customers) to understand their needs and provide high\-leverage infrastructure primitives that help them move faster, safely * Strengthen Watershed’s cloud security in partnership with our Security and Compliance functions, and drive infrastructure cost efficiency in collaboration with our Finance team * Participate in the team’s 24/7 on\-call rotation and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements **You might be a good fit if** ------------------------------ * You have 2–5 years of software and/or infrastructure engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience * You have hands\-on experience in some of these areas: Kubernetes, Terraform / infrastructure as code, CI/CD, networking, relational databases, observability, reliability, or cloud security. Experience with a major cloud provider is a must; experience with GCP is helpful, but not required * You enjoy the challenge of building the appropriate level of tooling for the stage and arc of the company, in particular being on the front lines of supporting AI infrastructure and agentic products * You enjoy building enabling systems that help other engineers deliver excellent customer outcomes **Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)** Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. **What’s the interview process like?** It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. **What if I need accommodations for my interview?** At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long\-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy\-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: Welcome. We're glad you're here. And we're not just saying that. We're glad we're here too. We are proud of this company and take great pleasure in introducing you to the Watson difference. **We are builders.** For more than 60 years we have designed and built workspaces for some of the most dynamic and innovative companies. Our designs are functional, refined, and manufactured with respect for our people and the environment. We are proud to source the best talent and materials at our manufacturing facility in Poulsbo, WA. We're looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to design and improve the processes that let our production floor run safely, consistently, and better every day. Our floor runs CNC routers, fiber lasers, press brakes, edgebanders, weld, and a powder coat line, and you'll work hands\-on across all of it. This role is part of Watson's manufacturing engineering team, led by the Maintenance and Process Manager (MPM). The Value Stream Managers and the MPM define the current condition, the target condition, and the goals that matter. You help make it happen through process design, standard work, tooling, programs, and automation, and through a culture where problems get solved at the root, not just patched for the shift. Sitting squarely within operations, you stay guided by customer demand, giving the Value Stream Managers and floor teams the process, tooling, and data they need to execute on time, every time. This role reports to the Maintenance and Process Manager and works closely with the Value Stream Managers, floor teams, Product Development, Production Planning, and Safety to bring practical, deliberate, and well thought out changes to production. ***Please note, this role is 100% on site at our Poulsbo, Washington workplace called The Orchard.*** The Orchard is more than merely our Pacific Northwest headquarters and the land that surrounds it. With a perimeter of towering Douglas firs and vistas of the Olympic Mountains, it's quite an inspirational workplace. The Orchard is more expansive than its literal acreage. It's an oxygen rich metaphor of what we're here to do and, more importantly, what we're here to take care of. We love working here, and we think you will too! **What You'll Do:** **Process Engineering** * Use lean as the shared language with the floor (standard work, 5S, value stream mapping, A3, kaizen) to find and remove waste. * Work with the Value Stream Managers and floor teams to turn current and target conditions into process changes, layouts, and standard work. * Build and maintain the work instructions, tooling, fixtures, and CNC programs that let the floor run safely, consistently, and at quality. * Analyze workflow, equipment placement, and space requirements to improve throughput and flow. * Coach operators to solve their own problems rather than solving it for them every time. **Projects and Partnership** * Research and build business cases for new equipment, automation, and technology, including feasibility, labor, and cost estimates. * Support kaizen events and lead your own improvement projects through to completion with key stakeholders. * Work with Product Development on manufacturability during new product introduction and product modifications. * Use ERP and production data to set targets for quality and speed, and measure whether changes actually worked. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED** * B.S. in Engineering, or 2\+ years of relevant manufacturing or process engineering experience * Working knowledge of lean tools, ideally applied on the floor and not just in training * Fluency with 3D CAD and familiarity with ERP systems * Familiarity with production processes such as CNC routing, sheet metal fabrication, welding, or finishing * Ability to diagnose root cause quickly and follow through until the fix sticks * Ability to convey complex ideas simply to both the floor and leadership * Ability to manage changing priorities across several projects at once * Basic business sense and an understanding of how decisions affect cost, throughput, and revenue * A plus: CNC programming, automation, or NPI experience **WHO YOU ARE** * You think in lean and see waste and flow problems naturally. * You're insanely curious about root cause, and you're not satisfied with a fix that only lasts a shift. * You'd rather teach than do it for someone. You build rapport at all levels and earn trust by showing up on the floor. * You see how small details fit the big picture. **WAGE AND COMPENSATION** * This role can expect to earn $33\.50\-43\.25 per hour, based on experience **ESSENTIAL ATTRIBUTES OF WATSON EMPLOYEES** * Insane curiosity * Excited and enthusiastic about your work * Embrace and exhibit our values **OUR CULTURE** * Monthly BBQ * Espresso bar * Annual Bravo Night * Onsite gym and showers * Campus walking trail * Fun, challenging, and engaging culture * Pride and satisfaction of manufacturing tangible products **OUR BENEFITS** * INSURANCE \| All employees and their dependents will have the ability to enroll in medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans. If enrolled, benefits begin on the first day of the month following the 60th day of employment at Watson. * RETIREMENT \| Watson will match 50% of employees' 401k contributions, up to 2\.5% of base annual salary. All employees over the age of 21 will be automatically enrolled on the first day of the month following 6 months of employment. You can opt out, decrease, or increase contribution at any time. * PAID TIME OFF \| Hourly employees will earn 80 hours of paid time off during their first year at Watson, 120 hours of paid time off during years 2 through 5, and 160 hours of paid time off each year after being employed for 6 years. * PAID TIME OFF \| Salaried employees do not have a cap on PTO usage. However, we expect a reasonable amount to be a few weeks during your first year of employment. * PAID HOLIDAYS \| Watson is closed for 8 holidays every year and offers every employee an additional paid holiday to choose upon employment. * PROFIT SHARING \| Profit sharing is how we reward the effort and commitment of our employees. Generally, 25% of profits are allocated to the Profit Sharing Plan after the baseline profit level is met. The overall profit sharing amount varies from year to year. * EMPLOYEE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM \| This is a free service for all employees and dependents to provide support for any mental, emotional, relational, and financial need, as well as crisis and grief support. **WHY WATSON?** Everything we do is rooted in soulful design and a deep respect for how things are made. At Watson, operations isn't a back office function. It's where the promise gets kept. There's dignity in working with your hands, and we honor the commitment our people bring to their craft. The Manufacturing Engineer makes sure that craft is backed by processes built to last, so good work isn't a matter of luck. It's built in. At Watson it's all about the details and personal touches. From unique design elements and sustainable materials to the way we build and deliver our products, you'll see the Watson difference. We aren't furniture assemblers. We take the design conceptions and raw materials and turn them into finished products entirely under one roof. At Watson we don't just design and build workplace solutions, we invest in our people. Build your career and grow your skills with us today. *Watson is an equal opportunity employer of all qualified individuals, including minorities, women, veterans \& individuals with disabilities. Watson will consider qualified applicants for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state, and local ordinances. Any job offer with Watson is contingent upon a drug screening. Please note that Watson is a second chance employer and we do not screen for cannabis unless otherwise noted.*

jobs.title: 26.08. Senior Data Engineer V2
jobs.description: WebCreek is looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong Python and RESTful API development experience for an on\-site role in Houston, TX. This position is ideal for an experienced data\-focused engineer who can design, build, and support enterprise\-level data architecture, backend services, APIs, and data solutions in complex business environments. The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on experience with Python, FastAPI, REST API development, relational and non\-relational databases, SQL optimization, ETL pipeline design, event\-driven architecture, CI/CD workflows, and production support. This role requires someone who can work closely with business and technical teams to understand data needs, build reliable services, and deliver scalable solutions that support enterprise operations. **What You'll Do:** * Design, develop, maintain, and support backend services and data solutions using Python. * Build and consume RESTful APIs, with hands\-on experience using FastAPI. * Design and implement enterprise\-level data architecture to support business and technical requirements. * Work with relational databases and write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries. * Support non\-relational database technologies and apply them appropriately based on use case. * Design and implement custom ETL pipelines and event\-driven systems at scale. * Collaborate with application teams, data teams, business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver reliable technical solutions. * Support CI/CD workflows and development automation using tools such as GitHub and Jenkins. * Work with Elastic Stack technologies, including Elasticsearch, Kibana, and APM, for log aggregation, search, monitoring, and application performance visibility. * Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to APIs, databases, data flows, performance, and system reliability. * Use AI\-assisted development tools to support software design, code generation, research, and technical decision\-making. * Maintain code quality, documentation, and best practices for backend, API, and data engineering work. **What You Bring:** * 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, backend development, or enterprise data application development. * Strong proficiency in Python and Python fundamentals. * Hands\-on experience building and consuming RESTful APIs. * Required experience with FastAPI. * Solid experience with relational databases and strong SQL skills. * Ability to write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries. * Working knowledge of non\-relational database technologies and their appropriate use cases. * Experience designing and implementing ETL pipelines. * Experience with event\-driven architecture and scalable data workflows. * Familiarity with CI/CD practices and tools such as GitHub and Jenkins. * Familiarity with Elastic Stack, including Elasticsearch, Kibana, and APM. * Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently, understand complex systems, and deliver high\-quality solutions. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and business stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications (Nice\-to\-Haves):** * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience working in oil and gas, energy, or enterprise data environments. * Familiarity with oil and gas operations or industry\-specific data concepts. * Experience supporting production systems and business\-critical applications. * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar platforms. * Experience with cloud platforms is a plus, but this is not primarily a cloud infrastructure role. **What You'll Gain:** * Full\-time position in a quickly growing company. * Competitive salary with regular revisions. * 401(k) Retirement Plan and comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance. * Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays. * In\-house IT training and certifications through WebCreek University. * Flexible work environment within a diverse, international team. * Wellness programs and exclusive "workcation" opportunities for top performers. **Location:** On\-site in Houston, TX. *(Relocation candidates are encouraged to apply)* WebCreek is an equal opportunity employer. We believe our strength comes from our people and we welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, color, gender, age, or disability. If you have the skills and the passion for tech, we want you on our team. Apply today and evolve your career with a global leader. For more information, please visit: https://www.webcreek.com/

This role will also provide oversight, mentoring, and leadership to less experienced on\-shore and off\-shore staff. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Software Engineer (LSE) to serve as a key technical contributor for Customer Account Servicing (CAS) team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying software solutions, while actively participating in all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, and architectural planning. The LSE will leverage modern technologies, including Generative AI and integration tools, to deliver scalable and innovative solutions. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross\-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, AI engineers, and full\-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production\-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter. **About the Role** **As an AI Engineer in Agent Factory, you will develop and integrate the intelligent feature layers behind Workday’s next generation of AI agents. While our ML Engineers focus on building, training, and optimizing foundational algorithms, your mission is intelligence orchestration and product delivery—connecting the brain to the product.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Working within a collaborative, cross\-functional pod, you’ll implement how pre\-trained foundational models (LLMs, vision APIs, etc.) power functional, user\-facing enterprise software. You will be hands\-on with building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, managing orchestration frameworks, and continuous prompt engineering. This role sits at the intersection of AI application building and software engineering: you will work closely with senior engineers, product managers, and designers to turn cutting\-edge agentic workflows into highly responsive, reliable, and user\-centric features embedded directly into the Workday stack. **About You** **About You** **Basic Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a solid track record of developing, testing, and deploying production code. * 1\+ years of professional experience (or a strong, demonstrable portfolio of applied project work) working with Large Language Models (LLMs), foundational models, or modern AI APIs. * Demonstrated experience working with AI orchestration concepts (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar tooling) and a strong foundation in prompt engineering to build functional LLM\-powered features. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with API integration, backend application development, and managing data pipelines. * 2\+ years of experience working with core development languages (such as Python) and handling modern software engineering workflows (CI/CD, testing frameworks, and version control). **Other Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical field. * Product \& Application Focus: A strong interest in user experience and a passion for applying AI capabilities to solve practical, real\-world customer problems. * Hands\-on Orchestration: Familiarity with AI orchestration concepts, vector databases, semantic search, and prompt optimization techniques. * Data Fluency: Experienced in handling data exploration, transformation, and integrating varied data sources to contextually ground AI outputs. * Agile Collaboration: Proven ability to thrive in a team environment, collaborating closely with software developers, product managers, and UX designers. Curiosity \& Growth Mindset: Eagerness to stay up to date with the rapid advancements in generative AI, autonomous agents, and LLM application design. * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton Primary Location Base Pay Range: $173,000 USD \- $259,000 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $147,000 USD \- $259,000 USD **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. jobs.title: AI-Native Software Engineer - Consultant
jobs.description: **XPRIZE Overview** XPRIZE is an established global leader in designing and executing large\-scale competitions to solve humanity’s greatest challenges. As a 501(c)3, our unique model democratizes innovation by incentivizing crowd\-sourced, scientifically viable solutions to create a more equitable and abundant future for all. Since our founding in 1994, we’ve launched $519 million in prize competitions that are driving more than $31 billion in social and economic impact — a 60x return on philanthropic investment. These competitions not only de\-risk early\-stage breakthrough ideas but also mobilize capital, talent, and momentum to accelerate solutions from concept to real\-world scale. We operate across 5 areas of impact, including: * Deep Tech \+ Exploration * Energy \+ Climate \+ Nature * Food \+ Water \+ Waste * Health * Learning \+ Society **Project Description** XPRIZE is seeking an experienced AI\-Native Software Engineer to support the build of our new **Prize Execution Platform** — a unified system replacing our current, fragmented set of tools and expanding significantly on what they do today. The platform will manage the full lifecycle of an XPRIZE competition in a single ecosystem connecting four core user groups: * **XPRIZE staff**, who design and configure competitions, manage milestones and timelines, oversee submission intake, coordinate judging, and track prize disbursement. * **Competitors**, who register teams, submit applications and milestone deliverables, track their progress through the competition lifecycle, and receive AI\-assisted matchmaking with relevant mentors. * **Judges**, who review and score submissions — supported by AI\-assisted scoring and automated submission review tools that surface relevant context and flag issues before human review. * **Alumni**, who stay connected to the XPRIZE ecosystem post\-competition through community and continued\-engagement features. AI is embedded directly into the product, not just the development process. Core AI\-powered capabilities include: * **AI\-assisted judging and scoring** to support judges with consistent, efficient evaluation. * **Automated submission review** to pre\-screen and triage incoming applications and deliverables. * **Competitor\-mentor matchmaking** to connect competing teams with relevant subject\-matter mentors. * **An applicant\-facing chatbot** to answer questions and guide competitors through the application and submission process. This is a net\-new platform, not a like\-for\-like migration — it will consolidate and significantly extend the capabilities of XPRIZE's current tooling. The engagement will be built using spec\-driven and AI\-assisted development practices on a .NET, Angular/React, and Python stack. The ideal consultant can move quickly within a defined scope, work independently with minimal ramp\-up, and deliver production\-quality results on a set timeline — while also helping XPRIZE's internal engineering team build lasting capability in AI\-assisted and spec\-driven development practices. **Scope of Work:** * Design, develop, and deliver features and modules across the Prize Execution Platform, including competition management, submission intake, judging/scoring, competitor and mentor matchmaking, and applicant\-facing AI tools within the defined project scope, using .NET, Angular/React, and Python as needed. * Collaborate with the internal product and engineering team to confirm requirements, milestones, and acceptance criteria for the engagement. * Deliver clean, maintainable, and tested code that meets the quality, security, and testing criteria defined in the Statement of Work and the technical guidelines provided at kickoff. * Submit work product for XPRIZE review at agreed milestones, and join technical planning and review sessions as needed to confirm requirements and acceptance criteria. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as the primary development workflow — for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and documentation. * Apply AI\-first, spec\-driven development practices, translating specifications into AI\-assisted implementation, and document this workflow so it's reusable by the internal team after the engagement ends. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit. * Transfer knowledge to XPRIZE's internal engineers — including training on AI\-assisted and spec\-driven development methods used on this project — as part of project deliverables. * Deliver clear technical documentation enabling the internal team to maintain and extend the solution post\-engagement. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Minimum 4 years of hands\-on experience developing full stack web applications, including prior consulting/contract engagements. * Demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on an existing codebase and deliver th the ability to teach this approach to an internal team as part of a knowledge\-transfer deliverable. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code for security, performance, and architectural consistency. * Strong proficiency in .NET technologies and Python. * Proven experience with Angular (v12\+) or React w/ TypeScript. * Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript. * Proficiency with SQL Server or other relational database systems. * Familiarity with Azure, Git, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar). * Able to deliver the milestones in the Statement of Work within the engagement timeline. * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; comfortable working independently with minimal day\-to\-day oversight. **Work Arrangement** This is a fully remote engagement. The consultant may work from any location within the United States, subject to applicable tax and legal requirements. The consultant determines when and where the work is performed. The consultant will attend milestone reviews and collaboration sessions, which are scheduled by mutual agreement and are expected to occur approximately 2\-3 times per week. The consultant is expected to be reasonably responsive to XPRIZE team communications during U.S. Pacific business hours. Expected effort is approximately 30\-40 hours per week, not to exceed 40 hours without written approval. **Tools and Access** XPRIZE will provide access to the AI\-assisted development tools, repositories, cloud environments, and accounts needed for this engagement (including Claude Code, GitHub, Azure etc.). To protect XPRIZE data and systems, the consultant will use XPRIZE\-provided tools and environments for all work involving XPRIZE code, data, or confidential information, and will not input XPRIZE confidential information into unapproved AI tools or services. The consultant is responsible for providing their own computer, internet connection, and general office equipment. Access will be revoked at the end of the engagement. **Intellectual Property and Confidentiality** All work product created under this engagement, including code, documentation, specifications, prompts, workflows, and training materials, will be owned by XPRIZE and assigned to XPRIZE under the consulting agreement. The consultant will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and IP assignment before starting work. **Independent Contractor Status** The consultant will be engaged directly by XPRIZE as an independent contractor and will receive IRS Form 1099\. The consultant is not an employee of XPRIZE and is not eligible for employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, or paid time off. The consultant is responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and business expenses. The consultant controls the means and methods of their work, within the scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria agreed in the Statement of Work. **Compensation** $75\-85/hour based on skills and experience Please note: Submitting a resume or proposal does not make you a candidate for engagement. You will be considered a candidate only after XPRIZE contacts you directly to begin the engagement process, which may include interviews, a technical assessment, reference checks, and a background check where permitted by law. Final engagement is contingent on execution of a written independent contractor agreement, including confidentiality and IP assignment terms. XPRIZE is an equal opportunity organization and considers all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. *Note: if you experience any issues or errors while trying to submit your application, please try* ***clearing your cache and cookies*** *or* ***applying through a different browser*** *(for example, Safari instead of Google Chrome).* 0bAyAu9IV4

In this position, you will drive the complete product lifecycle from technology development and prototyping through stage\-gated NPI execution and global high\-volume manufacturing deployment. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise, strong organizational leadership, and customer engagement to deliver uniquely innovative solutions to the world's leading semiconductor manufacturers. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** **Technical \& Product Leadership** * Define system architectures, engineering methodologies, and multi\-generation technology roadmaps. * Lead the development of complex electromechanical systems, balancing performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and time\-to\-market objectives. * Drive innovation and adoption of AI\-enabled engineering workflows. **Product Development \& Execution** * Lead a disciplined stage\-gate NPI process, ensuring successful verification, validation, manufacturing readiness, and product launch. * Establish best practices for systems engineering, requirements management, risk assessment, design reviews, reliability, and quality. **Customer \& Business Engagement** * Collaborate with Product Marketing, Applications Engineering, and key customers to align product strategy to emerging market requirements. * Serve as the senior technical interface for strategic customer engagements and technology reviews. **Organizational Leadership** * Lead, mentor, and develop a global engineering organization consisting of engineering managers, principal engineers, and technical specialists. * Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation. **Manufacturing \& Operations** * Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Quality organizations to ensure successful product introduction and lifecycle support. * Drive product objectives for reliability, serviceability, safety, uptime, and customer satisfaction. **Education and Experience** **Required** * BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline. * 10\+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience in semiconductor capital equipment, semiconductor test, wafer fabrication equipment, or related industries. * Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex product development programs. * Strong systems architecture experience delivering products through formal NPI processes. * Experience managing engineering managers, geographically distributed teams, and significant R\&D investments. **Preferred** * Experience in semiconductor test, ATE, probe, wafer sort, advanced packaging, or related technologies. * Technical knowledge of digital, RF, power, jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Who we are** -------------- Yoodli is a venture\-backed company building an AI Platform for Human Skills, helping people get measurably better in their careers by supporting them in the flow of work. Our team includes former employees from Google, Apple, Microsoft, Tableau, and beyond, united by a passion for empowering people using AI. We're headquartered in the heart of Seattle, and we're having a lot of fun along the way. Our culture is built on failing fast, iterating constantly, and taking bold bets. We value humility, a bias for action, and the belief that we win together. We've raised $60M, including a $40M Series B led by WestBridge Capital, backed by Madrona, Neotribe, Cercano, and incubated at the Allen Institute for AI. We're valued at $300M and grew revenue 900% year over year. Our customers include Google Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, RingCentral, SAP, FranklinCovey, Korn Ferry, Sandler Training, Toastmasters, and many more, with learners in over 150 countries. Google Cloud certified 15,000\+ reps without scaling headcount. Snowflake recovered 1,200\+ manager hours per quarter. Harness cut training review time by 75%. We've been featured in TechCrunch, Axios, The Information, Forbes, Fast Company, and more. Try the platform free at yoodli.ai. **What we are hoping you will bring** ------------------------------------- You believe in the mission and care deeply about helping people achieve more by communicating better. As our most senior data scientist, you will own the data function end to end: the infrastructure, the standards, and the judgment calls that decide what we build next. This is a principal\-level, high\-autonomy role. You'll set the measurement strategy for a product whose core output is generated by LLMs, which means defining what "measurable skills development" means in numbers and then proving we move it. You'll be the person leadership turns to when a decision needs evidence, and the person the product team turns to when a metric looks wrong. You'll also help our customers quantify their own impact with Yoodli, which makes this work directly commercial. You won't have a team to start, though you may build one over time as the role evolves. Either way, you'll raise the data bar for everyone here by example. This role is hybrid with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office — you'll need to be based in the Greater Seattle Area. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own the measurement strategy for the platform: define the metrics that say whether learners are actually improving, and hold the company to them * Design and run the experimentation program — A/B tests, holdouts, and rigorous LLM evaluation — and set the standards other teams build on * Build the data foundation: pipelines, semantic layer, dashboards, and models that serve both internal decisions and customer\-facing analytics * Partner with product, design, and engineering to turn ambiguous questions into analyses that change what we ship * Work directly with customers' BI and enablement teams so they can tell the story of impact with Yoodli inside their own organizations * Build models that turn communication signal into product value — scoring, skill progression, benchmarking, and churn or expansion prediction * Translate analysis into a clear recommendation for executives and the board, and defend it * Set the technical bar for data at Yoodli: review others' analyses, mentor engineers and PMs on experiment design, and lay the groundwork for a team **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 8\+ years in data science, product analytics, or a closely related field, including time as the most senior data person on a product or business line * Deep expertise in SQL and Python, and comfort shipping production\-grade analytical code * A track record of running an experimentation program, not just individual tests — power analysis, sequential testing, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to call a result null * Experience evaluating LLM or other generative systems: building eval sets, designing rubrics, measuring quality when there is no clean ground truth * Fluency with modern data stacks (dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery) and BI tooling (Looker, Mode, Hex, or similar), and the judgment to choose what a company this size actually needs * Demonstrated influence on product strategy at the exec level — you can show a decision that went a different way because of your analysis * Excellent communication skills, and the ability to be the clearest thinker in a room full of opinions * Nice to have: speech analytics, NLP, or conversational AI; embedded or customer\-facing analytics; early\-stage startup experience * Ability to be on\-site at our Seattle,WA office M, T, and TH **Why Yoodli** -------------- * Mission\-driven company helping millions improve how they communicate * The data function is yours to define, with executive visibility from day one * Collaborative, inclusive team with room to grow * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity * Base Salary: $200k – $220k * Flexible work environment * Startup culture

jobs.title: Data Architect Supervisor
jobs.description: **Job Title**: Data Architect Supervisor **Summary** The Data Architect Supervisor works as a full\-time employee of Zeiders Enterprises, Inc. (Zeiders) and is responsible for designing, developing, managing, and continuously improving the organization's enterprise data architecture and data technology environment. This position plays a hands\-on role in establishing a scalable, secure, and reliable data foundation that enables business operations, reporting, analytics, automation, and emerging AI capabilities. The Data Architect Supervisor will actively engage in technical work. The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and hands\-on technologist who can translate business requirements into practical data solutions and establish the standards, processes, and technologies necessary to support a data\-driven organization. They will work closely with IT, business leaders, cybersecurity, finance, human resources, and other stakeholders to ensure that data is accessible, accurate, secure, governed, and actionable. They will be responsible for the development of data policies, procedures, and technical controls. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Data Architecture \& Technology Management** * Develop and maintain the organization's enterprise data architecture, including data sources, databases, data warehouses, data lakes, integrations, APIs, and reporting platforms. * Design scalable data solutions that support operational systems, business intelligence, analytics, automation, and AI initiatives. * Evaluate, select, implement, and manage data technologies and platforms. * Establish data architecture standards, patterns, principles, and technology roadmaps. * Assess the current data environment and develop a multi\-year roadmap for modernization and optimization. * Identify opportunities to consolidate, integrate, automate, and improve the organization's data environment. * Maintain hands\-on responsibility for data engineering, database administration, data integration, and architecture activities as appropriate. * Monitor data technology performance, capacity, availability, and reliability. **Data Engineering \& Integration** * Design and implement data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to integrate data from enterprise applications and external sources. * Develop and maintain data models supporting operational reporting, analytics, and business intelligence. * Establish integration patterns for connecting applications, databases, cloud services, and other data sources. * Ensure data pipelines are reliable, documented, monitored, and appropriately secured. * Troubleshoot complex data, integration, and performance issues. * Support the development and maintenance of data warehouses, data marts, and analytical environments. **Data Governance \& Quality** * Establish and maintain data governance practices, standards, policies, and procedures. * Define data ownership, stewardship, classification, retention, and lifecycle requirements. * Develop processes for monitoring and improving data quality, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. * Establish and maintain data dictionaries, metadata repositories, business glossaries, and data lineage documentation. * Partner with business stakeholders to define authoritative sources of data and establish common data definitions. * Promote data as an enterprise asset and establish appropriate controls around its use. **Government Contracting \& Security** * Ensure data architecture and solutions align with applicable government contracting, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance requirements. * Support the protection of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), Personally Identifiable Information (PII), and other sensitive organizational information. * Collaborate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to implement appropriate access controls, encryption, monitoring, logging, and data protection mechanisms. * Support compliance with applicable contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements, including NIST\-based security controls where applicable. * Ensure appropriate data segregation, access, retention, and handling practices within government and commercial environments. * Participate in security assessments, risk reviews, technology evaluations, and compliance activities as required. **Business Intelligence, Analytics \& AI** * Partner with business and technology teams to establish a reliable data foundation for enterprise reporting and analytics. * Support the development of dashboards, management reporting, operational metrics, and executive\-level analytics. * Enable data solutions supporting automation, machine learning, and AI initiatives. * Establish standards for data preparation and accessibility for analytics and AI use cases. * Help identify opportunities to leverage data to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, program performance, and decision\-making. **Project \& Stakeholder Management** * Work with ex a architectures, data warehouses, data integration solutions, and data pipelines. * Experience with relational databases, Python, and SQL. * Experience with cloud\-based data technologies and platforms. * Experience developing ETL/ELT processes and integrating data from multiple systems. * Experience working with Data orchestration tools Kafka, FiveTran, dbt, and others. * Experience with data modeling, data governance, data quality, and metadata management. * Experience supporting a government contractor or federal government organization. * Experience working with CUI, NIST SP 800\-171, CMMC, FedRAMP, or other government cybersecurity requirements. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, SQL Server, Power BI, Databricks, or similar technologies. * Experience supporting enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, or Lakehouse architecture. * Experience with APIs, integration platforms, and modern data architectures. * Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation initiatives. * Experience establishing or maturing an enterprise data governance program. **Other required Skills and Competencies** **Team Leadership** * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data professionals. * Establish team priorities, objectives, performance expectations, and professional development plans. * Assign work based on organizational priorities, technical capabilities, and project requirements. * Establish standards for documentation, development, testing, deployment, and operational support. * Promote collaboration between the data team and other IT and business functions. * Balance strategic responsibilities with hands\-on technical execution. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. **Other Required Skills and Competencies** * **Technical Leadership \-** Ability to establish a practical data technology strategy while remaining jobs.description: ***\*We are looking for a candidate who is already located in either Boston/New England or the San Francisco Bay Area\**** **About Us**: Zeitview is the leading intelligent aerial imaging company for high\-value infrastructure, providing businesses with actionable, real\-time insights to recover revenue, reduce risk and improve build quality. Trusted by the largest enterprises in the world, Zeitview is active in over 70 countries. Our mission is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure through advanced inspection solutions. Take a look at our latest achievements here! **This role in one paragraph**: Be the voice of the customer for an entire industry at Zeitview. You will be Zeitview's resident expert for our Oil \& Gas vertical. You own problem definition: understanding what enterprise customers in your vertical actually need, why they need it, and what it's worth. You run discovery, build client relationships alongside sales, synthesize market signals, and translate all of that into clear, prioritized requirements that our platform product managers and engineering teams can execute against. You are responsible for competitive intel and defining metrics to demonstrate the success of the product and strategies. You should be growth focused. You do not own the product backlog or ship software directly, you own the "what" and "why," then work with solutions\-side PMs to negotiate the "how" and "when." **What you'll actually do in the first 6 months**: * Define what "success" looks like for the Oil \& Gas vertical in terms that connect to revenue, retention, and customer outcomes, not just feature delivery * Embed with 3–5 strategic accounts within our Oil \& Gas portfolio. You will not own a product backlog, write technical specs, or ship software with engineers day\-to\-day. If that's what you're looking for, see our Senior Product Manager \- Asset Insights posting. * A pure strategy role, with no customer contact. You will be on calls with enterprise clients regularly. You can present to a customer's VP of Asset Management on Monday and translate that conversation into a product brief for solutions PMs and Engineering on Tuesday * Willingness to travel to customer sites and inspection locations **Strongly preferred: These will move you to the top**: * Experience working with operational or service delivery teams (field inspection, drone operations, or similar) * Experience with geospatial data, remote sensing, or asset management platforms * Familiarity with AI/ML\-powered products, enough to assess where these capabilities address real vertical problems vs. where they're a distraction * Experience with go\-to\-market strategy: product launches, positioning, pricing, or vertical\-specific marketing * Experience in mobile application development **What’s Included**: * Feel great about your work as you join a leading mission\-driven intelligent aerial imaging company \- our goal is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure, and you personally will play a large part in making this happen! * Competitive base salary, annual bonus and stock options * Your choice of multiple medical insurance plans, including options with an HSA and 100% coverage of the premium for yourself and your dependents * Unlimited PTO: We mean it when we say we prioritize work\-life balance and mental health * Autonomy and upward mobility * Diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture: a place where your voice matters *This role has a base salary range of $160,000 \- $180,000 USD, plus a target annual bonus and eligibility for stock options. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location within USA.* *Zeitview is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Encouraging identity and belonging is one of the many aspects of our culture that makes us stronger as an organization and drives innovation. We are constantly striving to be better, and we continue to take strategic steps to advance representation.* *We also provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and for seriously held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - Big Data
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ The Big Data Engineering team builds the scalable data platforms, pipelines, and infrastructure that power analytics, machine learning, and AI\-driven experiences across Zillow. Our newest effort is a shared AI context and agent platform. Working at the intersection of software engineering and data, this team creates reliable, high\-quality data products that help teams make informed decisions and deliver great customer experiences. We value collaboration, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement, and we're excited by the opportunity to solve complex data challenges at scale. **About the role** ------------------ The Senior Software Development Engineer, Big Data designs, builds, and optimizes scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that power analytics and AI\-driven capabilities across Zillow. This role applies advanced software engineering and big data expertise to create reliable, high\-quality data products that enable teams to deliver innovative customer experiences and data\-informed decisions. jobs.title: Director of Security
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** Finalsite is the most valued partner for K–12 schools to build trust, strengthen community, and grow enrollment. Ranked among the best EdTech Companies in America, Finalsite supports more than 7,000 schools and districts worldwide with an integrated platform for websites, communications, mobile apps, enrollment, and marketing services. Headquartered in Glastonbury, Connecticut, Finalsite is a global company with employees working remotely across nearly every U.S. state, as well as throughout Europe, South America, and Asia. We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, connected, and empowered to grow. That’s why we invest in our employees through competitive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative culture built on partnership and purpose. Whether you’re looking to expand your skills, take on new challenges, or make a meaningful impact in education, Finalsite offers the opportunity to grow your career while helping schools thrive. At Finalsite, every interaction matters — with our clients, with each other, and with the schools and families we serve. Join us and help shape stronger school communities around the world ##### **SUMMARY** You will lead the team responsible for it. This is a hands\-on leadership role at a company that is formalizing its security program. You will set direction for the team, lead us toward SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, lead the response when something goes wrong, and build the practices that let engineering teams ship securely without waiting in a queue for permission. The environment is broad. Finalsite is an established software estate spanning several products and several generations of technology, hosted across more than one cloud provider, and built by distributed teams in multiple countries. The products are increasingly meant to work together as one platform, which means the security program has to span products as well. Your work will cover compliance, customer trust, vendor risk, application security, cloud and infrastructure, and identity and access. We want SOC 2 Type 2 attestation to describe how our engineering teams actually work. Type 2 looks at whether controls operated consistently over an observation period, so they have to hold up in everyday practice and not only exist on paper. That means controls built into the design review, deployment, access, and incident practices teams already follow, with evidence produced as a byproduct of that work instead of assembled before an audit. The attestation matters to our customers, and the program behind it matters more. You will report to the Senior Director of SRE and Security, in the same organization as the SRE team you will work with every day. Finalsite also has a part\-time CISO, who approves security policy, makes formal risk acceptance decisions, and is accountable for the program to auditors and customers. You will run the program that the CISO oversees. That includes the team, the roadmap, the security documentation and assessments customers see, and the decisions you bring to the CISO. You do not need K\-12 experience or familiarity with our stack. We are looking for a security leader who can earn engineers' trust, who is comfortable being accountable when an incident happens, who can explain risk plainly to executives and to customers, and who works well with a CISO who holds the final call on policy and risk. ##### **LOCATION** 100% Remote \- Anywhere within the US ##### **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Lead the security team: set its priorities, hire, develop, and manage its engineers and analysts, including performance reviews, promotions, and compensation recommendations * Build and run the security roadmap, agreeing priorities with the CISO, ranking work by risk to schools and to the business, and making those tradeoffs visible in planning next to product and engineering work * Lead execution of SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, including defining scope, assessing current controls, planning and driving remediation, running the observation period with continuous evidence collection, and giving the CISO and the auditors what they need * Own and manage Vanta, our security and compliance platform, so that the Customer Trust Portal and external\-facing security documentation stay current and accurately reflect Finalsite's security posture for customers and auditors * Lead the review and completion of customer security questionnaires and external assessments, partnering with sales and customer success to describe Finalsite's security practices clearly and accurately * Establish and run security evaluations of new third\-party vendors, with particular attention to vendors that process school and customer data, and bring the risks they carry to the CISO's attention * Build controls into the way engineering teams already work, and keep an accurate picture of where each control applies today and how that coverage will expand * Draft and maintain security policies and standard cluding AI\-enabled features, before they reach schools * Train engineers and the wider company on security practices, and help build a culture where people report mistakes and near misses early * Report on security risk and progress to leadership in plain terms, including when the news is bad * Manage the security budget, and make tooling and build, buy, or partner recommendations ##### **QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** * Eight or more years in information security, including three or more leading a security team * Hands\-on technical credibility across application security and cloud infrastructure, enough to evaluate a design or an architecture yourself * Direct experience taking an organization through a SOC 2 Type 2 audit, or a comparable attestation such as ISO 27001 * Experience leading customer security reviews and third\-party vendor risk assessments at a software company * Experience leading response to real security incidents, including coordinating engineers, executives, and customers at the same time * Experience partnering with a CISO or another executive who owns security risk decisions, including preparing those decisions well * Experience working with engineering teams as a partner, so that security requirements get adopted * Clear, honest communication about risk with technical and non\-technical audiences * Experience hiring and developing security professionals * Comfort working with colleagues across several countries and time zones ##### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * **R**unning a compliance automation platform such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe, including a customer\-facing trust center * Leading a company through its first SOC 2 Type 2 attestation * Security leadership at a SaaS company with multiple products or a history of acquisitions * Established systems spanning multiple generations of technology, where security improvements have to land alongside ongoing delivery * PCI DSS experience for software that handles payments * Student or children's data privacy, including FERPA, COPPA, and state student privacy laws, or other heavily regulated data * Securing software across more than one cloud provider * Identity and access security, including large single sign\-on and multi\-factor authentication rollouts * Building a security program with a small team and growing it deliberately * Assessing the security and privacy risks of AI\-enabled products, and using AI\-assisted tools in security work * Experience with K\-12 or other public\-sector customers and their procurement and security review processes ##### **RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT** Finalsite offers 100% fully remote employment opportunities, however, these opportunities are limited to permanent residents of the United States. Current residency, as well as continued residency, within the United States is required to obtain (and retain) employment with Finalsite. ##### **DISCLOSURES** Finalsite is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact Finalsite's People Operations Team. Finalsite is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Finalsite will ensure that persons with disabilities or special needs are provided a reasonable accommodation. Ensure your Finalsite job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of verbal communication and ensure all email correspondence is from a finalsite.com email address. For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at finalsite.com/jobs.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Python/Typescript
jobs.description: ### **About Turing** Turing is one of the world’s leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high\-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.### **About the Role** We’re looking for experienced, hands\-on software engineers to help **evaluate and improve AI coding models**. Rather than primarily building production applications, you’ll work with coding agents across real\-world repositories and assess the quality of their work. You’ll review generated code and agent behavior, determine whether solutions are technically correct, identify failure modes, and create the evaluation signals and feedback used to improve model performance. **Think of the coding agent as another engineer whose work you’re reviewing:** Can it understand the task? Did it choose the right approach? Is the resulting code correct, robust, and maintainable? Can you explain precisely where it succeeded or failed?### **What You’ll Do** * Evaluate AI\-generated code and solutions across real\-world software repositories * Review agent behavior, tool usage, and code changes for correctness and quality * Identify technical errors, weak approaches, and recurring model failure modes * Compare model outputs and explain why one solution is better than another * Create and refine rubrics and evaluation criteria for coding tasks * Produce high\-quality evaluation and preference data used to improve coding models * Build and maintain pipelines and infrastructure supporting data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows * Synthesize findings from data work into clear write\-ups, updates, and recommendations for the team * Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes * Share clear, actionable findings with AI researchers and engineers ### **What We’re Looking For** * **5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience** * Strong proficiency in **Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or another major production language** * Experience working in substantial real\-world codebases * Strong code\-review skills and technical judgment * Ability to clearly explain why an implementation is correct, incorrect, or could be improved * Strong written communication * Experience using modern LLMs or AI coding tools Experience with **LLM evaluation, coding agents, RLHF, preference data, rubric design, or post\-training** is a plus, but not required.### **Engagement Details** * **Compensation:** Market rate; please provide a specific hourly rate expectation * **Availability:** 40 hours/week preferred, with at least 6 hours of Pacific Time overlap * **Type:** Independent contractor * **Duration:** Approximately 3 months * **Start:** As soon as possible ### **Evaluation Process** * AI interview (\~25 minutes) * Practical code/AI evaluation exercise (\~30 minutes) * Hiring manager interview (\~20 minutes) The practical exercise focuses on your ability to **review and evaluate AI\-generated code**, not competitive programming or algorithm puzzles.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineering Manager (EN.FMFM)
jobs.description: 地點: Austin, US 日期: 2026年10月16日 部門: 職缺ID: 2422 出差: 否 工作年資要求: 7年以上 外派要求: 否 * Lead firmware engineers and responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of embedded firmware and software for Super I/O (SIO) and Embedded Controller (EC) chip products used in enterprise\-class PC platforms, including desktops, workstations, notebooks, and all\-in\-one systems. * Oversee and contribute hands\-on to the firmware architecture and software design for multiple generations of SIO and EC products, including boot flow, low\-level drivers, system services, and firmware frameworks. * Lead the definition and implementation of complex firmware features such as thermal monitoring, fan control, power management, and hardware\-software interaction mechanisms, including algorithms that combine firmware logic with silicon capabilities. * Act as the primary technical authority for SIO and EC firmware, performing design reviews, code reviews, and architectural assessments to ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability. * Develop firmware primarily in C, with direct involvement in bare\-metal and RTOS\-based environments, and support integration with system BIOS and platform firmware. * Collaborate closely with hardware teams, validation teams, and global customers to define requirements, analyze technical constraints, and develop customer\-specific firmware features and solutions. * Serve as a key interface with strategic customers to troubleshoot complex firmware and silicon\-related issues, analyze root causes, and deliver corrective actions. * Design and implement security\-related firmware functionality, including cryptographic mechanisms, secure boot flows, and device identity features for products used as part of platform security and Root of Trust solutions. Support proof\-of\-concept activities for new technologies and future product directions. * Debug complex firmware, hardware, and system\-level issues using hardware and software debugging tools, and guide engineering teams in the resolution of critical customer escalations. * Provide technical mentorship and guidance to firmware engineers to support consistent implementation practices and successful project execution.
